main.pt: 零税额法定强制申报情形
main.trap: 没欠税即免报陷阱
main.stem: During the 2026 taxation year, Liam disposed of mutual fund units held in a non-registered account, realizing a taxable capital gain. After applying his allowable deductions and non-refundable tax credits, Liam's calculated net federal and provincial tax payable is $0. He did not receive a formal demand to file from the CRA. Is Liam legally required to file a 2026 T1 personal tax return?
main.zh: 在 2026 纳税年度中，Liam 处置了非注册账户中的互惠基金份额，实现了应税资本利得。在扣除各项法定抵扣额与非退还税收抵免后，Liam 计算出的联邦与省净应纳税额为 $0。他未收到 CRA 发出的催报通知。根据加拿大税法，Liam 是否负有提交 2026 年 T1 个人申报表的法定申报义务？

opts.t: No, because Canada's self-assessment system only mandates filing when an individual has an unpaid tax balance owing.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的「没欠税即免报陷阱」；所得税法规定即使最终应纳税额为零，只要触发特定法定情形（如处置资本财产）就必须申报。

opts.t: Yes, because disposing of capital property or realizing a taxable capital gain triggers a mandatory filing requirement regardless of tax payable.
opts.w: 正确。根据《所得税法》(Income Tax Act, ITA)，个人若处置了资本财产 (capital property) 或实现了应税资本利得 (taxable capital gain)，即使净应纳税额 (tax payable) 为零，也属于必须强制申报的法定情形之一。

opts.t: No, because mandatory reporting applies only when gross capital proceeds exceed the $3,500 basic exemption threshold.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了概念；$3,500 是加拿大退休金计划 (Canada Pension Plan, CPP) 的基本免供额，与资本财产处置申报无关。

opts.t: Yes, but he is only required to submit an information schedule directly to his provincial tax authority rather than a federal T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。除魁北克外，各省个人所得税与资本利得申报均通过联邦 T1 申报表由 CRA 统一征管，无需且不存在单独向省里提交信息表。

main.pt: 2026最低税阶税率
main.trap: 过渡期税率混淆
main.stem: For the 2026 taxation year, what is the federal income tax rate applicable to an individual's taxable income in the lowest tax bracket (taxable income up to $58,523)?
main.zh: 对于 2026 纳税年度，个人在最低联邦税阶内（应税收入在 $58,523 及以下）适用的法定联邦所得税税率是多少？

opts.w: 错误。15% 是 2024 税年（旧培训材料口径）的最低税阶税率，2026 税年已降到 14%。
错误。14.5% 是 2025 税年中因下半年降税生效而适用的全年折算混合税率 (blended rate)，仅在 2025 单一过渡年适用。
正确。2026 税年联邦最低税阶 (lowest federal tax bracket) 两年降税落地，全年适用 14%（该档上限 58,523 元）。
错误。20.5% 是联邦第二档（58,523 元以上至 117,045 元）的边际税率，不是最低税阶。

main.pt: 自雇申报与付款双轨截止日
main.trap: 自雇延期双日混淆陷阱
main.stem: Marcus operates an unincorporated web design business. For the 2026 taxation year, his return reflects a balance owing of $5,000. Marcus files his T1 return on June 10, 2027, and pays the $5,000 balance in full on the same date. What are the legal consequences regarding penalties and interest?
main.zh: Marcus 经营一家未注册成公司的网页设计生意（自雇）。2026 纳税年度，其税表显示应补税款余额为 $5,000。Marcus 于 2027 年 6 月 10 日提交了 T1 申报表，并在同日全额缴清了这笔 $5,000 欠税。关于罚款与利息，法律后果是什么？

opts.t: No late-filing penalty is assessed, but prescribed interest is charged on the $5,000 balance owing from May 1, 2027, to June 10, 2027.
opts.w: 正确。自雇人士的申报截止日 (filing due date) 延至 6 月 15 日，因此 6 月 10 日申报不产生迟报罚款 (late-filing penalty)；但税款结清截止日 (balance owing due date) 仍为 4 月 30 日，因此逾期税款自 5 月 1 日起计收规定利息 (prescribed interest)。

opts.t: A 5% late-filing penalty is assessed because the filing extension to June 15 is voided if the tax balance is not paid by April 30.
opts.w: 错误。申报延期是法定的独立权利，并不以在 4 月 30 日前缴清税款为前提条件，不会因此产生迟报罚款。

opts.t: Neither penalties nor interest apply because both filing and payment deadlines are extended to June 15 for business operators.
opts.w: 错误。落入「自雇延期双日混淆陷阱」；延期只针对提交申报表免除罚款，绝不免除 4 月 30 日后的欠税利息。

opts.t: Prescribed interest and a 17% maximum penalty are charged retroactively from January 1, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。罚款不存在，利息也是从付款截止日次日（5 月 1 日）起算，绝不可能追溯至 1 月 1 日。

main.pt: 迟报罚款计算基数与费率
main.trap: 迟报罚款全额基数陷阱
main.stem: David had an assessed total tax payable of $16,000 for the 2026 tax year. His employer withheld $12,000 at source, leaving an unpaid balance owing of $4,000. David filed his return on July 10, 2027 (two complete months late) without paying the balance. He had no late-filing penalties for the prior three taxation years and received no CRA demand. What is David's late-filing penalty?
main.zh: David 在 2026 纳税年度核定的应纳税总额为 $16,000。其雇主在源头预扣了 $12,000，尚余未缴税款余额 $4,000。David 于 2027 年 7 月 10 日提交了申报表（逾期整两个月），且未缴税。他在前三个税年中无迟报罚款记录，也未收到 CRA 催报令。David 应缴纳的迟报罚款是多少？

opts.t: $1,120: 7% of the $16,000 total tax payable for the year
opts.w: 错误。落入「迟报罚款全额基数陷阱」：基数是截止日未缴的 $4,000，不是全年应纳税总额；$16,000 × 7% = $1,120 用错了基数。

opts.t: $200: 5% of the $4,000 unpaid balance, with no monthly add-on
opts.w: 错误。漏了每逾期一个整月加 1%：$4,000 × 5% = $200 只算了起步的 5%，逾期两个整月还要加 2%。

opts.t: $680: the 17% first-time cap applied to the $4,000 unpaid balance
opts.w: 错误。17% 是首次迟报逾期满 12 个月的封顶，逾期两个月不能直接套：$4,000 × 17% = $680。

opts.t: $280: 5% plus 1% per complete month, on the $4,000 unpaid balance
opts.w: 正确。首次迟报罚款＝截止日未缴税款的 5%，每逾期一个整月加 1%（两个整月加 2%），合计 7%：$4,000 × 5% = $200，$4,000 × 2% = $80，合计 $280。

main.pt: T1六步申报流程与省税位置
main.trap: 旧版七步流程残留陷阱
main.stem: In the current structure of the Canadian T1 Income Tax and Benefit Return, at which step is provincial or territorial tax (such as BC tax calculated on Form 428) formally integrated into the calculation?
main.zh: 在加拿大现行 T1 所得税与福利申报表结构中，省或属地税（例如在 Form 428 上计算出的 BC 省税）是在哪一步骤正式纳入汇总计算的？

opts.t: Step 6 (Refund or balance owing), added to net federal tax before amounts already paid are subtracted.
opts.w: 正确。自 2021 税年起，申报表取消了独立的省税步骤，改为在 Step 6（退税或欠税 Refund or balance owing）中将 Form 428 算出的省/属地税与联邦净税额相加，再减去已扣缴税款及退还性抵免。

opts.t: Step 5 (Federal tax), where provincial credits are blended directly with the federal non-refundable credits.
opts.w: 错误。Step 5 仅计算联邦税与联邦非退还税收抵免，省税计算不在此步骤混合。

opts.t: Step 3 (Net income), where it is claimed as a deduction from total income before taxable income is set.
opts.w: 错误。省税是税额而非收入扣除项 (deduction)，绝不在 Step 3 扣除。

opts.t: On a standalone provincial return, as CRA returns do not process provincial tax calculations.
opts.w: 错误。除魁北克外，CRA 为所有省份统一征收个税，省税直接整合在 T1 主表中由 CRA 结算。

main.pt: 个人异议通知法定申请期限
main.trap: 个人异议期限一律 90 天陷阱
main.stem: Nathan, an employed individual, filed his 2026 T1 personal return on March 10, 2027. The CRA assessed his return and issued a Notice of Assessment (NOA) dated March 25, 2027, disallowing an eligible deduction. What is the latest date by which Nathan can file a valid Notice of Objection?
main.zh: 受雇雇员 Nathan 于 2027 年 3 月 10 日提交了 2026 年 T1 个人申报表。CRA 进行了评税并于 2027 年 3 月 25 日签发了评税通知（NOA），调减了他申报的一项合格扣除。Nathan 提交有效异议通知（Notice of Objection）的最迟法定截止日期是哪一天？

opts.t: June 23, 2027, which is 90 days following the date of the Notice of Assessment.
opts.w: 错误。落入「个人异议期限一律 90 天陷阱」；90 天规则适用于公司，对个人纳税人而言如果申报截止日后一年更晚，则适用较晚者。

opts.t: April 30, 2028, which is the later of one year after the filing due date and 90 days after the NOA date.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA 规定，个人纳税人异议期限为「申报截止日后一年（2028 年 4 月 30 日）」与「评税通知寄出后 90 天（2027 年 6 月 23 日）」两者中较晚的一个 (the later of)，因此截止日为 2028 年 4 月 30 日。

opts.t: March 10, 2028, which is exactly one year following his actual filing date.
opts.w: 错误。法定起算点是法定的「申报截止日（filing due date，4 月 30 日）」后一年，而非纳税人的实际提前提交日。

opts.t: September 25, 2027, which is six months following the issuance of the Notice of Assessment.
opts.w: 错误。税法中并无评税通知签发后 6 个月提出异议的法定标准期。

main.pt: BC省税统一征管与申报机制
main.trap: 省税独立申报误解
main.stem: Rachel is an employed resident of British Columbia. How does she fulfill her provincial personal income tax compliance obligations for the 2026 taxation year?
main.zh: Rachel 是一名居住在卑诗省（BC）的受雇雇员。对于 2026 纳税年度，她应当如何履行其省级个人所得税的申报合规义务？

opts.t: She must file an electronic T1 return with the CRA by April 30 and mail a separate provincial return to the BC Ministry of Finance by June 15.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省并不设立独立的省税申报表，也无需向省财政厅单独申报。

opts.t: She files a federal return with the CRA and is exempt from BC provincial tax calculations if her income is under $100,000.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省所得税按累进税制普遍征收，并无 $100,000 的免税门槛。

opts.t: She files a single combined T1 return with the CRA, calculating BC tax on Form 428, which is collected jointly by the CRA.
opts.w: 正确。除魁北克外，所有省份的个人所得税均由 CRA 统一征收；BC 居民只需向 CRA 提交一份申报表，通过 Form 428 计算省税并计入主表 Step 6 结算。

opts.t: She reports BC provincial tax exclusively through her municipal property tax declaration.
opts.w: 错误。所得税属于省与联邦税权，与市政物业税 (property tax) 是完全独立的税种与申报体系。

main.pt: 普通法同居判定与短暂分离
main.trap: 分开即计时归零陷阱
main.stem: Liam and Sophia began living together in a conjugal relationship on March 1, 2025. In October 2025, due to a relationship dispute, Sophia moved out for 45 days, after which they reconciled and resumed living together. As of March 15, 2026, they had no children. When filing his 2026 personal income tax return, how should Liam determine his marital status as of December 31, 2026?
main.zh: Liam 与 Sophia 于 2025 年 3 月 1 日开始保持同居伴侣关系。2025 年 10 月，因感情争执，Sophia 搬出居住了 45 天，之后两人复合并继续同居。截至 2026 年 3 月 15 日，两人未育有子女。在申报 2026 纳税年度个人所得税时，Liam 在确定其截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日的法定婚姻状况时应如何认定？

opts.t: He must file as Single, because any separation during the qualification period resets the 12-month cohabitation clock back to zero.
opts.w: 错误。落入「分开即计时归零陷阱」；根据税法，同居期间因感情破裂分开只要不满 90 天，仍算作连续同居，不会导致计时器归零。

opts.t: Living common-law, because the 45-day break was under 90 days and did not interrupt the 12-month count.
opts.w: 正确。普通法同居（Living common-law）要求连续同居满 12 个月；税法明确规定，这 12 个月内因感情破裂分开但不满 90 天又复合的，该间断期仍计入连续同居时间。他们在 2026 年 3 月即满 12 个月，截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日应确认为普通法同居。

opts.t: He must file as Separated, because a relationship breakdown occurred within the 12-month qualification period.
opts.w: 错误。分居（Separated）要求因感情破裂分开居住满 90 天，且两人已复合，年底处于共同居住状态，不能填分居。

opts.t: He must file as Single, because federal tax law requires at least 24 consecutive months of cohabitation before common-law status is recognized.
opts.w: 错误。联邦《所得税法》规定的普通法伴侣同居基础门槛是 12 个月，而非 24 个月。

main.pt: 分居成立条件与追溯生效日
main.trap: 分居生效日第90天陷阱
main.stem: Marcus and Elena, who are legally married, experienced a breakdown in their marriage and began living separate and apart on November 15, 2026. They continued to live apart continuously, reaching 90 days of separation on February 13, 2027. When Marcus files his 2026 T1 personal tax return in April 2027, what was his marital status as of December 31, 2026, and what was the effective date of that status?
main.zh: Marcus 与 Elena 为法定夫妻。因感情破裂，两人于 2026 年 11 月 15 日开始分开居住。两人持续分居，至 2027 年 2 月 13 日分居满 90 天。当 Marcus 于 2027 年 4 月提交其 2026 年 T1 个人税表时，其截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日的法定婚姻状况是什么，且该状况的生效日期是哪一天？

opts.t: Married, because the mandatory 90-day separation period had not yet elapsed by December 31, 2026.
opts.w: 错误。虽然 12 月 31 日时未满 90 天，但在 2027 年 4 月申报时 90 天已届满，分居成立后其生效日追溯至开始分开住的那一天（2026 年 11 月 15 日），因此 12 月 31 日当天的状态已被追溯确认为分居。

opts.t: Separated, with an effective legal date of February 13, 2027, when the 90-day threshold was officially reached.
opts.w: 错误。落入「分居生效日第90天陷阱」；分居生效日不是第 90 天那一天，而是开始分开居住的第一天。

opts.t: Separated, effective November 15, 2026, since once 90 days pass the status dates back to the first day apart.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA 规则，分居（Separated）必须因感情破裂分开住满 90 天才成立，但一旦满 90 天，其生效日期不是第 90 天，而是回溯到开始分开住的那一天（2026 年 11 月 15 日）。到 2027 年 4 月报税时，90 天条件已满足，故 2026 年 12 月 31 日应填报为分居。

opts.t: Divorced, because living apart for more than 90 days automatically dissolves the legal marriage for federal tax purposes.
opts.w: 错误。分居满 90 天不等于离婚（Divorced），离婚必须具有法定的法院离婚判决文件。

main.pt: 配偶净收入与自雇延期
main.trap: 配偶零收入不报陷阱
main.stem: Julian was legally married to Claire as of December 31, 2026. Claire had no earnings or taxable income during 2026 and did not file a tax return. However, Claire operated a small unincorporated consulting business as a sole proprietor in 2026 (generating $0 net profit). Which of the following statements is correct regarding Julian's 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: 截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，Julian 与 Claire 为合法夫妻。Claire 在 2026 年没有工作收入或应税收入，亦未提交税表；但 Claire 在 2026 年以独资经营者身份经营一家未注册成公司的咨询生意（净利润为 $0）。关于 Julian 的 2026 年 T1 申报表，下列哪项表述是正确的？

opts.t: Julian must enter Claire's name, SIN, and net income as $0 on line 23600, and Julian's filing due date is extended to June 15, 2027, because his spouse was self-employed.
opts.w: 正确。只要 12 月 31 日有配偶，对方净收入（第 23600 行）即使为零也必须填写；配偶当年自雇（经营生意），纳税人本人的申报截止日也顺延至次年 6 月 15 日——净利润为零不改变她当年经营生意的事实。

opts.t: Julian may omit Claire's net income on line 23600 because Claire had zero income and did not file a return, and his deadline remains April 30, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。落入「配偶零收入不报陷阱」；配偶净收入是计算配偶额抵免和各项家庭福利的必要参数，零收入也必须填报；且自雇配偶使本人申报期延至 6 月 15 日。

opts.t: Julian must report Claire's details, but his filing deadline remains April 30, 2027, because the deadline extension applies solely to the self-employed individual.
opts.w: 错误。税法明确规定申报截止日跟着配偶自雇身份走，夫妻双方的申报期均同步顺延至 6 月 15 日。

opts.t: Julian must file Claire's return together with his own as a single joint consolidated return by April 30, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大实行个人单独申报制，不存在夫妻合并编制的单一联合税表（joint return）。

main.pt: 12月31日居住省判定
main.trap: 居住省全年最长居住地陷阱
main.stem: Rachel resided in Calgary, Alberta from January 1, 2026, until December 20, 2026. On December 21, 2026, she permanently relocated to Vancouver, British Columbia, established her primary residence there, and resided in BC on December 31, 2026. How should Rachel determine her provincial tax liability on her 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: Rachel 于 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 12 月 20 日期间一直居住在阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里。2026 年 12 月 21 日，她永久搬迁至不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华并建立主要居所，且于 2026 年 12 月 31 日当天居住在 BC 省。Rachel 在申报 2026 年 T1 税表时应如何确定其省税？

opts.t: She must file using Alberta Form 428 because she resided in Alberta for more than 11 months of the tax year.
opts.w: 错误。落入「居住省全年最长居住地陷阱」；居住省不按全年住得最久的省份判断，只看 12 月 31 日当天。

opts.t: She must apportion her 2026 taxable income between Alberta and BC based on the exact number of days lived in each province.
opts.w: 错误。税法以 12 月 31 日这一单一时间点拟制省税归属，不进行按天数分摊。

opts.t: She must file two separate provincial returns, one with Alberta Treasury Board and Finance and one with the CRA for BC.
opts.w: 错误。除魁省外各省税均由 CRA 通过联邦 T1 申报表统一处理，不存在向阿尔伯塔单独报税。

opts.t: She must report British Columbia as her province of residence on December 31 and calculate her entire 2026 provincial tax using BC Form 428.
opts.w: 正确。居住省判断以 12 月 31 日当天纳税人实际居住或被视为事实居民（factual resident）的省份为准；Rachel 在 12 月 31 日居住在 BC，全年的省税均按 BC 表格（Form 428）计算，即使大部分时间住在阿尔伯塔。

main.pt: T1135成本门槛判定
main.trap: T1135市值与夫妻合并陷阱
main.stem: Throughout 2026, Nathan held the following offshore assets: a foreign bank deposit with a cost amount of $35,000 (fair market value $35,000), shares in a foreign corporation with an adjusted cost base of $75,000 (fair market value $130,000), and a personal vacation home in Mexico used exclusively for family holidays with a cost amount of $250,000. Is Nathan required to check 'Yes' on his 2026 T1 return and file Form T1135?
main.zh: 在 2026 年全年，Nathan 名下持有以下境外资产：原始成本为 $35,000（公允市值 $35,000）的海外银行存款、调整后成本基础为 $75,000（公允市值 $130,000）的境外公司股票，以及一套专门用于家庭度假且不产生租金的墨西哥度假屋（成本额 $250,000）。Nathan 是否需要在 2026 年 T1 税表上勾选「是」并提交 Form T1135？

opts.t: No, because each individual specified foreign property is below the $100,000 threshold and the personal vacation home is exempt.
opts.w: 错误。门槛按个人名下各项特定海外财产的成本额合计判断（$35,000 + $75,000 = $110,000），不是逐项判断。

opts.t: Yes, because his deposit and shares total $110,000 in cost, and the vacation home is excluded.
opts.w: 正确。特定海外财产 (specified foreign property) 总成本额超过 100,000 元即须申报；仅供度假的自用物业依法排除；存款与股票成本额合计 $110,000，超过门槛，必须勾选「是」并提交 Form T1135。

opts.t: Yes, solely because the personal vacation home cost exceeds $100,000, while the bank deposits and shares are exempt.
opts.w: 错误。度假屋属于个人自用财产（personal-use property），依法不属于特定海外财产；反而是存款与股票属于受控申报财产。

opts.t: No, because Form T1135 filing is determined strictly by fair market value exceeding $250,000 rather than historical cost.
opts.w: 错误。落入「成本额误当市值」陷阱；T1135 申报门槛是成本额（cost amount/ACB）而非公允市场价值（FMV），且基础门槛是 100,000 元 而非 250,000 元。

main.pt: T1135违规复评期延长
main.trap: 正常复评期固定不变陷阱
main.stem: An individual taxpayer owned specified foreign property with a total cost amount of $180,000 throughout 2026 and earned $6,000 in foreign dividend income, which was omitted from the 2026 T1 return. In addition, the taxpayer failed to check the foreign property box and did not submit Form T1135 by the deadline. If the CRA issued the original Notice of Assessment on May 20, 2027, how does this failure affect the CRA's reassessment period for the 2026 tax year?
main.zh: 某个人纳税人在 2026 年全年持有总成本额为 $180,000 的特定海外财产，并取得 $6,000 境外股息收入，但该笔收入未在 2026 年 T1 税表上申报。此外，该纳税人未勾选海外财产框，且未在截止日前提交 Form T1135。若 CRA 于 2027 年 5 月 20 日寄发了原始评税通知（NOA），该违规行为对 CRA 针对 2026 税年的复评期限有何影响？

opts.t: The normal three-year reassessment period is extended by an additional 3 years, allowing the CRA to reassess the return within 6 years of the original assessment date.
opts.w: 正确。当年未申报指定海外财产收入，且 Form T1135 未按时提交或包含虚假陈述/遗漏时，CRA 对该税年的正常复评期（normal reassessment period，通常为 NOA 寄出后 3 年）再延长 3 年（extended reassessment period，共 6 年）。

opts.t: The CRA's reassessment period is unchanged at 3 years, but an automatic non-waivable 50% gross negligence penalty is applied to total taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。根据《所得税法》特别规定，未报海外收入且未按时合规提交 T1135 时，复评期明确延长 3 年，并非保持 3 年不变。

opts.t: The reassessment period is extended permanently with no statutory limitation period regardless of whether the omission was fraudulent.
opts.w: 错误。永久无限期复评通常要求纳税人存在欺诈（fraud）或故意疏忽，单纯未报且遗漏 T1135 触发的是法定延长 3 年的特定规则。

opts.t: The CRA loses the right to reassess the return once the standard 1-year objection deadline expires following the initial assessment.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了纳税人的异议期限与税局的审计复评权限；异议期限是纳税人维权的截止日，不限制税局的复评期。

main.pt: 印第安人法免税与福利前置
main.trap: 免税即免报误区
main.stem: Tarrant is a registered Status Indian who worked on a reserve during 2026. All of his employment income is fully exempt from tax under Section 87 of the Indian Act. Tarrant has two dependent children under age 6 and earned no other income. Why is Tarrant strongly advised to file a 2026 T1 return along with Form T90?
main.zh: Tarrant 是一名已登记的身份印第安人，2026 年在保留地上的雇主处工作，其全部就业收入根据《印第安人法》第 87 条完全免税。Tarrant 抚养两名未满 6 岁的子女，且无其他收入。为什么强烈建议 Tarrant 连同 Form T90 一同提交 2026 年 T1 申报表？

opts.t: Filing is mandatory because Section 87 exemptions automatically expire if a return is not submitted annually.
opts.w: 错误。《印第安人法》第 87 条赋予的法定免税待遇不会因未申报个人所得税而失效。

opts.t: Filing is required to convert his tax-exempt employment earnings into RRSP contribution room for future deductions.
opts.w: 错误。根据第 87 条免税的就业收入不产生 RRSP 供款额度（RRSP contribution room）。

opts.t: Filing is needed to qualify for and calculate income-tested benefits such as the CCB and CGEB, which require a filed return.
opts.w: 正确。讲义案例三与清单第6条明确指出：CCB、CGEB 等几乎所有现金福利的前提都是「已提交申报表」，免税不等于不用报；必须通过 Form T90 计算免税净收入并报税，才能使 CRA 获得核发福利的输入数据。

opts.t: Filing allows the CRA to allocate a portion of his exempt earnings to provincial income tax under the First Nations personal income tax agreement.
opts.w: 错误。原住民税收协议结算土地勾选仅适用于西北地区、育空和纽芬兰特定居民，与通过 T90 申报保留地免税收入无直接关联。

main.pt: Box 14 与 Box 40 关系
main.trap: Box 40 重复相加陷阱
main.stem: Sarah received a 2026 T4 slip from her employer showing $65,000 in Box 14 (Employment income) and $3,200 in Box 40 (Other taxable allowances and benefits). What amount should Sarah enter on Line 10100 of her 2026 T1 personal income tax return?
main.zh: Sarah 收到雇主寄来的 2026 年 T4 报表，其中 Box 14（雇佣收入）显示为 $65,000，Box 40（其他应税补贴与福利）显示为 $3,200。Sarah 在其 2026 年 T1 个人所得税申报表的第 10100 行应填报多少金额？

opts.t: $65,000, because the $3,200 reported in Box 40 is already included in Box 14.
opts.w: 正确。根据税法与 T4 报表设计规则，Box 40（其他应税补贴与福利，other taxable allowances and benefits）是一个备忘栏，其金额本来就已经被计算包含在 Box 14（雇佣收入，employment income）的总数中；Line 10100 直接填报 Box 14 的 $65,000，不能重复相加。

opts.t: $68,200, because Box 40 represents additional taxable benefits that must be added to gross salary.
opts.w: 错误。落入「Box 40 重复相加陷阱」；误以为 Box 40 是额外收入，将其与 Box 14 重复相加（$65,000 + $3,200 = $68,200），导致虚增应税收入。

opts.t: $61,800, because non-cash taxable benefits in Box 40 must be deducted from gross employment remuneration.
opts.w: 错误。Box 40 属于应税福利，绝不能从工资总额中扣除。

opts.t: $3,200, because Line 10100 is specifically reserved for taxable benefits while salary is reported elsewhere.
opts.w: 错误。Line 10100 是雇佣收入总额（包含工资与福利）的法定报告行，绝非仅填报福利部分。

main.pt: CPP 基础与增强供款分流
main.trap: CPP 增强段与基础段混淆走错行陷阱
main.stem: In the 2026 tax year, Kevin earned $90,000 from his sole employer. His T4 slip shows the maximum employee contributions: $4,230.45 in Box 16 and $416.00 in Box 16A. How should Kevin allocate these CPP contributions between Line 30800 (tax credit) and Line 22215 (deduction) on his 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: 在 2026 纳税年度，Kevin 从其唯一雇主处获得 $90,000 的收入。其 T4 报表显示了雇员法定最高供款：Box 16 显示 $4,230.45，Box 16A 显示 $416.00。Kevin 在其 2026 年 T1 申报表中应如何将这些 CPP 供款分配到第 30800 行（抵免）与第 22215 行（扣除）？

opts.w: 错误。把 Box 16 与 Box 16A 全部当抵免：$4,230.45 + $416.00 = $4,646.45 全进 Line 30800，忽略了 1% 增强段与 CPP2 走 Line 22215 扣除。
错误。整个 Box 16 当抵免、只把 Box 16A 当扣除，漏了 Box 16 里的 1% 第一层增强（$711.00）也要分到 Line 22215。

main.pt: 雇主福利与伤病险应税性
main.trap: 主要个人受益应税判定混淆
main.stem: During 2026, Liam was away from work on medical leave for three months and received $12,000 in wage-loss replacement benefits under a group disability plan fully paid for by his employer. His employer also provided him with an assigned office parking space (not required for business travel) and a company smartphone used exclusively for emergency business communications. Which of these benefits is taxable to Liam?
main.zh: 2026 年期间，Liam 因病休假三个月，在一项保费完全由雇主承担的团体残疾保险计划下领取了 $12,000 的工资损失替代给付。雇主还为他提供了一个固定办公停车位（日常工作无需驾车外出）以及一部仅用于紧急业务联络的公司智能手机。Liam 的上述福利中哪一项属于应税福利？

opts.t: Only the company smartphone is taxable, because electronic devices are always deemed personal benefits.
opts.w: 错误。主要用于业务联络且无重大个人使用的公司手机，根据 CRA 行政政策不属于应税福利。

opts.t: None of these benefits are taxable, because sick leave benefits and working tools are statutory tax-exempt.
opts.w: 错误。雇主全额出资的工资损失替代险给付性质等同于工资，必须全额交税；无业务理由的停车位也是应税福利。

opts.t: Both the $12,000 insurance benefit and the parking space are taxable, while the business smartphone is non-taxable.
opts.w: 正确。判定基准看「主要谁受益」和「保费谁付」：团体伤病保费全部由雇主支付，雇员从未自付税后保费，工资损失替代计划（wage-loss replacement plan）给付性质等同继续发工资，因此 $12,000 给付全额应税；非业务必需的固定停车位主要受益人是雇员个人便利，属于应税福利（taxable benefit）；手机以业务为主要目的，不属于应税福利。

opts.t: All three items are fully taxable, because all employer-provided benefits must be included in employment income.
opts.w: 错误。主要为雇主业务需要提供的工具或便利（如业务手机）并不属于应税福利。

main.pt: 股票期权 50% 扣除比例
main.trap: 股票期权扣除率未遂改革错误引用陷阱
main.stem: In 2026, Emily exercised qualifying stock options from her arm's-length corporate employer, generating a taxable benefit of $24,000 reported in T4 Box 14 and Code 38. The shares were eligible common shares, the exercise price was not less than the grant-date fair market value, and the annual vesting limit was not exceeded. What deduction should Emily claim on Line 24900 of her 2026 T1 return under ITA s.110(1)(d)?
main.zh: 2026 年，Emily 行权了其非关联公司雇主授予的合格股票期权，产生 $24,000 的应税福利，已列于 T4 Box 14 及其他信息代码 38。标的股票为合格普通股，行权价不低于授权日公允市值，且未超过年度归属上限。根据 ITA s.110(1)(d)，Emily 在其 2026 年 T1 申报表第 24900 行应申报多少扣除额？

opts.t: $8,000, because the 2024 federal budget reduced the stock option deduction rate to one-third (33.33%).
opts.w: 错误。落入「股票期权扣除率未遂改革错误引用陷阱」；2024 年预算提议将扣除率降至 33.33% 的改革从未生效便被撤销，不能套用 33.33% 的过时提议。

opts.t: $24,000, because eligible stock options grant a full 100% tax exemption upon exercise.
opts.w: 错误。证券期权扣除仅扣减符合条件福利的一部分，并非 100% 全免。

opts.t: $0, because stock option deductions were entirely eliminated for non-CCPC corporations under the 2021 rules.
opts.w: 错误。2021 年规则只对大型雇主设了 200,000 元的年度归属上限，上限以内仍按 50% 扣除，并非整体取消。

opts.t: $12,000, because the 50% deduction rate still applies after the proposed cut was withdrawn.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义明确规定，2024 年拟将股票期权扣除率降至 33.33% 的提议已随资本利得纳入率改革一并撤销，2026 税年仍维持 50% 的法定扣除比例（security options deduction）。Line 24900 应申报 $24,000 × 50% = $12,000。

main.pt: 多雇主 CPP 与 EI 超缴退还
main.trap: 多雇主 CPP 与 EI 超缴自动退税误区陷阱
main.stem: In 2026, Chloe changed jobs in July. Employer 1 withheld $2,500 in CPP (Box 16) and $700 in EI (Box 18). Employer 2, unaware of her prior deductions, withheld $3,000 in CPP (Box 16) and $650 in EI (Box 18). Chloe's total CPP withheld ($5,500) exceeded the 2026 maximum of $4,230.45, and total EI withheld ($1,350) exceeded the 2026 maximum of $1,123.07. How are these overpayments recovered?
main.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Chloe 更换了工作。雇主 1 代扣了 $2,500 的 CPP（Box 16）与 $700 的 EI（Box 18）。雇主 2 在不知情的情况下代扣了 $3,000 的 CPP（Box 16）与 $650 的 EI（Box 18）。Chloe 全年被扣缴的 CPP（$5,500）超过了 2026 年最高上限 $4,230.45，EI（$1,350）超过了最高上限 $1,123.07。这些超额扣缴的款项应如何拿回？

opts.t: Claim them as refundable credits on Line 44800 (CPP) and Line 45000 (EI) on her 2026 return.
opts.w: 正确。多位雇主独立代扣导致的超额 CPP 和 EI 供款不会自动退回给纳税人，必须在报税时通过 Schedule 8 核算并在主表 Line 44800（CPP 超额退还，overpayment of CPP）与 Line 45000（EI 超额退还，overpayment of EI）申报可退还抵免（refundable credits），直接冲抵应纳税额或增加退税。

opts.t: The CRA automatically mails a refund cheque to the employee in March without requiring any schedule or line entry on the T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。落入「多雇主 CPP 与 EI 超缴自动退税误区陷阱」；CRA 系统不会自动邮寄支票，必须在个人税表上主动核算申报。

opts.t: The overpaid amounts expire permanently and are retained in the federal insurance reserve fund as unallocated revenue.
opts.w: 错误。税法赋予纳税人法定超额退税权，绝不会自动没收或失效。

opts.t: The employee must submit a formal refund lawsuit against Employer 2 to recover the deductions before April 30.
opts.w: 错误。雇主代扣是按单份收入依法执行，雇主并无过错，退税完全通过 CRA 个人税表清算流程退回。

main.pt: Box 52 养老金调整额去向
main.trap: Box 52 养老金调整额当年抵税误区陷阱
main.stem: Brian received a 2026 T4 slip showing $3,500 in Box 20 (RPP contributions) and $6,200 in Box 52 (Pension Adjustment, PA). How should Brian report these two boxes on his 2026 personal income tax return?
main.zh: Brian 收到 2026 年 T4 报表，其中 Box 20（RPP 供款）显示为 $3,500，Box 52（养老金调整额，PA）显示为 $6,200。Brian 应如何在其 2026 年个人所得税申报表上填报这两个框？

opts.t: Report $3,500 on Line 20700 and report $6,200 on Line 20800 as an RRSP deduction.
opts.w: 错误。Box 52 是 PA（养老金调整额），不是雇员自缴的 RRSP 供款，不能在 Line 20800 申报扣除。

opts.t: Deduct $3,500 on Line 20700; Box 52 goes on no line but trims next year's RRSP room.
opts.w: 正确。Box 20（RPP 雇员供款，Registered Pension Plan contributions）在 Line 20700 申报税前扣除；而 Box 52（养老金调整额，Pension Adjustment, PA）反映今年在注册退休金计划中积累的退休储蓄价值，不出现在 T1 申报表的任何一行，仅用于 CRA 计算并压缩纳税人下一年度（2027 年）的 RRSP 供款额度。

opts.t: Report the sum of both boxes ($9,700) on Line 20700 as total retirement plan deductions.
opts.w: 错误。落入「Box 52 养老金调整额当年抵税误区陷阱」；将 PA 与 RPP 供款相加申报扣除会违规双重虚增税前扣除。

opts.t: Report $3,500 on Line 30800 and report $6,200 on Line 43700 as prepaid retirement credits.
opts.w: 错误。RPP 供款是扣除项（Line 20700），不是抵免（Line 30800）；PA 更不是预缴税款（Line 43700）。

main.pt: 加拿大就业额规则与省表
main.trap: 就业额自雇不适用与省表缺失陷阱
main.stem: In 2026, Zoe had $1,200 in employment income from a part-time job (Line 10100) and $40,000 in net business income from self-employment. She is a resident of British Columbia. How much can Zoe claim for the Canada employment amount on federal Line 31260, and what corresponding credit can she claim on provincial Form BC428?
main.zh: 2026 年，Zoe 从一份兼职工作中获得 $1,200 的雇佣收入（Line 10100），另有 $40,000 的自雇经营净利润。她是卑诗省（BC）居民。Zoe 在联邦第 31260 行可以申报多少加拿大就业额，在卑诗省表 Form BC428 上可以申报多少对应的省级抵免？

opts.t: Federal Line 31260: $1,501; Form BC428: $1,501.
opts.w: 错误。就业额取 1,501 元上限与合格雇佣收入孰低（1,200 元 < 1,501 元），自雇利润不算；而且 BC 没有对应的省级就业额抵免。

opts.t: Federal Line 31260: $1,501; Form BC428: $0.
opts.w: 错误。联邦就业额取 2026 年上限 1,501 元与合格雇佣收入孰低，Zoe 雇佣收入只有 1,200 元（自雇 40,000 元不算），只能申报 1,200 元。

opts.t: Federal Line 31260: $1,200; Form BC428: $0.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大就业额（Canada employment amount, Line 31260）为非退还抵免，取 2026 税年上限 1,501 元 与合格雇佣收入（Line 10100 与 10400）孰低，自雇经营净利润不属于雇佣收入，因此联邦抵免额为 $1,200；同时根据讲义第四节，BC 省没有对应的省级就业额抵免，BC428 对应金额为 $0。

opts.t: Federal Line 31260: $1,000; Form BC428: $1,000.
opts.w: 错误。$1,000 是 2006 年条文面值，2026 年指数化后上限是 1,501 元，而且 BC 没有对应省表抵免。

main.pt: 多雇主CPP超缴分流计算
main.trap: 照抄实扣金额
main.stem: In 2026, David worked for two different employers in Vancouver. Employer 1 paid him $50,000 and deducted $2,766.75 in Box 16. Employer 2 paid him $40,000 and deducted $2,171.75 in Box 16. Neither employer deducted CPP2 (Box 16A is blank) because neither salary alone reached the 2026 YMPE ($74,600). His total pensionable earnings of $90,000 exceed both the YMPE and the YAMPE ($85,000). Total CPP deducted in Box 16 was $4,938.50. How should David complete Line 44800 and the related CPP lines on his 2026 return?
main.zh: 2026 年，David 在温哥华先后为两家雇主工作。雇主 1 支付 $50,000，Box 16 代扣 $2,766.75；雇主 2 支付 $40,000，Box 16 代扣 $2,171.75。单家工资都没到 2026 年 YMPE（$74,600），两家都没扣 CPP2（Box 16A 为空）。他全年可供款收入 $90,000，超过 YMPE 与 YAMPE（$85,000）。两张 T4 的 Box 16 合计 $4,938.50。David 在 2026 年税表上应如何填 Line 44800 及相关 CPP 各行？

opts.t: $292.05 on Line 44800, with Lines 30800 and 22215 showing the required amounts, not the amounts withheld
$292.05 on Line 44800, with Line 30800 showing the full $4,938.50 that both employers withheld
opts.w: 错误。照抄实扣金额陷阱：把两张 T4 的 Box 16 加总填 Line 30800，又在 Line 44800 要回超缴，同一笔钱既抵免又退款，还漏了 Line 22215 的增强扣除。

opts.t: Nothing on Line 44800, because the CPP2 that was never withheld must be paid off separately first
opts.w: 错误。Schedule 8 把基础段、第一层增强与 CPP2 合并成一个净额比较；账面欠着 CPP2，但整体仍是超缴，CPP2 已在净额里抵掉，不用另行补缴。

opts.t: $708.05 on Line 44800, being the total withheld minus the $4,230.45 Box 16 maximum
opts.w: 错误。只减了第一层的 Box 16 上限，漏掉收入超过 YMPE 后依法应缴的 CPP2（2026 年 416 元），超缴额被算大。

main.pt: EI二千元低收入退还开关
main.trap: 将EI二千元开关误作免税额
main.stem: In 2026, Kevin, an 18-year-old student, earned $1,800 from a short-term part-time job. His T4 slip showed Box 14 and Box 24 insurable earnings of $1,800, and his employer withheld $29.34 of EI premiums in Box 18 (1.63% of $1,800). Kevin had no other employment or insurable income during the year. How should Kevin report this EI premium on his 2026 personal income tax return?
main.zh: 2026 年，18 岁的学生 Kevin 从一份短期兼职工作中赚取了 $1,800。他的 T4 表显示 Box 14 和 Box 24 可保收入均为 $1,800，雇主在 Box 18 中代扣了 $29.34 的 EI 保费（$1,800 的 1.63%）。Kevin 在该年度内没有其他受雇或可保收入。Kevin 在 2026 年个人所得税申报表上应如何申报这笔 EI 保费？

opts.t: Report $29.34 on Line 31200 as a non-refundable tax credit, with $0 on Line 45000.
opts.w: 掉入 EI 低收入处理误区。当全年可保收入不超过 $2,000 时，纳税人不应在 Line 31200 申报非退还抵免，而应全额申请退款。

opts.t: Apply a $2,000 basic exemption to his earnings, which reduces insurable earnings to $0 and forfeits the $29.34 withheld.
opts.w: 将开关误作免税额陷阱。$2,000 是一道全额退还的判定开关，并非免税额；代扣的保费不会被没收，而是退还给雇员。

opts.t: Report $0 on Line 31200 and claim the entire $29.34 as a refundable tax credit on Line 45000 via Form T2204.
opts.w: 准确应用 EI 低收入全额退款规则。根据税法，全年受保收入不超过 $2,000 的雇员几乎无法满足申领失业金的工时条件，因此在 T2204 表上将其全年已扣缴的 EI 保费全额（$29.34）填入 Line 45000 退回，Line 31200 填零。

opts.t: Report $29.34 on Line 23200 as an employment expense deduction to reduce net taxable income.
opts.w: 性质混淆。EI 保费不是 Line 23200 的其他扣除项（Line 23200 用于退还多领的社会福利金），该保费属于可退还抵免。

main.pt: 满18岁CPP折算与EI对照
main.trap: 将CPP按月折算套用于EI
main.stem: Marcus turned 18 years old on May 14, 2026. From June 1 to December 31, 2026, he worked part-time and earned $12,000 in employment income (T4 Box 14, Box 24, and Box 26 all show $12,000). He had no other income in 2026. How are his CPP contributory period and his EI premiums determined for the 2026 tax year?
main.zh: Marcus 于 2026 年 5 月 14 日年满 18 岁。2026 年 6 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日期间，他从事兼职工作并获得 $12,000 的受雇收入（T4 表 Box 14、Box 24 和 Box 26 均显示为 $12,000）。他在 2026 年没有其他收入。他的 CPP 供款期以及 EI 保费在 2026 税年应如何确定？

opts.t: Both CPP and EI are prorated for 7 months; the basic exemption and MIE are both multiplied by 7/12.
opts.w: 将 CPP 折算套用于 EI 陷阱。EI 没有年龄限制，也没有按月折算规则，MIE 不能乘以 7/12。

opts.t: CPP is prorated over 7 months (June to December), but EI applies to the full $12,000 with no age rule or proration.
opts.w: 正确。当年满 18 岁，CPP 供款期是生日当月之后的月份（6–12 月共 7 个月），YMPE 与基本免税额按 7/12 折算；EI 没有年龄门、没有免税额、不按月折算，按全年可保收入 12,000 元 × 1.63% = 195.60 元计算。

opts.t: CPP is prorated for 8 months (May through December, including the birth month), while EI is entirely exempt because Marcus was a minor during part of the year.
opts.w: 月数计算错误且错判 EI 适用范围。满 18 岁当月不计入 CPP 供款期（应从次月算起），且未成年人工作同样须正常扣缴 EI。

opts.t: Neither CPP nor EI is prorated because Marcus was 18 years old on December 31, 2026, so the full annual CPP basic exemption of $3,500 applies.
opts.w: 忽略了法定供款期折算要求。年满 18 岁当年属于典型的按月折算情形，不能直接享受全额 $3,500 免税额。

main.pt: 家庭办公室详细法限制
main.trap: 房主在家庭办公室扣除按揭利息
main.stem: Jason is a salaried employee in Vancouver who entered into a formal written remote work agreement with his employer in 2026, requiring him to work from home four days a week. His employer signed Form T2200. Jason owns a condo where his dedicated home office occupies 15% of the total floor area. In 2026, he incurred the following expenses: mortgage interest $14,000, mortgage principal repayment $8,000, electricity and heat $2,400, home internet monthly access fees $1,200, internet initial connection fee $150, and condo maintenance fees of $3,600 (of which $1,200 covers in-unit heat and water). What is the total home office expense deduction Jason can claim on Line 9945 of Form T777?
main.zh: Jason 是温哥华的一名受薪雇员。他在 2026 年与雇主签订了正式书面远程办公协议，要求其每周在家工作 4 天，雇主为其签署了 T2200 表。Jason 拥有一套自住公寓，其中专用家庭办公室占总面积的 15%。2026 年，他发生了以下支出：按揭利息 $14,000、按揭本金还款 $8,000、电费与暖气费 $2,400、家庭网络月度接入费 $1,200、网络初装开通费 $150，以及公寓管理费 $3,600（其中 $1,200 为户内暖气与水费）。Jason 在 T777 表 Line 9945 上最多可申报多少家庭办公室支出扣除？

opts.t: $2,820, by also including 15% of the mortgage interest with the other eligible costs.
opts.w: 错误。房主扣除按揭利息陷阱：受薪雇员自住房主不能把按揭利息纳入家庭办公室支出（多算了 14,000 元 × 15% = 2,100 元）。

opts.t: $1,080, calculated as 15% of the full condo maintenance fee ($3,600), utilities ($2,400), and internet access ($1,200).
opts.w: 错误全额计入公寓管理费。公寓管理费中仅有直接对应水暖电气等公用事业费的明确份额（$1,200）才可纳入，其余储备基金或大楼维护不可扣除。

opts.t: $3,300, by calculating a deemed fair market rent equivalent for home ownership expenses under CRA detailed method rules.
opts.w: 概念捏造。税法只承认向第三方实际支付的运营费用，严禁房主虚拟'自住租金'进行抵扣。

opts.t: $720, being 15% of utilities, monthly internet and the utility share of condo fees, with no mortgage costs.
opts.w: 正确。合格基数＝电暖 2,400 元＋网络月费 1,200 元＋物业费中水暖部分 1,200 元＝4,800 元；按揭本息与网络开通费都不可扣；4,800 元 × 15% = 720 元。

main.pt: 佣金雇员与受薪口径二选一
main.trap: 照抄实扣金额
main.stem: In 2026, Rachel was employed as a sales representative with Box 14 total employment income of $75,000, which included Box 42 commission income of $6,000. Her employer signed Form T2200 certifying she paid her own expenses without reimbursement. Rachel incurred $4,500 in eligible motor vehicle operating expenses (business portion, no CCA or interest), $1,200 in business travel meals (50% rule applied = $600), $1,500 in lodging, $800 in client entertainment (50% rule applied = $400), and $1,000 in advertising and promotion. She also had $2,000 in eligible home office expenses (utilities and rent). If claimed under commission employee rules, expenses under those provisions are capped at Box 42 commission income ($6,000). What is the optimal strategy for Rachel on Form T777, and what total amount can she deduct on Line 22900?
main.zh: 2026 年，Rachel 担任销售代表，T4 表 Box 14 受雇总收入为 $75,000，其中包括 Box 42 的佣金收入 $6,000。雇主签署了 T2200 表证明其自理费用且未获报销。Rachel 实际发生了 $4,500 的合格车辆营运支出（业务使用部分，无 CCA 或利息）、$1,200 的出差差旅餐饮费（适用 50% 限制后为 $600）、$1,500 的住宿费、$800 的客户娱乐费（适用 50% 限制后为 $400），以及 $1,000 的广告推广费。她还有 $2,000 的合格家庭办公室支出（水电租金部分）。若按佣金雇员口径申报，相关支出受 Box 42 佣金收入（$6,000）的封顶限制。Rachel 在 T777 表上的最佳申报策略是什么？她在 Line 22900 上最多可扣除多少？

opts.t: Use the salaried rules and deduct $8,600, giving up advertising and entertainment but escaping the $6,000 cap.
opts.w: 准确执行受薪与佣金口径二选一规则。若按佣金口径，虽然可包含广告与娱乐，但总额受佣金收入 $6,000 封顶限制（加上车辆 CCA/利息 $0 仍为 $6,000）；若按受薪口径，虽舍弃广告（$1,000）与娱乐（$400），但剩余的车辆（$4,500）＋ 差旅餐饮住宿（$2,100）＋ 家庭办公室（$2,000）＝ $8,600，且不受佣金封顶限制（受雇总收入 $75,000 空间充足）。因此选受薪口径可多扣除 $2,600。

opts.t: Must claim under the commission employee rules, deducting $10,000, because the presence of Box 42 strictly mandates the commission method.
opts.w: 误判选择权。Box 42 有数并不强制要求按佣金申报，税法允许佣金雇员逐年自由选择按受薪口径申报。

opts.t: Claim $6,000 under the commission rules and carry forward the disallowed $4,000 of expenses indefinitely to future tax years.
opts.w: 捏造结转规则。佣金封顶砍掉的常规支出（车辆、差旅、广告、娱乐等）当年不可结转，直接永久作废（仅家庭办公室支出在净收入不足时可结转）。

opts.t: Split the claims by filing two separate T777 forms, reporting vehicle and travel under salaried rules and advertising under commission rules.
opts.w: 违背表格申报规程。同一雇主在同一个税年内只能在受薪口径与佣金口径之间二选一，不可混搭切分。

main.pt: 劳动力流动扣除2026新规
main.trap: 劳动力流动扣除参数误区
main.stem: In 2026, Nathan, an apprentice electrician living in Prince George, BC, was dispatched to a temporary remote construction site 160 km away from his ordinary residence for five months. His temporary lodging was located 135 km closer to the work site than his ordinary residence. Nathan earned $32,000 in employment income from this temporary project and personally incurred $11,500 in eligible temporary lodging, meals, and transportation expenses that were not reimbursed by his employer. His employer refused to sign Form T2200. What is the maximum Labour Mobility Deduction Nathan can claim on Line 22900 of his 2026 return?
main.zh: 2026 年，家住卑诗省乔治王子城的学徒电工 Nathan 被派往距离其常住居所 160 公里的一个临时偏远建筑工地工作 5 个月。其临时住所距离该工地的距离比其常住居所近了 135 公里。Nathan 从该临时工程中获得受雇收入 $32,000，并自行承担了 $11,500 的合格临时住宿、餐饮与交通开支（雇主未予报销）。其雇主拒绝签署 T2200 表。Nathan 在 2026 年报税表 Line 22900 上最多可申报多少劳动力流动扣除（Labour Mobility Deduction）？

opts.t: $0, because no Form T2200 was signed by his employer
opts.w: 错误。劳动力流动扣除不以 T2200 为条件。

opts.t: $10,000, the 2026 cap, which is under half his income
$4,000, the older cap that applied before 2026
opts.w: 错误。用了旧年值：$4,000 与 150 公里是 2025 年及以前的参数，2026 年是 $10,000 与 120 公里。

opts.t: $11,500, all of his costs, as there is no cap

main.pt: GST370退税比例与次年收入
main.trap: 遗漏次年申报GST370退税收入
main.stem: In 2026, Gary, an IT consultant employed by a registered commercial firm in BC, properly claimed $4,200 of eligible employment expenses (all subject to sales tax, excluding any motor vehicle CCA) on Line 22900 of his return. In early 2027, he filed Form GST370 to claim an employee GST/HST rebate. In July 2027, CRA approved the rebate and issued a refund payment of $200 ($4,200 × 5/105). Which of the following correctly describes the provincial sales tax rule and the subsequent tax reporting requirement for this rebate?
main.zh: 2026 年，Gary 作为卑诗省一家已登记商业公司的 IT 顾问，在报税表 Line 22900 上合规申报了 $4,200 的合格雇佣支出（全部含消费税，不含任何车辆 CCA）。2027 年初，他提交了 GST370 表申请雇员消费税退税。2027 年 7 月，CRA 批准并核发了 $200 的退税款（$4,200 × 5/105）。关于省销售税规则以及该笔退税款后续的税务申报要求，下列哪项说明完全正确？

opts.t: Gary was entitled to a 12% combined rebate covering both GST and BC PST, and the resulting refund is permanently non-taxable.
opts.w: BC 省销售税误区与免税误区。BC 省为非参与省，PST（7%）不在联邦雇员消费税退还范围内；且该退税并非永久免税。

opts.t: The rebate is restricted to 5% GST, but the $200 refund must be applied to reduce the undepreciated capital cost (UCC) of his personal computer equipment in 2027.
opts.w: 冲减 UCC 对象混淆。只有针对车辆资本折让（CCA）所退回的消费税才用于冲减次年年初 UCC，针对常规雇佣支出的退款不冲减 UCC。

opts.t: The rebate is restricted to 5% GST because BC PST is not rebatable, and the $200 refund received in 2027 must be reported as taxable income on Line 10400 of his 2027 tax return.
opts.w: 准确阐释 BC 特殊规则与次年收入联动规则。BC 省未加入合并销售税（HST），7% 的 PST 绝不可退，退税率严格按 5/105 折算（$4,200 × 5/105 ＝ $200）；且税法规定，针对雇佣支出退回的消费税冲抵了往年已扣除的费用，必须在收到退款的纳税年度（2027 税年）计入 Line 10400（其他就业收入）缴税。

opts.t: Gary is completely ineligible for the rebate because technology employees are categorized as listed financial institutions under CRA excise tax guidelines.
opts.w: 错判排除行业。不可申请 GST370 的是银行、信托、保险等'列名金融机构'（listed financial institutions），普通科技商业公司雇员完全具备申请资格。

main.pt: 养老金收入额合格范围判定
main.trap: 未满65岁借RRIF抵免
main.stem: Martin, aged 62, retired during the current tax year. He received $14,000 from an employer Registered Pension Plan (RPP) periodic annuity, $6,000 from a Registered Retirement Income Fund (RRIF) withdrawal, and $4,500 in Canada Pension Plan (CPP) retirement benefits. None of these amounts were received as a consequence of a spouse's death. What is Martin's qualifying pension income for calculating the federal pension income amount on line 31400?
main.zh: 马丁（Martin）现年 62 岁，于当前税年退休。他收到了 $14,000 的雇主注册养老金计划（RPP）定期年金、$6,000 的注册退休收入基金（RRIF）提款，以及 $4,500 的加拿大退休金计划（CPP）退休给付。这些款项均非因配偶去世而承继。在计算 Line 31400 的联邦养老金收入额时，马丁的合格养老金收入是多少？

opts.w: 错误。此选项将 RPP、RRIF 和 CPP 全部加总（$14,000 + $6,000 + $4,500）。落入了「将所有退休性质的收入一概当作合格养老金」的陷阱。CPP 属于第二层强制社会保险，在任何年龄都不得计入合格养老金收入（qualified pension income）；且纳税人未满 65 岁，RRIF 提款同样不合格。

正确。根据税法规定，联邦养老金收入额（pension income amount, line 31400）的合格范围按 65 岁划分。纳税人未满 65 岁且非因配偶身故承继时，合格养老金收入仅限于雇主注册养老金计划（Registered Pension Plan, RPP）的定期给付。RRIF 提取须年满 65 岁才合格，而 CPP 任何年龄均不属于合格养老金收入，因此仅有 $14,000 RPP 符合资格。
错误。此选项包含了 $14,000 的 RPP 和 $6,000 的 RRIF，排除了 CPP。这落入了「以为转入 RRIF 就能在任何年龄享受养老金抵免」的陷阱。在纳税人未满 65 岁且未发生配偶身故承继的情况下，RRIF 提款并不属于合格养老金收入。
错误。此选项混淆了「合格养老金收入总额」（qualifying pension income）与「联邦养老金收入额的最高法定抵免基数」（maximum pension income amount of $2,000）。题干询问的是计算抵免前的合格收入金额，而非最终抵免限额。

main.pt: 2026年OAS回收门槛与列报
main.trap: OAS回收直接报净额
main.stem: For the 2026 tax year, Arthur received a T4A(OAS) slip showing total Old Age Security payments of $9,000 in box 18. His net income before adjustments on line 23400 is $105,323, which exceeds the 2026 OAS recovery threshold of $95,323 by exactly $10,000. How should Arthur report his OAS income and the resulting OAS recovery tax on his 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: 在 2026 税年，亚瑟（Arthur）收到一张 T4A(OAS) 凭单，其 box 18 显示的老年保障金给付总额为 $9,000。他在 Line 23400 调整前的净收入为 $105,323，刚好超出 2026 税年 OAS 回收门槛（$95,323）整整 $10,000。亚瑟应如何在 2026 年 T1 申报表上列报其 OAS 收入及由此产生的 OAS 回收税？

opts.t: Report $7,500 on line 11300 and leave line 23500 blank.
opts.w: 错误。此选项按 15% 算出回收税 $1,500（$10,000 × 15%），并直接从 $9,000 中扣除，在 Line 11300 申报净额 $7,500。这落入了「OAS 回收直接报净额」的典型陷阱。CRA 无法通过此种填法核对 T4A(OAS) 的原始数据。

opts.t: Report $9,000 on line 11300 and report a recovery tax of $1,000 on line 23500.
opts.w: 错误。此选项虽然正确区分了行号，但误将超出门槛的回收率按 10% 计算（$10,000 × 10% = $1,000）。法定 OAS 回收率（clawback rate）固定为超出部分的 15%。

opts.t: Report $9,000 on line 11300 and report a recovery tax of $1,500 on line 23500.
opts.w: 正确。根据 2026 税年规则，T4A(OAS) box 18 的给付全额 $9,000 必须完整填入 Line 11300，不得自行扣除回收税；当年净收入超过 2026 年法定门槛 $95,323 的部分（$10,000），按 15% 的回收率计算出 $1,500 的 OAS 回收税（OAS recovery tax），独立申报在 Line 23500。

opts.t: Report $9,000 on line 11300 and report a recovery tax of $2,150 on line 23500.
opts.w: 错误。此选项用了 2024 税年的旧门槛 90,997 元（超额 14,326 元 × 15% ≈ 2,149 元）。2026 税年门槛已指数化为 95,323 元。

main.pt: 股息毛额化与抵免行号申报
main.trap: 直接拿实收股息报收入
main.stem: Raymond received a T5 slip from a Canadian public corporation indicating actual eligible dividends of $20,000 in box 24 and the taxable amount of dividends of $27,600 in box 25. The slip also reports a federal dividend tax credit of $4,145.46 in box 26. How should Raymond enter these amounts on his federal T1 return?
main.zh: 雷蒙德（Raymond）收到一家加拿大上市公司寄发的 T5 凭单：box 24 实际合资格股息 $20,000，box 25 股息应税金额 $27,600，box 26 联邦股息税收抵免 $4,145.46。雷蒙德应如何在联邦 T1 申报表上填报这些金额？

opts.t: Enter $27,600 on line 12000 and enter $4,145.46 on line 40425.
opts.w: 正确。对于收到 T5 凭单的合资格股息（eligible dividend），box 25 已经按 138%（38% gross-up）算好了毛额化后的应税金额，纳税人应直接将其抄入 Line 12000；凭单 box 26 印出的联邦股息税收抵免（Dividend Tax Credit, DTC）则直接抄入 Line 40425。合资格股息不进 Line 12010（该行仅用于非合资格股息）。

opts.t: Enter $20,000 on line 12000 and enter $4,145.46 on line 40425.
opts.w: 错误。此选项直接拿实收现金金额 $20,000 填报 Line 12000。这落入了「直接拿实收股息报收入」的典型陷阱。加拿大股息实行毛额化制度，必须申报放大后的应税金额 $27,600。

opts.t: Enter $27,600 on both line 12000 and line 12010, and enter $4,145.46 on line 40425.
opts.w: 错误。Line 12010 是非合资格股息（non-eligible dividends）的专用校验行。雷蒙德收到的是合资格股息，只能计入 Line 12000，绝不能填入 Line 12010。

opts.t: Enter $38,088 on line 12000 after multiplying box 25 by 138%, and calculate credit manually.
opts.w: 错误。此选项把 box 25 的应税金额又乘以了一次 138%（$27,600 × 138% = $38,088）。凭单上的 box 25 已经完成了毛额化（$20,000 × 138% = $27,600），纳税人直接抄录即可，切勿二次毛额化。

main.pt: 退休收入分割T1032资格与上限
main.trap: OAS与CPP做T1032分割
main.stem: Harold (age 69) and his spouse Margaret (age 68) are Canadian residents who lived together throughout the tax year. Harold received $36,000 from an employer Registered Pension Plan (RPP periodic annuity), $8,000 in Old Age Security (OAS), and $6,000 from the Canada Pension Plan (CPP). Margaret had no pension income. Harold and Margaret wish to make a joint election to split pension income using Form T1032. What is the maximum amount of pension income Harold can allocate to Margaret?
main.zh: 哈罗德（Harold，69 岁）与其配偶玛格丽特（Margaret，68 岁）均为加拿大居民，且整年共同生活。哈罗德当年收到了 $36,000 的雇主注册养老金计划（RPP 定期年金）、$8,000 的老年保障金（OAS）以及 $6,000 的加拿大退休金计划（CPP）。玛格丽特没有任何养老金收入。哈罗德与玛格丽特希望通过 Form T1032 办理退休收入分割联合选择。哈罗德最多可以将多少养老金收入分割转让给玛格丽特？

opts.w: 错误。此选项将所有收入全部相加后除以 2（($36,000 + $8,000 + $6,000) × 50% = $25,000）。这落入了「把 OAS 和 CPP 也混入 T1032 分割」的典型陷阱。OAS 与 CPP 从制度设计上被法律严格排除在可分割收入之外。
错误。此选项将 RPP（$36,000）与 CPP（$6,000）合计后取 50%（$42,000 × 50% = $21,000）。CPP 虽然有向 Service Canada 申请的独立养老金分享渠道，但绝对不能通过税表上的 Form T1032 进行夫妻收入分割。
错误。此选项将 RPP（$36,000）与 OAS（$8,000）合计后取 50%（$44,000 × 50% = $22,000）。OAS 没有任何形式的夫妻分割机制，严禁计入合格分割基数。

正确。根据税法规定，Form T1032 退休收入分割（pension income splitting）的上限为转出方「合格养老金收入」（eligible pension income）的 50%。合格收入仅包括 Line 11500 上的合格项目（如本例中 $36,000 的 RPP 定期给付）；而 OAS（Line 11300）与 CPP（Line 11400）法律上严禁通过 T1032 进行分割。因此，最大可分割金额为 $36,000 × 50% = $18,000。

main.pt: 配偶RRSP三年归属规则
main.trap: 提款直接归提取人名下
main.stem: Nathan contributes to a spousal RRSP in which his spouse, Chloe, is the annuitant. His only contributions in 2024, 2025 and 2026 were $5,000 made in November 2025. In October 2026, Chloe withdrew $8,000 from this spousal RRSP. Neither spouse is separated or non-resident. Under the spousal attribution rules in subsection 146(8.3) of the Income Tax Act, how must this $8,000 withdrawal be reported on their 2026 tax returns?
main.zh: 内森（Nathan）向以配偶克洛伊（Chloe）为年金领取人的配偶 RRSP 供款，他在 2024、2025、2026 三年里唯一的一笔供款是 2025 年 11 月的 $5,000。2026 年 10 月，克洛伊从该配偶 RRSP 中提取了 $8,000。夫妻均未分居且均为加拿大居民。根据《所得税法》第 146(8.3) 条配偶归属规则，这笔 $8,000 应如何在两人 2026 年税表上申报？

opts.t: Chloe reports the full $8,000 on line 12900 of her return, and Nathan reports $0.
opts.w: 错误。此选项仅根据 T4RSP 上的名字将提款全部算在提取人克洛伊名下，完全忽略了配偶归属规则。由于内森在提取当年及前两个历年内发生过供款，供款部分会强制归属给内森。

opts.t: Nathan reports $5,000 on line 12900 of his return, and Chloe reports the remaining $3,000 on line 12900 of her return.
opts.w: 正确。根据配偶供款归属规则（spousal attribution rules, ITA s.146(8.3)），配偶在提取当年（2026）或前两个纳税年度（2024、2025）向配偶 RRSP 供款的，提取款项中相当于该 3 年窗口内供款总额的部分，必须强制归属于供款方（内森）在 Line 12900 申报为收入；超出供款额的剩余部分（$8,000 - $5,000 = $3,000）才由提取人（克洛伊）在自己的 Line 12900 申报。

opts.t: Nathan reports the entire $8,000 on line 12900 of his return, and Chloe reports $0.
opts.w: 错误。此选项将全部提款强制归属于供款人内森。归属规则的上限是供款人在三年窗口内的实际供款额（$5,000），超出部分依然归提取人本人申报。

opts.t: Nathan and Chloe split the $8,000 equally, reporting $4,000 each on line 12900 under pension splitting rules.
opts.w: 错误。配偶 RRSP 提款不适用 T1032 退休收入分割；且归属规则是法定强制规则，并非夫妻可以自由协商对半平分的机制。

main.pt: RRSP提款阶梯预扣与拆单规则
main.trap: 拆小额提款少预扣税
main.stem: Frank, a resident of British Columbia, wishes to withdraw a total of $12,000 from his regular RRSP. To reduce the immediate withholding tax, Frank requests the financial institution to process this as three separate withdrawals of $4,000 on three consecutive days. Under CRA administrative rules and standard withholding rates outside Quebec, how should the financial institution apply the withholding tax to Frank's request?
main.zh: 定居卑诗省（BC）的弗兰克（Frank）打算从其普通 RRSP 中提取总额为 $12,000 的资金。为了降低当期的预扣税率，弗兰克要求金融机构在连续三天内将其拆分成三笔每次 $4,000 的独立提款分别执行。根据 CRA 行政规则及魁省以外的标准预扣税率，金融机构应如何对弗兰克的提款请求计征预扣税？

opts.t: Apply a 20% withholding rate to each payment because withholding is based on the total requested withdrawal of $12,000.
opts.w: 正确。魁省以外：不超过 5,000 元预扣 10%，超过 5,000 元至 15,000 元预扣 20%，超过 15,000 元预扣 30%。同一份提款指令拆成几次执行，预扣率按请求总额（$12,000，落在 20% 档）确定，不能靠拆单适用 10%。

opts.t: Apply a 10% withholding rate to each $4,000 payment because each separate transaction is under $5,000.
opts.w: 错误。这落入了「以为拆成多次小额提款就能适用较低预扣税率」的常见误解。CRA 明确规定连续或分批执行的同一提款指令按累计总额确定预扣税档次。

opts.t: Apply a 30% withholding rate to each payment because splitting withdrawals is subject to a statutory punitive rate.
opts.w: 错误。拆单提款并不存在惩罚性预扣税率，金融机构只是按照实际总请求额（$12,000）对应的正常法定税档（20%）执行预扣。

opts.t: Apply zero withholding at the time of withdrawal and settle the entire tax liability upon filing the annual T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。普通 RRSP 提取属于应税付款，金融机构依法负有强制代扣代缴预扣税（withholding tax）的法定义务，不可免除预扣。

main.pt: T4A(P)各框归属与死亡给付
main.trap: 伤残重复加进汇总
main.stem: Irene received a T4A(P) slip from Service Canada for the current tax year. Box 20 (Total CPP benefits) shows $11,000, which includes $3,000 of disability benefit shown in box 16. In addition, as a named individual beneficiary of her deceased father, Irene received a $2,500 CPP death benefit reported in box 18 of a separate T4A(P) slip issued in her name. How should Irene report these amounts on her T1 tax return?
main.zh: 艾琳（Irene）在当前税年收到了加拿大服务局（Service Canada）寄发的一张 T4A(P) 凭单。Box 20（CPP 给付总额）显示为 $11,000，其中已包含 box 16 所列的 $3,000 伤残给付。此外，作为其已故父亲指定的个人受益人，艾琳收到了以其个人名义出具的另一张 T4A(P) 凭单，box 18 载明 $2,500 的 CPP 死亡给付。艾琳应如何在 T1 报税表上申报这些金额？

opts.t: Enter $14,000 on line 11400, enter $3,000 on line 11410, and enter $0 on line 13000.
opts.w: 错误。此选项把 box 16 的伤残给付与 box 20 重复相加（$11,000 + $3,000 = $14,000）。落入了「将 T4A(P) box 16 再次加进 Line 11400」的常见错报陷阱；且错误地漏报了死亡给付。

opts.t: Enter $13,500 on line 11400, enter $3,000 on line 11410, and enter $0 on line 13000.
opts.w: 错误。此选项将本人领取的死亡给付 $2,500 也并入了 Line 11400。本人作为受益人直接收到的 CPP 死亡给付是唯一走出 Line 11400 汇总框的款项，必须改走 Line 13000。

opts.t: Enter $11,000 on line 11400, enter $3,000 on line 11410, and enter $2,500 on line 13000.
opts.w: 正确。根据 T4A(P) 填报规则，box 20 已经将 box 14 至 19 的所有 CPP/QPP 给付汇总，因此 Line 11400 原样填入 $11,000；box 16 的伤残给付另抄入 Line 11410 仅作为信息性备注，绝不能与 Line 11400 重复相加；而个人以受益人身份直接收到的 CPP 死亡给付（death benefit）不进 Line 11400，须独立计入 Line 13000（其他收入）。

opts.t: Enter $8,000 on line 11400, enter $3,000 on line 11410, and enter $2,500 on line 13000.
opts.w: 错误。此选项从 box 20 中扣减了 box 16 的伤残金（$11,000 - $3,000 = $8,000）。Line 11400 要求原样填入 box 20 的汇总全额，不需要扣除伤残部分。

main.pt: EI常规回收门槛与特殊福利排除
main.trap: EI回收与OAS回收混同
main.stem: Darren received $12,000 in Employment Insurance (EI) regular benefits during the 2026 tax year (T4E box 14 shows $12,000, box 7 rate is 30%, and box 15 contains an amount). His net income before adjustments on line 23400 is $96,125. Darren has no other deductions or additions affecting line 23500. What amount should Darren report on line 11900 as EI benefits, and what amount of EI benefit repayment must be reported on line 23500?
main.zh: 达伦（Darren）在 2026 税年收到了 $12,000 的就业保险（EI）常规福利（T4E box 14 显示为 $12,000，box 7 费率为 30%，box 15 有金额）。他在 Line 23400 调整前的净收入为 $96,125。达伦没有其他影响 Line 23500 的扣除或加项。达伦应在 Line 11900 申报多少 EI 福利，以及必须在 Line 23500 申报多少 EI 福利回收额？

opts.t: Report $12,000 on line 11900 and $3,000 on line 23500.
Report $9,000 on line 11900 and $0 on line 23500.
opts.w: 错误。从 $12,000 减去 $3,000 回收额报净额 $9,000，违背总额入表原则。

opts.t: Report $12,000 on line 11900 and $1,500 on line 23500.
Report $12,000 on line 11900 and $5,138 on line 23500.

main.pt: 工伤社保计入再扣回及福利影响
main.trap: 工伤社保直接隐形不报
main.stem: In 2026, Liam sustained a workplace injury and received $15,000 in Workers' Compensation Benefits (T5007 box 10). He had no other income during the year. How do these benefits affect Liam's net income (line 23600), taxable income (line 26000), and his eligibility for income-tested social benefits?
main.zh: 2026 年，利亚姆（Liam）遭遇工伤，收到了 $15,000 的工伤给付（T5007 box 10）。他在当年没有其他收入。这笔给付如何影响利亚姆的净收入（Line 23600）、应税收入（Line 26000）以及他享受收入测试型社会福利的资格？

opts.t: Net income is $0, taxable income is $0, and his income-tested benefits are calculated based on zero income.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误以为免税就代表完全不进入申报表。若不在 Line 14400 填报，会导致福利基数严重失真。

opts.t: Net income is $15,000, taxable income is $15,000, and he must pay federal tax at the lowest bracket while losing benefits.
opts.w: 错误。此选项遗漏了 Line 25000 的全额扣除项。工伤给付绝非应税收入，应税收入（taxable income）应为零。

opts.t: Net income is $15,000, taxable income is $0, and the $15,000 is included in the base to determine his income-tested benefits.
opts.w: 正确。根据税法两步机制，工伤给付（Workers' Compensation Benefits）由 T5007 box 10 填入 Line 14400，进入总收入并形成 $15,000 的净收入（Line 23600），确保所有收入测试型福利（CCB、CGEB 等）能准确核定其家庭经济状况；随后在 Line 25000 申报等额 $15,000 扣除，使得应税收入（Line 26000）为 $0，不产生任何所得税负。

opts.t: Net income is $15,000, taxable income is $0, but income-tested benefits are legally required to exclude line 14400.
opts.w: 错误。几乎所有收入测试型福利均直接以 Line 23600（含 Line 14400）为唯一定准基数，法律并未将其从福利核定基数中剔除。

main.pt: 赡养费1997分水岭与税负分流
main.trap: 断章取义子女抚养费一律免税
main.stem: Under a written separation agreement signed in March 1995 that has never been modified and for which no Form T1157 was ever filed, Carlos pays his former spouse Elena $1,000 per month in child support and $500 per month in spousal support throughout 2026 (totaling $12,000 child support and $6,000 spousal support). How should Carlos and Elena report these payments on their respective 2026 Canadian personal income tax returns?
main.zh: 根据一份签订于 1995 年 3 月的书面分居协议（此后从未做过任何修改，且双方从未提交过 Form T1157），卡洛斯（Carlos）在整个 2026 年每月向前妻埃莱娜（Elena）支付 $1,000 的子女赡养费和 $500 的配偶赡养费（全年合计子女赡养费 $12,000，配偶赡养费 $6,000）。卡洛斯与埃莱娜应如何在各自的 2026 年加拿大个人税申报表上列报这些款项？

opts.t: Carlos deducts $6,000 on line 22000; Elena reports $6,000 on line 12800; the $12,000 child support is neither deductible nor taxable.
opts.w: 错误。此选项直接套用了 1997 年 5 月 1 日之后成立的新协议规则，忽略了该协议订立于 1995 年且从未修改或签署 T1157 选择的事实。

opts.t: Carlos deducts the full $18,000 on line 22000, and Elena must report the full $18,000 as taxable support payments on line 12800.
opts.w: 正确。判断赡养费税务待遇的第一步是看协议成立日期。该协议成立于 1995 年（1997 年 5 月 1 日之前），且之后从未修改变更过金额、协议未载明 1997 年后免税条款、双方亦未提交 Form T1157 选择，因此依法维持旧口径：卡洛斯支付的全年 $18,000（含子女与配偶部分）均可在 Line 22000 全额扣除，埃莱娜收到的全部 $18,000 均须在 Line 12800 申报为应税赡养费收入（taxable support payments）。

opts.t: Carlos cannot deduct any amount because all support agreements older than 20 years are grandfathered out of deductions.
opts.w: 错误。税法中不存在旧赡养费协议满 20 年就自动废止扣除资格的法律条款。

opts.t: Carlos deducts $12,000 for child support on line 22000, while the $6,000 spousal support is tax-exempt.
opts.w: 错误。此选项将配偶赡养费错误视为免税，颠倒了旧税法和新税法的基本分类逻辑。

main.pt: 奖学金免税三档与合格学生界定
main.trap: 全日制身份等同合格学生
main.stem: Dr. Benjamin completed his PhD and worked as a full-time postdoctoral fellow at a Canadian university throughout 2026. He received a $35,000 postdoctoral fellowship grant reported in box 105 of Form T4A. How much of this fellowship grant is taxable on line 13010 of his 2026 return?
main.zh: 本杰明博士（Dr. Benjamin）已经博士毕业，2026 全年在加拿大某大学从事全职博士后研究。他收到了一笔 $35,000 的博士后研究资助金，标注在 Form T4A 的 box 105 中。本杰明在 2026 年报税表 Line 13010 上必须申报多少金额作为应税收入？

opts.t: $0, as full-time researchers are fully exempt
opts.w: 错误。这落入了「全日制身份等同合格学生」的典型陷阱。博士后研究员并非注册在合格教育项目中的在读学生，无法享受全额免税。

opts.t: $17,500, after a 50% research exemption
opts.w: 错误。没有博士后 50% 免税规则（$35,000 × 50% = $17,500 是编出来的算法）。

opts.t: $35,000, with no exemption at all
opts.w: 错误。漏了非合格学生仍有的 $500 基础免税额。

opts.t: $34,500, after the $500 basic exemption
opts.w: 正确。博士后不是就读合格教育项目的学生，只有 $500 基础免税额：$35,000 − $500 = $34,500。

main.pt: RESP三类派款税务归属与惩罚税
main.trap: 政府给的福利都不用交税
main.stem: In 2026, Lucas withdrew money from an RESP that had been established for his daughter Emily. Emily completed her post-secondary studies, and the remaining funds were distributed as follows: $10,000 was refunded to Lucas as original capital contributions; $6,000 was paid to Emily as an Educational Assistance Payment (EAP, T4A box 042); and $8,000 of remaining investment growth was paid to Lucas as an Accumulated Income Payment (AIP, T4A box 040). How are these distributions treated on Lucas's and Emily's 2026 tax returns?
main.zh: 2026 年，卢卡斯（Lucas）从为其女儿艾米莉（Emily）设立的 RESP 账户中提款。艾米莉已完成大专学业，账户剩余资金分配如下：$10,000 作为原始供款本金退还给卢卡斯；$6,000 作为教育资助金（EAP，T4A box 042）发放给艾米莉；$8,000 的剩余累积投资收益作为累积收益派款（AIP，T4A box 040）发放给卢卡斯。这些款项在卢卡斯与艾米莉的 2026 年报税表上应如何处理？

opts.t: Lucas's $10,000 capital is tax-free; Emily reports $6,000 and Lucas $8,000 on line 13000, plus 20% extra tax.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RESP 三条路径规则：供款本金（$10,000）由供款人卢卡斯免税取回，从来不进任何人的收入行；教育资助金 EAP（$6,000）属于受益学生艾米莉名下的应税收入，由艾米莉报在 Line 13000；累积收益派款 AIP（$8,000）付给供款人卢卡斯，按卢卡斯正常税率计入 Line 13000，且须在 Line 41800 另行计算 20%（非魁北克居民）的惩罚性附加税。

opts.t: Lucas reports $18,000 on line 13000, while Emily reports $6,000 on line 13000 with a 20% tax credit.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误将供款人免税取回的本金（$10,000）也当作应税收入计入，且把 Line 41800 的附加税颠倒成了税收抵免。

opts.t: Emily reports both the $6,000 EAP and the $8,000 AIP on line 13000, while Lucas has no tax reporting obligations.
opts.w: 错误。此选项将供款人收取的 AIP 收益错误归属给了学生，规避了针对供款人的 20% 惩罚性附加税。

opts.t: All $24,000 is fully tax-exempt because RESP funds represent government-approved educational savings.
opts.w: 错误。这落入了「注册教育计划全免税」的严重误区。RESP 中仅本金退还不课税，EAP 与 AIP 均为法定应税款项。

main.pt: 退休津贴免占限制与身故福利
main.trap: 政府给的福利都不用交税
main.stem: Harold commenced employment with a manufacturer in 2002 and was laid off in 2026 after 24 years of continuous service. Upon termination, he received a retiring allowance (severance pay) of $50,000, shown in box 67 of his T4 slip as non-eligible retiring allowance (box 66 is $0). Harold wants to transfer this amount into his RRSP to reduce his 2026 tax. His 2026 Notice of Assessment shows an unused RRSP deduction limit of $18,000. How much of the retiring allowance can Harold transfer to his RRSP without incurring an excess contribution?
main.zh: 哈罗德（Harold）于 2002 年入职某制造厂，在连续服务 24 年后于 2026 年被裁员解雇。离职时他获得了一笔 $50,000 的退休津贴（遣散费），显示在其 T4 表的 box 67（不合格退休津贴），而 box 66 为 $0。哈罗德希望将这笔款项转入 RRSP 以减轻 2026 年税负。他的 2026 年核定通知书（NOA）显示剩余未用 RRSP 供款额度为 $18,000。哈罗德最多能向 RRSP 转入多少退休津贴而不会产生超额供款？

opts.t: $50,000, because retiring allowances for employees with over 20 years of service can be transferred into an RRSP entirely without using contribution room.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误以为服务年限长就自动享有免占额度转入资格，忽视了 1996 年改革早已冻结该特权的法定历史节点。

opts.t: $18,000, because the eligible transfer room was frozen after 1995, meaning post-1995 service creates no special transfer room and can only use his existing $18,000 RRSP limit.
opts.w: 正确。根据第 2.6 节与第五节历史变革，退休津贴的免占额度转入机制（eligible transfer）已在 1996 年税制改革中冻结，只承认 1995 年及以前的服务年资。哈罗德于 2002 年入职，其全部服务均在 1996 年之后，合格部分（box 66）为零；全部 $50,000 均属于不合格部分（box 67），只能占用纳税人自身当年剩余的 RRSP 额度（$18,000），超出额度的 $32,000 无法转入，只能在 Line 13000 正常课税。

opts.t: $48,000, calculated as $2,000 per year of service for 24 years under the statutory severance sheltering formula.
opts.w: 错误。每年 $2,000 的累积额度仅计算至 1995 年底，1996 年以后的年资一年额度都不再增加。

opts.t: $0, because non-eligible retiring allowances are legally prohibited from being contributed to an RRSP under any circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。不合格退休津贴并非禁止供款，只要哈罗德自己有剩余的 RRSP 供款空间，就可以正常供款并抵扣。

main.pt: 工伤退还工资的三行号分流申报
main.trap: 工伤社保直接隐形不报
main.stem: In 2026, Kevin was injured on the job. His employer continued paying his regular salary of $50,000 throughout his recovery. WorkSafeBC approved his claim and issued a T5007 slip showing $10,000 in box 10. Pursuant to company policy, Kevin reimbursed the $10,000 to his employer. Kevin also received a T4 slip reporting $50,000 in box 14. How should Kevin properly report these transactions on his 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: 2026 年，凯文（Kevin）在工作中受伤。雇主在其康复休工期间按政策继续向其全额发放了 $50,000 的常规工资。WorkSafeBC 批准了他的工伤申请，并出具了一张 T5007 凭单，其 box 10 显示有 $10,000 工伤给付。依据公司政策，凯文将这笔 $10,000 退还给了雇主。凯文同时收到一张 T4 表，box 14 显示工资为 $50,000。凯文应如何在 2026 年 T1 表上合规申报这些收支事项？

opts.t: Report $40,000 on line 10100 and leave lines 14400, 22900, and 25000 blank, because the $10,000 reimbursement nets out against his employment income.
opts.w: 错误。此选项直接用退还款与 T4 工资私下抵消，在 Line 10100 申报净额 $40,000。这属于严重错报，违背了税法分通行号的核对要求。

opts.t: Report $50,000 on line 10100, report $10,000 on line 14400, and claim a $10,000 deduction on line 25000, with no entry on line 22900.
opts.w: 错误。此选项遗漏了退还给雇主款项在 Line 22900 的法定扣除，导致凯文为其已经退还给雇主的工资重复纳税。

opts.t: Report $50,000 on line 10100, report $10,000 on line 14400, claim a $10,000 deduction on line 25000, and claim a $10,000 deduction on line 22900 for wage reimbursement.
opts.w: 正确。根据第六节案例一的实务标准操作，各笔收支必须分走独立行号，严禁私自抵消：T4 表上雇主发放的 $50,000 工资如实报在 Line 10100；T5007 的 $10,000 工伤给付报在 Line 14400，同时在 Line 25000 申报 $10,000 扣除（工伤本身免税）；凯文退还给雇主的 $10,000 垫付工资，另在 Line 22900 申报其他就业扣除项。四处填报清晰完整，既不漏报也不重缴。

opts.t: Report $50,000 on line 10100 and report $10,000 on line 13000 as other income, with no deductions permitted.
opts.w: 错误。工伤给付绝非 Line 13000 的应税其他收入，此做法直接导致免税福利被错课所得税。

main.pt: 两层扣除与福利联动效应
main.trap: 扣除额一概降低净收入
main.stem: Liam relocated to Fort Nelson, British Columbia, and meets the qualifying residency requirements for the northern residents deduction. On his 2026 tax return, Liam claims a $4,000 northern residents deduction on line 25500. Liam and his spouse have two young children and receive the Canada Child Benefit (CCB). What is the direct effect of this $4,000 deduction on Liam's net income (line 23600) and his family's CCB entitlement?
main.zh: 莱姆（Liam）迁居至卑诗省纳尔逊堡（Fort Nelson），并符合北方居民扣除的法定居住要求。在其 2026 年报税表上，他在 Line 25500 申报了 $4,000 的北方居民扣除。莱姆与其配偶育有两名幼童且正在领取加拿大儿童福利（CCB）。这笔 $4,000 的扣除对莱姆的净收入（Line 23600）及家庭 CCB 待遇有何直接影响？

opts.t: It reduces line 23600 net income by $4,000, thereby increasing the family's CCB payments for the subsequent benefit year.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误将第 4 步的 Line 25500 扣除当成了第 3 步扣除。落入了「扣除额一概降低净收入」的典型陷阱。

opts.t: It reduces taxable income on line 26000 and net income on line 23600 by $2,000 each under federal-provincial allocation rules.
opts.w: 错误。北方居民扣除不存在联邦与省各分摊一半净收入扣减的规则。

opts.t: It reduces taxable income on line 26000 but leaves net income on line 23600 unchanged, resulting in zero increase to the family's CCB payments.
opts.w: 正确。根据第一节制度设计原理，加税表将扣除明确划分为两层：Line 20700 至 Line 23500 属于第 3 步，既减税又压低净收入；而 Line 24400 至 Line 25600 属于第 4 步，仅减少应税收入（taxable income, line 26000），对净收入（net income, line 23600）分毫不动。由于加拿大儿童福利（Canada Child Benefit, CCB）完全依据父母双方的调整后家庭净收入核定，落在 Line 25500 的北方居民扣除（northern residents deductions）不会降低净收入，因此对家庭儿童福利待遇毫无增加效果。

opts.t: It has no effect on federal taxable income because northern residency benefits are delivered exclusively through provincial non-refundable credits.
opts.w: 错误。北方居民扣除是《所得税法》规定的法定联邦应税收入扣除项目，直接在联邦 Line 25500 生效。

main.pt: 托儿费三道天花板与结转限制
main.trap: 托儿费未扣余额跨年结转
main.stem: Natalie is a single parent who has two children: a 5-year-old son and a 9-year-old daughter (neither eligible for the DTC). In 2026, Natalie paid $15,000 in qualifying child care expenses. Her only income for 2026 was $18,000 of net employment earnings. Under Form T778 and line 21400, what is Natalie's maximum allowable child care expense deduction for 2026, and what is the tax treatment of the remaining undeducted balance?
main.zh: 娜塔莉（Natalie）是一位单亲母亲，育有两名子女：5 岁的儿子和 9 岁的女儿（均不符合 DTC 条件）。2026 年，娜塔莉实际支付了 $15,000 的合格托儿费。她 2026 年的唯一收入是 $18,000 的就业净收益。根据 Form T778 和 Line 21400，娜塔莉在 2026 年可申报的最高托儿费扣除额是多少，剩余未扣除的托儿费在税务上如何处理？

opts.t: She can deduct $13,000 based on the combined child age limits, and the remaining $2,000 can be carried forward indefinitely.
opts.w: 错误。子女限额之和算对了（8,000 元 + 5,000 元 = 13,000 元），但漏了挣得收入三分之二的天花板（18,000 元 × 2/3 = 12,000 元），还误以为托儿费可以像搬家费一样结转。

opts.t: She can deduct $12,000 under the two-thirds earned income ceiling, and the remaining $3,000 lapses completely and cannot be carried forward.
opts.w: 正确。三道天花板取最低：实付 15,000 元；子女限额之和 8,000 元（5 岁）+ 5,000 元（9 岁）= 13,000 元；挣得收入 18,000 元 × 2/3 = 12,000 元。取最低 12,000 元；当年扣不完的 3,000 元直接作废，不能结转。

opts.t: She can deduct $15,000 based on actual amounts paid, because single-parent filers are exempt from the earned income limitation.
opts.w: 错误。单亲纳税人同样严格受制于挣得收入三分之二的法定天花板，税法没有任何豁免规定。

opts.t: She can deduct $12,000 under the earned income ceiling, and the remaining $3,000 may be carried forward for up to seven tax years.
opts.w: 错误。托儿费根本不具备结转机制，差额直接作废，七年结转是企业亏损规则的混淆干扰项。

main.pt: 托儿费高收入方例外限额计算
main.trap: 高收入方扣托儿费更省税
main.stem: Oliver earned $110,000 and his spouse Sophia earned $25,000 in 2026. They have two children aged 5 and 8 (neither eligible for the DTC) and incurred $14,000 in child care expenses. Sophia was enrolled full-time in a designated educational program for exactly 10 weeks during the year. Under Form T778 rules, how much of the child care expenses can Oliver (the higher-income spouse) claim, and who claims the rest?
main.zh: 奥利弗（Oliver）在 2026 年收入为 $110,000，其配偶索菲亚（Sophia）收入为 $25,000。他们育有两名子女，年龄分别为 5 岁和 8 岁（均不符合 DTC 条件），全年支付托儿费 $14,000。索菲亚当年在一家指定教育机构全日制在校就读整整 10 周。根据 Form T778 规则，奥利弗（高收入方）最多可申报多少托儿费，其余部分由谁申报？

opts.t: $3,250 ($325 a week for 10 weeks); Sophia claims the rest
$13,000, the full annual ceiling, as Sophia was a student
opts.w: 错误。把在校例外当成整年转移：$8,000 + $5,000 = $13,000；高收入方只能按在读周数申报。

opts.t: $2,000 ($200 a week for 10 weeks), the under-7 child only
opts.w: 错误。只算了 5 岁孩子的每周额度（$200 × 10），漏了 8 岁孩子每周 $125。

opts.t: $0, as the exceptions cover only illness or prison
opts.w: 错误。全日制在校就读是法定例外之一。

main.pt: 搬家费40公里测试方向判定
main.trap: 搬家距离只量两处住所
main.stem: Patrick changed jobs and moved his residence within the Greater Vancouver area in 2026. The shortest normal public route distances between the relevant locations are: from Old Residence to New Residence is 18 km; from Old Residence to New Workplace is 52 km; and from New Residence to New Workplace is 9 km. Does Patrick meet the 40-kilometre distance requirement under Form T1-M to claim moving expenses?
main.zh: 帕特里克（Patrick）于 2026 年在大温哥华地区更换了工作并搬迁了住所。各相关地点之间按最短公共路线测得的距离如下：从旧居到新居为 18 公里；从旧居到新工作地点为 52 公里；从新居到新工作地点为 9 公里。根据 Form T1-M，帕特里克是否满足申报搬家费的 40 公里距离要求？

opts.t: No, because the distance between his old residence and new residence is only 18 km, which falls far short of the 40 km minimum.
opts.w: 错误。此选项直接拿旧居到新居的距离来判定，落入了「搬家距离只量两处住所」的最常见陷阱。税法测算的终点是新工作地点，而非新居。

opts.t: No, because relocations within the same metropolitan transit region are statutory ineligible moves regardless of distance.
opts.w: 错误。税法没有任何针对大都市圈同城搬家的排除条款，只要满足 40 公里法定距离测试即可合格。

opts.t: Yes, provided that Patrick's daily round-trip commute between his new residence and new workplace exceeds 40 km.
opts.w: 错误。日常通勤往返里程并非法定搬家费距离测试的标准。

opts.t: Yes, because his new residence is 43 km closer to his new workplace than his old residence was (52 km − 9 km = 43 km ≥ 40 km).
opts.w: 正确。根据第二节搬家费规则，40 公里门槛测量的不是「搬了多远」，而是「搬家是否让你离新工作地点显著更近」。法定公式为：旧居到新工作地点的距离减去新居到新工作地点的距离（按最短公共路线计算）必须 ≥ 40 公里。本题中 52 公里 − 9 公里 = 43 公里 ≥ 40 公里，因此完全满足资格条件。

main.pt: 搬家费收入限制与结转规则
main.trap: 搬家费跨年回溯申报
main.stem: In October 2026, Benjamin incurred $12,000 of allowable moving expenses when relocating to Kelowna for a new employment contract. Between October and December 2026, he earned $7,000 in employment income at the Kelowna location. He also had $15,000 in investment dividends and $8,000 in employment income earned at his prior location earlier in 2026. What amount can Benjamin deduct on line 21900 for 2026, and how is the unused balance treated?
main.zh: 2026 年 10 月，本杰明（Benjamin）因前往基洛纳（Kelowna）履行新雇佣合同发生了 $12,000 的合资格搬家费。在 2026 年 10 月至 12 月期间，他在基洛纳新地点赚取了 $7,000 的就业收入。他在 2026 年早些时候还在原居住地赚取了 $8,000 的就业收入，并拥有 $15,000 的投资股息。本杰明在 2026 年 Line 21900 上可扣除多少金额，未使用的余额如何处理？

opts.t: He can deduct $12,000 in full against his combined 2026 income, with zero balance carried forward.
opts.w: 错误。搬家费严禁用来抵扣全年的其他收入（如旧地点收入或投资收入），扣除额受新地点收入严格封顶。

opts.t: $7,000 against his Kelowna income, with $5,000 carried forward indefinitely against future new-location income.
opts.w: 正确。根据第二节搬家费规则，合资格搬家费只能从「在新地点赚取的新就业或自雇收入」中抵扣。本杰明在新地点仅赚取了 $7,000，因此 2026 年最高只能扣除 $7,000。第二条关键规则是：当年未扣完的合格搬家费（$5,000）可以无限期向后结转（carry forward indefinitely），在以后年度从同一新地点赚取的同类收入中继续扣除。

opts.t: He can deduct $7,000 in 2026, and the remaining $5,000 must be carried back to amend his 2025 tax return.
opts.w: 错误。搬家费税法明确规定「绝不可回溯」（cannot be carried back），不能拿回上一年去抵扣。

opts.t: He can deduct $12,000 because moving expenses are permitted to offset any Canadian-source taxable employment or dividend income.
opts.w: 错误。投资收入和非新地点的就业收入依法一律不得作为搬家费扣除的抵扣基数。

main.pt: 赡养费双行申报与偿付顺序
main.trap: 赡养费漏填Line 21999
main.stem: Under a written court-registered separation agreement executed in 2021, Lucas was required to pay $12,000 in child support and $8,000 in spousal support during 2026. Due to financial hardship, Lucas paid a total of only $15,000 during the year. How should Lucas report these support payments on lines 21999 and 22000 of his 2026 T1 return?
main.zh: 根据 2021 年订立并经法院登记的书面分居协议，卢卡斯（Lucas）在 2026 年应支付 $12,000 的子女赡养费和 $8,000 的配偶赡养费。由于经济困难，卢卡斯当年总共仅支付了 $15,000。卢卡斯应如何在其 2026 年 T1 申报表的 Line 21999 和 Line 22000 上列报这些赡养费？

opts.t: Report $15,000 on line 21999 and $3,000 on line 22000, because payments are allocated to non-deductible child support first.
opts.w: 正确。根据第二节赡养费规则，1997 年 4 月之后订立的协议中，子女赡养费不可扣除，配偶赡养费可全额扣除。当付款人未足额支付协议约定的款项时，税法规定已付款项优先冲抵子女赡养费。在实际支付的 $15,000 中，前 $12,000 优先清偿子女赡养费，剩余的 $3,000 才归属配偶赡养费。申报时必须走双行结构：Line 21999 申报实际支付的赡养费全额（$15,000），Line 22000 申报合资格可扣除金额（$3,000）。

opts.t: Report $3,000 on line 22000 and leave line 21999 blank, because non-deductible child support should not be entered on the tax return.
opts.w: 错误。落入了「只填 Line 22000 漏填 Line 21999」的高频错报陷阱。CRA 必须靠 Line 21999 的全额与收款方的 Line 12799 进行交叉比对，漏填会导致核对失败并触发税局问询。

opts.t: Report $15,000 on line 21999 and $6,000 on line 22000, prorating the shortfall proportionally between child and spousal support.
opts.w: 错误。税法明确禁止按比例分摊欠付金额，必须强制优先足额偿付子女赡养费。

opts.t: Report $15,000 on line 21999 and $8,000 on line 22000, prioritizing the deductible spousal support amount.
opts.w: 错误。税法保护未成年子女权益，偿付顺序永远是子女赡养费优先，配偶赡养费在后。

main.pt: 投资持有成本合格范围排除
main.trap: 注册账户借款利息进Line 22100
main.stem: During the 2026 tax year, Victoria incurred the following investment-related outlays: $1,200 in portfolio management fees for a non-registered dividend-paying equity account; $2,500 in interest on a loan used to purchase dividend-yielding shares in a non-registered account; $800 in interest on a loan used to contribute to her Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA); and $150 for a safety deposit box rental. What is the total carrying charges deduction Victoria can claim on line 22100?
main.zh: 在 2026 税年，维多利亚（Victoria）发生了以下投资相关支出：非注册派息股票账户的投资组合管理费 $1,200；为在非注册账户中购买产生股息的股票而借款所支付的利息 $2,500；为向其免税储蓄账户（TFSA）供款借款所支付的利息 $800；以及保管箱租金 $150。维多利亚在 Line 22100 上可申报的投资持有成本扣除总额是多少？

opts.t: $4,650, because all expenses incurred in managing investments and borrowing capital are fully deductible under the Income Tax Act.
opts.w: 错误。此选项将所有支出简单加总，忽略了税法对注册账户借款利息和保管箱租金的明确排除规定。

opts.t: $4,500, combining the management fees and all loan interest, while excluding the safety deposit box rental.
opts.w: 错误。此选项计入了为向 TFSA 供款而借款的利息。税法明令禁止扣除为向任何注册计划（TFSA/RRSP/FHSA）供款借款的利息。

opts.t: $3,700, consisting of the non-registered portfolio management fees ($1,200) and the loan interest incurred to earn taxable dividends ($2,500) only.
opts.w: 正确。根据第二节 Line 22100 投资持有成本规则，可扣除项的判定标准是「是否为了产生应税投资收入（利息或股息）」。非注册账户的管理费（$1,200）与购买派息股票的借款利息（$2,500）均属于合格支出，合计 $3,700。税法明确排除的项目包括：为向注册账户（TFSA/RRSP 等）供款而借款的利息（$800 不合格）以及保管箱租金（$150 不合格）。

opts.t: $2,500, because management fees are required to be capitalized into the adjusted cost base rather than deducted annually on line 22100.
opts.w: 错误。非注册账户的专业投资管理费和照管费是标准的 Line 22100 税前扣除项，不要求资本化进入成本基数（买卖证券的交易佣金才需要计入成本基数）。

main.pt: 非退还抵免性质与零税额限制
main.trap: 抵免额无税照样能退钱
main.stem: Ethan graduated from university in late 2026 and worked for only one month, earning $4,500 of employment income. His federal tax payable before credits was $630 (14% × $4,500). His basic personal amount of $16,452 generated a tax credit of $2,303.28, which reduced his federal tax payable to zero. In December 2026, Ethan purchased his first home and qualified for the $10,000 home buyers' amount (Line 31270). What is the total federal tax benefit (reduction of tax or cash refund) Ethan receives from claiming the home buyers' amount on his 2026 return?
main.zh: 伊森（Ethan）于 2026 年底大学毕业并仅工作了一个月，获得受雇收入 $4,500。在计入抵免前其联邦应缴税额为 $630（14% × $4,500）。其基本个人金额 $16,452 产生了 $2,303.28 的税收抵免，已将他的联邦应缴税额抵减至零。2026 年 12 月，伊森购买了首套合资格自住房，符合申报 $10,000 首次购房者额（Line 31270）的条件。伊森在其 2026 年报税表上申报该首次购房者额可获得的联邦税收好处（减税或现金退税）是多少？

opts.t: A cash refund of $1,400 paid directly by CRA under federal refundable tax credit rules.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误将首次购房者额当成了可退还税收抵免（refundable tax credit）。首次购房者额是非退还抵免，绝不会直接派发现金退税。这落入了「抵免额无税照样能退钱」的典型陷阱。

opts.t: $0, because the home buyers' amount is a non-refundable tax credit and Ethan's tax payable was already reduced to zero.
opts.w: 正确。根据第一节制度设计底层逻辑，非退还税收抵免（non-refundable tax credit）的法律效力仅限于将纳税人的当期应缴税额压降至零，不能变为负数，多余的抵免额既不退还现金，也不能结转。由于基本个人金额（basic personal amount, BPA）在法定扣减顺序中排在首位，且已完全将伊森的 $630 联邦税额冲抵至零，因此排在后面的首次购房者额（Line 31270）无法产生任何实际税收减免效果，最终税收价值为 $0。

opts.t: $1,500, calculated using the historical 15% credit rate and credited against Ethan's future tax liabilities.
opts.w: 错误。不仅 2026 年联邦抵免率已调整为 14%（而非 15%），而且首次购房者额依法不可向未来年度结转（carry-forward）。

opts.t: A tax reduction of $630 allocated equally between federal and provincial tax liabilities on Form BC428.
opts.w: 错误。伊森的联邦税已经被基本个人金额抵为零，首次购房者额无法再抵减任何联邦税；联邦与省税各自按独立表单结算，不存在平分 $630 的规则。

main.pt: Top-Up补丁触发与保15%折算
main.trap: 抵免额总和超第一档门槛
main.stem: In the 2026 tax year, the federal lowest bracket tax rate and the general non-refundable credit conversion rate were reduced to 14%. To prevent taxpayers with substantial credits from experiencing a net tax increase, Parliament introduced the Top-Up Tax Credit under ITA s. 118(11). Under what specific statutory condition is a taxpayer entitled to receive the federal Top-Up Tax Credit on their 2026 return?
main.zh: 在 2026 税年中，联邦最低税阶税率及常规非退还抵免折算率被同步调降至 14%。为了避免拥有大额抵免项的纳税人反而承担净增税负，国会通过《所得税法》ITA s.118(11) 引入了顶额补充抵免（Top-Up Tax Credit）。纳税人在何种法定具体条件下有资格在其 2026 年税表上获得这项联邦 Top-Up 抵免？

opts.t: When the taxpayer's taxable income exceeds the highest federal 33% tax bracket threshold of $258,482.
opts.w: 错误。Top-Up 补丁的触发完全不取决于纳税人是否进入最高税阶。事实上，很多高收入者抵免额少也拿不到，而中等收入大额抵免者完全可以拿到。

opts.t: Whenever the taxpayer's claimed tuition fee transfers or medical expenses alone exceed $5,000 in the current tax year.
opts.w: 错误。触发补丁不取决于单项学费或医疗费是否达到某一固定值，而是考查全部合资格非退还抵免额的加总总额。

opts.t: When the total sum of qualifying non-refundable tax credit amounts exceeds the federal first bracket threshold of $58,523.
opts.w: 正确。根据第二节第 2.2 小节规定，Top-Up Tax Credit（ITA s.118(11)）是 2026 税年新增的关键补丁，其唯一触发条件是纳税人当年全部合资格非退还抵免额的总和超过第一档联邦税阶门槛（2026 税年为 $58,523）。当抵免总额超出门槛时，抵免率从 15% 降至 14% 所造成的损失大于降税带来的利益，税法通过公式对超出门槛部分的抵免额按约 1%（14% × 7.14% ＝ 0.9996%）进行补足，确保纳税人保留原 15% 的抵免价值。

opts.t: Exclusively when the taxpayer resides in British Columbia where the provincial basic credit rate was raised to 5.60%.
opts.w: 错误。第四节明确指出，Top-Up 补丁仅在联邦层面（ITA Part I）存在，BC 省由于并未降低最低税阶，根本没有设立任何省侧 Top-Up 补丁。

main.pt: 基本个人额与配偶额递减测算
main.trap: 配偶没工作即报满配偶额
main.stem: In 2026, Kevin had a net income of $85,000. His spouse, Brenda, had zero employment earnings from any job during 2026, but received $6,452 in taxable investment dividends and interest. Under 2026 tax year federal rules, what is the maximum spouse or common-law partner amount (Line 30300) Kevin is entitled to claim on Schedule 5?
main.zh: 2026 年，凯文（Kevin）全年净收入为 $85,000。其配偶布伦达（Brenda）在 2026 年内没有任何受雇工作薪资，但获得了 $6,452 的应税投资分红与利息。根据 2026 税年联邦规则，凯文有资格在附表 5（Schedule 5）上申报的配偶或同居伴侣额（Line 30300）最高是多少？

opts.t: $10,000, calculated as the maximum base entitlement of $16,452 reduced dollar-for-dollar by Brenda's net income of $6,452.
opts.w: 正确。第 2.4 节：凯文净收入 $85,000 低于 181,440 元，配偶额上限为足额 16,452 元；配偶额按配偶全年净收入（不论薪资还是投资收益）逐元递减：$16,452 − $6,452 = $10,000。

opts.t: $16,452, because Brenda did not earn any active employment income from a job or business.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误以为只有受雇工作薪资才冲减配偶额，落入了「配偶没工作即报满配偶额」的经典陷阱。税法规定按配偶全部净收入（包括投资收入）逐元扣减。

opts.t: $9,253, calculated by subtracting Brenda's net income from the expired 2024 historical maximum of $15,705.
opts.w: 错误。此选项使用了过期的 2024 税年历史基准值 $15,705，未采用 2026 年现行的 $16,452。

opts.t: $0, because any spouse receiving passive investment income exceeding $3,500 is completely disqualified from the credit.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在所谓投资收入超过 $3,500 即全额取消配偶额的门槛，只有当配偶净收入达到或超过上限 $16,452 时，该格才会归零。

main.pt: CPP供款双轨分流申报定性
main.trap: CPP全部供款按同方式抵扣
main.stem: During 2026, Daniel was employed as a financial manager with total earnings of $90,000, which exceeded both the YMPE ($74,600) and YAMPE ($85,000). On his T4 slip, his mandatory contributions were reported as: base CPP of $3,519.45, first enhanced CPP tier of $711.00, and second enhanced CPP tier (CPP2) of $416.00. How must these CPP components be classified and reported on Daniel's 2026 federal T1 return?
main.zh: 2026 年期间，丹尼尔（Daniel）受雇担任财务经理，总受雇收入为 $90,000，同时超过了当年 YMPE（$74,600）与 YAMPE（$85,000）。在其 T4 表上，法规划扣款项显示为：基础 CPP 供款 $3,519.45、第一层增强 CPP 供款 $711.00、以及第二层增强 CPP2 供款 $416.00。在丹尼尔的 2026 年联邦 T1 报税表上，这三笔 CPP 供款应如何归类申报？

opts.t: The entire combined sum of $4,646.45 is reported as a non-refundable tax credit on Line 30800.
opts.w: 错误。将全部 CPP 供款一概作为非退还抵免申报，完全忽略了自 2019 年及 2024 年改革后增强段改走税前扣除项的重大制度重塑。

opts.t: The entire combined sum of $4,646.45 is reported as an employment expense deduction on Line 22900.
opts.w: 错误。CPP 供款并非雇佣支出（Line 22900），且基础 CPP 供款依法必须走非退还抵免，绝不能全额作为扣除项。

opts.t: $3,519.45 is deducted from net income on Line 20800, while $1,127.00 is claimed as an employment insurance credit on Line 31200.
opts.w: 错误。Line 20800 是 RRSP 扣除行，Line 31200 是就业保险（EI）保费抵免行，混淆了行号性质。

opts.t: $3,519.45 is claimed as a non-refundable tax credit on Line 30800, while $1,127.00 ($711.00 + $416.00) is deducted from total income on Line 22215.
opts.w: 正确。第二节第 2.7 小节深入剖析了 CPP 制度设计的「双轨分流」结构：雇员 4.95% 的基础 CPP 供款（2026 上限 $3,519.45）在 Line 30800 申报为非退还税收抵免（拉平按 14% 折算省税）；而 1.00% 增强第一层（$711.00）与 4.00% 增强第二层 CPP2（$416.00）合计 $1,127.00，在 Line 22215 申报为扣除项（deduction），直接冲减应税收入并按纳税人的边际税率折算节税。

main.pt: 学费自用优先与结转单向门
main.trap: 学费当年不转留待以后转
main.stem: In 2026, Brandon was a full-time university student with $8,000 in qualifying tuition paid (Form T2202). His net employment income was $12,000, and his basic personal amount completely wiped out his federal tax payable to zero. Brandon is deciding whether to transfer his unused tuition to his mother or carry it forward. Which statutory rule strictly governs Brandon's decision regarding the transfer and carry-forward of his 2026 tuition fees?
main.zh: 2026 年，布兰登（Brandon）是一名全日制大学生，支付了 $8,000 的合资格学费（Form T2202）。其净受雇收入为 $12,000，其基本个人金额已完全将其当期联邦应缴税款降为零。布兰登正在考虑是将未使用的学费转让给母亲，还是结转至未来年度。哪项税法刚性规则严格约束了布兰登关于 2026 年学费转让与结转的决定？

opts.t: Brandon can carry forward the entire $8,000 now and elect to transfer up to $5,000 of this carry-forward balance to his mother in any future tax year.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误以为结转后的学费以后还能转让给父母，落入了「学费当年不转留待以后转」的致命单向门陷阱。税法明确规定一旦结转，终身不可再转。

opts.t: He may transfer up to $5,000 to his mother for 2026; the other $3,000 carries forward and can never be transferred later.
opts.w: 正确。第二节第 2.9 小节与第六节案例三阐明了学费的三大硬规则：第一，优先自用（布兰登税额已被 BPA 清零，故自用额为 $0）；第二，当年联邦法定转移上限为 $5,000，且受让人仅限配偶或父母/祖父母，须在 T2202 背面签署指定；第三，单向门机制——当年未转让而结转至未来的学费（$3,000），终身永久锁定为学生本人自用，未来任何年份均严禁再转让给任何人。

opts.t: Brandon is entitled to transfer the entire $8,000 to his mother in 2026 because tuition transfers have no statutory dollar ceiling.
opts.w: 错误。联邦学费转让拥有严格的每年 $5,000 法定上限（该限额从未指数化），不可全额转让 $8,000。

opts.t: Because Brandon earned $12,000, he is legally mandated to convert all $8,000 of tuition into a deduction against line 23600 net income.
opts.w: 错误。学费（Line 32300）是 T1 第五步的非退还税收抵免，绝非降低第 3 步净收入的扣除项。

main.pt: 残障额核准与未成年补充冲减
main.trap: 残障额需事前核准与冲减
main.stem: In 2026, George and Martha's 12-year-old son, Peter, had a valid Form T2201 (Disability Tax Credit Certificate) on file and approved by CRA. On their 2026 return, they claimed Peter's base disability amount of $10,341. In addition, George claimed $6,000 of qualifying child care expenses paid for Peter as a child care deduction on Line 21400. After the $6,000 child care deduction, what is Peter's supplemental disability amount for children (2026 maximum $6,032) on Line 31600?
main.zh: 2026 年，乔治与玛莎（George and Martha）12 岁的儿子彼得（Peter）已在 CRA 备有经官方正式核准有效的 Form T2201（残障税收抵免证明）。在其 2026 年税表上，他们申报了彼得的基础残障额 $10,341。此外，乔治在 Line 21400 申报了为彼得支付的 $6,000 合资格托儿费扣除。申报这 $6,000 托儿费后，彼得在 Line 31600 的未成年残障补充额（2026 年最高 $6,032）还剩多少？

opts.t: $3,565, the supplement less child care above $3,533
$6,032, as the two claims are calculated separately
opts.w: 错误。两格各算各的，漏了冲减。

opts.t: $2,467, the child care above the $3,533 threshold
opts.w: 错误。把冲减额当成了剩余额：$6,000 − $3,533 = $2,467 是要减掉的部分，补充额还剩 $3,565。

opts.t: $5,192, after cutting 14% of the child care
opts.w: 错误。按抵免率 14% 比例折减（$6,000 的 14% 从 $6,032 里扣掉）会得到 $5,192；冲减是逐元扣额度，不按 14%。

main.pt: 无障碍改造禁与医疗费双报
main.trap: 新规下改造与医疗费双报
main.stem: In July 2026, Arthur, a 68-year-old homeowner, paid $18,000 to construct an exterior wheelchair ramp and zero-threshold shower (goods acquired and services performed entirely in 2026). This expenditure meets the qualifying criteria for both the Home Accessibility Tax Credit (HATC, Line 31285) and the Medical Expense Tax Credit (METC, Line 33099). How must Arthur report this $18,000 expenditure on his 2026 federal T1 return under Bill C-15?
