Samantha did not experience any of the nine statutory life event exceptions. How is the $45,000 profit treated under the federal residential property flipping rule (ITA s.12(12)–(14))?
main.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Samantha 在维多利亚购入了一套住宅出租公寓作为投资。她立即将其投入长期租赁市场，租给了一名非关联租客。2026 年 11 月，在持有该房产连续满 240 天后，Samantha 收到了一位买家主动提出的一份高价要约，并以 $45,000 的净利润将该公寓售出。Samantha 并未遭遇九大免责法定生活事件中的任何一项。根据联邦住宅翻炒规则（ITA s.12(12)–(14)），这笔 $45,000 的利润应如何处理？

opts.t: The entire $45,000 is deemed to be business income, fully taxable at 100% ordinary rates, without entitlement to the 50% capital gains inclusion rate.
opts.w: 正确。根据《所得税法》第 12(12)–(14) 条的住宅物业翻炒规则 (flipped property rule)，持有不足 365 连续天的住宅处置利得视同经营收入 (business income)，100% 全额计税，不能享受资本利得 1/2（50%）的纳入率。极其重要的考点是：翻炒规则不仅适用于自住房，纯出租用途的住宅物业同样受其约束；由于 Samantha 持有仅 240 天且无生活事件例外，利润全额视同经营收入。

opts.t: The profit is treated as a regular capital gain eligible for the 50% inclusion rate ($22,500 taxable), because the flipping rule exclusively targets owner-occupied principal residences.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了“翻炒规则只管自住房”的典型认知陷阱。税法明确将住宅性质的出租物业同样纳入翻炒规则约束范围。

opts.t: The profit is completely exempt from income tax because Samantha rented the condo under a genuine residential tenancy agreement.
opts.w: 错误。真实出租并不能豁免联邦 365 天翻炒规则，只有税法列明的九大生活事件（如死亡、残疾、工作调动等）才能豁免。

opts.t: The profit is split evenly: $22,500 as business income and $22,500 as an exempt capital gain under the short-term investor concession.
opts.w: 错误。翻炒规则没有减半或对半分摊的规定，一旦触发，整笔收益全额视同经营收入。

main.pt: BC投机空置税与联邦双轨
main.trap: 误以为获得 BC 投机空置税出租豁免就无需报联邦税
main.stem: Victor, a Canadian citizen residing in Vancouver, owns a secondary residential condominium in Richmond. In the 2026 calendar year, he leased the condo to an arm's length tenant under a formal written residential tenancy agreement for 8 continuous months, collecting $18,000 in gross rental income. Victor applied for and successfully obtained the provincial tenancy exemption from the BC Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT). What are Victor's tax reporting obligations for the 2026 tax year?
main.zh: Victor 是一名居住在温哥华的加拿大公民，他在列治文拥有第二套住宅公寓。在 2026 自然年内，他依据正式书面租约将该公寓出租给一名非关联租客长达连续 8 个月，收取了 $18,000 的总租金收入。Victor 申请并成功获得了 BC 省投机与空置税 (SVT) 的省级出租豁免。Victor 在 2026 税年还有哪些报税义务？

opts.t: Victor has no further tax obligations; obtaining the provincial tenancy exemption legally establishes that the rental income is exempt from federal taxation.
opts.w: 错误。掉入了将省级空置税豁免与联邦所得税混同的严重误区。省级财产税的免税不代表联邦所得免税。

opts.t: Victor is exempt from paying the 1% BC SVT, but he remains legally required to report the $18,000 gross rental income and claim eligible expenses on Form T776 on his federal T1 return.
opts.w: 正确。BC 省投机与空置税 (Speculation and Vacancy Tax, SVT) 是省级财产税，与联邦个人所得税是完全独立并行的两套制度。Victor 满足了自然年出租满 6 个月的条件，成功豁免了 2026 年针对加拿大公民的 1% SVT；但只要取得了租金收入，联邦层面的 T776 出租收入申报义务（总收入 Line 12599、净收入 Line 12600）完全不受影响，必须如实申报。

opts.t: Victor must pay the 3% foreign owner SVT rate because Richmond properties are disqualified from the tenancy exemption, but he is exempt from federal T776 filing.
opts.w: 错误。Victor 是加拿大公民，且列治文完全适用 SVT 出租豁免；同时联邦申报绝不能免除。

opts.t: Victor may elect to pay the 1% BC SVT in lieu of filing federal Form T776, reducing his CRA audit exposure.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在以缴纳省级财产税来替代联邦所得税申报的选举权利，两者法律依据不同，必须依法独立履行。

main.pt: 主居所比例公式计算
main.trap: 未计入加一年或误算持有年数
main.stem: Elena bought a townhouse in 2017 for $400,000 and sold it in 2026 for $700,000 with no selling expenses (total gain: $300,000). She owned it for 10 tax years (2017 to 2026). Her family lived in it every year, but she designated it as her principal residence only for 2017 through 2021; for 2022 through 2026 she designated a cottage she also owned (one designation per family per year). She was a Canadian resident throughout. What is her taxable capital gain on the townhouse for 2026?
main.zh: Elena 2017 年以 $400,000 买入一套联排，2026 年以 $700,000 卖出，无出售费用（利得总额 $300,000），共持有 10 个纳税年度（2017 至 2026）。全家每年都住在这里，但她只把 2017 至 2021 年指定给这套联排；2022 至 2026 年她把主居所指定给自己的另一处度假屋（每家庭每年只能指定一处）。她一直是加拿大居民。这套联排 2026 年的应税资本利得是多少？

opts.w: 错误。免税按年数比例给：只有指定给这套联排的年份（加一年）才进分子，指定给度假屋的年份不算，所以不能全免。
错误。120,000 元是免税后的资本利得，还要乘 ½ 纳入率才是应税资本利得。

main.pt: 主居所申报与迟报罚款
main.trap: 误认自住房不报也能免税
main.stem: Marcus sold his solely-owned home in June 2024 (a year for which the T1 filing due date was April 30, 2025). He had lived in it as his sole principal residence since purchasing it. Believing that 'principal residence sales are never taxed and need not be reported,' he omitted the disposition entirely from his 2024 tax return. In August 2026 (15 complete months after the April 30, 2025 filing deadline), his accountant discovered the omission and submitted a request to CRA to accept a late designation on Form T2091(IND). What is the late-filing penalty prescribed under subsection 220(3.5) of the Income Tax Act?
main.zh: Marcus 于 2024 年 6 月出售了他单独拥有的住房（该纳税年度的 T1 申报截止日为 2025 年 4 月 30 日）。自购买以来，他一直将该房屋作为唯一的主居所居住。因深信“卖自住房免税所以根本不需要报税”的民间说法，他在 2024 年税表中完全没有提及该笔处置。2026 年 8 月（即 2025 年 4 月 30 日申报截止日之后整整 15 个完整月），他的会计师发现了这一疏漏，并向 CRA 提交申请，请求接受在 T2091(IND) 表上的迟做指定。根据《所得税法》第 220(3.5) 款，法定的迟做选择罚款是多少？

opts.w: 正确。s.220(3.5) 的罚款是 8,000 元与「100 元 × 逾期完整月数」两者取低。逾期 15 个完整月，100 × 15 ＝ 1,500 元，低于 8,000 元。
错误。8,000 元是封顶值，只有按月累计达到 80 个月以上才收满；本案 15 个月应取较低的 1,500 元。

opts.t: CAD 0, because genuine principal residences are fully exempt from all reporting penalties
opts.w: 错误。掉入“真自住就不罚款”的误区。2016 年税改后，主居所免税的享受以主动申报并指定为法定前置要件；忘记申报后补做指定属于税法特许程序，必须承担 s.220(3.5) 罚款。

opts.t: 5% of the total capital gain realized on the sale
opts.w: 错误。混淆了主居所迟做选举罚款与普通 T1 欠税迟报罚金（late-filing penalty）。主居所迟做指定适用法定的月度固定额计算规则（$100/月），与房产增值幅度完全无关。

main.pt: 45(2)选举与四年延展限制
main.trap: 出租期间计提折旧破坏选举
main.stem: In 2026, Liam moved out of his downtown condo that he had occupied as his principal residence since 2020, and began renting it out entirely to arm's length tenants. To defer the deemed disposition under subsection 45(1) and preserve his principal residence exemption, Liam files an election under subsection 45(2) with his 2026 income tax return. Which of the following conditions must Liam strictly satisfy to maintain the validity of this election and claim the maximum 4-year exemption extension?
main.zh: 2026 年，Liam 搬出了自 2020 年起一直作为主居所居住的市区公寓，并将其整套出租给非关联租客。为了推迟《所得税法》第 45(1) 条规定的视同处置并保留主居所免税资格，Liam 在其 2026 年个人所得税税表中随附了第 45(2) 条选举信。Liam 必须严格满足下列哪项条件，才能维持该选举的有效性并享有最长 4 年的主居所免税延展？

opts.t: He must continue to physically reside in the condo for at least 30 days during each rental year.
opts.w: 错误。45(2) 选举制度的立法初衷就是允许纳税人在人已经完全搬出、不住在里面的情况下，依 ITA s.54(b) 仍将该房产合法指定为主居所，不要求每年返回居住 30 天。

opts.t: He may not claim CCA on the condo while the election applies, nor designate another property for those years.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.45(2) 及 s.54 主居所定义，做 45(2) 选举的硬性代价是在选举有效期间严禁对该房产申报任何资本成本折旧 (capital cost allowance, CCA)；同时，由于每家庭每年只能指定一处主居所，在享受 45(2) 延展的最多 4 年期间，纳税人不得将其他任何房产指定为主居所。

opts.t: He must re-file the election letter annually with each subsequent year's T1 return until the property is sold.
opts.w: 错误。45(2) 选举信只需在改变用途当年（即 2026 税年）的税表中提交一次即可，后续年份无需年年重复提交信件。

opts.t: He must ensure that the rental income generated each year does not exceed 50% of his total net employment income.
opts.w: 错误。税法第 45(2) 条对租金收入绝对金额或占总收入比例没有任何限制要求。

main.pt: 45(3)选举时限与先决条件
main.trap: 将45(3)选举期限简单记为卖房年
main.stem: In 2022, Kevin purchased a residential townhouse as a pure rental investment and earned rental income, but he never claimed any capital cost allowance (CCA). In July 2026, Kevin ceased renting the townhouse and moved into it as his personal home. He plans to make an election under subsection 45(3) of the Income Tax Act to defer the deemed disposition and designate up to 4 prior years as principal residence years. According to the Income Tax Act, when must Kevin submit this election letter, and what would invalidate it?
main.zh: 2022 年，Kevin 购买了一套联排作为纯出租投资并赚取租金，但他从未申报过任何资本成本折旧 (CCA)。2026 年 7 月，Kevin 停止出租并搬入该联排作为个人住所自住。他计划根据《所得税法》第 45(3) 款做出选举，以推迟视同处置并将入住前最多 4 年指定为主居所年份。根据《所得税法》，Kevin 最晚必须在何时提交该选举信？且什么情形会导致该选举彻底失效？

opts.t: He must file it with his 2026 T1 return; it is invalidated if he sells the townhouse within 365 days.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了 45(2) 与 45(3)。45(2) 是自住转出租当年随 T1 提交，而 45(3) 是出租转自住，法条规定最晚可推迟至实际出售物业那一年（或 CRA 提出要求后 90 天）提交，并非改变用途当年必须提交。

opts.t: He must file it strictly on the filing deadline of the year the property was acquired; it is invalidated if he claims moving expenses.
opts.w: 错误。购房年份完全无法预知未来是否转为自住，根本不可能在取得年提交；申报搬家费与 45(3) 选举的有效性无关。

opts.t: He must file it within 30 days of moving in; it is invalidated if his spouse owns any registered accounts.
opts.w: 错误。税法中不存在 30 天内提交 45(3) 的规定；配偶是否拥有注册账户与该选举毫无关联。

opts.t: By the earlier of 90 days after a CRA request or the filing due date for the sale year; any prior CCA voids it.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.45(3)(a)，该选举信的法定截止期限为“CRA 发出书面要求后 90 天”与“最终实际处置房产那一年的纳税申报截止日”两者中较早的那个；根据 s.45(4)，若在改变用途之前任何一年曾对该房产申报过资本成本折旧 (CCA)，该 45(3) 选举直接被法律视为从未做出（deemed never made）。

main.pt: 联邦365天翻炒与楼花转让
main.trap: 误以为楼花未交付就不算翻炒
main.stem: In March 2025, Lucas entered into a presale purchase agreement for a condominium unit in Vancouver and paid the required deposit. In December 2025 (270 days after signing the contract), prior to building completion and possession, Lucas assigned his rights under the purchase contract to another buyer, realizing a net profit of $60,000. Lucas did not experience any of the nine statutory life event exceptions. Under the federal residential property flipping rule (ITA s.12(12)–(14)), how must this $60,000 gain be treated on Lucas's tax return?
main.zh: 2025 年 3 月，Lucas 签署了温哥华一套公寓的预售合同（楼花）并支付了定金。2025 年 12 月（签合同后第 270 天），在房屋竣工交付之前，Lucas 将购房合同项下的权利转让（assignment）给另一位买家，实现净利润 $60,000。Lucas 并未发生九项法定生活事件中的任何一项。根据联邦住宅物业翻炒规则（ITA s.12(12)–(14)），这笔 $60,000 的利得在 Lucas 的税表上必须如何处理？

opts.t: As a capital gain eligible for the 50% inclusion rate and reported on Schedule 3 line 13800.
opts.w: 错误。持有期不足 365 连续日且无豁免的处置被翻炒规则完全剔除出资本利得区间，不得享受 50% 纳入率，也不能报在 Schedule 3 上。

opts.t: Fully included as business income on Form T2125 with no capital gains inclusion rate and ineligible for the principal residence exemption.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.12(12)–(14)，翻炒房规则的适用标的明确包含“取得加拿大住宅单元的权利”（right to acquire a housing unit，即预售楼花转让合同）。Lucas 持有该权利仅 270 天（不足 365 连续日）且无生活事件例外，其全部利得被强制视同经营收入 (business income)，100% 进应税收入，申报在 T2125 表上，且无法主张主居所免税。

opts.t: Fully exempt from tax because a presale contract is an intangible right rather than a completed physical housing unit.
opts.w: 错误。掉入“楼花不是房子、没交房没收钥匙就不算卖房”的陷阱。税法条文 s.12(13)(a)(ii) 明确将预售合同权利列为翻炒房法定标的。

opts.t: Treated as taxable capital gain, but permitted to deduct a statutory $20,000 primary residence deduction against the federal gain.
opts.w: 错误。$20,000 的主要居所扣除是 BC 省翻炒税独有的概念，联邦所得税根本没有该项扣除；且预售合同转让从未实际居住，即使在 BC 省也无法享受主要居所扣除。

main.pt: 联邦翻炒生活事件例外条件
main.trap: 联邦合格搬迁境内限制误区
main.stem: Grace purchased a home in Burnaby in September 2025. In April 2026 (holding period: 215 days), Grace accepted a new permanent engineering job offer in Seattle, Washington, USA. To relocate for her new employment, she sold her Burnaby home at a gain of $50,000. Her new residence in Seattle is over 200 kilometers closer to her new work location than her Burnaby home was. Which of the following statements correctly describes the application of the federal residential property flipping rule to Grace?
main.zh: Grace 于 2025 年 9 月在温哥华本拿比购入一套住宅。2026 年 4 月（持有期：215 天），Grace 接受了美国华盛顿州西雅图的一份全职工程师职位。为了搬迁就职，她以 $50,000 的利得出售了本拿比的住房。她在西雅图的新住处比本拿比旧居距离新工作地点近了 200 多公里。下列哪项陈述正确描述了联邦住宅物业翻炒规则对 Grace 的适用情况？

opts.t: The flipping rule applies because the eligible relocation exception strictly requires both the old residence and the new workplace to be located within Canada.
opts.w: 错误。这是常规合格搬迁与翻炒例外之间的重大考点。ITA s.12(13)(b)(vi) 在翻炒生活事件例外中，明确豁免了搬迁费扣除规则中“新工作地点与新居必须在加拿大境内”的要求。

opts.t: The flipping rule applies because voluntary job changes never qualify under any of the nine life event exceptions.
opts.w: 错误。主动更换工作只要满足合格搬迁（eligible relocation，新居比旧居离新工作地近至少 40 公里）即属于法定九项生活事件之一，并不限于被动裁员。

opts.t: It is exempt under the eligible relocation exception, which here drops the rule that the new work location be in Canada.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.12(13)(b)(vi)，因就业或就学发生的合格搬迁（eligible relocation，距离缩短至少 40 公里）属于九项生活事件例外之一；且法条特别明确在此处不适用“新工作地点与新居须在加拿大境内”的通常限制。Grace 迁往美国西雅图就职完全符合该例外，不落入翻炒规则，其利得按资本利得处理并可主张主居所免税。

opts.t: Grace must pay a 20% flat penalty tax under federal rules because her holding period was under 365 days regardless of relocation.
opts.w: 错误。20% 税率是 BC 省翻炒税的规则，并非联邦所得税规则；且符合生活事件例外时并不征收惩罚税。

main.pt: BC翻炒税与联邦规则差异
main.trap: 将联邦自动豁免误套用于BC省
main.stem: In May 2025, a homeowner purchased a single-family house in Surrey, BC, and occupied it as their primary residence. In July 2026 (holding period: 425 continuous days), the homeowner sold the property for a profit of $80,000. When preparing the 2026 tax filings, which of the following statements correctly reflects the treatment under the BC Home Flipping Tax compared to federal rules?
main.zh: 2025 年 5 月，一位房主在 BC 省素里购入一套独立屋并作为主要居所自住。2026 年 7 月（持有期：连续 425 天），该房主以 $80,000 的利润出售了该房产。在准备 2026 年税表时，下列哪项陈述正确反映了《BC 省住宅物业短期持有利润税法》相比于联邦所得税规则的处理要求？

opts.t: BC flipping tax applies under 730 days, but the BC primary residence deduction (up to CAD 20,000) is allowed after 365 days.
opts.w: 正确。联邦：持有 425 天已超过 365 天，不触发联邦翻炒规则。BC：门槛 730 天，425 天仍应税（递减税率）；作为主要居所且持有满 365 天，可减最高 20,000 元的主要居所扣除。

opts.t: The sale is subject to federal flipping rules because the holding period is under 730 days, reclassifying the entire gain as business income.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了管辖权与门槛。联邦翻炒规则门槛为 365 天，425 天已脱离联邦翻炒范围，联邦利得仍为资本利得；730 天是 BC 省独立法案的门槛。

opts.t: The homeowner cannot claim the BC primary residence deduction because that deduction is strictly reserved for properties held for under 365 days.
opts.w: 错误。把门槛完全记反了。BC 省主要居所扣除恰恰要求持有满 365 天以上才给，不足 365 天的高税率持有者反而不享有该项扣除。

opts.t: No BC return is required because under the 2024 tax-year exam benchmark and current rules, provincial flipping rules are administered automatically through federal Schedule 3.
opts.w: 错误。虽然 2024 税年考试口径定稿时 BC 翻炒税尚未开征（考试口径覆盖为零），但在 2026 现行税法下，BC 翻炒税是一部完全独立的省级税法，既不通过联邦 Schedule 3 管理，也不与联邦税合并，处置后 90 天内必须向 BC 财政厅独立交表申报。

main.pt: 事实居民与视同居民判定顺序
main.trap: 视同居民与事实居民顺序倒置
main.stem: Chloe, an international IT specialist from France, arrived in Vancouver on March 1, 2026 on a two-year work permit. She immediately signed a 12-month residential apartment lease, enrolled in the BC Medical Services Plan (MSP), and opened Canadian bank accounts. During the 2026 calendar year, Chloe stayed physically present in Canada for 306 days. How should Chloe's residency status and Canadian tax liability be determined for the 2026 tax year?
main.zh: 来自法国的国际 IT 专家 Chloe 于 2026 年 3 月 1 日持两年工签抵达温哥华。她随即签署了为期 12 个月的住宅公寓租约，办理了 BC 省医疗保险 (MSP)，并开设了加拿大银行账户。在 2026 日历年中，Chloe 在加拿大境内实际居留了 306 天。对于 2026 税年，Chloe 的税务居民身份及加拿大纳税义务应如何认定？

opts.t: She is a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1)(a) because she stayed over 183 days; therefore, she must pay federal tax on her worldwide income for the entire year plus a 48% federal surtax in lieu of provincial tax.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的“倒置判定顺序”陷阱。根据 CRA Income Tax Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.30，ITA s.250(1)(a) 的 183 天逗留视同居民规则仅在确认个人不是事实居民（factual resident）的前提下才适用。Chloe 拥有住所和省医保，已构成事实居民，绝不能适用视同居民。

opts.t: She is a factual resident (part-year resident) from March 1, 2026 because she established significant and secondary residential ties; she is taxed on worldwide income only from March 1 onward and pays BC provincial tax.
opts.w: 正确。根据最高法院 Thomson 案判例及 ITA s.250(3)，判定居民身份必须先考察事实居住联系（residential ties）。Chloe 租住公寓（重大联系）、办理 BC 省医保及开设银行账户（次要联系），自 2026 年 3 月 1 日入境起即建立起通常居住关系，属于部分年度事实居民 (factual resident/part-year resident)。她只需就 3 月 1 日至年末期间的全球收入向加拿大纳税，按 12 月 31 日居住省缴纳 BC 省税，并享有省级抵免。

opts.t: She remains a non-resident for the entire 2026 tax year because temporary work permit holders cannot acquire factual tax residency until permanent resident status is granted.
opts.w: 错误。这是“混淆移民身份与税务居民身份”陷阱。加拿大税法实行事实居住原则而非国籍或移民签证原则（ITA s.2(1)），工签持有人只要建立居住联系，第一天起即可成为事实税务居民。

opts.t: She is a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1)(a), which allows her to claim full BC provincial tax credits while excluding all Canadian employment income earned prior to March 1.
opts.w: 错误。视同居民不仅适用前提错误，而且法律后果也完全相反：视同居民按全年的全球收入纳税，且因不属于任何省份而无法享受省税抵免，须加征 48% 联邦附加税。

main.pt: 首年基本个人额天数折算与税率
main.trap: 首年基本个人额按全额申报
main.stem: Marcus landed in Vancouver as a permanent resident on May 15, 2026 and established immediate factual residency. For the 2026 tax year, Marcus earned $65,000 from Canadian employment between May 15 and December 31, with no income before landing. Under the 2026 tax-year rules stated in the lecture, what is the maximum basic personal amount (BPA) Marcus can claim on line 30000 of his federal T1 return, and what is its actual federal tax credit value?
main.zh: Marcus 于 2026 年 5 月 15 日作为永久居民登陆温哥华并立即建立了事实居住联系。在 2026 税年中，Marcus 于 5 月 15 日至 12 月 31 日期间获得加拿大受雇收入 $65,000，登陆前无收入。根据讲义中明确的 2026 税年规则，Marcus 在联邦 T1 税表第 30000 行可申报的最高基本个人额 (BPA) 是多少，该额度对应的实际联邦税收抵免价值是多少？

opts.t: BPA of $16,452, yielding a tax credit value of $2,467.80 calculated at the 15% credit rate.
opts.w: 错误。此选项犯了三重错误：第一，直接填报了全年全额 $16,452，忽略了首年部分年度居民必须按天数打折；第二，使用了过时的 15% 抵免率（2024 口径），而 2026 税年联邦最低税阶及抵免率已降至 14%；第三，得出的税额严重高估。

opts.t: BPA of $15,705, yielding a tax credit value of $2,355.75 calculated at the 15% credit rate.
opts.w: 错误。此选项使用的是 2024 税年的考试口径数字（$15,705 与 15%），既未采用 2026 现行数字，也未按居民天数比例折算。

opts.t: BPA of $10,412.09, yielding a tax credit value of $1,457.69 calculated at the 2026 credit rate of 14%.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.118.91(b)(ii) 及 CRA 规则，部分年度居民的额度型抵免须按居民天数比例折算。2026 年为平年（365 天），5 月 15 日至 12 月 31 日共计 231 天。2026 税年联邦基本个人额上限为 $16,452，因此第 30000 行可申报金额为 $16,452 × 231 ÷ 365 = $10,412.09。2026 税年联邦最低税阶抵免率已降至 14%，实际联邦抵税价值为 $10,412.09 × 14% = $1,457.69。

opts.t: BPA of $10,412.09, yielding a tax credit value of $1,561.81 calculated at the 15% credit rate.
opts.w: 错误。虽然按天数正确折算出了 $10,412.09，但错误地乘上了 2024 税年的 15% 抵免率。2026 税年法定抵免率已降为 14%（抵税价值为 $1,457.69）。

main.pt: 视同取得与T1135申报门槛
main.trap: 用原始购入价判定 T1135 门槛与利得
main.stem: Victor immigrated to Canada on June 1, 2026. On his landing date, he owned foreign investment shares purchased years ago for $70,000 CAD equivalent, which had a fair market value (FMV) of $140,000 CAD on June 1, 2026. He also owned a condominium in his home country used exclusively as his personal vacation home (FMV $300,000 CAD). During 2026 and 2027, he made no sales or new purchases. Under the Income Tax Act, how are Victor's foreign reporting obligations (Form T1135) determined for the 2026 and 2027 tax years?
main.zh: Victor 于 2026 年 6 月 1 日移民加拿大。在登陆当天，他名下持有多年前以等值 $70,000 加元购入的境外投资股票，该股票在 2026 年 6 月 1 日当天的公允市值 (FMV) 为等值 $140,000 加元。此外，他还在原国拥有一套完全供个人度假自住的公寓（FMV 等值 $300,000 加元）。在 2026 与 2027 年期间，他未发生任何买卖。根据《所得税法》，Victor 在 2026 和 2027 税年的境外资产申报义务 (Form T1135) 应如何确定？

opts.t: Exempt for 2026 as a first-year resident; for 2027 he must file, since the shares' stepped-up $140,000 cost exceeds $100,000.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.233.7，首次成为加拿大税务居民的个人在首个税年（2026）完全豁免提交 Form T1135。根据 ITA s.128.1(1)(c)，Victor 境外资产的成本基础（cost amount）在登陆当天视同按公允市值（FMV）重新取得，因此股票的新成本基础被抬高至 $140,000（而非原始买入价 $70,000）。自用房产（personal-use property）依法排除在指定境外财产之外。因此到第二年（2027），股票成本额 $140,000 超过了 $100,000 门槛，Victor 必须在 2027 税年申报 T1135。

opts.t: He must file Form T1135 for both 2026 and 2027 because the combined fair market value of his foreign shares and foreign condominium ($440,000) exceeds the $100,000 threshold at all times.
opts.w: 错误。此选项犯了两项严重错误：第一，忽略了首年豁免（ITA s.233.7）；第二，误将自用房产（personal-use property）计入指定境外财产，且误按市值而非税收成本额（cost amount）判定。

opts.t: He is permanently exempt from Form T1135 as long as he does not remit any investment income or capital proceeds back into Canadian bank accounts.
opts.w: 错误。T1135 是法定信息申报表，只要成本额在年内任何时点超过 $100,000 即有硬性申报义务，与资金是否汇入加拿大完全无关。

opts.t: He is exempt for 2026, and also exempt for 2027 because the historical cost of his investment shares is only $70,000, which is below the statutory $100,000 threshold.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的“用原始购入价判定 T1135 门槛”陷阱。新移民成为居民时受 ITA s.128.1 视同取得规则约束，税法成本被重置为登陆日市值 $140,000，必须用 $140,000 判定门槛。

main.pt: 新移民福利申请与SOI规则
main.trap: 误以为报税会自动追补 CGEB 且拒报 SOI
main.stem: The Zhang family landed in British Columbia as permanent residents in June 2026. They did not submit Form RC151 or Form RC66 upon arrival. In April 2027, while preparing their first Canadian tax return, Mr. Zhang inquires whether filing the 2026 T1 will automatically disburse retroactive Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit (CGEB) payments for the quarters prior to filing, and expresses concern that reporting their pre-landing world income on the Statement of Income (SOI) will trigger Canadian income tax. What is the correct advice?
main.zh: 张先生一家于 2026 年 6 月作为永久居民登陆 BC 省。他们在抵加时未提交 RC151 表或 RC66 表。2027 年 4 月在准备第一份加拿大税表时，张先生咨询：申报 2026 年 T1 税表是否会自动补发报税前已错过季度的加拿大日用品补贴 (CGEB)；同时他担忧在登陆前收入声明 (SOI) 中填报抵加前全球收入会导致加拿大对其追征所得税。正确的税务指导是什么？

opts.t: The T1 tax return automatically calculates and retroactively issues all missed CGEB quarters from their landing date, and SOI income is taxed at the lowest 14% federal rate.
opts.w: 错误。CGEB（原 GST/HST 补贴）要求新居民主动提交申请表，报税绝不会自动追补未申请的过往季度；且 SOI 填报的登陆前收入完全不属于加拿大征税范围。

opts.t: Newcomers cannot receive any CGEB or CCB payments until they have filed at least two consecutive annual Canadian tax returns, regardless of application forms.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 明确规定新居民符合条件的抵加后即可立即申请福利，永久居民完全无需等待报税或居留满两年。

opts.t: Filing the T1 will automatically trigger CGEB back-payments, but pre-landing income reported on the SOI is fully taxable unless protected by a bilateral tax treaty.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的“将 SOI 误认为应税收入”陷阱。CRA 官方明确重申：登陆前在境外赚取的收入无需在加拿大交税，SOI 仅作为核定福利发放金额的门槛计算基准。

opts.t: CGEB needs an RC151 or RC66 application and missed quarters are not back-paid on filing; SOI income is used only for benefits, not taxed.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA 新居民指南及实务规程，新居民必须主动提交 RC151（无子女）或 RC66（有未成年子女）申请 CGEB；若落地后未提交，报税不会自动追补此前未申请季度的款项。同时，登陆前最多两年的全球收入声明（SOI）纯粹用于计算福利额度的家庭净收入递减，CRA 明确规定该笔收入绝不计入加拿大应税收入，不用缴纳任何加拿大所得税。

main.pt: 非居民期抵免与90%规则
main.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
main.stem: Raymond immigrated to Canada on October 1, 2026. During the non-resident period from January 1 to September 30, 2026, Raymond earned $60,000 CAD from remote consulting services provided to a Canadian company (Canadian-source income) and $3,000 CAD in foreign bank interest. On his 2026 Canadian T1 return, can Raymond claim non-refundable tax credits for the pre-landing non-resident period under ITA section 118.94?
main.zh: Raymond 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日移民加拿大。在 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日的非居民期间，Raymond 从为一家加拿大公司提供远程咨询服务中赚取了 $60,000 加元（加拿大来源收入），以及 $3,000 加元的境外银行利息。在 2026 年加拿大 T1 税表上，Raymond 能否依据《所得税法》第 118.94 条为其登陆前的非居民期申报非退还税收抵免？

opts.t: Yes; Canadian-source income is more than 90% of his net world income for that period, so he may claim them, attaching a statement.
opts.w: 正确。s.118.94 的标准是「全部或几乎全部」，CRA 按 90% 执行。非居民期加拿大来源收入 60,000 元，占该期净全球收入 63,000 元的约百分之九十五，超过 90%，可就该期全额申报额度型抵免；纸质申报要附非居民期境内外收入说明。

opts.t: No, because non-refundable tax credits can never be claimed by any taxpayer for any period prior to physical landing under any circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。ITA s.118.94 明确为满足“全部或几乎全部”（90%）门槛的纳税人保留了申报非居民期抵免的法定权利。

opts.t: Yes, but only if he agrees to subject his pre-landing foreign bank interest ($3,000) to Canadian income tax at the top marginal rate.
opts.w: 错误。非居民期间的境外被动收入依法完全不受加拿大管辖，不需要也不应当在加拿大纳税。

opts.t: No, because the 90% rule is strictly evaluated against the taxpayer's entire calendar-year worldwide income rather than the non-resident period income.
opts.w: 错误。90% 规则的分母明确限定为“非居民期那一段时间内的全球净收入”（net worldwide income for that non-resident period），绝非全年收入。

main.pt: 临时居民申领CCB十八月规则
main.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
main.stem: In April 2026, two families arrived in British Columbia: the Miller family (permanent residents) and the Gupta family (holding temporary closed work permits). Both families have 4-year-old children, established factual residency on arrival, and filed all required applications. Under CRA rules governing the Canada Child Benefit (CCB), when are these two families eligible to begin receiving monthly CCB payments?
main.zh: 2026 年 4 月，两个家庭抵达 BC 省：Miller 一家（永久居民身份）与 Gupta 一家（持有临时封闭式工签）。两个家庭均育有一名 4 岁儿童，抵达时均建立了事实居住联系，并提交了所有必要申请表。根据 CRA 关于加拿大儿童福利 (CCB) 的规定，这两个家庭分别于何时有资格开始领取每月 CCB 款项？

opts.t: Both families must wait 18 continuous months after arrival before becoming eligible for CCB payments.
opts.w: 错误。永久居民与受保护人从建立事实居住联系起即可享受福利，完全没有 18 个月的等待期限制。

opts.t: Both families are immediately eligible to receive monthly CCB payments starting the month following their arrival.
opts.w: 错误。持有临时工作许可或学习许可的临时居民受《所得税法》严格限制，不能落地即领，必须满足 18 个月的居住期门槛。

opts.t: The Millers can receive it right away; the Guptas must first live in Canada 18 months and hold a valid permit in the 19th month.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA 官方指引，永久居民（PR）与受保护人只要成为税务居民并符合监护条件，抵加后即可立即申领 CCB，无任何等待期。而持学签、工签等临时居留许可的个人，必须在加拿大连续居住满 18 个月，且在第 19 个月必须持有有效的居留许可，方可开始领取 CCB 付款。

opts.t: Neither family is eligible for CCB until both parents have filed at least three consecutive Canadian tax returns.
opts.w: 错误。CCB 资格取决于居住身份和事实监护，绝不需要等待连续三年报税后才发放。

main.pt: 离境税务规则与T1161门槛
main.trap: 离境日期判断错误与忽视离境财产清单
main.stem: Ethan and his family emigrated from British Columbia to Singapore in 2027. Ethan physically departed Canada on August 10, 2027; his spouse and children joined him on September 1, 2027; and Ethan officially established tax residency in Singapore on September 15, 2027. On that date, Ethan held Canadian bank cash of $40,000 CAD, an RRSP worth $60,000 CAD, and non-registered Canadian stock shares with a fair market value (FMV) of $55,000 CAD (ACB $30,000 CAD). Under the Income Tax Act rules stated in the lecture, what is Ethan's official departure date and his reporting obligation under Form T1161?
main.zh: Ethan 一家于 2027 年从 BC 省移民至新加坡。Ethan 本人于 2027 年 8 月 10 日离开加拿大；其配偶与子女于 2027 年 9 月 1 日前往汇合；Ethan 于 2027 年 9 月 15 日正式取得新加坡税务居民身份。在离境日，Ethan 名下持有加元银行现金存款 $40,000 加元、价值 $60,000 加元的 RRSP，以及公允市值 (FMV) 为 $55,000 加元（ACB 为 $30,000 加元）的加拿大非注册股票。根据讲义中明确的《所得税法》规则，Ethan 的法定离境日期是哪一天，且他对 Form T1161 的申报义务是什么？

opts.t: His departure date is August 10, 2027, and he is exempt from Form T1161 because his capital gain ($25,000) does not exceed the statutory $25,000 threshold.
opts.w: 错误。离境日期不能简单取本人离开之日，必须取三者中最晚的日期（2027 年 9 月 15 日）；此外，T1161 的 $25,000 门槛考查的是财产公允市值总额而非资本利得。

opts.t: His departure date is September 1, 2027, and he must file Form T1161 reporting all $155,000 of his assets including cash and RRSP.
opts.w: 错误。离境日应为取得新国税籍的 9 月 15 日；且填报 T1161 判定 $25,000 门槛时，加元现金存款和注册退休储蓄计划 (RRSP) 均属于法定先予排除的资产。

opts.t: His departure date is August 10, 2027, and Form T1161 is strictly optional unless requested in writing by the CRA.
opts.w: 错误。日期判定错误，且只要符合条件的财产总市值超过 $25,000，T1161 就是法定强制申报表。

opts.t: September 15, 2027, the latest of the three dates; he must file T1161, as his $55,000 of shares exceed $25,000 once cash and RRSP are excluded.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA 离境税务规则，官方离境日取以下三个日期中最晚者：本人离开日（8月10日）、配偶及受养人离开日（9月1日）、取得新国税务居民日（9月15日），因此离境日为 2027 年 9 月 15 日。根据 Form T1161 申报指引，加元现金存款和规定注册权益（如 RRSP）属于法定排除项；排除后剩余财产（非注册股票市值 $55,000）的公允市值合计超过了 $25,000 门槛，因此 Ethan 必须依法提交 Form T1161。

main.pt: 事实居民与视同居民判定顺序
main.trap: 颠倒判定顺序先数天数
main.stem: Jin, an international graduate student from South Korea, moved to Vancouver in January 2026 to begin a full-time university program. Jin signed a one-year apartment lease, obtained BC Medical Services Plan (MSP) coverage, opened local bank accounts, and was physically present in BC for 330 days in 2026. A tax software prompts Jin to declare as a 'deemed resident under the 183-day rule' and pay the 48% federal surtax. How should Jin's residency status and provincial tax obligations be correctly reported under the Income Tax Act?
main.zh: 来自韩国的国际留学生 Jin 于 2026 年 1 月迁至温哥华攻读全日制大学课程。Jin 签署了一年期公寓租约，办理了 BC 省医疗保险 (MSP)，开设了本地银行账户，并在 2026 年内在 BC 省实际居留了 330 天。某报税软件提示 Jin 申报为“183 天规则下的视同居民”并缴纳 48% 联邦附加税。根据《所得税法》，Jin 的税务居民身份及省税纳税义务应如何正确申报？

opts.t: Jin should file as a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1)(a) because staying 330 days legally triggers automatic deemed residency, requiring payment of the 48% federal surtax in lieu of BC provincial tax.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的“颠倒判定顺序先数天数”陷阱。根据 CRA 解释件，只有确认纳税人不是事实居民的前提下，s.250(1)(a) 的视同居民条款才适用。

opts.t: Jin is a factual resident: the lease, MSP and bank accounts are residential ties, so Jin pays BC tax, not the 48% surtax.
opts.w: 正确。根据最高法院判例及 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1，判定必须严格遵循阶梯顺序：第一步考察居住联系。Jin 租住公寓（重大居住联系）并办了 BC 医保和银行账户（次要联系），属于事实居民（factual resident）。事实居民按 12 月 31 日居住省（BC 省）缴纳省税并享受省级抵免，绝不适用视同居民，也不缴纳 48% 联邦附加税。

opts.t: Jin is considered a non-resident for 2026 because foreign study permit holders are statutorily barred from becoming factual Canadian tax residents.
opts.w: 错误。混淆移民签证身份与税务居民身份。学签持有人只要建立居住联系，第一天起即可成为事实税务居民。

opts.t: Jin is a deemed resident, which allows Jin to claim both full BC provincial tax credits and the 48% federal surtax refund.
opts.w: 错误。视同居民在法律上不属于任何省份，不能申报省抵免，且附加税是应纳税额而非可退税额。

main.pt: 次要联系门槛考试与实务口径差异
main.trap: 机械套用六项次要联系数量门槛
main.stem: For an individual with no significant residential ties in Canada (no home, spouse or dependants), how many secondary ties did the 2024 training-material checklist require to establish residency, and how does that contrast with current CRA practice in Folio S5-F1-C1?
main.zh: 对一位在加拿大没有重大居住联系（无住所、配偶、受养人）的人，2024 年培训材料的判定表要求凑满几项次要联系才定性为居民？这与 CRA 现行 Folio S5-F1-C1 的做法有何不同？

opts.t: The exam checklist requires at least 3 ties, while CRA administrative position requires at least 10 ties.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径并非要求 3 项，CRA 实务中也从未要求 10 项。

opts.t: The exam checklist requires at least 1 tie, while CRA administrative position states that secondary ties can never establish residency under any circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。单独一项次要联系通常不寻常定性，但 CRA 并未否定次要联系定性的法律效力。

opts.t: The 2024 checklist asked for at least 6; current CRA practice sets no number and weighs the ties together.
opts.w: 正确。2024 年培训材料把次要联系写成「至少凑满六项」；CRA 现行解释件没有任何数量门槛，原话是次要联系一般要合起来看（looked at collectively），各项权重不等。本站按现行口径作答，旧的六项门槛只用来认出过期材料。

opts.t: Both the exam checklist and CRA administrative practice strictly enforce a statutory minimum threshold of 8 secondary ties.
opts.w: 错误。无论是考试口径还是 CRA 实务，都不存在 8 项次要联系的门槛。

main.pt: 183天逗留与跨境通勤例外
main.trap: 颠倒判定顺序先数天数
main.stem: Robert resides permanently with his family in Point Roberts, Washington, USA. During 2026, Robert drove across the international border into Delta, BC every business day to work at an engineering firm, returning home to sleep in Washington every evening, completing 225 border crossings. In July 2026, Robert also stayed at a resort hotel in Whistler, BC for a 10-day family vacation (spanning 10 full calendar days). Under ITA s.250(1)(a) and CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.33, how many days did Robert 'sojourn' in Canada during 2026?
main.zh: Robert 与家人永久居住在美国华盛顿州罗伯茨角。在 2026 年，Robert 每个工作日开车跨越国境前往 BC 省三角洲的一家工程公司上班，每天傍晚返回华盛顿州的家中睡觉，累计跨境 225 次。在 2026 年 7 月，Robert 还带着家人在 BC 省惠斯勒的一家度假酒店度假了 10 天（实际跨越 10 个日历日）。根据 ITA s.250(1)(a) 及 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.33，Robert 在 2026 年在加拿大合计“逗留”(sojourn) 了多少天？

opts.t: 10 days: daily commuting sets up no temporary residence and counts as zero, while each vacation day counts.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.33 及讲义第 2.2 节，“逗留”（sojourn）的法律定义是建立临时居所的居留。每天跨境往返上班、当晚回家睡觉的日常通勤者（commuter），即使跨境 225 次，在税法上逗留天数也是零；而为期 10 天的度假在加拿大建立了临时居住状态，含首尾零头天数共计 10 天。因此 Robert 在 2026 年的法定逗留天数仅为 10 天，远未达到 183 天门槛，属于非居民。

opts.t: 235 days (225 commute days + 10 vacation days), because any physical presence in Canada for any part of a day statutorily counts as a full day of sojourning under all circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。机械套用“一天的任何部分算一天”，忽视了通勤日不构成逗留的核心例外。

opts.t: 225 days, because only days spent working count towards the residency test, while personal leisure vacation days are statutorily exempt.
opts.w: 错误。工作通勤不算逗留，度假反而算逗留，方向完全颠倒。

opts.t: 0 days, because US residents are completely exempt from Canadian residency day-counting under the bilateral tax treaty.
opts.w: 错误。税收协定不免除国内法的天数计算，且度假天数已构成事实逗留。

main.pt: 特殊职务视同居民与受养子女门槛
main.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
main.stem: Captain Tremblay, an active member of the Canadian Armed Forces, was stationed abroad at a NATO base in Germany throughout the entire 2026 tax year. Captain Tremblay had no Canadian dwelling during 2026. Living with him in Germany was his 19-year-old dependent son, Felix. During 2026, Felix earned $14,200 CAD in global investment income and part-time wages. Under ITA s.250(1)(b) and s.250(1)(f), and the 2026 tax parameters stated in the lecture, what is the residency status of Captain Tremblay and Felix for the 2026 tax year?
main.zh: Tremblay 上尉是加拿大武装部队现役军人，2026 全年被派驻在德国北约基地工作。Tremblay 上尉在 2026 年内没有在加住所。与其在德国同住的是其 19 岁的受养儿子 Felix。在 2026 年内，Felix 获得了 $14,200 加元的全球投资收益与兼职收入。根据 ITA s.250(1)(b) 及 s.250(1)(f)，以及讲义中明确的 2026 税年参数，Tremblay 上尉与 Felix 在 2026 税年的税务居民身份分别是什么？

opts.t: Both Captain Tremblay and Felix are non-residents of Canada because neither maintained a dwelling place or stayed physically present in Canada during 2026.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了 ITA s.250(1) 对武装部队成员及其受养子女的法定视同居民特别规定。

opts.t: Captain Tremblay is a deemed resident, but Felix is a non-resident because adult dependent children over age 18 can never qualify for deemed residency under s.250(1)(f).
opts.w: 错误。s.250(1)(f) 看的是经济依附与收入门槛，而非以 18 岁为硬性排除条件。

opts.t: Captain Tremblay is a factual resident of BC, while Felix is a deemed non-resident subject to a flat 25% withholding tax.
opts.w: 错误。驻外军人无在加住所应为视同居民，而非事实居民；Felix 也并非视同非居民。

opts.t: Both are deemed residents: he serves in the Armed Forces, and Felix's $14,200 is within the $16,452 BPA.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(1)(b)，加拿大武装部队成员年内任何时候服役均视同加拿大居民；根据 s.250(1)(f)，其受养子女若当年净收入不超过当年的联邦基本个人额（BPA），亦视同居民。在 2026 税年，联邦基本个人额上限为 $16,452。Felix 的全球收入为 $14,200，未超过 $16,452，因此父子二人均为 2026 年的视同居民（deemed residents）。

main.pt: 协定仲裁视同非居民条文效力
main.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
main.stem: Elena, a dual national of Canada and the United Kingdom, owned a condo in Vancouver and a house in London. In 2026, both Canada and the UK claimed Elena as a tax resident under their respective domestic tax laws. Under Article 4 of the Canada-UK bilateral tax treaty, the tie-breaker rules formally assigned Elena's residence to the United Kingdom as of July 1, 2026. What is the statutory effect of this tie-breaker determination under ITA subsection 250(5) on Elena's Canadian tax position?
main.zh: Elena 拥有加拿大和英国双重国籍，在温哥华拥有一套公寓，在伦敦拥有一栋住宅。在 2026 年，加拿大和英国均根据各自国内税法将 Elena 认定为其税务居民。根据加拿大-英国双边税收协定第 4 条，仲裁规则于 2026 年 7 月 1 日正式将 Elena 的居民身份判归英国。根据《所得税法》第 250(5) 条，该协定仲裁结果对 Elena 的加拿大税务地位产生何种法定效力？

opts.t: From July 1, 2026 she is deemed non-resident for all purposes of the Act, triggering departure tax and Part XIII withholding.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(5) 及讲义第 1.1、1.4 与 2.2 节，当税收协定仲裁规则将双重居民判归对方缔约国时，该当事人在加拿大税法上被视同非居民（deemed non-resident）。关键在于条文明确规定其效力是“适用于本法所有条文”（for all purposes of the Act）——这意味着不仅条约限制课税，而且国内法的视同处置离境税（deemed disposition）、Part XIII 预扣税以及 TFSA 非居民供款罚税等从那一刻起全套适用。

opts.t: Elena remains a factual resident for Canadian capital gains purposes, but becomes a non-resident solely for foreign pension reporting.
opts.w: 错误。s.250(5) 是“for all purposes of the Act”（适用于本法全部条文），绝非仅针对特定收入类型的局部调整。

opts.t: Elena is classified as a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1) and must pay the 48% federal surtax on her worldwide UK income.
opts.w: 错误。协定仲裁判归对方国后适用 s.250(5) 视同非居民，而非视同居民。

opts.t: Elena is exempt from Canadian departure tax because tax treaty tie-breaker decisions only apply to employment income earned within Canada.
opts.w: 错误。协定仲裁判给对方国直接触发国内法视同非居民，进而直接触发离境税，绝非免除。

main.pt: 视同居民附加税与卑诗省税负差异
main.trap: 误把视同居民当成省钱通道
main.stem: A junior tax preparer suggests to an international client residing in British Columbia: 'If we structure your status as a deemed resident rather than a BC factual resident for 2026, you will pay no BC provincial tax, saving you significant money.' Under the 2026 tax-year rules and parameters stated in the lecture (federal lowest bracket 14.0%, BC lowest bracket 5.60%, BC basic personal amount $13,216, federal surtax 48%), why is this advice completely flawed?
main.zh: 一位初级报税员向一位居住在卑诗省的国际客户建议：“如果我们将你在 2026 年的身份做成视同居民而非卑诗省事实居民，你将无需缴纳任何卑诗省省税，从而为你节省大笔资金。”根据讲义中明确的 2026 税年规则与参数（联邦最低税阶 14.0%，卑诗最低税阶 5.60%，卑诗基本个人额 $13,216，联邦附加税 48%），为什么该建议是完全荒谬的？

opts.t: Deemed residents must pay double BC provincial tax in addition to the 48% federal surtax.
opts.w: 错误。视同居民在法律上不属于任何省份，对非省内所得不交省税，而非交双倍省税。

opts.t: BC provincial income tax is calculated at a fixed 48% rate, so both statuses result in mathematically identical tax bills.
opts.w: 错误。卑诗省税率最低为 5.60%，48% 是联邦附加税率而非省税率。

opts.t: The 48% surtax applies to gross worldwide income rather than basic federal tax.
opts.w: 错误。联邦附加税是基于联邦应付税（basic federal tax）按比例计算的 48%，并非对总收入按 48% 课税。

opts.t: The surtax replaces BC tax at 6.72% (14% × 48%) in the lowest bracket, and the $13,216 BC credit is lost too.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第四部分，把“视同居民”当省钱通道完全算反了方向。在 2026 税年：视同居民在最低税阶的附加税边际税负为 14% × 48% = 6.72%，本身就高于卑诗省 5.60% 的最低税阶省税率；更重要的是，事实居民可享受卑诗省基本个人额 $13,216 抵税额及省级可退还抵免，而视同居民省抵免全无。因此视同居民在卑诗省几乎总是税负更贵的那一档。

main.pt: 回原居国离境日期例外规定
main.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
main.stem: Daniel, who originally moved to Canada from New Zealand in 2018, decided to permanently return to New Zealand to re-establish his home. Daniel departed Canada on May 1, 2026 and began employment in Auckland. His spouse remained in Vancouver until August 31, 2026 to oversee the sale of their Canadian home and allow their child to finish the school term. Under CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 and the departure date exception explained in the lecture, what is Daniel's official departure date for Canadian tax purposes?
main.zh: Daniel 最初于 2018 年从新西兰移居加拿大，后决定永久返回新西兰重建原居生活。Daniel 于 2026 年 5 月 1 日离开加拿大，并在奥克兰开始工作。其配偶在温哥华停留至 2026 年 8 月 31 日，以便处理出售加拿大房产事宜并让孩子完成本学年学业。根据 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 及讲义中解释的离境日期例外规则，Daniel 在加拿大税务上的法定离境日期是哪一天？

opts.t: August 31, 2026, under the general rule that takes the latest date among the taxpayer's departure, the spouse's departure, and establishing foreign residence.
opts.w: 错误。这是讲义第七部分列明的第 7 项常见错报陷阱：将通则机械套用于“回原居国重建居所”的特殊情形，误将离境日推迟至家属离开日。

opts.t: December 31, 2026, because residency can only be terminated at the conclusion of a calendar tax year.
opts.w: 错误。部分年度居民离境日在年内离境当天定格，绝非固定在年末。

opts.t: May 1, 2026: someone returning to re-establish a home in their country of origin leaves on the day they personally depart.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.24 及讲义第 7 部分，常规离境日判定虽取“三日期取最晚”（本人离境、家属离境、取得新国税籍），但存在一条关键例外：纳税人离开加拿大返回原居国重建原居（re-establishing residence in country of origin）的，以本人离境当日为准（即 2026 年 5 月 1 日）。配偶与孩子留在加拿大处理售房或完成学业，不会推迟当事人的法定离境日。若误按 8 月 31 日计算，会连带把视同处置日和全球收入截止日一起算错。

opts.t: April 30, 2027, the deadline for filing the 2026 departure tax return.
opts.w: 错误。将申报截止日混同于离境日。

main.pt: 个人异议法定期限取较晚者计算
main.trap: 机械套用90天异议期限
main.stem: Lucas is an employed individual taxpayer who timely filed his 2025 personal income tax return on April 25, 2026. The CRA assessed the return and mailed an initial Notice of Assessment on May 20, 2026, disallowing his moving expense deduction. Lucas intends to dispute the adjustment by serving a formal Notice of Objection (Form T400A). Under subsection 165(1) of the Income Tax Act, what is the statutory deadline for Lucas to serve his Notice of Objection on the CRA?
main.zh: Lucas 是一名受雇个人纳税人，于 2026 年 4 月 25 日按时申报了其 2025 税年个人税表。CRA 完成评税并于 2026 年 5 月 20 日寄出了原始评税通知（NOA），剔除了他的搬迁费扣除。Lucas 拟通过递交正式异议通知书（Form T400A）进行争议。根据《所得税法》第 165(1) 条，Lucas 向 CRA 提出异议的法定期限是哪一天？

opts.t: August 18, 2026, which is exactly 90 days after the mailing date of the Notice of Assessment.
opts.w: 错误。这是落入“机械套用 90 天”陷阱；个人与 graduated rate estate 并非单纯适用 90 天规则，还要与申报截止日后一年比对并取较晚者。

opts.t: December 31, 2026, which represents the end of the taxation year in which the disputed assessment was rendered.
opts.w: 错误。税法从未规定以评税发出的日历年底作为异议截止期。

opts.t: April 30, 2027: for an individual it is the later of one year after the filing due date and 90 days after the NOA.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.165(1)(a) 及讲义第 2.5 节，个人（非信托）与 graduated rate estate 的异议期限为「该年申报截止日后一年」与「评税通知发出后 90 天」两者取较晚者。2025 税年普通雇员申报截止日为 2026 年 4 月 30 日，其后一年为 2027 年 4 月 30 日；NOA 发出日后 90 天约为 2026 年 8 月 18 日。取两者较晚者，法定异议截止日为 2027 年 4 月 30 日。

opts.t: May 20, 2029, because an objection can be initiated at any time throughout the three-year normal reassessment period.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了异议时效与正常复评期（3 年）；正常复评期是 CRA 重新评税的期限，绝非纳税人提异议的法定期限。

main.pt: 正常复评期起算与疏忽超期复评
main.trap: 把正常复评期当无条件保护伞
main.stem: Marcus, an individual taxpayer, filed his 2021 personal return on April 28, 2022, and the CRA issued his initial Notice of Assessment on June 15, 2022. In October 2026, during an audit of third-party corporate records, the CRA discovered that Marcus failed to report a $25,000 taxable dividend in 2021 as a result of careless bookkeeping. Marcus argues the CRA is legally prohibited from reassessing his 2021 return because more than three years have passed since his initial assessment. How does the Income Tax Act apply?
main.zh: Marcus 是一名个人纳税人，于 2022 年 4 月 28 日申报了其 2021 税年税表，CRA 于 2022 年 6 月 15 日发出了原始评税通知（NOA）。2026 年 10 月，CRA 在审查第三方公司记录时发现 Marcus 因记账粗心遗漏了 2021 年一笔 $25,000 的应税股息。Marcus 辩称距其原始评税已过三年以上，CRA 在法律上已被禁止重新评税。根据《所得税法》，应如何处理？

opts.t: The CRA is entitled to reassess Marcus beyond the normal reassessment period because the misrepresentation was attributable to carelessness or neglect under ITA s.152(4)(a)(i).
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.152(4)(a)(i) 及讲义第 1.2 与 2.2 节，个人 3 年正常复评期并非无条件的保护伞。只要存在“可归因于疏忽、粗心或故意隐瞒的失实陈述”或欺诈，CRA 即可无限期往回复评，且法律不要求 CRA 必须先成立重大过失罚。Marcus 因粗心记账漏报应税股息构成疏忽失实陈述，CRA 完全有权超期复评。

opts.t: The CRA is permanently barred from reassessing Marcus because the three-year statutory limitation period expired on June 15, 2025, and no criminal fraud occurred.
opts.w: 错误。落入“把正常复评期当无条件保护伞”陷阱；超期复评不需要达到刑事欺诈门槛，民事上的粗心或疏忽（carelessness or neglect）即可打开无限期复评大门。

opts.t: The CRA may only reassess Marcus if it simultaneously establishes liability for a gross negligence penalty under ITA s.163(2).
opts.w: 错误。讲义第 2.2 节明确强调超期复评与重大过失罚是两道独立的门槛，s.152(4)(a)(i) 覆盖门槛更低的“疏忽”，不以成立重大过失罚为前置条件。

opts.t: The CRA may reassess the return only if Marcus consents in writing by executing a retrospective waiver on Form T2029.
opts.w: 错误。T2029 放弃书必须在复评期届满前由纳税人主动签署，在存在疏忽失实陈述时 CRA 享有法定无限期复评权，根本不需要纳税人签署放弃书。

main.pt: CRA审查信类型与处理边界
main.trap: 混淆核对审查与全面稽查
main.stem: In August 2026, three months after receiving his 2025 Notice of Assessment, Brian receives a letter from the CRA titled 'Processing Review.' The letter requests receipts and proof of payment for the childcare expenses and charitable donations claimed on his return, providing a reference claim code and a 30-day response window. Brian panics, believing he is undergoing a comprehensive tax audit. How should this correspondence and Brian's appropriate response be characterized?
main.zh: 2026 年 8 月，在收到 2025 税年评税通知书（NOA）三个月后，Brian 收到了一封来自 CRA 题为「Processing Review」的信件。该信要求其为税表申报的托儿费及慈善捐赠补交收据与付款凭证，信中附有 reference claim code 及 30 天回复窗口。Brian 陷入恐慌，误以为自己正面临全面税务稽查。应如何定性该信件性质及 Brian 的合理应对措施？

opts.t: It is a comprehensive field audit examining Brian's complete financial books for the past six years, requiring immediate legal representation.
opts.w: 错误。落入“混淆核对审查与全面稽查”陷阱；Processing Review 仅是针对特定抵扣格子的日常凭证核对，绝非针对企业或个人多年账目的现场全面稽查（audit）。

opts.t: A routine post-assessment check of specific claims; he should send the requested receipts via the claim code within 30 days.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.3 节，Processing Review（评税后审查）发生在 NOA 发出之后，属于 CRA 八大核对项目之一。其性质是核实特定格子是否有支持文件，而非深入账目的稽查（audit）。Brian 应当在信给定的网址输入 claim code 查明所需文件，并在 30 天窗口内如期补交凭证。

opts.t: It is a Pre-assessment Review that immediately revokes Brian's issued Notice of Assessment and suspends his social insurance number.
opts.w: 错误。Pre-assessment Review 发生在 NOA 出具之前；且核对程序绝不会吊销纳税人的工卡号（SIN）。

opts.t: It is a Matching Program inquiry signaling that Brian's employer or financial institution submitted conflicting tax information slips to the CRA.
opts.w: 错误。比对项目（Matching Program）查的是第三方申报单（T4/T5）与税表的比对，而 Processing Review 查的是纳税人自主申领的扣除或抵免收据。

main.pt: 报税调整渠道与十年回溯上限
main.trap: 混淆改表十年与减免十年
main.stem: In July 2026, Trevor discovers that he omitted an eligible tuition tax credit on his 2014 personal return and neglected to claim an eligible medical expense deduction on his 2022 return. He has already received the initial Notice of Assessment for both taxation years. Trevor prepares adjustment requests to claim refunds for both years. Under the Income Tax Act (s.152(4.2)) and CRA administrative rules, how will his adjustment requests be treated?
main.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Trevor 发现自己在 2014 税年个人税表上漏报了一笔合规学费税额抵免，在 2022 税年税表上漏报了一笔合规医疗费用扣除。两年的原始评税通知（NOA）此前均已收到。Trevor 准备申请调整以获取这两年的退税。根据《所得税法》第 152(4.2) 条及 CRA 行政规则，他的调整申请将如何被处理？

opts.t: Both adjustment requests will be processed and refunded because the 10-year limitation rule applies exclusively to corporate tax returns.
opts.w: 错误。ITA s.152(4.2) 的 10 年退税公平条款明确适用于个人税表调整，并非仅适用于公司。

opts.t: Both adjustment requests will be rejected because taxpayers are strictly prohibited from adjusting any return once the three-year normal reassessment period has elapsed.
opts.w: 错误。虽然 3 年正常复评期已过，但依据 s.152(4.2)，CRA 拥有长达 10 个日历年的酌情调整权力，2022 年依然可以受理。

opts.t: The 2014 adjustment can be processed online through ReFILE, whereas the 2022 adjustment must be submitted via paper Form T1-ADJ.
opts.w: 错误。ReFILE 软件改表只能改 2021 及以后税年，根本无法处理 2014 年；且 2022 年支持更快的在线修改。

opts.t: The 2022 adjustment can be processed and refunded, but the 2014 adjustment cannot yield a refund because it falls outside the 10-calendar-year statutory limitation cap.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.152(4.2) 及讲义第 2.4 节，CRA 发放调整退税有一条硬上限：退税不得对超过 10 个日历年的调整请求发放。该 10 年窗口锚在“要改的税年”，2026 年受理的请求最远只能回溯到 2016 税年。2022 税年完全在 10 年窗口内，可正常调整并退税；而 2014 税年已超过 10 个日历年，依法无法发放退税。

main.pt: 异议期间追缴暂停与利息计收
main.trap: 误把追缴暂停当免除利息
main.stem: Derek received a Notice of Reassessment assessing an additional $8,000 in federal income tax plus $600 in accrued interest. In July 2026, Derek timely serves a formal Notice of Objection (Form T400A) disputing the entire reassessment. During the ten months that the CRA Appeals Branch spends reviewing his objection, Derek makes no payments toward the disputed balance. What are the legal ramifications regarding CRA collection actions and interest accrual under ITA s.225.1?
main.zh: Derek 收到一份重新评税通知（NOR），要求补缴 $8,000 联邦所得税及 $600 累积利息。2026 年 7 月，Derek 按期递交了正式异议通知书（Form T400A）对全额税款提出争议。在 CRA 上诉处审查该异议的十个月期间，Derek 未就争议款项进行任何支付。根据 ITA s.225.1，关于 CRA 强制追缴行动与利息计算的法律后果为何？

opts.t: The CRA is legally restricted from initiating collection enforcement actions against Derek, but prescribed arrears interest continues to accumulate on the unpaid balance.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.225.1(1) 及讲义第 2.6 节，纳税人对评税提出异议后，CRA 必须暂停对个人的强制追缴行动（不能起诉、不能冻结账户或扣押工资）。然而，追缴暂停（collection restrictions）保护的只是纳税人的财产不被强扣，并非免除税债；欠税利息依然会按法定的规定利率（prescribed rate）在整个异议期间每日复利累加。

opts.t: The CRA is statutorily authorized to garnish Derek's wages for 50% of the disputed balance while freezing the remaining 50% until court adjudication.
opts.w: 错误。普通个人的追缴是 100% 暂停；只有“大公司（large corporation）”或涉及“税务庇护慈善捐赠”的情形，CRA 才可以执行 50% 的追缴。

opts.t: Both collection actions and the accumulation of arrears interest are fully frozen until the Appeals Branch renders a final decision.
opts.w: 错误。落入“误把追缴暂停当免除利息”陷阱；暂停的仅仅是追缴动作，利息从未停止滚存。

opts.t: The CRA may seize Derek's financial accounts unless he posts a commercial surety bond equal to 100% of the disputed reassessment.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大个人税异议享有法定的自动暂停追缴权利，无需纳税人提供任何商业保证保险或担保金。

main.pt: 纳税人减免与自愿披露适用边界
main.trap: 混淆已评定减免与未申报自愿披露
main.stem: In 2026, two taxpayers seek administrative relief from the CRA. Sandra omitted rental income from an overseas apartment for the past four taxation years; the CRA has never contacted her or commenced an audit regarding this income. Gregory, due to a severe automobile collision resulting in prolonged hospitalization in 2024, missed his tax filing and payment deadlines; the CRA subsequently issued an assessment correctly calculating late-filing penalties and arrears interest. Which relief channels should Sandra and Gregory pursue?
main.zh: 2026 年，两名纳税人向 CRA 寻求行政救济。Sandra 在过去四个税年漏报了海外一套公寓的租金收入，CRA 从未就该收入联系过她或启动稽查。Gregory 则因 2024 年遭遇严重车祸长期住院，错过了报税和缴税截止日；CRA 随后下达评税，正确计征了迟报罚款与欠税利息。Sandra 与 Gregory 分别应走哪条救济渠道？

opts.t: Sandra should apply for Taxpayer Relief under Form RC4288, while Gregory should file an Unprompted application under the Voluntary Disclosures Program.
opts.w: 错误。完全搞反了两个制度的适用对象；漏报未评定收入不能走 RC4288，而已被正确评定罚息不能走 VDP。

opts.t: Both Sandra and Gregory must submit Form T400A to initiate formal objections before the CRA Appeals Branch.
opts.w: 错误。异议针对的是评税本身的定性或计算错误；本案中 Gregory 的罚息是正确计算的（只是情有可原），而 Sandra 尚未被评税，均不可提起异议。

opts.t: Sandra should apply under the Voluntary Disclosures Program (VDP), while Gregory should request discretionary relief under Taxpayer Relief Provisions (Form RC4288).
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.7、2.8 节及第七节错报清单第 6 项，区分两者的核心判断标准是“CRA 到底有没有评定过这笔钱”。Sandra 的海外租金收入属于从未申报过的税项且 CRA 尚未发现，应走自愿披露计划（VDP，符合 Unprompted 条件）；而 Gregory 的罚款与利息已经被 CRA 正确下达，但因严重车祸等超出纳税人控制的不可抗力情有可原，应通过 RC4288 申请纳税人减免（Taxpayer Relief）。

opts.t: Both Sandra and Gregory must appeal directly to the Tax Court of Canada because the CRA lacks statutory jurisdiction to cancel interest.
opts.w: 错误。税务法院没有管辖权去减免或撤销被正确评定的罚款与利息，这项酌情权专属于 CRA 纳税人减免程序。

main.pt: 税务法院非正式程序门槛与规则
main.trap: 误认小额诉讼判决具判例效力
main.stem: Nathan received a decision from the CRA Appeals Branch confirming an unfavorable reassessment involving $22,000 in disputed federal income tax and $2,500 in disputed penalties (totaling $24,500, excluding interest). Nathan files an appeal to the Tax Court of Canada (TCC) electing the Informal Procedure. Which of the following correctly describes the procedural rules and legal characteristics of Nathan's appeal under the Tax Court of Canada Act (s.18)?
main.zh: Nathan 收到 CRA 上诉处的决定书，确认了一份涉及 $22,000 争议联邦所得税及 $2,500 争议罚款（合计 $24,500，不含利息）的不利重新评税。Nathan 向加拿大税务法院（TCC）提起上诉并选择走非正式程序（Informal Procedure）。根据《加拿大税务法院法》第 18 条，关于 Nathan 上诉的程序规则与法律特征，下列哪项表述是正确的？

opts.t: Nathan must retain a licensed lawyer, pay a mandatory court filing fee, and strictly adhere to formal rules of judicial evidence.
opts.w: 错误。这是“一般程序（General Procedure）”的要求；非正式程序免申请费、不受严格证据规则约束，且允许非律师代理人出庭。

opts.t: He pays no filing fee, may act alone or through an agent, and the judgment does not bind other cases as precedent.
opts.w: 正确。根据《加拿大税务法院法》第 18 条及讲义第 2.9 节，非正式程序的法定门槛为争议税额加罚款不超过 $25,000（2024 至 2026 年未变且不随通胀指数化）。该程序免收法院申请费、不受严格证据规则约束、允许非律师代理人代理出庭；同时根据第 18.28 条，非正式程序的判决不得被援引作为约束其他案件的司法先例（no precedent value）。

opts.t: Nathan is disqualified from the Informal Procedure because disputed penalties must be excluded when determining the $25,000 threshold.
opts.w: 错误。两万五门槛计算公式明确包含争议的联邦税与罚款（federal tax and penalties），仅不包含利息；$22,000 + $2,500 = $24,500，未超过 $25,000 门槛。

opts.t: The final judgment rendered under the Informal Procedure creates a binding national legal precedent that CRA must apply to all identical disputes across Canada.
opts.w: 错误。落入“误认小额诉讼判决具判例效力”陷阱；《税务法院法》第 18.28 条明文规定非正式程序判决不具备正式判例拘束力。

variants.pt: 零税额法定强制申报情形
variants.trap: 没欠税即免报陷阱
variants.stem: In 2026, Chloe earned $4,800 in net self-employment income from freelance copywriting, with no other income sources. After applying the basic personal amount, her calculated income tax liability is $0. Is Chloe legally required to file a 2026 T1 return?
variants.zh: 2026 年，Chloe 从事自由文案写作取得净自雇收入 $4,800，且无其他收入来源。在计入基本个人免税额后，其计算出的应纳个人所得税为 $0。Chloe 是否负有提交 2026 年 T1 申报表的法定申报义务？

opts.t: No, because self-employed individuals with zero net income tax liability are fully exempt from filing.
opts.w: 错误。落入「没欠税即免报陷阱」；虽然所得税为零，但自雇净收入超过 CPP 基本免供额会产生强制申报并缴纳供款的义务。

opts.t: No, because CPP contributions are entirely optional for self-employed individuals with net profits below $10,000.
opts.w: 错误。自雇人士对 CPP 供款并非自愿选择，超过基本免供额的部分必须强制供款（仅就业保险 EI 供款为自愿加入）。

opts.t: Yes, because her net self-employment earnings exceeded the $3,500 CPP basic exemption, triggering mandatory CPP contributions.
opts.w: 正确。自雇净收入超过 2026 年 CPP 基本免供额 (basic exemption) $3,500 时，纳税人必须缴纳 CPP 供款并通过 T1 申报表申报，属于法定强制申报情形。

opts.t: Yes, but only if the CRA serves her with a formal written requirement to file within 90 days after year-end.
opts.w: 错误。超过 CPP 免供额是法定直接触发的申报义务，不需要 CRA 另行寄发催报函 (demand to file)。

variants.pt: 2026最低税阶税率
variants.trap: 过渡期税率混淆
variants.stem: While calculating federal tax on an individual's 2026 taxable income of $45,000, a tax preparer applies a tax rate of 14.5%. Why is this rate incorrect under 2026 tax rules?
variants.zh: 在计算某个人 2026 年 $45,000 应税收入的联邦税时，报税员适用了 14.5% 的税率。根据 2026 税年规则，为什么这一税率是错误的？

opts.t: The 14.5% rate was a blended rate used only for the 2025 transition year; for 2026 the full-year rate is 14%.
opts.w: 正确。14.5% 只在 2025 过渡年出现，是上半年 15%、下半年 14% 折算出的全年混合税率；2026 税年起全年 14%。

opts.t: The lowest federal tax rate reverted back to 15.0% after the temporary tax reduction expired at the end of 2025.
opts.w: 错误。联邦最低税阶降至 14% 是法定结构性降税，并没有在 2025 年底过期或回滚到 15%。

opts.t: The 14.5% rate applies solely to taxable income between $58,523 and $117,045.
opts.w: 错误。第二档税阶税率为 20.5%，14.5% 并非第二档税阶税率。

opts.t: The 14.5% rate is restricted to corporations eligible for the small business deduction rather than individuals.
opts.w: 错误。14.5% 是个人所得税 2025 年的过渡税率，与公司小型企业扣除无关。

variants.pt: 自雇申报与付款双轨截止日
variants.trap: 自雇延期双日混淆陷阱
variants.stem: Elena is an employed accountant whose cohabiting spouse operates an unincorporated food truck business. For the 2026 tax year, Elena has an unpaid tax liability of $2,000. Which pair of dates correctly states Elena's filing deadline and payment deadline?
variants.zh: Elena 是一名受雇会计师，其同居配偶经营一家未注册成公司的流动餐车生意（自雇）。2026 纳税年度，Elena 有 $2,000 未缴税款。下列哪一组日期正确说明了 Elena 的申报截止日与付款截止日？

opts.t: Filing deadline: April 30, 2027; Payment deadline: April 30, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。经营业务者的配偶同样享受申报延期至 6 月 15 日的待遇，申报截止日并非 4 月 30 日。

opts.t: Filing deadline: June 15, 2027; Payment deadline: June 15, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。落入「自雇延期双日混淆陷阱」；付款截止日绝不随申报延期，仍为 4 月 30 日。

opts.t: Filing deadline: April 30, 2027; Payment deadline: June 15, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。申报期与付款期完全颠倒，税法绝无付款宽于申报的规定。

opts.t: Filing deadline: June 15, 2027; Payment deadline: April 30, 2027.
opts.w: 正确。所得税法规定，自雇经营者及其同居配偶或伴侣申报截止日 (filing due date) 均为次年 6 月 15 日；但所有个人的欠税付款截止日 (payment due date) 统一为次年 4 月 30 日。

variants.pt: 迟报罚款计算基数与费率
variants.trap: 迟报罚款全额基数陷阱
variants.stem: Sophia filed her 2026 T1 personal tax return four complete months late. Her total assessed tax payable for the year was $10,000, but her employer had already remitted $10,500 in source deductions by April 30, 2027. She had no prior penalty record. What is Sophia's late-filing penalty?
variants.zh: Sophia 的 2026 年 T1 个人申报表逾期整整 4 个月才提交。她全年的核定应纳税总额为 $10,000，但其雇主在 2027 年 4 月 30 日前已通过源头预扣缴付了 $10,500。她此前无处罚记录。CRA 会对 Sophia 评定多少迟报罚款？

opts.t: $900, representing 9% (5% initial plus 4% for four months) of her $10,000 total tax payable.
opts.w: 错误。落入「迟报罚款全额基数陷阱」；迟报罚款计算基数是截止日未缴税款，而非应纳税总额。

opts.t: $0, because her balance owing on the filing deadline was zero.
opts.w: 正确。迟报罚款的法定计算基数是申报期限时尚未缴付的税款 (unpaid tax)；由于 Sophia 已全额预扣并产生退税，欠税余额为零，罚款计算结果必然为 $0。

opts.t: $100, representing the statutory minimum administrative penalty for filing more than 90 days late.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大税法对于无欠税的个人所得税迟报并未设定法定最低行政罚款。

opts.t: $1,700, representing the maximum statutory penalty of 17% applied to her total tax liability.
opts.w: 错误。无欠税时不存在迟报罚款，更不可能适用 17% 的上限。

variants.pt: T1六步申报流程与省税位置
variants.trap: 旧版七步流程残留陷阱
variants.stem: A tax student references an older training manual describing the T1 return as having seven distinct steps. What structural change made by the CRA explains why current returns contain only six steps?
variants.zh: 一名税务学员查阅旧培训考试资料时发现 T1 申报表被描述为包含七个独立步骤。CRA 做出的哪项结构调整解释了为何现行申报表仅包含六个步骤？

opts.t: Step 1 (Identification) and Step 2 (Total income) were combined into a single intake step.
opts.w: 错误。Step 1 识别信息与 Step 2 总收入在现行主表中依然各自保持独立步骤。

opts.t: Step 3 (Net income) was removed, and deductions are now directly applied to calculate federal tax.
opts.w: 错误。净收入 (Net income) 是核定各类联邦与省福利资格的关键基准，绝未被取消。

opts.t: The separate provincial and territorial tax step was dropped for 2021, and that tax now flows into Step 6.
opts.w: 正确。讲义第三节与第五节明确指出，2021 税年取消了单列的「省/属地税」这一步，改为通过 Form 428 算出后并入 Step 6 结算，七步由此正式变成六步。

opts.t: Federal tax and refundable tax credits were split into two separate numbered steps, changing the total count.
opts.w: 错误。分拆会导致步数增加，而历史变更是将七步精简整合为六步。

variants.pt: 个人异议通知法定申请期限
variants.trap: 个人异议期限一律 90 天陷阱
variants.stem: Grace filed her 2026 T1 return on April 20, 2027. Following an audit, the CRA issued a Notice of Reassessment dated May 20, 2028. What is the deadline for Grace to file a Notice of Objection?
variants.zh: Grace 于 2027 年 4 月 20 日提交了 2026 年 T1 申报表。在后续审计后，CRA 于 2028 年 5 月 20 日签发了重新评税通知（Notice of Reassessment）。Grace 提交异议通知的最迟截止日是哪一天？

opts.t: April 30, 2028, which is one year after the original filing due date for the 2026 tax year.
opts.w: 错误。虽然申报截止日后一年是 2028 年 4 月 30 日，但个人纳税人取两者中「较晚」者；由于通知在 2028 年 5 月才寄出，90 天规则给出了更晚的保护期。

opts.t: May 20, 2029, which is one year after the date of the Notice of Reassessment.
opts.w: 错误。所得税法中没有「重新评税通知日后一年」这一异议期限规则。

opts.t: June 19, 2028, which is 30 days after the reassessment notice was issued.
opts.w: 错误。法定异议期基准为 90 天，并非 30 天。

opts.t: August 18, 2028, 90 days after the reassessment, which is later than April 30, 2028.
opts.w: 正确。个人异议期限取「申报截止日后一年（2028 年 4 月 30 日）」与「复评通知后 90 天（2028 年 8 月 18 日）」中较晚者 (the later of)；复评晚于那一年，所以 90 天那个日期更晚、就是截止日。

variants.pt: BC省税统一征管与申报机制
variants.trap: 省税独立申报误解
variants.stem: Gabriel moved from Montreal, Quebec, to Vancouver, British Columbia, in early 2026. How does his 2026 personal income tax filing process in BC differ from his previous filing experience in Quebec?
variants.zh: Gabriel 于 2026 年初从魁北克省蒙特利尔搬到卑诗省温哥华。在准备 2026 年个人税申报时，他在 BC 省的申报流程与此前在魁北克的经历有何不同？

opts.t: In BC he files one T1 with the CRA covering both taxes; Quebec needed separate federal and Revenu Québec returns.
opts.w: 正确。魁北克自 1954 年起独立运营个税系统，居民须分别向 CRA 和魁北克税局 (Revenu Québec) 报两份税表；而 BC 居民只需向 CRA 提交一份合并申报表 (single return)。

opts.t: In BC, provincial tax is assessed as a flat percentage of federal tax, whereas Quebec used a bracketed system.
opts.w: 错误。各省现行均按应税收入适用本省的税阶与税率（省税已非单纯按联邦税额比例计算），差异在于是否需要向省税局独立申报。

opts.t: In BC, he is required to obtain prior clearance from the provincial Ministry of Finance before filing his federal T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省无须纳税人预先向省财政厅办理任何清税或申报许可。

opts.t: In BC, provincial income tax is optional for former residents of other provinces during their first tax year.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大按 12 月 31 日纳税人所在省份确定省税管辖权，省税属于强制性法定税负，绝无首年自愿免纳规定。

variants.pt: 普通法同居判定与短暂分离
variants.trap: 分开即计时归零陷阱
variants.stem: Ethan and Olivia began cohabiting in an intimate relationship on February 1, 2026. On August 15, 2026, a child was born to them. As of December 31, 2026, they had cohabited for only 11 months. What is Olivia's marital status for her 2026 T1 return?
variants.zh: Ethan 与 Olivia 于 2026 年 2 月 1 日开始保持亲密同居关系。2026 年 8 月 15 日，两人的亲生子女出生。截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，两人同居仅满 11 个月。在填报 2026 年 T1 申报表时，Olivia 的法定婚姻状况应填报为什么？

opts.t: Single, because they had not yet lived together for the mandatory 12 consecutive months required under the general rule.
opts.w: 错误。忽视了普通法关系的替代条件；只要对方是纳税人子女的生父/生母，无需等待满 12 个月即可成立普通法同居。

opts.t: Married, because having a common biological child automatically legally marries the partners under federal tax legislation.
opts.w: 错误。已婚（Married）严格限于具有合法登记婚姻关系的人士，有共同子女不会自动变成已婚。

opts.t: Single, unless they jointly submit a formal notarized declaration to Service Canada prior to the tax filing deadline.
opts.w: 错误。普通法地位是法定事实判断，不以向政府提交公证声明为成立前提。

opts.t: Living common-law, because her partner is the child's parent, which qualifies without the 12-month wait.
opts.w: 正确。普通法同居三项判定条件满足其一即可：① 连续同居满 12 个月；② 对方是子女的生父/生母（含收养）；③ 拥有监护权且该子女完全依赖扶养。因两人有共同亲生子女，即使同居未满 12 个月亦依法成立普通法伴侣关系。

variants.pt: 分居成立条件与追溯生效日
variants.trap: 分居生效日第90天陷阱
variants.stem: David and Grace are legally married. In September 2026, Grace was transferred to another city for a temporary 1-year work assignment and lived in a rented apartment, while David remained in their family home. Their marital relationship remained intact throughout 2026. How should David report his marital status on his 2026 T1 return?
variants.zh: David 与 Grace 是合法夫妻。2026 年 9 月，Grace 因工作被临时外派至另一城市工作 1 年并租房居住，而 David 留在原家庭住宅，两人的婚姻感情在 2026 年始终保持良好。在申报 2026 年 T1 税表时，David 应如何填报其婚姻状况？

opts.t: Married, because living apart for work, school or health reasons is not a breakdown of the relationship.
opts.w: 正确。因工作、求学、健康原因或服刑而分开居住属于非自愿分居（involuntary separation），并非感情破裂分居，双方在税法上依然按已婚（Married）申报。

opts.t: Separated, because physical separation exceeding 90 days automatically triggers separated status regardless of the underlying reason.
opts.w: 错误。分居在税法上的核心前提是「因感情破裂而分开居住」（breakdown of the relationship），工作外派不属于税法分居。

opts.t: Single, because they maintained two separate primary residences as of December 31, 2026.
opts.w: 错误。保持两处住所不改变合法婚姻存续的事实，不能填单身（Single）。

opts.t: Living common-law, because their legal marriage is suspended during periods of cross-regional employment.
opts.w: 错误。合法婚姻关系不会因异地工作而中止或转为普通法同居。

variants.pt: 配偶净收入与自雇延期
variants.trap: 配偶零收入不报陷阱
variants.stem: Kevin is legally married to Maya as of December 31, 2026. Maya is a newcomer to Canada who had zero income from all sources in 2026. Kevin's tax preparer explains that Maya's net income (line 23600) must still be entered on Kevin's T1 return. What is the statutory rationale for this requirement?
variants.zh: 截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，Kevin 与 Maya 为合法夫妻。Maya 是新移民，2026 年度在全球范围内收入均为零。报税员告知 Kevin，其 T1 税表上仍必须填写 Maya 的第 23600 行净收入。该项法定要求的核心制度逻辑是什么？

opts.t: To allow the CRA to impose a mandatory minimum tax assessment on spouses who fail to seek active employment.
opts.w: 错误。税法不对未就业配偶课征最低惩罚税款。

opts.t: To ensure that Kevin can be held jointly liable for Maya's future personal tax debts across subsequent years.
opts.w: 错误。填报配偶净收入不是为了确立对配偶未来个人税务债务的连带保证责任。

opts.t: To serve as a necessary input parameter for calculating Kevin's spouse credit and evaluating eligibility for family-based benefits.
opts.w: 正确。配偶净收入（第 23600 行）并非仅用于判断欠税，而是作为计算申报人本人配偶额抵免（spouse amount tax credit）及 CCB、CGEB 等按调整后家庭净收入核发福利的法定输入变量。

opts.t: To transfer Maya's unused basic personal amount automatically to Kevin's provincial tax return without documentation.
opts.w: 错误。配偶额抵免通过附表 5（Schedule 5）计算，并非未经计算自动转移基本个人免税额。

variants.pt: 12月31日居住省判定
variants.trap: 居住省全年最长居住地陷阱
variants.stem: Lucas lives in Victoria, BC, where he owns a home and maintains his primary residential ties. On December 15, 2026, he traveled to Ontario for a two-week holiday and was physically staying in a hotel in Toronto on December 31, 2026, returning to Victoria on January 5, 2027. Which province or territory should Lucas enter as his province of residence on his 2026 T1 return?
variants.zh: Lucas 是不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市的常住居民，在当地拥有住房并维系着主要居住联系。2026 年 12 月 15 日，他前往安大略省度假两周，2026 年 12 月 31 日当天实际住在多伦多的一家酒店中，并于 2027 年 1 月 5 日返回维多利亚。Lucas 在其 2026 年 T1 税表上应填报哪个省作为其居住省？

opts.t: Ontario, because physical location on midnight of December 31 strictly supersedes all residential ties.
opts.w: 错误。临时旅行借宿酒店不构成税法上的居住地变更，不能机械按物理所在地填报安省。

opts.t: British Columbia, because he is considered a factual resident of BC where his significant residential ties remained on December 31.
opts.w: 正确。居住省指 12 月 31 日当天居住或被视为「事实居民」（factual resident）的省份。Lucas 仅是短期赴安省度假，其重要居住联系（住房、主要生活基地）始终在 BC 省，应填报 BC 省。

opts.t: Both Ontario and BC, requiring a pro-rata allocation of his taxable income across both provincial forms.
opts.w: 错误。税法不允许个人在同一税年中跨两省按比例分摊申报居住省税。

opts.t: Federal non-resident status, because he was not physically present in his home province at the end of the taxation year.
opts.w: 错误。境内跨省短期度假完全不影响加拿大居民与省级事实居民身份。

variants.pt: T1135成本门槛判定
variants.trap: T1135市值与夫妻合并陷阱
variants.stem: In 2026, Henry and his wife Grace each hold foreign assets. Henry owns foreign shares with an adjusted cost base of $60,000. Grace owns offshore bonds with an adjusted cost base of $55,000. Neither holds any other foreign property. How does the Form T1135 filing requirement apply to them?
variants.zh: 2026 年，Henry 与其妻子 Grace 各自持有境外资产。Henry 拥有调整后成本基础为 $60,000 的境外股票；Grace 拥有调整后成本基础为 $55,000 的海外债券。两人均未持有其他境外资产。Form T1135 海外财产申报要求如何适用于他们？

opts.t: Neither must file, since the cost threshold is tested for each person separately, not for the couple.
opts.w: 正确。T1135 的 100,000 元成本额门槛按每个申报人自己名下的特定海外财产相加，不按夫妻或家庭合并；Henry（$60,000）与 Grace（$55,000）各自都没超过，两人都不用报。

opts.t: Both must file Form T1135, because their combined family foreign property cost of $115,000 exceeds the $100,000 threshold.
opts.w: 错误。落入「夫妻合并陷阱」；误以为 T1135 与 CCB 等家庭福利一样按家庭总资产合并计算。

opts.t: Only Henry must file Form T1135, because he is the primary earner and holds the larger share of offshore assets.
opts.w: 错误。税法中不存在所谓主要收入方代为合并申报海外财产的规定。

opts.t: Henry and Grace must file a single joint Form T1135 reporting all assets under one submission.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大不实行联合申报制，T1135 也必须按个人分别提交。

variants.pt: T1135违规复评期延长
variants.trap: 正常复评期固定不变陷阱
variants.stem: An individual taxpayer realized that they neglected to file Form T1135 for 2026 despite holding $150,000 in foreign shares. The return and form were filed voluntarily 40 days after the filing deadline, without any demand letter from the CRA. Assuming no intentional gross negligence, what is the ordinary late-filing penalty for the form?
variants.zh: 某个人纳税人意识到自己在 2026 年持有 $150,000 境外股票却遗漏了提交 Form T1135。该纳税人在申报截止日过去 40 天后主动补交了税表和表格，且未收到 CRA 的催报函。在不存在故意或重大疏忽的情况下，这份表格的普通迟报罚款是多少？

opts.t: A flat $2,500 penalty charged as soon as the form is late, however short the delay.
opts.w: 错误。$2,500 是普通迟报罚款的法定封顶最高额，不是固定立即征收的金额。

opts.t: 5% of the total cost amount of the foreign property, regardless of days late.
opts.w: 错误。5% 成本额罚款仅针对超过 24 个月的持续严重违规，不适用于迟报 40 天的情形。

opts.t: $500 for each month the form is late, totaling $1,000 here.
opts.w: 错误。每月 $500 是故意或重大疏忽（gross negligence）时的升级罚款，非普通迟报罚。

opts.t: $25 per day late (minimum $100, maximum $2,500), so $1,000 here.

variants.pt: 印第安人法免税与福利前置
variants.trap: 免税即免报误区
variants.stem: When completing the Identification section of the 2026 T1 return, a tax preparer in British Columbia notices the checkbox asking whether the taxpayer 'resided on Indigenous government lands.' Under what circumstance does this specific checkbox apply?
variants.zh: 在填写 2026 年 T1 申报表的识别信息部分时，不列颠哥伦比亚省的一位报税员注意到询问纳税人是否「居住在原住民政府土地上」的勾选框。在何种情形下才适用该特定勾选框？

opts.t: It must be checked by any taxpayer across Canada who claims tax-exempt income under Section 87 of the Indian Act on Form T90.
opts.w: 错误。第 87 条免税通过 Form T90 计算并勾选其专用框，与「居住在原住民政府土地上」是两码事。

opts.t: It applies only to residents of Newfoundland and Labrador, the NWT or Yukon living on certain settlement lands.
opts.w: 正确。讲义 2.5 节明确指出：「居住在原住民政府土地上」只适用纽芬兰与拉布拉多、西北地区、育空三地居民，用于把省/属地税收入分配给签署协议的原住民政府，BC 居民不适用。

opts.t: It applies to all Indigenous persons living in British Columbia who work for a band council or on reserve lands.
opts.w: 错误。BC 居民不适用该结算土地勾选框。

opts.t: It is a mandatory field for any homeowner whose property is subject to municipal property tax exemptions in Canada.
opts.w: 错误。市政财产税豁免属于地方政府范畴，与联邦 T1 申报表上的原住民税收协议勾选无关。

variants.pt: Box 14 与 Box 40 关系
variants.trap: Box 40 重复相加陷阱
variants.stem: David received a 2026 T4 slip from an engineering firm showing $82,000 in Box 14 and $4,500 in Box 40 for employer-paid parking and group term life insurance. When completing his tax return, how should David report these figures on Line 10100?
variants.zh: David 收到工程设计公司开具的 2026 年 T4 报表，其中 Box 14 显示为 $82,000，Box 40 显示为 $4,500（包含雇主支付的停车位及团体定期人寿保费）。在编制报税表时，David 应如何在第 10100 行申报这些数字？

opts.t: He must add the two boxes together to report $86,500 on Line 10100.
opts.w: 错误。落入「Box 40 重复相加陷阱」；Box 40 的 $4,500 已经内含于 Box 14 中，相加会导致重复计税。

opts.t: He must subtract Box 40 from Box 14 and report $77,500 on Line 10100.
opts.w: 错误。应税福利无需从工资总额中扣减。

opts.t: Report $82,000, since Box 40 only breaks out benefits already inside Box 14.
opts.w: 正确。Box 40 只是一面透视镜，告知纳税人 Box 14 内部有多少来自非现金福利，Line 10100 严格填报 Box 14 的总数 $82,000。

opts.t: He must report $82,000 on Line 10100 and report $4,500 separately on Line 10400.
opts.w: 错误。Line 10400 适用于无 T4 的其他雇佣收入（如境外雇佣），已有 T4 的应税福利不能填进 Line 10400。

variants.pt: CPP 基础与增强供款分流
variants.trap: CPP 增强段与基础段混淆走错行陷阱
variants.stem: Rachel earned $74,600 in 2026, reaching exactly the YMPE cap. Her T4 Box 16 shows $4,230.45 and Box 16A shows $0. What exact amount should Rachel claim on Line 22215 as an enhanced CPP deduction on her 2026 T1 return?
variants.zh: Rachel 2026 年受雇收入为 $74,600，恰好达到 YMPE 上限。其 T4 Box 16 显示为 $4,230.45，Box 16A 显示为 $0。Rachel 在其 2026 年 T1 申报表的第 22215 行应申报多少金额的增强 CPP 扣除？

opts.t: $0, as no CPP2 was deducted in Box 16A
opts.w: 错误。以为没有 CPP2 就没有增强扣除；Box 16 本身含 1% 第一层增强（$711.00），照样走 Line 22215。

opts.t: $4,230.45, the full Box 16 amount
opts.w: 错误。整个 Box 16 当扣除；其中 4.95% 基础段 $3,519.45 只能走 Line 30800 抵免。

opts.t: $3,519.45, the 4.95% base portion
opts.w: 错误。把方向弄反：$3,519.45 是基础段，属于 Line 30800 抵免，不是 Line 22215 扣除。

opts.t: $711.00, the 1% first enhancement

variants.pt: 雇主福利与伤病险应税性
variants.trap: 主要个人受益应税判定混淆
variants.stem: Sophia was off work for two months due to an illness. She received $8,000 from a wage-loss replacement plan where the premiums were 100% paid by Sophia through payroll deductions using after-tax earnings. How is the $8,000 benefit treated on Sophia's 2026 tax return?
variants.zh: Sophia 因病离岗休假两个月。她从一项由自己通过工资代扣用税后收入 100% 自付保费的工资损失替代计划中领取了 $8,000 给付。这笔 $8,000 给付在 Sophia 的 2026 年纳税申报表上应如何处理？

opts.t: Fully non-taxable, because Sophia paid all the premiums with her own after-tax pay.
opts.w: 正确。讲义核心规则：谁付保费决定给付应不应税。如果雇员用自己的税后收入全额支付了团体伤病保险保费，相当于雇员自费购买保障，领取的工资替代给付完全免税，无需并入收入。

opts.t: The entire $8,000 benefit is taxable and must be reported on Line 10100 as regular employment income.
opts.w: 错误。只有雇主支付保费时给付才应税；雇员税后自付保费的给付免税。

opts.t: Only 50% of the benefit ($4,000) is taxable under the standard non-accountable benefit rules.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在对工资损失保险减半征税的规则。

opts.t: The benefit is reported on Line 14400 and then deducted on Line 25000 like WorkSafeBC benefits.
opts.w: 错误。T5007 流转仅适用于公共工伤保险，自费商业团体伤病险给付直接免税，无需填表流转。

variants.pt: 股票期权 50% 扣除比例
variants.trap: 股票期权扣除率未遂改革错误引用陷阱
variants.stem: Carlos exercised qualifying employee security options in 2026, receiving a T4 slip with Code 38 showing an eligible taxable benefit of $36,000 and Code 39 showing $18,000. Carlos was told by a colleague that recent tax reforms lowered the security option deduction to one-third. How much can Carlos legally deduct on Line 24900?
variants.zh: Carlos 2026 年行权了合格雇员证券期权，收到的 T4 报表上代码 38 显示合格应税福利为 $36,000，代码 39 显示为 $18,000。Carlos 听同事说近期税改已将期权扣除率削减为三分之一。Carlos 在第 24900 行依法可以扣除多少金额？

opts.t: $12,000, reflecting the statutory one-third inclusion relief enacted in recent federal legislation.
opts.w: 错误。三分之一扣除率（33.33%）属于未落地的未遂提案，税法现行扣除率未变。

opts.t: $18,000, because the 50% deduction rate remains intact under 2026 law and Code 39 reflects this exact entitlement.
opts.w: 正确。拟议中的 33.33% 期权扣除收紧未曾生效，2026 税年扣除比例保持 50%，T4 代码 39 已经计算出的 $18,000（$36,000 的一半）直接填入 Line 24900。

opts.t: $36,000, representing the gross benefit offset under reciprocal private corporation agreements.
opts.w: 错误。期权扣除额是福利金额的 50%，不是 100%。

opts.t: $9,000, because security options must be discounted by both 50% and provincial clawback percentages.
opts.w: 错误。不存在双重打折或省级扣回机制。

variants.pt: 多雇主 CPP 与 EI 超缴退还
variants.trap: 多雇主 CPP 与 EI 超缴自动退税误区陷阱
variants.stem: Lucas held two part-time jobs in 2026. Across both T4 slips, his total EI payroll deductions in Box 18 totaled $1,400, which exceeds the 2026 maximum employee premium of $1,123.07 by $276.93. Where and how should Lucas claim the $276.93 excess on his T1 return?
variants.zh: Lucas 在 2026 年同时从事两份兼职工作。两张 T4 报表汇总后，其 Box 18 中的 EI 扣缴总额达到 $1,400，超出 2026 税年雇员最高保费上限 $1,123.07 达 $276.93。Lucas 应在其 T1 申报表的哪一行如何申报这笔 $276.93 的超额款项？

opts.t: He should add $276.93 to Line 31200 to increase his non-refundable employment insurance tax credit.
opts.w: 错误。Line 31200 只能申报法定保费上限（$1,123.07），超额部分不能塞进非退还抵免。

opts.t: He must claim a tax deduction of $276.93 on Line 22215 alongside enhanced pension deductions.
opts.w: 错误。Line 22215 是 CPP 增强段扣除行，与 EI 保费退税无关。

opts.t: He must report the excess on Line 10400 as other employment income.
opts.w: 错误。超缴保费是退还款项，绝非新增应税收入。

opts.t: He should claim the $276.93 excess on Line 45000 as a refundable EI overpayment credit.
opts.w: 正确。两份工作导致的 EI 超缴（$1,400 - $1,123.07 = $276.93）走 Line 45000（EI 超额缴费退还），作为可退还抵免（refundable credit）直接退还给纳税人。

variants.pt: Box 52 养老金调整额去向
variants.trap: Box 52 养老金调整额当年抵税误区陷阱
variants.stem: A tax preparer is reviewing a client's 2026 T4 slip with $5,800 in Box 52 (Pension Adjustment). The client insists on entering this $5,800 onto Line 23200 (Other deductions) to lower taxable income. How should the preparer advise the client?
variants.zh: 报税人员正在审核客户 2026 年的 T4 报表，其中 Box 52（养老金调整额）为 $5,800。客户坚持要将这笔 $5,800 填入第 23200 行（其他扣除）以降低应税收入。报税人员应如何向客户解释？

opts.t: The client is correct, because PA represents an unutilized employee contribution deductible under ITA s.60.
opts.w: 错误。PA 不是雇员的自付扣除项，税法从未允许将其作为其他扣除直接抵税。

opts.t: The client should report the amount on Line 31260 to boost the Canada employment amount credit.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大就业额（Line 31260）与退休金调整额毫无关联。

opts.t: Box 52 goes on no T1 line; it only reduces the client's RRSP room for the following year.
opts.w: 正确。Box 52 不进入申报表任何一行，它只是通报给 CRA 用来压缩纳税人次年（2027 税年）RRSP 供款额度的核心数据，强行填入扣除行属于错报。

opts.t: The amount must be split evenly between Line 10100 as additional salary and Line 20700 as pension expense.
opts.w: 错误。PA 既不是工资收入也不是养老金支出，严禁计入 Line 10100 或 Line 20700。

variants.pt: 加拿大就业额规则与省表
variants.trap: 就业额自雇不适用与省表缺失陷阱
variants.stem: An accountant is preparing a 2026 tax return for a Vancouver employee who earned $55,000 in salary on Line 10100 and incurred $2,000 in unvouched transit and clothing expenses. What is the maximum Canada employment amount credit the employee can claim on federal Line 31260, and do they need to submit expense receipts?
variants.zh: 会计师正在为一位温哥华雇员编制 2026 年税表，该雇员在第 10100 行有 $55,000 的工资收入，并发生了 $2,000 未保留发票的通勤与工作置装支出。该雇员在联邦第 31260 行最高可申报多少加拿大就业额抵免，是否需要提交支出发票？

opts.t: $1,501, and no receipts or proof of expenses are required.
opts.w: 正确。就业额取 1,501 元上限与当年雇佣收入孰低，55,000 元远超上限，故取 1,501 元；这项抵免本来就是给受雇杂项支出的固定弥补，不需要凭证。

opts.t: $2,000, provided original receipts are uploaded through CRA My Account.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大就业额是固定上限抵免，不按实际开支 2,000 元报销。

opts.t: $1,000, because statutory credits cannot exceed the base unindexed amount stated in ITA s.118(10).
opts.w: 错误。报税用 s.117.1 指数化后的现行值（2026 税年 1,501 元），不是 2006 年条文面值 $1,000。

opts.t: $0, because employees earning over $50,000 are clawed back from claiming employment credits.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大就业额无高收入扣回机制，所有受雇纳税人均可依法享受。

variants.pt: 多雇主CPP超缴分流计算
variants.trap: 照抄实扣金额
variants.stem: In 2026, Brenda held two concurrent jobs in Surrey. Employer A deducted $2,500.00 in Box 16, and Employer B deducted $2,400.00 in Box 16. Neither employer deducted CPP2 (Box 16A is blank). Her total pensionable earnings from both T4 slips were $88,000, exceeding both the YMPE ($74,600) and YAMPE ($85,000). Total CPP deducted was $4,900.00. What is Brenda's correct CPP overpayment amount to be refunded on Line 44800?
variants.zh: 2026 年，Brenda 在素里同时兼做两份工作。雇主 A 代扣了 $2,500.00 的 CPP（Box 16），雇主 B 代扣了 $2,400.00 的 CPP（Box 16），两家雇主均未扣缴 CPP2（Box 16A 为空）。两张 T4 的可供款收入合计为 $88,000，超过了 YMPE（$74,600）与 YAMPE（$85,000）。实扣 CPP 合计为 $4,900.00。Brenda 在 Line 44800 上应申报退回的 CPP 超缴金额是多少？

opts.t: $669.55, calculated by simply subtracting the 2026 maximum Box 16 threshold ($4,230.45) from her total deductions.
opts.w: 错误。只减了第一层上限 $4,230.45，漏掉收入已超 YMPE 依法应缴的 CPP2（416 元），超缴额被算大。

opts.t: $0.00, because the uncollected CPP2 liability of $416.00 cancels out any potential overpayment.
opts.w: 错判净额正负。实扣 $4,900.00 高于全部应缴法定总额 $4,646.45，冲抵欠缴的 CPP2 后仍有净超缴，不会归零。

opts.t: $253.55, her $4,900.00 withheld minus the $4,646.45 required for base, enhanced and CPP2 together.
$416.00, representing the maximum employee second additional contribution payable under Schedule 8.
opts.w: 张冠李戴。$416.00 是 2026 年 CPP2 的应缴法定上限，并非超缴退税金额。

variants.pt: EI二千元低收入退还开关
variants.trap: 将EI二千元开关误作免税额
variants.stem: In 2026, Maya worked as a casual weekend worker earning a total of $1,600 in insurable earnings (Box 24). Her employer deducted $26.08 in EI premiums (Box 18). Maya wants to know how her EI premiums will be handled when filing her 2026 tax return using Form T2204. Which statement correctly describes the outcome?
variants.zh: 2026 年，Maya 从事临时周末工作，全年累计可保收入（Box 24）为 $1,600。雇主在 Box 18 代扣了 $26.08 的 EI 保费。Maya 想了解在通过 T2204 表申报 2026 年个税时，这笔 EI 保费将如何处理。下列哪项陈述准确描述了其申报结果？

opts.t: The $26.08 is converted into a non-refundable tax credit on Line 31200 because all withheld EI premiums generate non-refundable credits.
opts.w: 忽略了 $2,000 低收入开关。可保收入不超过 $2,000 时不可进 Line 31200 抵免，必须全额退款。

opts.t: The full $26.08 is refunded to Maya on Line 45000, and Line 31200 is set to zero, because her insurable earnings did not exceed $2,000.
opts.w: 准确判定低收入退费规则。Maya 的可保收入为 $1,600，未超过 $2,000 临界线，全额已扣保费 $26.08 自动通过 T2204 转入 Line 45000 退还，Line 31200 为零。

opts.t: Only the portion of premiums corresponding to earnings above $1,000 is refundable, while the remainder is forfeited.
opts.w: 捏造分段规则。EI 没有 $1,000 分段扣缴或部分没收规则，低于 $2,000 为 100% 全额退还。

opts.t: The $26.08 cannot be refunded unless Maya also had CPP deductions exceeding the basic exemption on her T4 slip.
opts.w: 混淆两套独立险种。EI 的超缴与低收入退还完全独立于 CPP，不需要 CPP 扣缴作为前置条件。

variants.pt: 满18岁CPP折算与EI对照
variants.trap: 将CPP按月折算套用于EI
variants.stem: Chloe celebrated her 18th birthday on September 22, 2026. During the remainder of 2026, she earned $8,000 in employment income. Her employer withheld both CPP and EI premiums. When preparing Schedule 8 and Form T2204, how many months should be entered for Chloe's CPP contributory period, and how are her EI premiums evaluated?
variants.zh: Chloe 于 2026 年 9 月 22 日庆祝了 18 岁生日。在 2026 年剩余时间里，她赚取了 $8,000 的受雇收入。雇主代扣了 CPP 与 EI 保费。在准备 Schedule 8 与 T2204 表时，Chloe 的 CPP 供款期应输入多少个月？她的 EI 保费又该如何评估？

opts.t: CPP contributory period is 4 months (September to December); EI insurable earnings ceiling is prorated to 4/12 of the 2026 MIE.
opts.w: 数错月份且将折算套用于 EI。满 18 岁当月（9月）不计，供款期从 10 月起算；且 EI 绝不进行任何按月折算。

opts.t: CPP contributory period is 12 months because she reached the age of majority during the tax year; EI applies normally.
opts.w: 遗漏按月折算规则。税法明确规定年满 18 岁当年供款期短于全年，必须打折。

opts.t: CPP contributory period is 3 months, and EI premiums are entirely waived because her earnings occurred across fewer than six active months.
opts.w: 捏造 EI 豁免条件。EI 保费的征缴与受雇月数长短无关，只要有受雇收入即须正常征收。

opts.t: 3 months (October to December), with the exemption prorated to 3/12; EI is assessed on the full $8,000.
opts.w: 正确。生日在 9 月，合格月数是生日当月之后的 10、11、12 月共 3 个月，免税额折算为 3,500 元 × 3/12 = 875 元；EI 不受年龄与月份影响，按 8,000 元全额计算。

variants.pt: 家庭办公室详细法限制
variants.trap: 房主在家庭办公室扣除按揭利息
variants.stem: Sarah, a salaried graphic designer in Burnaby, rented a two-bedroom apartment in 2026. Under a formal T2200 arrangement, she used one bedroom exclusively as a home office, representing 20% of the apartment's square footage. In 2026, she paid $24,000 in residential rent, $1,800 in utilities (heat and electricity), $960 in home internet monthly access fees, $600 in tenant home insurance, and $1,500 to purchase an ergonomic workstation desk. Her rent, utilities and internet access fees add up to $26,760. What is Sarah's eligible home office deduction on Form T777?
variants.zh: Sarah 是本拿比的一名受薪平面设计师，2026 年租住在一套两居室公寓中。在正式 T2200 安排下，她将其中一间卧室专门用作家庭办公室，占公寓总面积的 20%。2026 年，她支付了住宅租金 $24,000、公用事业费（水暖电）$1,800、家庭网络月度接入费 $960、租客家庭保险 $600，并花费 $1,500 购买了一张人体工学办公桌。她的租金、水暖电与网络接入费合计 $26,760。Sarah 在 T777 表上合格的家庭办公室扣除额是多少？

opts.t: $5,352: 20% of rent, utilities and internet ($26,760)
opts.w: 正确。受薪租客可扣租金、水暖电与网络接入费：$24,000 + $1,800 + $960 = $26,760，× 20% = $5,352；房屋保险只有佣金雇员可扣，办公桌是资本性支出。

opts.t: $5,472: the same plus 20% of the $600 insurance
opts.w: 错误。受薪雇员误扣房屋保险：$5,352 + $600 × 20%（$120）= $5,472；房屋保险只有 Box 42 有数的佣金雇员可扣。

opts.t: $5,652: the same plus 20% of the $1,500 desk
opts.w: 错误。把办公桌当办公用品：$5,352 + $1,500 × 20%（$300）= $5,652；办公桌是资本性支出，不能扣也不能计 CCA。

opts.t: $4,800: 20% of the $24,000 rent only
opts.w: 错误。只算租金（$24,000 × 20%）；水暖电与网络月费也在受薪雇员可扣清单里。

variants.pt: 佣金雇员与受薪口径二选一
