opts.t: The buyer ignores the accrued interest paid and treats the entire subsequent coupon payment as a tax-free return of capital.
opts.w: 属于「免税本金误区」。后续收到的利息仍须正常申报，已支付的应计利息有专门的法定扣除机制，不能直接认定为免税资本返还。

opts.t: The buyer must wait until the bond is disposed of, treating the accrued interest paid as an allowable capital loss on Schedule 3.
opts.w: 属于「资本亏损定性陷阱」。买方支付的应计利息属于利息性质支出，应当期在承担费用中扣除，不能转化为资本亏损。

opts.t: The buyer must add the accrued interest paid to their gross income on line 12100 and claim a 50% deduction on line 12700.
opts.w: 属于「重复计入与分类混淆陷阱」。买方支付的是利息成本，绝不能并入自己总收入再去做资本利得扣除。

opts.t: Deduct the accrued interest paid to the seller on line 22100 and reduce the bond's ACB by the same amount.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节第3步，中途受让债券的买方可以在第22100行将这笔已计入卖方收入的应计利息申报为扣除项（Interest Paid by You），同时必须相应调低自己的债券调整后成本基数（ACB）。

variants.pt: T3信托单各框号分流填报
variants.trap: T3框号混填陷阱
variants.stem: A tax preparer is completing a return for a client who received a T3 slip displaying $4,000 in Box 21 (Capital gains) and $800 in Box 26 (Other income). What is the correct reporting line and treatment on the T1 return for these two boxes?
variants.zh: 一名报税员正在为一位客户报税，其收到的 T3 凭单上显示 Box 21（资本利得）$4,000以及 Box 26（其他收入）$800。这两个框号在 T1 税表上的正确申报行号与处理方式是什么？

opts.t: Box 21 goes through Schedule 3, giving a $2,000 taxable capital gain on line 12700; Box 26 goes on line 13000.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节第4步，T3表Box 21属于资本利得，必须填入附表3（Schedule 3）并按50%纳入率进入第12700行（应税金额$2,000）；Box 26属于信托分配的其他收入，必须填入第13000行，不能混入第12100行。

opts.t: Both Box 21 and Box 26 are combined into a single entry of $4,800 on line 12100 under interest and other investment income.
opts.w: 属于「T3整单混填陷阱」。将资本利得与其他收入整单混填入第12100行，不仅剥夺了资本利得50%纳入率的优惠，还会引起CRA系统不匹配核查。

opts.t: Box 21 is reported at 100% ($4,000) on line 12700, and Box 26 is grossed up and reported on line 12000 as Canadian dividend income.
opts.w: 属于「纳入率与定性错误」。资本利得纳入率为50%而非100%，信托其他收入不是加拿大公司股息，不得毛额化填入第12000行。

opts.t: Box 21 is reported on line 13000, and Box 26 is reported on Schedule 3 at 50% ($400).
opts.w: 属于「框号完全倒置陷阱」。将资本利得与信托其他收入的行号张冠李戴，完全颠倒了税表流向。

variants.pt: 归属规则与TOSI分工协调
variants.trap: 反避税机制混淆陷阱
variants.stem: When analyzing an anti-avoidance situation involving a private corporation distributing dividends to family members, how does ITA s.74.5(13) prevent double taxation between attribution rules and the Tax on Split Income (TOSI)?
variants.zh: 在分析涉及私有企业向家庭成员分配股息的反避税情景时，ITA s.74.5(13) 如何防止归属规则与分割收入税（TOSI）之间的重复课税？

opts.t: If an amount of private corporate dividend received by a spouse is taxed under TOSI, that same amount must also be attributed back to the other spouse under s.74.1(1) and taxed a second time.
opts.w: 属于「重复课税误解」。税法s.74.5(13)正是为了排除这种重复征税后果而设立的法定协调收口。

opts.t: Under s.74.5(13), an amount already subject to TOSI is excluded from the attribution rules, so it is not taxed twice.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第2.4节，ITA s.74.5(13)明确规定：已经按分割收入税（TOSI）课过税的部分，归属规则不再重复起作用，从而在立法上排除了对同一笔分红重复适用两套反避税规则。

opts.t: Attribution rules require active business involvement, whereas TOSI applies whenever cash is gifted between spouses without any business involvement.
opts.w: 属于「适用对象完全倒置陷阱」。TOSI考察的是企业真实经营参与度（如排除股份/排除营业），归属规则关注的是无偿或低息财产转移。

opts.t: Attribution rules automatically apply the top marginal tax bracket, whereas TOSI taxes dividends at the recipient's personal progressive rates.
opts.w: 属于「税率机制颠倒错误」。TOSI强制按最高联邦与省边际税率征税，而归属规则是将收入拉回转移人名下按转移人的整体边际税率计税。

variants.pt: 现行½纳入率与应税利得计算
variants.trap: 纳入率过期拟议陷阱
variants.stem: In November 2026, Chloe realized a capital gain of $400,000 from disposing of investment property held in Canada. Her tax preparer relied on an outdated 2025 study manual that instructed preparers to apply a 2/3 inclusion rate to individual gains exceeding $250,000. Under the enacted 2026 federal rules, what is Chloe's correct taxable capital gain for line 12700?
variants.zh: 2026年11月，Chloe 处置加拿大境内的投资物业实现了$400,000资本利得。她的报税员依据一本过期的2025年培训考试资料，指示其对个人超过$250,000的利得部分适用2/3纳入率。根据2026年已生效的联邦规则，Chloe 在 line 12700 上正确的应税资本利得是多少？

opts.w: 属于「纳入率过期拟议陷阱」。以25万为分界线套用66.67%的算法从未生效，讲义第2.1节明确指出该提议已在2025年被彻底取消。

opts.t: $200,000, because the federal inclusion rate remains 50% across the entire gain without any threshold tiering.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第2.1节，2026税年的资本利得纳入率依然是全额按½（50%）计算，不存在$250,000的分段门槛。$400,000 × ½ ＝ $200,000进入第12700行。

opts.t: $266,680, calculated as a uniform 66.67% inclusion rate on all capital gains realized after June 2024.
opts.w: 属于「提案生效误判陷阱」。2024年6月25日生效的2/3纳入率提案未获御准，且已被正式废止，Schedule 3官方表格明确印制50%。

opts.t: $100,000, because personal investment properties receive an additional 50% secondary exemption under provincial rules.
opts.w: 属于「捏造二次减免错误」。省税以联邦应税收入为税基，没有任何省份对个人投资物业额外减半课税。

variants.pt: 同种财产加权ACB与T5008
variants.trap: T5008成本栏直抄陷阱
variants.stem: Emily owns shares of ABC Corp. in two non-registered accounts. Account X holds 200 shares bought at $20 each ($4,000 total, no commission). Account Y holds 300 shares bought at $40 each ($12,000 total, no commission). In 2026 she sold 250 shares from Account Y at $60 per share ($15,000 proceeds, no commission). Account Y's T5008 shows a cost of $10,000. What is her capital gain under ITA s.47?
variants.zh: Emily 在两个非注册账户里持有 ABC Corp. 股票：账户 X 持有每股 $20 买入的 200 股（共 $4,000，无佣金）；账户 Y 持有每股 $40 买入的 300 股（共 $12,000，无佣金）。2026 年她从账户 Y 以每股 $60 卖出 250 股（处置所得 $15,000，无佣金）。账户 Y 的 T5008 成本栏为 $10,000。按 ITA s.47，她的资本利得是多少？

opts.t: $7,000, using an ACB of $8,000 for the 250 shares, averaged over all 500 shares in both accounts.
$5,000, taking the $10,000 cost on Account Y's T5008 slip as the ACB of the 250 shares sold.
opts.w: 错误。照抄 T5008 成本栏（只含账户 Y 每股 40 元的持仓），漏了跨账户加权平均，算出 5,000 元会少报利得。

opts.t: $9,000, treating the 200 cheaper Account X shares as sold first and 50 Account Y shares after them.
opts.w: 错误。先进先出：成本 4,000 ＋ 50 × 40 ＝ 6,000 元，利得 9,000 元。加拿大税法不认先进先出，同种财产必须加权平均。

opts.t: $3,500, because the resulting capital gain must be halved before stating the capital gain amount.
opts.w: 属于「概念混淆错误」。资本利得为$7,000，乘以50%纳入率后的应税资本利得才是$3,500。

variants.pt: 自住转出租视同处置与申报罚款
variants.trap: 主居所免税不报没事陷阱
variants.stem: Grace purchased a residential townhouse in 2017 for $500,000 and resided there until August 2026, when she relocated and converted the townhouse entirely into a long-term rental property (FMV was $800,000). She filed her 2026 return without reporting the conversion or submitting Form T2091, assuming that zero cash flow meant zero reporting. What is the potential statutory penalty if Grace requests CRA to accept a late principal residence designation under ITA s.220(3.5)?
variants.zh: Grace 于2017年以$500,000购入一套联排住宅并一直自住，直至2026年8月迁出并将该物业全部转为长期出租物业（当时FMV为$800,000）。她在申报2026年税表时未申报该项用途转变亦未提交 Form T2091，误以为零现金流即无需申报。若 Grace 事后请求 CRA 根据 ITA s.220(3.5) 接受迟报的主居所指定，其面临的潜在法定罚款是多少？

opts.t: A fixed penalty of 50% of the deemed capital gain ($150,000), payable immediately.
opts.w: 属于「捏造巨额比例罚款错误」。迟做主居所指定的罚金并非按资本利得的一半计算，而是有法定封顶金额。

opts.t: Zero penalty, because CRA automatically grants free retroactive elections for principal residence conversions within 10 years.
opts.w: 属于「免费补救幻想陷阱」。讲义第一节1.4与第六节明确指出，迟做指定不是免费的，税法设定了专门的按月累进罚款。

opts.t: An administrative charge of $1,000 per year, capped at $10,000 under provincial legislation.
opts.w: 属于「省税法条捏造错误」。主居所指定罚款属于联邦所得税法ITA s.220(3.5)管辖，非省税项目。

opts.t: A penalty of $100 for each complete month the designation is late, up to a statutory maximum of $8,000.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第一节1.4与第六节6.2，请求CRA接受迟报的主居所指定（Form T2091），罚金为每迟报满一个月$100，法定上限封顶$8,000（ITA s.220(3.5)）。

variants.pt: 表面亏损判定与成本基础转移
variants.trap: 表面亏损30天窗口陷阱
variants.stem: On May 10, 2026, Hannah sold 500 ETF units at a loss of $8,000 in her non-registered trading account. On May 22, 2026 (12 days later), a private corporation wholly owned and controlled by Hannah purchased 500 identical ETF units and continued holding them beyond 30 days. How does the superficial loss rule affect Hannah's $8,000 capital loss?
variants.zh: 2026年5月10日，Hannah 在其非注册交易账户中卖出500个ETF单位，产生$8,000亏损。2026年5月22日（12天后），一家由 Hannah 全资拥有并控制的私人公司买入了500个完全相同的ETF单位并持续持有超过30天。表面亏损规则如何影响 Hannah 的这笔$8,000资本亏损？

opts.t: Hannah can claim the allowable capital loss of $4,000 because a corporation is a distinct legal person under corporate law.
opts.w: 属于「法人独立资格抗辩陷阱」。关联人（affiliated person）的定义包括纳税人或其配偶控制的公司，受控公司买回同样触发表面亏损。

opts.t: It is a superficial loss: denied to Hannah in 2026, with the $8,000 added to the ACB of the units her corporation holds.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节3.4，受纳税人控制的公司属于关联人（affiliated person）。在处置后30天内由受控公司买回同种财产，构成表面亏损；Hannah当年不能扣除亏损，该$8,000并入公司名下该ETF的ACB中。

opts.t: Hannah is assessed an immediate penalty of 20.5% under the alternative minimum tax rules for abusive wash sales.
opts.w: 属于「错套AMT惩罚陷阱」。表面亏损的处理机制是调增替代财产ACB，不产生AMT惩罚性罚金。

opts.t: The loss can be carried back 3 years immediately using Form T1A to offset Hannah's past taxable capital gains.
opts.w: 属于「表面亏损强行结转错误」。表面亏损当年直接归零并转移至ACB，无法形成当年的净资本亏损（net capital loss），因而不能使用T1A回抵。

variants.pt: 净资本亏损结转与死亡例外
variants.trap: 亏损冲抵工资致命错报
variants.stem: Jack passed away in October 2026. On his final tax return (and the return for 2025, the immediately preceding year), his legal representative discovered $40,000 in unapplied net capital losses that exceeded Jack's remaining taxable capital gains. How does the special rule under ITA s.111(2) apply to Jack's unabsorbed net capital losses?
variants.zh: Jack 于2026年10月去世。在其最终纳税申报表（以及其前一年的2025年税表）中，其法定代表人发现有$40,000未申请的净资本亏损超出了 Jack 剩余的应税资本利得。根据 ITA s.111(2) 的特别规则，这笔未被吸收的净资本亏损应如何处理？

opts.t: The unused net capital losses immediately expire upon death and cannot offset any remaining income of the deceased.
opts.w: 属于「死亡结转终止误解」。税法专为逝者设立了特别宽免，未用完的净资本亏损不会直接作废。

opts.t: The losses must be transferred to Jack's surviving spouse and can only offset the spouse's capital gains in subsequent years.
opts.w: 属于「配偶继承亏损错误」。个人净资本亏损属于个人独立税务属性，不能直接转移到配偶未来的报税表中。

opts.t: In the year of death and the year before, unused net capital losses can be applied against any other income of the deceased.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节3.4与第七节自查清单第5条，ITA s.111(2)明确规定，纳税人死亡当年及其前一年，未用完的净资本亏损（net capital loss）可以冲抵任何收入（any income），不再受「只能冲抵资本利得」的严格限制。

opts.t: The losses can only be applied against dividend gross-up amounts on Schedule 4.
opts.w: 属于「荒谬抵扣限制错误」。死亡当年的宽免针对的是纳税人的总综合收入，不限于股息毛额化部分。

variants.pt: PUP与LPP财产规则
variants.trap: 个人用途财产亏损扣除陷阱
variants.stem: In 2026, Laura sold a piece of rare jewelry (listed personal property, LPP) for $3,000 (original cost was $7,000), suffering a $4,000 LPP loss. She also realized an $8,000 capital gain from selling publicly traded shares. How does the loss from the jewelry interact with Laura's other investment gains?
variants.zh: 2026年，Laura 以$3,000卖出了一件珍稀珠宝（属于上市个人财产，LPP）（原成本$7,000），产生$4,000的 LPP 亏损。她当年处置上市公司股票还实现了$8,000资本利得。该珠宝亏损如何与 Laura 的其他投资利得相互作用？

opts.t: The $4,000 LPP loss immediately offsets the $8,000 stock gain on Schedule 3, reducing Laura's net capital gain to $4,000.
opts.w: 属于「LPP亏损独立池混淆陷阱」。LPP亏损不能冲抵常规股票或房地产的资本利得，只能冲抵LPP类财产（珠宝、艺术品等）的利得。

opts.t: The jewelry loss is treated as personal-use property (PUP) and is permanently forfeited without any carryback or carryforward.
opts.w: 属于「LPP与PUP混同错误」。珠宝属于税法明确列举的五类LPP之一，享有向后回抵3年、向前结转7年的待遇，不是普通PUP那样永久作废。

opts.t: Laura must deduct the $4,000 loss against her employment income on line 23200.
opts.w: 属于「跨类别乱冲陷阱」。资本属性的亏损严禁冲抵受雇收入。

opts.t: It cannot offset the stock gain; the LPP loss can only reduce LPP gains, 3 years back or 7 years forward.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节3.4与第七节自查清单第9条，上市个人财产（LPP）亏损自成一池，只能冲抵LPP利得，不能冲抵普通股票利得；未抵扣的LPP亏损可向后回抵3年、向前结转7年（ITA s.41(2)）。

variants.pt: LCGE与最低税AMT互动
variants.trap: 大额资本利得漏跑AMT陷阱
variants.stem: Nancy claimed the full Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption (LCGE) on the sale of her farm property in 2026, which eliminated her regular income tax. However, due to the 100% inclusion rate and 7/5 deduction scaling under AMT, Nancy was required to pay $35,000 in Alternative Minimum Tax for 2026. Nancy plans to retire immediately and anticipates having very modest pension income in future years. What is the tax recovery mechanism and risk regarding Nancy's $35,000 AMT payment?
variants.zh: Nancy 在2026年出售农场财产时全额申请了终身资本利得豁免（LCGE），从而免除了其常规所得税。然而，由于AMT下100%的纳入率和7/5的扣除放大比例，Nancy 在2026年仍需缴纳$35,000的替代性最低税（AMT）。Nancy 计划立即退休，预计未来年份的养老金收入非常微薄。关于 Nancy 这笔$35,000的 AMT 税款，其回抵机制与潜在风险是什么？

opts.t: It is a prepayment that can offset regular tax above minimum tax for 7 years, but may be lost if her later regular tax is too low.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第二节2.3与第六节6.3，多缴的AMT可在其后7个税年内，在常规税超过最低税的限度内申请回抵（ITA s.120.2）；但如果纳税人卖掉资产后随即退休、未来7年收入过低无法产生足够的常规税，多缴的AMT将面临到期作废无法抵回的风险。

opts.t: Nancy can apply for an immediate cash refund of the $35,000 from CRA at the end of the 2026 tax year by filing Form T1A.
opts.w: 属于「AMT现金返还妄想陷阱」。AMT不是多退少补的预扣款，不能通过T1A直接申请现金退款，只能逐年冲抵未来的常规应税税额。

opts.t: The $35,000 is an irreversible non-refundable punitive fine imposed by CRA for claiming high capital gains deductions.
opts.w: 属于「AMT罚款误解」。讲义明确说明AMT不是罚款，而是一套平行的税收计算制度，具有法定7年回抵期。

opts.t: Nancy can carry back the AMT liability to offset taxes paid in any of the preceding 10 years.
opts.w: 属于「向后回抵十年捏造错误」。AMT没有向后回抵（carry back）的机制，只能向后结转7年（carry forward 7 years）。

variants.pt: RRSP额度计算与年限封顶
variants.trap: RRSP额度公式计算陷阱
variants.stem: In 2025, Evelyn had an earned income of $210,000 as a corporate executive. Her 2025 T4 slip reported a Pension Adjustment (PA) of $12,000. Her Notice of Assessment for 2025 showed zero unused RRSP contribution room carried forward. The 2026 statutory annual RRSP dollar limit is $33,810. What is Evelyn's RRSP deduction limit for the 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: 2025年，Evelyn 作为企业高管的赚取收入为$210,000。她2025年的 T4 凭单上显示养老金调整额（PA）为$12,000。她2025年的评税通知书显示结转的未用 RRSP 额度为$0。2026税年法定 RRSP 年度法定上限为$33,810。Evelyn 在2026税年的 RRSP 扣除限额是多少？

opts.t: $25,800, calculated as 18% of $210,000 ($37,800) minus $12,000 PA, ignoring the statutory annual dollar cap.
opts.w: 属于「忽略年度上限封顶陷阱」。$210,000 × 18% ＝ $37,800，已经超过了2026年法定上限$33,810，必须被强行封顶在$33,810。

opts.t: $33,810, calculated as the statutory maximum without subtracting the Pension Adjustment.
opts.w: 属于「遗漏扣减PA陷阱」。即使触及最高限额，在雇主年金计划中积累的PA（$12,000）仍须从当年可用额度中全额扣除。

opts.t: $21,810, calculated as the 2026 statutory maximum cap of $33,810 minus the $12,000 Pension Adjustment.
$37,800, calculated solely as 18% of earned income with no caps or adjustments applied.
opts.w: 属于「纯比例裸算错误」。既未考虑法定封顶上限$33,810，也未扣除企业年金PA调整额。

variants.pt: TFSA取存时点与超额罚税
variants.trap: TFSA同年取存额度恢复陷阱
variants.stem: On January 1, 2026, Grace had an unused TFSA contribution room of $4,000 carried forward, plus her new 2026 annual room of $7,000 (total available room: $11,000). In March 2026, Grace contributed $11,000 to her TFSA. In May 2026, she withdrew $6,000. In October 2026, Grace deposited $6,000 back into her TFSA and withdrew the $6,000 excess on November 15, 2026. How many months of the 1% per month Part XI.01 penalty tax does Grace owe for 2026?
variants.zh: 2026年1月1日，Grace 拥有结转的未用 TFSA 额度$4,000，加上2026年新增年度额度$7,000（可用额度总计$11,000）。2026年3月，Grace 向其 TFSA 存入$11,000。2026年5月，她提取了$6,000。2026年10月，Grace 又将$6,000重新存入该 TFSA，后于2026年11月15日将该笔$6,000超额款项取出。在2026税年，Grace 需为几个月份缴纳每月1%的 Part XI.01 罚税？

opts.t: 0 months, because her total net contributions in 2026 ($11,000) did not exceed her initial January 1 room of $11,000.
opts.w: 属于「总净值相抵错觉陷阱」。TFSA额度是动态按供款总额跟踪的，不能用年终净供款额来倒算中间的超额。

opts.t: 0 months, because Grace corrected the excess within 30 days of the deposit.
opts.w: 属于「虚构30天宽限期陷阱」。只有在产生超额的同一个自然月结束前取出才免当月税；跨入11月已产生第2个计税月份。

opts.t: 1 month, because she withdrew the funds in mid-November before November month-end.
opts.w: 属于「月度计税按日折算误解」。只要该自然月内有任何一天存在超额，该月即按最高超额全额计征1%税，11月仍算整整1个月。

opts.t: 2 months, October and November, since the May withdrawal only restores room on January 1, 2027.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第二节2.3与第三节3.1，5月取出的$6,000要到次年1月1日才恢复为可用额度；10月重新存入后即构成$6,000超额供款。由于超额状态存在于10月全月和11月上半月，因此跨越了10月和11月两个日历月，须按2个月征收每月1%的超额税。

variants.pt: 配偶RRSP归属日历窗口
variants.trap: 配偶RRSP归属日历年计算陷阱
variants.stem: In January 2025, Henry contributed $12,000 to a spousal RRSP for his spouse, Olivia, and deducted the amount on his 2024 tax return (using the first 60 days rule). Neither Henry nor Olivia made any further contributions. In December 2026, Olivia withdrew $8,000 from this spousal RRSP. Under ITA s.146(8.3), how is this $8,000 withdrawal taxed?
variants.zh: 2025年1月，Henry 向其配偶 Olivia 的配偶 RRSP 供款$12,000，并利用前60天规则在自己的2024年税表上做了扣除。此后两人未再存入任何配偶供款。2026年12月，Olivia 从该配偶 RRSP 中提取了$8,000现金。根据 ITA s.146(8.3)，这笔$8,000的提取应如何课税？

opts.t: The entire $8,000 is attributed back to Henry and taxed as his income on his 2026 tax return using Form T2205.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第三节3.4，配偶提取发生在2026年，归属窗口覆盖提取当年（2026）及前两个纳税年度（2024与2025）。Henry在2025年1月存入的$12,000正落在该三年窗口期内；实际提取额$8,000与供款额$12,000取较小者，因此全部$8,000归属回供款人Henry头上课税，通过Form T2205计算并计入Henry的2026年收入。

opts.t: The entire $8,000 is taxed as Olivia's income because Olivia is the legal annuitant and owner of the account.
opts.w: 属于「持有人纳税一刀切陷阱」。配偶RRSP在归属窗口期内的提取依法优先触发归属规则，不能直接按配偶收入课税。

opts.t: Only $4,000 is attributed to Henry because the attribution amount is capped at 50% of the withdrawal.
opts.w: 属于「虚构半数归属上限陷阱」。归属规则采用取小者原则（lesser of total contributions in window and withdrawal amount），本案$8,000小于$12,000，全额归属。

opts.t: The withdrawal is exempt from attribution because Henry originally claimed the deduction against his 2024 tax return.
opts.w: 属于「前60天扣除豁免归属误解」。供款实际发生于2025年日历年，不论其扣在2024还是2025年，均落在2026年提取的三年回溯窗口之内。

variants.pt: FHSA最长参与期与到期处理
variants.trap: FHSA到期不关户全额课税陷阱
variants.stem: Lucas opened his first FHSA in 2023. By 2037, Lucas has never purchased a home and has never made any qualifying withdrawal. In 2038, Lucas reaches the 15th anniversary of opening his FHSA, and the account holds a fair market value of $55,000. Lucas does not want the $55,000 to be taxed as income. What is Lucas's proper tax-deferred exit strategy before December 31, 2038?
variants.zh: Lucas 于2023年开立了首个 FHSA。截至2037年，Lucas 从未买房也从未做过任何合格提取。2038年，Lucas 迎来了开立 FHSA 满15周年的年份，账户内资产公允市值为$55,000。Lucas 不希望这$55,000被计入收入课税。在2038年12月31日之前，Lucas 应当采取何种合法的递延税出口策略？

opts.t: Withdraw the entire $55,000 in cash and claim it as a non-taxable personal savings allowance on Schedule 15.
opts.w: 属于「非合格提款免税妄想陷阱」。未购房直接提现属于应税提取（taxable withdrawal），必须全额并入当年收入课税。

opts.t: Transfer the whole balance directly to his RRSP or RRIF, which defers tax and uses no RRSP contribution room.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第二节2.4提示框，未买成房的纳税人在FHSA参与期结束前，最佳出口是将全部余额直接转入RRSP或RRIF。该转移依法享受完全税收递延（tax-deferred），且法律明确规定不占用纳税人的RRSP供款额度（does not use RRSP contribution room）。

opts.t: Transfer the $55,000 to his TFSA tax-free, provided his TFSA has at least $55,000 in accumulated room.
opts.w: 属于「跨注册计划直接混转陷阱」。FHSA法律规定只能免税转入RRSP或RRIF，严禁直接转入TFSA。

opts.t: Lucas is barred from transferring the funds and must forfeit 30% withholding tax directly to the federal receiver general.
opts.w: 属于「捏造惩罚性没收条款陷阱」。税法给予纳税人充分的转入RRSP/RRIF保护机制，不存在强制扣罚30%无法救济的情况。

variants.pt: HBP提取上限与五年宽限期
variants.trap: HBP还款宽限期政策更新陷阱
variants.stem: Samuel withdrew $60,000 under the Home Buyers' Plan (HBP) in 2026, with his first repayment due in 2031 (annual required repayment: $4,000). In 2031, Samuel contributes $10,000 to his RRSP. However, on his 2031 Schedule 7, Samuel fails to designate any portion of the contribution as an HBP repayment. What is the tax consequence of this omission under Canadian tax law?
variants.zh: Samuel 于2026年通过购房者计划（HBP）提取了$60,000，其首个还款年度为2031年（每年法定应还$4,000）。2031年，Samuel 向其 RRSP 存入了$10,000。然而，在2031年的 Schedule 7 上，Samuel 未将任何供款金额指定为 HBP 还款。根据加拿大税法，这一疏漏的税务后果是什么？

opts.t: CRA will automatically designate $4,000 of his RRSP contribution as an HBP repayment on his behalf without adjusting his income.
opts.w: 属于「CRA自动代办指定幻想陷阱」。CRA不会代纳税人做主观指定；Schedule 7未做指定依法直接视为当年未还款。

opts.t: The entire $10,000 contribution is rejected and refunded to Samuel with a $500 penalty.
opts.w: 属于「退还供款虚构惩罚陷阱」。$10,000供款完全合法并被作为常规RRSP供款处理，不会被退回。

opts.t: The $4,000 not repaid is added to his 2031 income, and the $10,000 is treated as an ordinary RRSP contribution.
opts.w: 正确。HBP 还款必须在 Schedule 7 上指定。没指定时，当年供款按普通供款处理，当年应还未还的 4,000 元直接计入 2031 年收入。

opts.t: Samuel's HBP repayment period is automatically extended from 15 years to 20 years with zero tax impact.
opts.w: 属于「自动顺延期限错误」。HBP的15年还款期是刚性的，欠缴年份直接变应税收入，还款期不会因此被拉长。

variants.pt: TFSA非居民供款独立罚税
variants.trap: 非居民TFSA供款独立罚税陷阱
variants.stem: Sophia was a non-resident of Canada for the entirety of the 2025 and 2026 tax years. She maintained an existing Canadian TFSA opened in 2020 that held Canadian dividend-paying stocks. In 2026, her TFSA generated $3,000 in Canadian dividends and realized $4,000 in capital gains, and Sophia made no new contributions or withdrawals. How are these 2026 account earnings treated by the CRA?
variants.zh: Sophia 在2025和2026两个税年整年均为加拿大非税务居民。她保留了2020年开立的加拿大 TFSA 账户，该账户持有派发股息的加拿大股票。2026年，该 TFSA 产生了$3,000加拿大股息，并实现了$4,000资本利得，Sophia 年内未做任何新供款或取款。CRA 对这笔2026年的账户收益如何征税？

opts.t: The $7,000 total earnings are subject to a 25% Canadian Part XIII withholding tax because she is a non-resident.
opts.w: 属于「非居民TFSA账户内收益误征税陷阱」。加拿大税法明确规定TFSA账户内的增值与分红即使持有人为非居民，在加拿大一侧依然享受免税待遇。

opts.t: Sophia owes a 1% per month penalty tax on the total fair market value of the account simply for maintaining a TFSA as a non-resident.
opts.w: 属于「持有即受罚误读陷阱」。非居民完全可以合法保留离境前开立的TFSA，只要不进行新供款，绝不会产生每月1%罚税。

opts.t: The account loses its registered tax-exempt status immediately and is converted into a regular taxable trading account.
opts.w: 属于「身份变更强制除名错误」。税法允许非居民继续持有TFSA外壳，无需强制转换为常规应税账户。

opts.t: The $7,000 stays exempt from Canadian tax; an existing TFSA keeps growing tax-free while the holder is non-resident.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第二节2.3「离境后TFSA的完整待遇」，成为非税务居民后，纳税人已有的TFSA账户可以继续保留，账户内的股息、利息与资本利得在加拿大一侧完全免税（居住国如英国/美国可能课税）。非居民受限的仅是「不得存入新资金」和「全年在册非居民不产生新额度」。

variants.pt: 71岁RRIF最低额与因子选择
variants.trap: RRIF最低提取额预扣税误解陷阱
variants.stem: Leonard turned 71 in 2025 and established his RRIF. On January 1, 2026, Leonard is 71 years old (turning 72 later in the year), and the fair market value of his RRIF is $400,000. Under Income Tax Regulations s.7308(4), the prescribed factor for age 71 is 5.28%. Leonard withdraws a total of $35,000 from his RRIF in 2026. What is the statutory minimum withdrawal amount, and how is withholding tax applied by the financial institution on this $35,000 withdrawal?
variants.zh: Leonard 于2025年年满71岁并设立了 RRIF。2026年1月1日，Leonard 年初年龄为71岁（年内晚些时候满72岁），其 RRIF 的公允市值为$400,000。根据《所得税条例》s.7308(4)，71岁对应的法定因子为5.28%。Leonard 于2026年共从该 RRIF 提取了$35,000现金。该 RRIF 当年的法定最低提取额是多少？金融机构对这笔$35,000提取如何代扣预扣税？

opts.t: Minimum CAD 21,120 with no withholding; the CAD 13,880 above it has 20% withheld, which is CAD 2,776.
The minimum amount is CAD 21,120, and the entire CAD 35,000 withdrawal is subject to a flat 30% withholding tax (CAD 10,500 withheld).
opts.w: 属于「全额按最高档预扣错误」。最低提取额依法不预扣，且超额部分$13,880在$15,000以下，预扣税率为20%而非30%。

opts.t: The minimum amount is CAD 35,000, and no withholding tax is deducted because RRIF withdrawals are completely exempt from tax withholding.
opts.w: 属于「超额提取免预扣误解」。超出法定最低额的提取款项必须依法按10/20/30%分档代扣代缴预扣税。

opts.t: The minimum amount is CAD 0 because Leonard can defer mandatory withdrawals until he reaches age 75.
opts.w: 属于「虚构延期至75岁陷阱」。71岁是硬性分水岭，从满71岁的次年（72岁那年年初）起每年必须强制提取最低额。

variants.pt: 出租折旧造亏限制
variants.trap: 误用 CCA 制造或扩大出租亏损抵扣其他收入
variants.stem: In the 2026 tax year, Diana owns two separate residential rental condominiums. Property 1 generated net rental income before CCA of $8,000. Property 2 incurred an operating rental loss before CCA of $3,000. Across both properties, the total maximum calculated CCA allowable under the class rates is $11,000. Diana has $90,000 in professional employment income. What is the maximum aggregate CCA deduction Diana can claim across both properties on Form T776 for 2026?
variants.zh: 在 2026 税年，Diana 拥有两处独立的住宅出租公寓。物业 1 在计提折旧前产生净租金收入 $8,000；物业 2 在计提折旧前发生运营租金亏损 $3,000。按资产类别税率计算，两处物业的理论最大可用 CCA 合计为 $11,000。Diana 当年另有 $90,000 的专业受雇收入。Diana 在 2026 年 T776 表上最多可就两处物业合计申报多少 CCA 折旧？

opts.t: $8,000, because the CCA limit is calculated individually for each profitable property without considering losses from other properties.
opts.w: 错误。误以为可以按单一盈利物业单独算上限。税法规定必须合并计算本人适用的全部出租物业损益，物业 2 的 $3,000 亏损必须与物业 1 的 $8,000 收益合并抵消，合计净出租收入仅为 $5,000。

opts.t: $5,000, which reduces Diana's combined net rental income to $0, with all remaining unclaimed capital cost retained in UCC.
opts.w: 正确。根据出租物业 CCA 限制规则，纳税人必须合并计算名下所有出租物业扣除其他费用后的净损益。物业 1 的净收入 $8,000 扣除物业 2 的净亏损 $3,000 后，合计净出租收入为 $5,000。因此，Diana 合计最多只能申报 $5,000 的折旧扣除额 (CCA)，将整体净出租收入降为零，不得利用折旧造亏抵扣其 $90,000 工资。

opts.t: $11,000, creating an allowable combined rental loss of $6,000 to offset Diana's professional employment earnings.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的违规造亏申报，违反了 CCA 不能制造或扩大出租亏损的核心法定红线。

opts.t: $0, because owning any loss-making rental property completely eliminates the taxpayer's eligibility to claim CCA for that tax year.
opts.w: 错误。拥有一处亏损物业不会剥夺所有物业提折旧的权利，只要合并后的合计出租净收入大于零，即可在合计净收入范围内申报 CCA。

variants.pt: 当期费用与资本支出辨析
variants.trap: 把资本改良当维修全额扣除
variants.stem: In 2026, landlord Nathan incurred two separate expenses for his rental condominium in Burnaby. First, he spent $14,000 replacing standard builder-grade laminate counters and hollow-core interior doors with luxury quartz countertops and custom solid mahogany doors, substantially enhancing the property's market value. Second, he paid $650 to an HVAC technician for annual furnace servicing and replacing air filters to restore standard operating condition. How must Nathan treat these two expenses on his 2026 tax return?
variants.zh: 2026 年，房东 Nathan 为其位于本拿比的投资公寓支付了两笔不同的费用。首先，他花费 $14,000 将原建筑商标配的普通复合台面和空心室内门拆除，更换为奢华石英石台面和定制实木红木门，大幅提升了房产的市场价值。其次，他支付了 $650 给暖通技工进行年度暖炉检修及更换滤网，以恢复正常运转状态。Nathan 在 2026 年税表上应如何处理这两笔支出？

opts.t: The entire $14,650 is a fully deductible current expense in 2026 because all expenses were incurred to attract higher-paying tenants.
opts.w: 错误。吸引高租金并不能改变资本支出的法律性质。大幅提升房屋档次与价值的豪华改装必须资本化逐年折旧。

opts.t: The entire $14,650 must be capitalized into Class 1 because any expenditure exceeding $500 is deemed capital in nature.
opts.w: 错误。税法中不存在所谓超过 $500 即强行资本化的金额硬门槛，恢复正常运转的例行检修维护（$650）属于纯粹的当期费用。

opts.t: The $14,000 upgrade is deductible in full in 2026, while the $650 routine servicing must be capitalized into UCC.
opts.w: 错误。定性颠倒。实质性改良必须资本化，例行维护与恢复原状属于当期扣除。

opts.t: The $650 servicing is a current expense for 2026; the $14,000 upgrade is capital and is depreciated through CCA.
opts.w: 正确。根据划分标准，$650 的暖炉检修和换滤网属于维持资产正常运转的经常性开支，为当期费用 (current expense)，当年全额扣除；而 $14,000 的升级换装显著改善了资产原有水平并带来长期增值利益，属于资本支出 (capital expenditure)，必须计入未折旧资本成本 (UCC) 逐年折旧。

variants.pt: 卖房折旧收回与资本利得
variants.trap: 将卖房利得与折旧收回混为一谈统一按五成计税
variants.stem: In 2026, Chloe sold her sole Class 1 rental building for allocated building proceeds of $320,000. She had purchased the building for $300,000 and claimed $50,000 in cumulative CCA in prior years, resulting in an opening UCC balance of $250,000. Chloe acquired no new rental buildings during the year. What amounts must Chloe include in her 2026 taxable income as recaptured CCA and taxable capital gain?
variants.zh: 2026 年，Chloe 出售了名下唯一的 Class 1 出租建筑，建筑分摊售价为 $320,000。她当年以 $300,000 购入该建筑，在过往年度累计申报了 $50,000 的 CCA，年初 UCC 余额为 $250,000。Chloe 当年未购入新出租建筑。Chloe 在 2026 年应税收入中必须计入多少折旧收回和应税资本利得？

opts.t: Recaptured CCA of $70,000 and taxable capital gain of $0, because all disposition proceeds under $350,000 are treated as ordinary recapture.
opts.w: 错误。折旧收回的法定上限是历史上实际申报过的折旧总额（$50,000），不可能产生 $70,000 的折旧收回；售价超过原始成本的 $20,000 属于资本利得。

opts.t: Recaptured CCA of $50,000 (100% inclusion in income), and a taxable capital gain of $10,000 ($20,000 capital gain × 50% inclusion rate).
opts.w: 正确。第一步，处置所得冲减 UCC 封顶在原始成本 $300,000。$300,000 减年初 UCC $250,000 = $50,000，该负数绝对值全额（100%）作为折旧收回 (Recaptured CCA) 计入收入；第二步，售价超出原成本部分为资本利得（$320,000 − $300,000 = $20,000），按 2026 税年现行 50% 纳入率计入应税资本利得为 $20,000 × 50% = $10,000。

opts.t: Recaptured CCA of $25,000 (50% inclusion) and taxable capital gain of $10,000 ($20,000 × 50%).
opts.w: 错误。误将折旧收回按 50% 折半计入。折旧收回不适用资本利得纳入率，必须 100% 全额计入所得。

opts.t: Recaptured CCA of $0 and a combined taxable capital gain of $35,000 ($70,000 total gain × 50%).
opts.w: 错误。将折旧收回与资本利得混为一谈，全部按 50% 优惠计税，忽略了税法对折旧收回全额补税的规定。

variants.pt: 不合规短租费用比例剔除
variants.trap: 将短租法定门槛误记为 30 天或以为 2026 仍有宽限
variants.stem: In 2026, George rented his Kelowna condominium exclusively through an online platform under three separate bookings of 40 consecutive days each (totaling 120 rented days). Kelowna municipal bylaws legally require short-term rental operators to hold a valid municipal business license, which George did not possess. Total annual property operating expenses for the condo were $12,000. How much of the $12,000 operating expenses can George deduct on Form T776 for 2026?
variants.zh: 2026 年，George 通过网络平台将其位于基隆拿的公寓出租，全年共完成三笔独立的订单，每笔租期均为连续 40 天（合计出租 120 天）。基隆拿市政法规明确要求短租经营者必须持有有效的市政营业执照，而 George 并未取得。该公寓全年的房屋运营费用为 $12,000。George 在 2026 年 T776 表上最多可扣除这 $12,000 运营费用中的多少金额？

opts.t: George can deduct all expenses allocated to the 120 rented days ($12,000 × 120/365) because the 2024 year-end compliance grace period remains permanently available.
opts.w: 错误。误以为 2024 年的补办合规宽限期在 2026 年仍可使用。2026 税年无任何宽限期，未合规短租费用直接剔除。

opts.t: George can deduct the entire $12,000 because each rental period exceeded 30 days, successfully bypassing the short-term rental classification.
opts.w: 错误。把短租法定门槛误记成了 30 天。ITA s.67.7 的法定短租门槛为不足 90 连续天，40 天的租约属于法定短租。

opts.t: $0 of the expenses allocated to the 120 rental days can be deducted, because every booking was under 90 consecutive days and lacked required licensing, and 2026 offers no grace period.
opts.w: 正确。根据《所得税法》第 67.7 条，由于三段租约每段均为 40 连续天（均不足 90 连续天），全部属于法定短租 (short-term rental)；在当地要求许可而未取得的情况下，2026 税年无任何宽限期，出租期间对应的全部运营费用依法全额剔除，不可抵扣。

opts.t: George can deduct 50% of the allocated expenses under standard administrative penalty reduction rules.
opts.w: 错误。税法规定按“不合规天数 ÷ 短租天数”比例全额剔除费用，由于所有短租天数均不合规，剔除比例为 100%，不存在减半的行政宽减。

variants.pt: 共有产权与合伙折旧差异
variants.trap: 将共有产权与合伙企业的折旧申报规则相混淆
variants.stem: Contrast the co-ownership scenario with a formal business partnership: Sarah and Michael formally registered a general commercial partnership that owns a residential rental building. For the 2026 tax year, the partnership generated net rental profit. Michael wants the partnership to claim maximum CCA to lower distributed income, but Sarah wants no CCA claimed this year. Under the Income Tax Act, how must CCA be handled for property owned by a partnership?
variants.zh: 对比共有产权与正式合伙企业的情形：Sarah 和 Michael 正式注册成立了一家普通商业合伙企业，该合伙拥有一栋住宅出租建筑。在 2026 税年，该合伙取得了净出租利润。Michael 希望合伙申报最大 CCA 以降低分得的净利润，但 Sarah 希望今年不申报 CCA。根据《所得税法》，合伙企业所拥有的财产应如何处理 CCA？

opts.t: CCA is decided and claimed once at the partnership level; partners cannot each make their own CCA claims.
opts.w: 正确。根据合伙企业 (partnership) 的税务规则，出租物业的资本财产属于合伙企业整体，CCA 折旧必须在合伙企业层面统一核算与申报（或统一不报），扣除折旧后的净收入再按合伙协议份额分配给各个合伙人，单个合伙人无法在个人税表上各自独立提折旧。

opts.t: Each partner reports their pro-rata share of the building's cost on their personal Form T776 and independently chooses their own CCA rate.
opts.w: 错误。这是共有产权 (co-ownership) 的处理方式，不能套用到合伙企业上。合伙财产的 UCC 属于合伙整体，不在个人层面上独立分割记账。

opts.t: Partnerships are legally prohibited from claiming CCA on residential buildings under any circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。合伙企业完全有权对其持有的合资格资本财产计提 CCA 折旧，只是折旧决定必须在合伙层面统一做出。

opts.t: The partner with the highest personal marginal tax rate automatically dictates the CCA claim for all partners.
opts.w: 错误。税法中没有按个人最高边际税率决定合伙报税的规定，合伙报税决策由合伙协议及合伙整体管理机制决定。

variants.pt: 出租物业持有未满一年翻炒
variants.trap: 忘记住宅翻炒规则也管出租物业
variants.stem: In January 2026, Lucas bought a residential rental property in Surrey. Due to a sudden market downturn, he sold the property in August 2026 after owning it for 210 continuous days, realizing a net loss of $30,000. Lucas did not experience any of the nine statutory life event exceptions. How does ITA section 12(12)–(14) treat this $30,000 loss on Lucas's 2026 tax return?
variants.zh: 2026 年 1 月，Lucas 在素里买入了一处住宅出租物业。由于市场突发下行，他在 2026 年 8 月（持有连续 210 天后）将该物业出售，录得净亏损 $30,000。Lucas 并未经历九大免责法定生活事件。根据 ITA 第 12(12)–(14) 条，这笔 $30,000 的亏损在 Lucas 2026 年税表上应如何处理？

opts.t: The $30,000 loss is treated as a fully deductible non-capital business loss that can offset Lucas's employment income in 2026.
opts.w: 错误。误以为利得被定性为经营收入则亏损也可作为经营亏损扣除。翻炒规则设置了单边惩罚机制：利得视同经营收入全额纳税，但亏损严禁扣除。

opts.t: The loss is classified as an allowable business investment loss (ABIL) deductible against all income sources at a 50% rate ($15,000).
opts.w: 错误。ABIL 仅适用于合资格小企业股份或债务损失，住宅翻炒绝不符合 ABIL 资格。

opts.t: The loss is treated as an allowable capital loss of $15,000 (50% of $30,000) that can be carried back three years to offset past capital gains.
opts.w: 错误。翻炒物业亏损不被允许作为常规资本亏损处理，税法明确规定其亏损在法律上单边归零。

opts.t: The loss is deemed to be nil ($0) under the statutory flipping rules, meaning Lucas cannot deduct any portion of this loss against any income.
opts.w: 正确。根据住宅物业翻炒规则 (flipped property rule)，持有不足 365 连续天处置住宅且无生活事件豁免的，税法单边规定处置亏损视同为零（deemed to be nil）。Lucas 的 $30,000 亏损既不能抵扣其他收入，也不能作为资本亏损结转，彻底归零不可扣除。

variants.pt: BC投机空置税与联邦双轨
variants.trap: 误以为获得 BC 投机空置税出租豁免就无需报联邦税
variants.stem: A foreign national investor who is not a Canadian resident owns a vacant residential condominium in Kelowna. Throughout the entire 2026 calendar year, the property was left completely unoccupied with zero rental activity. What are the owner's BC Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) and federal Canadian income tax obligations for the 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: 一位非加拿大税务居民的外国投资者在基隆拿拥有一套住宅公寓。在整个 2026 自然年内，该物业完全空置，没有任何出租活动。该业主在 2026 税年的 BC 省投机与空置税 (SVT) 及联邦加拿大个人所得税申报义务是什么？

opts.t: The owner must pay BC SVT at the 1% resident rate, and must file a zero-income Form T776 with CRA.
opts.w: 错误。外国业主在 2026 年适用上调后的 3% SVT 税率，而非 1% 居民税率；且未发生任何出租活动无需申报 T776。

opts.t: The owner must pay a 2% BC SVT and report deemed rental income on federal Line 12599.
opts.w: 错误。2% 是 2025 年的旧税率，2026 年外国业主税率已升至 3%；且联邦税法对完全空置房屋不征收视同租金收入。

opts.t: She owes SVT at the 3% foreign-owner rate on the assessed value; no T776 is needed since there was no rent.
opts.w: 正确。根据 2026 税年现行规则，BC 省投机与空置税 (SVT) 对外国业主的税率上调至 3%（2025 年为 2%），由于房屋全年空置且无豁免，必须全额缴纳 3% 的 SVT；在联邦所得税层面，由于没有产生任何租金收入，纳税人无需填报 Form T776。

opts.t: The property is automatically exempt from BC SVT under the tourist accommodation concession, but must pay a federal non-resident vacancy surcharge.
opts.w: 错误。空置住宅公寓不符合旅游住宿豁免，且不存在所谓的联邦非居民空置附加税替代机制。

variants.pt: 主居所比例公式计算
variants.trap: 未计入加一年或误算持有年数
variants.stem: David bought a home in 2019 for $500,000 and sold it in 2026 for $900,000 with no selling expenses (total gain: $400,000). He owned it for 8 tax years (2019 to 2026). His family lived in it every year, but he designated it as his principal residence only for 2019, 2020 and 2021; for 2022 through 2026 he designated a cottage he also owned. He was a Canadian resident throughout. What is his taxable capital gain on the home for 2026?
variants.zh: David 2019 年以 $500,000 买入一套住宅，2026 年以 $900,000 卖出，无处置费用（利得总额 $400,000），共持有 8 个纳税年度（2019 至 2026）。全家每年都住在这里，但他只把 2019、2020、2021 年指定给这套住宅；2022 至 2026 年他把主居所指定给自己的度假屋。他一直是加拿大居民。这套住宅 2026 年的应税资本利得是多少？

opts.w: 错误。漏了「加一年」：B 取 3 年时免税 150,000 元，剩 250,000 元，乘 ½ 得 125,000 元。他取得当年是居民，B 应为 4。
错误。200,000 元是免税后的资本利得，忘了乘 ½ 纳入率。
错误。只有指定年数加一覆盖全部持有年数（B/C ≥ 1）时才全免，这里只指定了 3 年。

variants.pt: 主居所申报与迟报罚款
variants.trap: 误认自住房不报也能免税
variants.stem: Chloe sold her principal residence in 2020 (filing deadline: April 30, 2021). She omitted the sale completely from her tax return. In November 2029 (102 complete months after the filing deadline), she applies to CRA to accept a late principal residence designation on Form T2091(IND). What is the late-filed election penalty under ITA subsection 220(3.5)?
variants.zh: Chloe 于 2020 年出售了其主居所（申报截止日为 2021 年 4 月 30 日）。她未在税表中申报该笔出售。2029 年 11 月（距离申报截止日已过去 102 个完整月），她向 CRA 申请补做 T2091(IND) 主居所迟做指定。根据 ITA s.220(3.5)，应适用的迟做选择罚款是多少？

opts.w: 错误。这是误按 12 个月封顶计算。ITA s.220(3.5) 的月度累计并不受 12 个月限制，其唯一的封顶是法定金额 $8,000。
错误。误以为超过一定追索期后免除罚款。主居所补做指定是纳税人主动寻求特许救济，必须按法条支付 s.220(3.5) 罚款。

variants.pt: 45(2)选举与四年延展限制
variants.trap: 出租期间计提折旧破坏选举
variants.stem: Sophia purchased a home in 2021 and lived in it until May 2026, when she converted it entirely into an income-producing rental property. She filed a valid subsection 45(2) election with her 2026 tax return. In 2027, to reduce her net rental income, Sophia claims Capital Cost Allowance (CCA) of $4,500 on the building on Form T776. What is the tax consequence of Sophia claiming CCA?
variants.zh: Sophia 于 2021 年购入一套自住房并一直居住至 2026 年 5 月，随后将其全部转为产生收入的出租物业。她在 2026 年税表中提交了有效的第 45(2) 条选举。2027 年，为了抵减出租净收入，Sophia 在 T776 表上对建筑物计提了 $4,500 的资本成本折旧 (CCA)。Sophia 申报 CCA 的税务后果是什么？

opts.t: The CCA claim is permitted up to 4% per year without affecting her principal residence designation years.
opts.w: 错误。45(2) 选举有效期间绝对禁止计提任何 CCA，根本不存在 4% 的安全容许额度。

opts.t: She can continue to designate the home as her principal residence for up to 4 years, but must recapture the CCA upon sale.
opts.w: 错误。计提 CCA 的后果不仅是卖房时发生折旧收回 (recapture)，而是直接导致 45(2) 选举撤销，从而丧失继续指定该房为主居所的资格。

opts.t: Her 45(2) election is extended by another 4 years because CCA creates a separate depreciable property pool.
opts.w: 错误。毫无税法依据的虚假表述，计提折旧绝不会延长选举期。

opts.t: Claiming CCA ends the 45(2) election from that year, so later years can no longer be designated under it.
opts.w: 正确。在 45(2) 选举生效期间计提资本成本折旧 (CCA)，属于纳税人以实际行动撤销（rescind）该选举。自计提 CCA 当年起，45(2) 选举失效，视同发生用途改变处置，且自该年起不能再依该选举享受主居所指定年数。

variants.pt: 45(3)选举时限与先决条件
variants.trap: 将45(3)选举期限简单记为卖房年
variants.stem: Rachel bought a rental property in 2020. On her 2021 and 2022 T776 forms, she claimed CCA on the building. In 2026, she converted the property into her primary residence. She sells the home in 2028 and submits a subsection 45(3) election with her 2028 tax return to shelter the pre-2026 appreciation. What will CRA's determination be regarding Rachel's 45(3) election?
variants.zh: Rachel 于 2020 年买入一套出租房。在 2021 和 2022 年的 T776 表上，她对建筑物计提了 CCA。2026 年，她将该物业转为自住房居住。她在 2028 年卖掉该房产，并在 2028 年税表中提交了第 45(3) 条选举信，试图免除 2026 年之前的增值部分。CRA 对 Rachel 的 45(3) 选举将做出何种判定？

opts.t: The election is deemed never to have been made under subsection 45(4) because CCA was previously deducted on the property in 2021 and 2022.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.45(4)，若本人、配偶或相关信托在改变用途之前任何一年对该物业计提过任何资本成本折旧 (CCA)，第 45(3) 款选举视为从未做出（deemed never to have been made）。Rachel 在 2021 和 2022 年计提过 CCA，彻底破坏了该选举的前提要件，递延完全无效。

opts.t: The election is accepted provided Rachel repays the previously claimed CCA with interest.
opts.w: 错误。《所得税法》没有提供补交折旧加利息即可复活 45(3) 选举的补救机制，一旦历史上扣过 CCA，法条明确规定选举视为从未做出。

opts.t: The election is valid for all years except 2021 and 2022, allowing 2020 and 2023–2025 to be designated as principal residence years.
opts.w: 错误。计提 CCA 是全局性破坏条件，不会只扣除计提折旧的具体年份，而是使整份 45(3) 选举整体无效。

opts.t: The election is automatically approved, but the capital gains inclusion rate increases from 50% to 100%.
opts.w: 错误。45(3) 无效导致在 2026 年用途改变时发生视同处置，增值按正常的资本利得纳税，不会被定性为 100% 纳入的翻炒经营收入。

variants.pt: 联邦365天翻炒与楼花转让
variants.trap: 误以为楼花未交付就不算翻炒
variants.stem: Benjamin purchased a residential rental duplex on February 1, 2025. Due to falling market prices, he sold the duplex on October 15, 2025 (holding period: 256 consecutive days) at a net loss of $40,000. Benjamin was not in the business of buying and selling real estate and none of the nine life event exceptions applied. Under ITA subsection 12(14), what is Benjamin's allowable deduction for this $40,000 loss?
variants.zh: Benjamin 于 2025 年 2 月 1 日购买了一套双拼出租住宅。因市场价格下跌，他在 2025 年 10 月 15 日（持有期：连续 256 天）将其卖出，净亏损 $40,000。Benjamin 本人并非从事房地产买卖的专业人员，且未发生九项生活事件例外。根据 ITA s.12(14)，Benjamin 就这笔 $40,000 的亏损可申报的允许抵扣额是多少？

opts.t: He can deduct a business loss of $40,000 against his employment income on Form T2125.
opts.w: 错误。翻炒规则是一条只朝一个方向生效的严苛单边规则。ITA s.12(14) 明确规定翻炒房产生的亏损视为零，严禁作为经营亏损抵扣其他收入。

opts.t: He can deduct an allowable business investment loss (ABIL) of 50% of the loss ($20,000).
opts.w: 错误。合格小企业投资亏损 (ABIL) 仅适用于小型企业公司的股票或债权投资损失，完全不适用于个人持有的住宅房地产亏损。

opts.t: The loss is deemed to be zero under ITA subsection 12(14), meaning no loss deduction is permitted against any income.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.12(14)，落入联邦住宅翻炒规则的处置，纳税人因该房产产生的任何亏损均被法律直接视同为零（deemed to be nil）。赚了算经营收入全额课税，亏了单边归零完全不给扣，不能抵扣当期或以后任何收入。

opts.t: He can claim an allowable capital loss of $20,000 to carry back 3 years or forward indefinitely.
opts.w: 错误。翻炒规则已经将该物业从资本资产定性中剔除，不能按资本亏损申报，更不存在向前结转 3 年或无限期向后结转的待遇。

variants.pt: 联邦翻炒生活事件例外条件
variants.trap: 联邦合格搬迁境内限制误区
variants.stem: In January 2025, Nathan and his spouse purchased a home. In August 2025, their marriage broke down and they separated. Nathan sold the home in October 2025 (holding period: 270 days) to divide assets. At the time of the sale, Nathan and his spouse had been living separate and apart due to the breakdown of their marriage for 95 consecutive days. Does Nathan qualify for an exception from the federal flipping rule?
variants.zh: 2025 年 1 月，Nathan 与配偶购入一套住宅。2025 年 8 月，两人婚姻破裂并开始分居。Nathan 于 2025 年 10 月出售了该房屋（持有期：270 天）以分割财产。在出售时，Nathan 与其配偶因婚姻破裂已经连续分居了 95 天。Nathan 是否符合联邦翻炒规则的生活事件例外？

opts.t: No, because relationship breakdown requires a formal divorce decree issued by a court before any property disposition can be exempt.
opts.w: 错误。税法并不要求必须取得法院正式离婚判决书，只需因婚姻或同居关系破裂而分居即可。

opts.t: Yes; a relationship breakdown qualifies if the couple lived apart for at least 90 days before the sale.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.12(13)(b)(iii)，因婚姻或同居伴侣关系破裂而处置房产属于生活事件例外之一，但法条设有一项客观时间要件：处置前必须已经分居至少 90 天（at least 90 days）。Nathan 夫妇已连续分居 95 天，满足了法定天数要求，因此完全符合例外条件，免受翻炒规则定性。

opts.t: No, because relationship breakdown requires a minimum separation period of at least 365 days to match the holding period.
opts.w: 错误。法定分居门槛是 90 天而非 365 天，切忌将连续持有期门槛与分居时间门槛相混淆。

opts.t: Yes, but only if Nathan surrenders 100% of the sale proceeds directly to CRA as an escrow deposit.
opts.w: 错误。税法中完全不存在将卖房款上缴 CRA 托管的荒谬要求。

variants.pt: BC翻炒税与联邦规则差异
variants.trap: 将联邦自动豁免误套用于BC省
variants.stem: An employee in Victoria, BC purchased a condominium on March 1, 2025. On October 1, 2025 (holding period: 214 days), the employee was involuntarily laid off by their employer and sold the condominium at a profit of $40,000. The seller believes that because involuntary termination is a recognized life event, no tax return of any kind needs to be filed with the BC Ministry of Finance. What is the correct legal position?
variants.zh: BC 省维多利亚的一名雇员于 2025 年 3 月 1 日购买了一套公寓。2025 年 10 月 1 日（持有期：214 天），该雇员被雇主非自愿解雇，随后以 $40,000 的利润卖掉了该公寓。该卖家认为，既然非自愿解雇是公认的生活事件，自己就完全无需向 BC 省财政厅提交任何申报表。正确的法律事实是什么？

opts.t: The seller is correct; life event exemptions under the BC flipping tax apply automatically without any reporting obligation.
opts.w: 错误。这是混淆联邦与 BC 省程序要求的致命误区。联邦九项例外符合即适用，而 BC 省翻炒税的生活事件豁免属于“必须申报类”，不交表不能享受豁免。

opts.t: Involuntary termination is recognized only under federal rules and is entirely excluded from the BC flipping tax exemption list.
opts.w: 错误。受雇人员的非自愿解雇在 BC 省翻炒税法下同样被列为法定生活事件豁免清单（但不适用于自雇者）。

opts.t: The seller must report the sale on federal Schedule 3, which automatically forwards the exemption request to BC without a provincial deadline.
opts.w: 错误。两套系统完全独立运作，CRA 不会替 BC 省代收或流转翻炒税申报。

opts.t: To get the exemption the seller must file a separate BC return within 90 days of the sale, or face penalties from $500.
opts.w: 正确。根据《BC 省住宅物业短期持有利润税法》，生活事件豁免并非自动生效，纳税人必须在房产处置后 90 天内向 BC 财政厅单独提交翻炒税申报表才能取得该豁免。若未在 90 天内交表，即使事实完全符合解雇条件，也将面临至少 $500 的最低迟报罚款 (late-filing penalty)。

variants.pt: 事实居民与视同居民判定顺序
variants.trap: 视同居民与事实居民顺序倒置
variants.stem: David, an engineering consultant from Australia, moved to Calgary on April 15, 2026 under a temporary employment contract. He rented a townhouse, moved his personal furniture, registered with provincial healthcare, and lived there with his spouse for 261 days in 2026. A tax software automatically flagged him as a 'deemed resident under the 183-day rule.' How should David's tax return be correctly filed under the Income Tax Act?
variants.zh: 来自澳大利亚的工程顾问 David 于 2026 年 4 月 15 日持临时雇佣合同搬至卡尔加里。他在当地租了一套联排别墅，运来了个人家具，办理了省医疗保险，并与配偶在加拿大共同居住了 261 天。某报税软件自动将他标记为“依据 183 天规则的视同居民”。根据《所得税法》，David 的税表应如何正确填报？

opts.t: David should accept the deemed resident designation because any foreign citizen spending more than 183 days in Canada is legally required to file under ITA s.250(1)(a).
opts.w: 错误。死记 183 天规则而忽略了法定判定阶梯。ITA s.250(1)(a) 是兜底条款，仅适用于不具备事实居住联系的个人。

opts.t: David must file as a non-resident paying 25% Part XIII withholding tax on his employment earnings because temporary residents cannot be factual residents.
opts.w: 错误。受雇收入属于 Part I 积极经营与受雇收入，非居民亦不适用 Part XIII 预扣；更重要的是 David 拥有重大居住联系，是事实居民而非非居民。

opts.t: David should file as a deemed resident, which subjects his entire calendar-year worldwide income to tax but grants him full provincial tax credits for the entire year.
opts.w: 错误。视同居民在法律上不属于任何省份，不能申报省税抵免，且须缴纳 48% 联邦附加税。

opts.t: David must file as a factual part-year resident from April 15, 2026, reporting worldwide income only for the period from April 15 to December 31 and claiming provincial tax credits.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(3) 及 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1，David 与配偶在加居住并租房、办医保，建立了不可动摇的事实居住联系，属于 2026 年 4 月 15 日起算的部分年度事实居民 (factual part-year resident)。他仅就 4 月 15 日之后的全球收入申报纳税，绝不能按 183 天视同居民处理。

variants.pt: 首年基本个人额天数折算与税率
variants.trap: 首年基本个人额按全额申报
variants.stem: Elena arrived in Canada as a new immigrant on September 1, 2026, establishing factual residency on that date. She had no Canadian-source income prior to landing and earned $40,000 in Canada during the remainder of 2026. Under the 2026 tax-year rules stated in the lecture, what is the maximum basic personal amount (BPA) Elena can claim on line 30000 of her federal return?
variants.zh: Elena 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日作为新移民抵达加拿大并在当天建立事实居住联系。她在登陆前无加拿大来源收入，在 2026 年剩余时间内在加拿大赚取了 $40,000。根据讲义中明确的 2026 税年规则，Elena 在其联邦税表第 30000 行最高可申报的基本个人额 (BPA) 是多少？

opts.t: CAD 5,499.02, calculated as CAD 16,452 × (122 resident days ÷ 365 days).
CAD 16,452.00, because the Income Tax Act provides the full annual basic personal amount to any individual residing in Canada at year-end.
opts.w: 错误。这是新移民首年最常见的错报（“首年基本个人额按全额申报”陷阱）。年末在加并不能享受全额基本个人额，部分年度居民必须按居民期天数严格打折。

opts.t: CAD 5,249.34, calculated as CAD 15,705 × (122 resident days ÷ 365 days).
opts.w: 错误。15,705 元是 2024 税年的旧额度；2026 税年应按 16,452 元折算。

opts.t: CAD 8,226.00, calculated as a flat 50% half-year deduction regardless of actual landing date.
opts.w: 错误。抵免额度并非按半年（50%）简单粗略概算，而是按实际居民天数除以 365 逐日精确计算到分。

variants.pt: 视同取得与T1135申报门槛
variants.trap: 用原始购入价判定 T1135 门槛与利得
variants.stem: Sophia immigrated to Canada on July 10, 2026. On that date, she owned a foreign rental property originally purchased in 2018 for $150,000 CAD equivalent. Its appraised fair market value on July 10, 2026 was $320,000 CAD. In November 2027, Sophia sold the rental property for $350,000 CAD equivalent. Under ITA subsection 128.1(1), what is Sophia's capital gain for Canadian income tax purposes upon the sale?
variants.zh: Sophia 于 2026 年 7 月 10 日移民加拿大。当天她持有一处 2018 年以等值 $150,000 加元购入的境外出租房产。该物业在 2026 年 7 月 10 日经专业评估的公允市值为等值 $320,000 加元。2027 年 11 月，Sophia 以等值 $350,000 加元将该出租物业出售。根据《所得税法》第 128.1(1) 条，Sophia 在出售该房产时应计入加拿大所得税申报的资本利得是多少？

opts.t: $200,000, calculated as total proceeds of $350,000 minus the historical purchase cost of $150,000.
opts.w: 错误。这是新移民最常踩的“未垫高成本基础”陷阱。若按历史原始成本计算，会把登陆前多年的增值（$170,000）错误计入加拿大税基造成重复缴税。

opts.t: $0, because foreign real estate acquired before becoming a Canadian resident is entirely exempt from Canadian capital gains tax forever.
opts.w: 错误。税法仅对登陆前的增值豁免，成为税务居民之后产生的后续增值（$350,000 - $320,000 = $30,000）必须作为资本利得向加拿大申报纳税。

opts.t: $30,000, calculated as gross proceeds of $350,000 minus the stepped-up cost base of $320,000 established on her landing date.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.128.1(1)(b) 和 (c)，个人成为加拿大居民前一刻视同按公允市值（FMV）处置名下资产并以同一价格重新取得。因此，Sophia 该出租房产在加拿大税法下的调整后成本基础 (ACB) 自动垫高为登陆日市值 $320,000。2027 年出售时的资本利得仅为售价与登陆日市值之差：$350,000 - $320,000 = $30,000。

opts.t: $15,000, calculated by taking 50% of the entire $30,000 gain under a blanket lifetime newcomer exemption.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了应税资本利得计入率与资本利得本身；资本利得总额为 $30,000，且并不存在任何“新移民终身减半特殊豁免”。

variants.pt: 新移民福利申请与SOI规则
variants.trap: 误以为报税会自动追补 CGEB 且拒报 SOI
variants.stem: After landing in Canada in 2026, Kevin applied for Canada Child Benefit (CCB) and Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit (CGEB) for his family. The CRA requested that Kevin complete a Statement of Income (SOI) detailing his and his spouse's worldwide income for the two calendar years prior to arrival. How does CRA treat this reported pre-landing income?
variants.zh: Kevin 于 2026 年登陆加拿大后，为家庭申请了加拿大儿童福利 (CCB) 与加拿大日用品补贴 (CGEB)。CRA 要求 Kevin 填写登陆前收入声明 (SOI)，详细列出其与配偶在抵达前两个日历年的全球收入。CRA 如何对待这份申报的登陆前收入？

opts.t: CRA includes this income on line 10400 of the newcomer's first T1 return and subjects it to Canadian income tax subject to foreign tax credits.
opts.w: 错误。登陆前在境外赚取的收入完全不属于加拿大纳税范围，绝不能填入 T1 税表的收入栏，否则会导致严重的多缴税。

opts.t: It is used only to work out family net income for benefits, is not taxed in Canada, and is converted at the Bank of Canada rate on receipt.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义与 CRA 官方指引，新移民提交的登陆前收入声明 (SOI) 仅用于计算 CCB 与 CGEB 等按收入递减的福利额度，不构成应税收入，完全无需向加拿大缴税。外币收入按收款当日加拿大银行（Bank of Canada）汇率折算。

opts.t: CRA treats the pre-landing income as a taxable capital gain under ITA s.128.1 unless the taxpayer applies for a special waiver within 90 days.
opts.w: 错误。s.128.1 是资本财产的视同处置与取得规则，与日常受雇或营业收入完全无关；且登陆前收入本来就不征税，根本不需要申请豁免。

opts.t: CRA automatically rejects benefit applications if pre-landing income exceeded $50,000 CAD, as benefits are reserved exclusively for zero-income newcomers.
opts.w: 错误。收入较高只会导致福利按比例递减，并不存在所谓“超过 $50,000 直接自动拒绝申请”的一刀切规则。

variants.pt: 非居民期抵免与90%规则
variants.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
variants.stem: Brenda landed in Canada as a permanent resident on August 1, 2026. During the non-resident period (January 1 to July 31, 2026), Brenda earned $8,000 from Canadian freelance editing and $72,000 from local employment in her former home country. Can Brenda claim non-refundable personal tax credits for that pre-landing period under ITA section 118.94?
variants.zh: Brenda 于 2026 年 8 月 1 日作为永久居民登陆加拿大。在非居民期间（2026 年 1 月 1 日至 7 月 31 日），Brenda 从加拿大自由职业文字编辑中赚取了 $8,000 加元，在原国当地受雇赚取了等值 $72,000 加元。Brenda 能否根据《所得税法》第 118.94 条申报该登陆前期间的非退还个人税收抵免？

opts.t: Yes, because she earned more than $5,000 in Canadian-source income during the pre-landing period.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在任何“加拿大收入满 $5,000 即可全额抵免”的绝对门槛，判定标准是相对比例（90%）。

opts.t: Yes, because becoming a permanent resident before year-end automatically entitles a taxpayer to full pre-landing personal credits.
opts.w: 错误。移民身份与抵免资格脱钩，部分年度居民默认仅享受居民期折算抵免，非居民期抵免严格受 s.118.94 的比例约束。

opts.t: No; her $8,000 of Canadian-source income is far below 90% of her $80,000 net world income for that period.
opts.w: 正确。在非居民期间，Brenda 的加拿大来源收入为 $8,000，全球净收入为 $8,000 + $72,000 = $80,000，加拿大来源收入占比仅为 10%（远低于 CRA 依据 ITA s.118.94 设定的 90%“全部或几乎全部”门槛）。因此，她无法就非居民期申报额度型个人抵免，只能就 8 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日的居民期按天数比例申报基本个人额。

opts.t: No, but she can elect to transfer 100% of the unused credit to her spouse's return without any income restriction.
opts.w: 错误。个人本身不具备该期间抵免资格，根本不存在可以转移给配偶的有效额度。

variants.pt: 临时居民申领CCB十八月规则
variants.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
variants.stem: Raj, a foreign software engineer on a work permit, moved to Canada with his young daughter in January 2025 and received CCB payments starting in his 19th month (July 2026). His initial work permit was set to expire on November 30, 2026. Raj properly submitted an extension application on November 10, 2026, and is waiting for Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) to process it. What happens to his family's monthly CCB payments in December 2026?
variants.zh: Raj 是一名持工签的外籍软件工程师，于 2025 年 1 月携幼女移居加拿大，并在居住满 19 个月（2026 年 7 月）起开始领取 CCB。他的初始工签原定于 2026 年 11 月 30 日到期。Raj 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日合法递交了工签续签申请，目前正在等待移民局 (IRCC) 审理。在 2026 年 12 月，他家庭的每月 CCB 款项将如何处理？

opts.t: CCB payments immediately terminate on December 1, 2026 and all previous benefits received must be fully refunded to CRA.
opts.w: 错误。在原许可到期前递交续签享有“维持身份”，且此前合法领取的福利完全合法，绝无退还之说。

opts.t: Payments continue, because the extension was filed before the old permit expired, so he keeps maintained status.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义与 CRA 实务指引，临时居民只要在旧居留许可到期前递交了续签申请，在审理期间即享有法定“维持身份”（maintained status），其居留许可被视为依然有效，因此每月 CCB 款项不会被中断，可继续按期发放。

opts.t: CCB payments are suspended automatically on December 1, 2026 and can only be repaid as a lump sum after permanent residency is approved.
opts.w: 错误。维持身份期间无需暂停支付，更不需要等到永居审批通过。

opts.t: Payments continue only if Raj pays an administrative status-maintenance guarantee deposit of $1,000 to the CRA.
opts.w: 错误。不存在向 CRA 缴纳所谓维持身份保证金的要求。

variants.pt: 离境税务规则与T1161门槛
variants.trap: 离境日期判断错误与忽视离境财产清单
variants.stem: After emigrating from Canada to the United Kingdom and establishing non-resident status, George continues to receive monthly rental income from a residential investment condo in Vancouver and quarterly dividend income from a Canadian corporation. Under ITA subsection 212(1), what immediate action must George take regarding these Canadian income streams?
variants.zh: 在从加拿大移民至英国并确立非居民身份后，George 继续从温哥华的一套投资公寓收取月租金，并从一家加拿大公司收取季度股息。根据《所得税法》第 212(1) 条，George 必须就这些加拿大来源收入流立即采取什么行动？

opts.t: Tell his Canadian payers he is now a non-resident so they withhold the 25% Part XIII tax, or a lower treaty rate.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.212(1) 及 CRA 非居民纳税人指引，离境成为非居民后，个人必须主动通知所有加拿大资金支付方（包括银行、租客、物业管理公司及派发股息的公司）其非居民身份，付款方依法负有代扣代缴 25% Part XIII 预扣税（或适用税收协定优惠税率）的法定扣缴义务。若未通知导致预扣不足，纳税人将面临追缴与利息处罚。

opts.t: He is not required to take any action because non-residents are completely exempt from Canadian tax on rental and dividend income.
opts.w: 错误。非居民虽然不就境外收入向加拿大纳税，但对加拿大来源的被动收入负有严格的纳税义务，通常通过 25% 预扣税完税。

opts.t: He must file an annual Part I tax return by June 15 and pay the flat 48% federal surtax on all Canadian dividends and rents.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大来源被动收入默认走 Part XIII 预扣税体系，不由纳税人自行在次年 6 月 15 日按 48% 附加税申报。

opts.t: He must immediately sell the Canadian properties and shares within 60 days of departure to avoid criminal penalties.
opts.w: 错误。税法完全允许非居民继续持有加拿大房产和投资，绝无强制出售的规定。

variants.pt: 事实居民与视同居民判定顺序
variants.trap: 颠倒判定顺序先数天数
variants.stem: Carlos, a renewable energy researcher from Spain, arrived in Victoria, BC on February 1, 2026 on a temporary work permit. He rented a residential townhouse for his exclusive use, registered for BC healthcare, and lived there for 315 days during 2026. A tax preparer calculated Carlos's taxes using the federal package for deemed residents, claiming that 'anyone staying over 183 days is deemed a resident and pays the 48% surtax.' What is the correct classification for Carlos?
variants.zh: 来自西班牙的可再生能源研究员 Carlos 于 2026 年 2 月 1 日持临时工作许可抵达 BC 省维多利亚。他租了一套供自己专属使用的联排住宅，办理了 BC 省医保，并在 2026 年内居住了 315 天。一名报税员使用视同居民专用税包为 Carlos 算税，声称“任何在加逗留超过 183 天的人均视同居民并交 48% 附加税”。Carlos 的正确定性是什么？

opts.t: Carlos is a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1)(a) because total days of physical presence exceed 183, overriding common-law residential ties.
opts.w: 错误。成文法 183 天视同居民规则不能凌驾于事实居住联系之上，必须先看事实联系。

opts.t: Carlos is a non-resident because temporary foreign workers cannot establish factual residency until permanent residency is officially granted.
opts.w: 错误。税务居民身份是事实判断，与是否取得永久居民身份无关。

opts.t: Carlos is a deemed resident who must pay 48% federal surtax on Canadian income while excluding foreign income.
opts.w: 错误。视同居民需就全年全球收入纳税，且 Carlos 具备事实联系，定性本身错误。

opts.t: Carlos is a factual resident (part-year resident for 2026) who must file a BC provincial return and pay BC provincial tax rather than the 48% federal surtax.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA 判定阶梯，Carlos 租住联排住宅并办理省医保，建立了不可动摇的重大与次要居住联系，属于事实居民。他应按 12 月 31 日居住省使用 BC 省税包申报，缴纳 BC 省税并享受省级抵免，绝不能被当作视同居民缴纳 48% 联邦附加税。

variants.pt: 次要联系门槛考试与实务口径差异
variants.trap: 机械套用六项次要联系数量门槛
variants.stem: A taxpayer has no home, spouse or dependants in Canada but keeps Canadian bank accounts, a Canadian credit card, a BC driver's licence, a vehicle registered in BC, a Canadian passport and a Canadian professional association membership (six secondary ties). Under current CRA practice, how are these ties assessed?
variants.zh: 一位纳税人在加拿大没有住所、配偶或受养人，但保留了加拿大银行账户、加拿大信用卡、BC 驾照、在 BC 注册的车辆、加拿大护照和加拿大专业协会会籍（六项次要联系）。按 CRA 现行做法，这些联系怎么判？

opts.t: No count decides it; CRA weighs these secondary ties together with all other facts to judge whether the person is resident.
opts.w: 正确。CRA 现行解释件对次要联系没有数量门槛，要合起来看、按分量权衡，再结合其他事实判断是否构成通常居住。旧培训材料的「凑满六项」不是现行口径。

opts.t: Resident, because holding six secondary ties meets the minimum count CRA requires to establish residency.
opts.w: 错误。「至少六项」是 2024 年旧培训材料的判定表，CRA 现行做法没有数量门槛。

opts.t: Non-resident, because without a home, spouse or dependant, secondary ties can never establish residency.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 说单独一项次要联系足以定性的情形「不寻常」，但多项次要联系合起来是可以构成居民的。

opts.t: Deemed resident under s.250(1)(a), because six secondary ties count as 183 days of presence in Canada.
opts.w: 错误。次要联系用来判事实居民；183 天视同居民看的是逗留天数，两者不能互换。

variants.pt: 183天逗留与跨境通勤例外
variants.trap: 颠倒判定顺序先数天数
variants.stem: Maya lives in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. During 2026, Maya commuted across the rainbow bridge into Niagara Falls, Ontario 210 times to manage a retail store, returning to her US home every night. Maya also spent one single long weekend (arriving Saturday at 11:00 AM and departing Monday at 2:00 PM, spanning 3 calendar days) staying at an Ontario hotel. How many days did Maya sojourn in Canada in 2026 for the purposes of the 183-day deemed residency rule?
variants.zh: Maya 居住在美国纽约州尼亚加拉瀑布城。在 2026 年，Maya 开车穿过彩虹桥进入安大略省尼亚加拉瀑布城管理一家零售店共计 210 次，每天晚上返回美国的家中。Maya 年内还在安大略省的一家酒店度过了一个长周末（周六上午 11 点入境入住，周一下午 2 点退房离境，跨越 3 个日历日）。为判定 183 天视同居民规则，Maya 2026 年在加拿大“逗留”的天数是多少？

opts.t: 213 days, because every entry into Canada constitutes a taxable sojourn day under ITA s.250(1)(a).
opts.w: 错误。日常跨境通勤不计入逗留天数。

opts.t: 0 days, because staying fewer than 7 consecutive days on any trip is statutorily rounded down to zero.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在少于 7 天舍入为零的规则，零头天数亦算完整一天。

opts.t: 3 days: commuting days count as zero, while each day of the hotel weekend, including part days, counts.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(1)(a) 及讲义第 2.2 节，日常跨境通勤（commute）因未在加建立临时居所，其 210 次往返逗留天数为零。而在酒店度假期间建立了临时居所，根据“一天的任何一部分均算一天”规则，周六、周日、周一三天全部计入逗留天数，合计 3 天。Maya 远未达 183 天，不是视同居民。

opts.t: 210 days, because employment days take priority over personal holiday days in residency calculations.
opts.w: 错误。概念颠倒，通勤工作日不算逗留，度假休闲日才算。

variants.pt: 特殊职务视同居民与受养子女门槛
variants.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
variants.stem: Sylvie is a Canadian diplomat serving at an overseas embassy in Tokyo throughout 2026, qualifying as a deemed resident under ITA s.250(1)(c). Her 20-year-old dependent daughter, Camille, lived with Sylvie in Tokyo and earned $19,500 CAD in 2026 working remotely as a graphic designer. Based on the 2026 tax parameters stated in the lecture ($16,452 federal BPA limit), how is Camille's Canadian residency status determined for the 2026 tax year?
variants.zh: Sylvie 是加拿大派驻东京大使馆的外交官，2026 全年驻外，符合 ITA s.250(1)(c) 视同居民资格。其 20 岁的受养女儿 Camille 与 Sylvie 在东京同住，2026 年内通过远程从事平面设计获得了 $19,500 加元收入。根据讲义中明确的 2026 税年参数（联邦 BPA 上限 $16,452），Camille 在 2026 税年的加拿大税务居民身份应如何确定？

opts.t: Camille is automatically a deemed resident under s.250(1)(f) regardless of her income because her parent is an active diplomatic officer.
opts.w: 错误。s.250(1)(f) 规定受养子女当年收入不得超过当年基本个人额，并非无条件随父母视同居民。

opts.t: She is not deemed resident, as her $19,500 exceeds the $16,452 BPA; her status is decided under the normal rules.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(1)(f) 及讲义第 2.2 节与案例三，派驻官员的受养子女只有在当年净全球收入不超过当年联邦基本个人额（2026 税年为 $16,452）时，才随同视同居民。Camille 收入为 $19,500，超过了 $16,452 门槛，因此不能自动视同居民，必须根据普通居住联系和逗留规则单独判定其税务身份。

opts.t: Camille is classified as a factual resident of Ontario and must pay 48% federal surtax on her Japanese earnings.
opts.w: 错误。Camille 在加无居住联系，不能直接判为安省事实居民；且事实居民不交 48% 附加税。

opts.t: Camille is exempt from all Canadian taxation permanently under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
opts.w: 错误。子女收入超过受养门槛需单独依税法判定，维也纳公约不免除加拿大对本国公民/居民的税收管辖。

variants.pt: 协定仲裁视同非居民条文效力
variants.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
variants.stem: Hiroshi is considered a tax resident of Canada under common-law ties and also a tax resident of Japan under Japanese domestic law for 2026. Applying the residency tie-breaker rules of the Canada-Japan Tax Convention, Hiroshi is determined to be a resident of Japan. What is the legal consequence of this treaty outcome under Canadian domestic tax legislation?
variants.zh: 根据普通法居住联系，Hiroshi 在 2026 年被认定为加拿大税务居民，同时根据日本国内法亦被认定为日本税务居民。在适用《加日税收协定》的居民身份仲裁规则后，Hiroshi 被最终判定为日本居民。根据加拿大国内税法，该协定仲裁结果的法律后果是什么？

opts.t: Hiroshi retains Canadian factual resident status and continues paying provincial tax, but receives a 15% treaty rebate on line 40400 of his T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。协定仲裁判归对方国直接使当事人丧失加拿大国内法居民地位，而非给 15% 退税。

opts.t: Hiroshi is treated as an ordinary resident in Canada for business tax but as a deemed non-resident for passive income only.
opts.w: 错误。视同非居民适用于本法全部条文，不可按收入类别切分身份。

opts.t: Under s.250(5) he is deemed non-resident for all purposes of the Act, so Part XIII applies to his Canadian passive income.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.250(5)，凡依据加拿大与其他国家税收协定被判定为该国居民的个人，在加拿大税法下“为了本法的一切目的”（for all purposes of the Act）均视同非居民。因此 Hiroshi 不再就全球收入向加拿大纳税，其在加投资收益转为适用 Part XIII 预扣税，且涉及视同处置离境税等全套非居民规则。

opts.t: Hiroshi must pay a 48% federal surtax on his Japanese employment income under ITA s.120(1).
opts.w: 错误。Hiroshi 已被视同非居民，不再就境外受雇所得向加拿大纳税，亦不适用 48% 视同居民附加税。

variants.pt: 视同居民附加税与卑诗省税负差异
variants.trap: 误把视同居民当成省钱通道
variants.stem: An unadvised taxpayer in Vancouver assumes that filing as a deemed resident under the 183-day rule is preferable to filing as a BC factual resident because 'deemed residents avoid provincial tax entirely.' Based on the lecture's analysis for a taxpayer with modest taxable income in the lowest bracket, what is the comparative tax burden in 2026?
variants.zh: 温哥华一位未咨询专业人士的纳税人认为，按 183 天规则申报为视同居民优于申报为 BC 省事实居民，因为“视同居民完全避免了省税”。根据讲义对最低税阶低收入纳税人的分析，2026 年两者的相对税负表现如何？

opts.t: Deemed resident status is substantially cheaper because the 48% federal surtax is fully refundable through the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit.
opts.w: 错误。附加税绝不可退还，日用品补贴也是定额福利，不能抵消高额附加税。

opts.t: Deemed status costs more: 14% × 48% = 6.72% exceeds BC's 5.60%, and the $13,216 BC amount is lost.
opts.w: 正确。讲义第四部分明确指出：视同居民并非省钱路径。最低税阶联邦税率 14%，附加税边际效果为 14% × 48% = 6.72%，已超过卑诗省最低税阶 5.60%；加上视同居民无法使用卑诗省 $13,216 的基本个人额抵税，亦无法获得任何卑诗省可退还抵免，其实际税负几乎必然高于事实居民。

opts.t: Factual residency is more expensive because BC taxpayers must pay both BC provincial tax and the 48% federal surtax simultaneously.
opts.w: 错误。事实居民按居住省交省税，绝不交 48% 联邦附加税。

opts.t: Both statuses produce identical net tax liabilities because CRA automatically levels out provincial disparities across Canada.
opts.w: 错误。省税与视同居民附加税是完全平行的计算，税负差异显著，CRA 不做拉平。

variants.pt: 回原居国离境日期例外规定
variants.trap: 混淆移民身份与税务居民身份
variants.stem: Sunita, an engineer who relocated from the UK to BC in 2020, decided to move back to the UK permanently to resume her life there. Sunita left Vancouver on June 15, 2026 and commenced her job in London. Her husband stayed in BC until October 31, 2026 to stage and sell their townhouse. A tax software defaulted Sunita's departure date to October 31, 2026 under the general 'latest of three dates' rule. Under CRA Folio S5-F1-C1, how should Sunita's departure date be correctly established?
variants.zh: Sunita 是一名工程师，于 2020 年从英国迁至 BC 省，现决定永久迁回英国恢复当地生活。Sunita 于 2026 年 6 月 15 日离开温哥华并在伦敦入职。她的丈夫在 BC 省停留至 2026 年 10 月 31 日，以便整理出售他们的联排住房。某报税软件根据通则“三日期取最晚”将 Sunita 的离境日默认为 2026 年 10 月 31 日。根据 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1，Sunita 的离境日应如何正确确定？

opts.t: October 31, 2026, because married couples must legally share an identical departure date under all circumstances.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在夫妻离境日必须强制绑定的规定。

opts.t: December 31, 2026, because emigrants are deemed full-year residents until the calendar year closes.
opts.w: 错误。部分年度居民离境日在年内离境当天确定。

opts.t: January 1, 2026, because departure tax retroactively covers the entire calendar year of emigration.
opts.w: 错误。离境税视同处置发生在离境日前一刻，并非追溯到年初。

opts.t: June 15, 2026, the day she left, because she is returning to re-establish her home in her country of origin.
opts.w: 正确。根据 CRA Folio S5-F1-C1 ¶1.24 及讲义第七部分，回原居国重建居所属于特殊例外情形，离境日以本人离境当天（2026 年 6 月 15 日）为准，配偶滞后离境处理房产并不推迟其离境日。Sunita 在 6 月 15 日之后在英国的受雇所得完全脱离加拿大税网。

variants.pt: 个人异议法定期限取较晚者计算
variants.trap: 机械套用90天异议期限
variants.stem: Evelyn operates an unincorporated sole proprietorship whose 2025 personal tax return was subject to the June 15, 2026 filing deadline. Evelyn filed her return on June 10, 2026. Due to internal administrative backlogs, the CRA did not mail her initial Notice of Assessment until May 5, 2027. Evelyn disagrees with an expense disallowance. Under ITA s.165(1)(a), what is Evelyn's statutory deadline to file a Notice of Objection?
variants.zh: Evelyn 经营一家未成立公司的独资企业，其 2025 税年税表适用 2026 年 6 月 15 日的申报截止日。Evelyn 于 2026 年 6 月 10 日报税。由于内部积压，CRA 迟至 2027 年 5 月 5 日才发出原始评税通知（NOA）。Evelyn 对费用剔除有异议。根据 ITA s.165(1)(a)，Evelyn 提交异议通知书的法定期限为何？

opts.t: August 3, 2027 (90 days after the Notice of Assessment date), because it falls later than one year after her return's filing due date (June 15, 2027).
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.165(1)(a)，自雇人士 2025 税年申报截止日为 2026 年 6 月 15 日，其后一年为 2027 年 6 月 15 日；而 NOA 发出日（2027 年 5 月 5 日）后 90 天为 2027 年 8 月 3 日。两者取较晚者，8 月 3 日晚于 6 月 15 日，因此截止日为 NOA 后 90 天的 2027 年 8 月 3 日。

opts.t: June 15, 2027, because the one-year window following the statutory filing deadline serves as an absolute statutory limitation bar for business proprietors.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了“取较晚者”规则；当 CRA 严重迟发 NOA 时，NOA 发出后 90 天晚于申报截止日后一年，以较晚的 90 天为准。

opts.t: June 10, 2027, precisely one year from the date Evelyn electronically submitted her tax return to the CRA.
opts.w: 错误。起算法定一年的基准是法定的“申报截止日”（filing-due date, 6月15日），而不是纳税人实际交表的日期（6月10日）。

opts.t: May 5, 2028, representing one full calendar year from the date the Notice of Assessment was mailed by the CRA.
opts.w: 错误。从 NOA 发出日起算的时间长度是 90 天，并非整整一年；只有从申报截止日起算才是整整一年。

variants.pt: 正常复评期起算与疏忽超期复评
variants.trap: 把正常复评期当无条件保护伞
variants.stem: Chloe, an individual taxpayer, filed her 2022 personal income tax return on April 30, 2023, and received her initial Notice of Assessment on May 25, 2023. Chloe made honest and diligent disclosures with no neglect, carelessness, or fraud. In September 2026, the CRA re-examines her file and issues a Notice of Reassessment disallowing a moving expense deduction claimed on her 2022 return. Chloe contends the reassessment is statute-barred. How should her objection be determined under ITA s.152(3.1)?
variants.zh: Chloe 是一名个人纳税人，于 2023 年 4 月 30 日申报了 2022 税年税表，并于 2023 年 5 月 25 日收到了原始 NOA。Chloe 的申报诚实详尽，无任何疏忽、粗心或欺诈。2026 年 9 月，CRA 重审其档案并发出一份重新评税通知，剔除了其 2022 年税表中的搬迁费扣除。Chloe 主张该复评已过法定追诉时效。根据 ITA s.152(3.1)，该争议应如何认定？

opts.t: The reassessment is valid because the CRA maintains an unrestricted four-year reassessment window for all individual personal returns.
opts.w: 错误。非 CCPC 公司法定期限才是 4 年，普通个人的正常复评期严格为 3 年。

opts.t: The reassessment is valid because the three-year clock does not begin until the end of the calendar year in which the initial assessment was mailed.
opts.w: 错误。正常复评期起算点为原始 NOA 发出当天（2023年5月25日），并非当年年底。

opts.t: The reassessment is valid because the CRA has administrative discretion to extend the limitation period whenever deductions exceed $5,000.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 没有任何仅凭金额大小就单方面延长正常复评期的行政酌情权。

opts.t: The reassessment is statute-barred and invalid because the three-year normal reassessment period expired on May 25, 2026, and no statutory exception applies.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.152(3.1)(b)，个人的正常复评期为原始 NOA 发出日起 3 年（2023 年 5 月 25 日至 2026 年 5 月 25 日）。由于纳税人如实申报、不存在任何疏忽、粗心或故意失实的陈述，法定的例外条款均不适用，2026 年 9 月发出的重新评税已过追诉时效（statute-barred），合法性不成立。

variants.pt: CRA审查信类型与处理边界
variants.trap: 混淆核对审查与全面稽查
variants.stem: Hannah filed her 2025 personal return in April 2026 reporting employment earnings and bank interest. In October 2026, after receiving her NOA, she receives a CRA letter titled 'Matching Program' saying that $3,500 of interest shown on a T5 slip from an investment account was not reported on her return, and proposing a revised balance. What is the basic mechanism of this CRA review?
variants.zh: Hannah 于 2026 年 4 月申报了 2025 税年税表，申报了工资与银行利息。2026 年 10 月收到 NOA 之后，她收到一封标题为「Matching Program」的 CRA 来信，指出一张投资账户 T5 上的 $3,500 利息没有报进她的税表，并提出拟调整的欠税额。这项 CRA 审查的基本机制是什么？

opts.t: It is a pre-assessment examination that delays the issuance of the taxpayer's original Notice of Assessment until in-person interviews conclude.
opts.w: 错误。Matching Program 发生在 NOA 发出之后，不属于在评税前拖延发单的 Pre-assessment Review。

opts.t: It is an arbitrary assessment issued under ITA s.152(7) as a legal sanction for non-filing of corporate partnership returns.
opts.w: 错误。武断评税是长期不报税被催告后的强制行政评税，与常规税后的 Matching Program 自动化比对性质完全不同。

opts.t: It is a post-assessment verification program that systematically cross-references amounts reported on the return against information slips submitted by third-party payors.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.3 节表格，信息比对项目（Matching Program）发生在 NOA 出具之后，其机制是将纳税人申报的数字与雇主、金融机构等第三方直接报送给 CRA 的税务滑单（如 T4、T5）进行系统化自动化比对，查实是否存在漏报收入或数字不一致。

opts.t: It is a taxpayer relief proceeding initiated to evaluate whether the taxpayer qualifies for an administrative penalty cancellation under Form RC4288.
opts.w: 错误。Matching Program 是 CRA 主动发起的核查项目，不是纳税人依据 RC4288 主动申请的纳税人减免程序。

variants.pt: 报税调整渠道与十年回溯上限
variants.trap: 混淆改表十年与减免十年
variants.stem: Brenda submitted her 2025 personal tax return electronically on April 15, 2026. On April 22, 2026, prior to receiving her initial Notice of Assessment, Brenda finds an unrecorded $500 charitable donation receipt. Brenda logs into CRA My Account and attempts to immediately submit an adjustment through 'Change my return.' What fundamental rule governs Brenda's adjustment request?
variants.zh: Brenda 于 2026 年 4 月 15 日电子申报了 2025 税年个人税表。在尚未收到原始评税通知（NOA）的 4 月 22 日，Brenda 发现了一张遗漏的 $500 慈善捐赠收据。Brenda 登录 CRA My Account 试图立即通过「Change my return」提交调整。哪项基本规则管辖 Brenda 的调整申请？

opts.t: Brenda must wait until she receives her initial Notice of Assessment before submitting any adjustment request through Change my return, ReFILE, or Form T1-ADJ.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.4 节及第三节第 2 节点，申请改一份已申报的税表（无论是通过 My Account 的 Change my return、软件 ReFILE 还是纸质 T1-ADJ），法定前置条件是“必须先收到 NOA”。在原始评税未完成前，系统不支持也不允许提交调整申请；此外，若有多次调整，必须等上一次处理完毕方可提交下一次。

opts.t: Brenda must immediately file a formal Notice of Objection on Form T400A within 90 days to prevent the unassessed return from becoming irreversible.
opts.w: 错误。异议通知书（T400A）只能针对已经下达的评税（NOA/NOR）提出，在评税尚未下达前根本无法提起异议。

opts.t: Brenda should immediately file a brand-new complete T1 return marked as an amended duplicate using standard NETFILE software.
opts.w: 错误。NETFILE 不接受同一税年的重复报税申报，盲目重报会导致系统报错并延误原始税表的初评。

opts.t: Brenda is required to file paper Form T1-ADJ immediately because electronic adjustment channels are prohibited prior to June 15.
opts.w: 错误。纸质 T1-ADJ 同样要求在收到 NOA 之后才能递交，且电子渠道并没有所谓 6 月 15 日前禁用的规定。

variants.pt: 异议期间追缴暂停与利息计收
variants.trap: 误把追缴暂停当免除利息
variants.stem: Apex Freight Inc., a large corporation subject to ITA s.225.1(7), and Neil, an individual disputing a disallowed charitable donation tax credit derived from a tax shelter arrangement, both file valid Notices of Objection. How do statutory collection restrictions apply to Apex Freight Inc. and Neil's tax shelter donation dispute under the Income Tax Act?
variants.zh: Apex Freight Inc.（受 ITA s.225.1(7) 规制的大公司）与 Neil（对源自税务庇护避税机制的慈善捐赠抵免被剔除提出异议的个人）均提出了合规的异议通知书。根据《所得税法》，法定追缴限制如何分别适用于 Apex Freight Inc. 与 Neil 的税务庇护捐赠争议？

opts.t: Both taxpayers enjoy complete 100% suspension of all collection actions because a valid statutory objection was served.
opts.w: 错误。这是通用规则，但大公司与税务庇护捐赠抵免均属于打破“个人全额暂停”的法定例外情形。

opts.t: Apex Freight Inc. must pay 100% of the disputed balance immediately, while Neil's entire tax shelter dispute is completely protected from collection.
opts.w: 错误。大公司无须全额立即缴纳，税法规定追缴限额为 50%；且个人涉及税务庇护捐赠时也不享受完全暂停。

opts.t: The CRA may collect 50% of the disputed amount from the large corporation within 90 days, and may actively collect 50% of the disputed tax shelter donation balance.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.225.1(7) 及讲义第 2.6 节，税法设立了两大打破追缴暂停的法定例外：大公司（large corporation）即使异议，CRA 仍可在 NOA 发出 90 天内先追缴 50% 的争议税额；涉及税务庇护（tax shelter）的慈善捐赠抵免争议，CRA 同样只暂停 50%，其余 50% 照常可以执行追缴。

opts.t: Collection is fully suspended for both entities, but the Tax Court must impose an automatic 20% delay penalty upon filing.
opts.w: 错误。只有在法院裁决纳税人提异议的主要目的是恶意拖延缴税时，法院才有权课以最高 10% 的拖延罚款，并非立案即自动课以 20%。

variants.pt: 纳税人减免与自愿披露适用边界
variants.trap: 混淆已评定减免与未申报自愿披露
variants.stem: In May 2026, Kevin submits an application on Form RC4288 requesting: (1) the cancellation of a late-filing penalty assessed on his 2014 personal tax return, and (2) the cancellation of arrears interest that accumulated between 2018 and 2023 on an unpaid tax assessment originating from his 2012 tax year. How does the 10-year limitation rule apply to Kevin's requested relief under CRA guidelines (IC07-1R1)?
variants.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Kevin 递交了 Form RC4288 申请，请求：(1) 减免其 2014 税年个人税表被征收的迟报罚款；(2) 减免其 2012 税年未缴税款在 2018 至 2023 年期间累积的滞纳利息。根据 CRA 指南（IC07-1R1），10 年法定申请时效如何适用于 Kevin 的减免请求？

opts.t: Both the 2014 penalty and the 2018–2023 interest are fully eligible for relief because personal tax liabilities fall under a 15-year statutory umbrella.
opts.w: 错误。税法中的纳税人减免严格受 10 年时限约束，不存在所谓的 15 年伞形窗口。

opts.t: The 2018–2023 interest can be considered, as it accrued within 10 years, but the 2014 penalty is outside the window.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.7 节，纳税人减免（RC4288）对罚款与利息适用不同的十年锚点：罚款锚在“所属税年或申报期”，2026 年申请只能减免 2016 及以后税年的罚款，2014 税年罚款已过期；利息锚在“实际累积的日历年”，2026 年申请可审查 2016 年 1 月 1 日及以后累积的利息，因此即便原始欠税源于 2012 年，其在 2018 至 2023 年累积的利息均在 10 年窗口内，依法有资格获减免考虑。

opts.t: The 2014 penalty is eligible for relief because personal penalties are unconstrained by time, but the interest is barred because the underlying debt arose in 2012.
opts.w: 错误。罚款受所属税年 10 年限制；而利息减免并不因原始欠税产生于 10 年前而被排除，只要利息是在近 10 年内滚存累加的即可申请。

opts.t: Neither request can be considered because any underlying tax balance originating prior to 2020 is permanently excluded from ministerial discretion.
opts.w: 错误。这忽略了利息减免锚在“累积年份”的特殊规则，误将利息与原始欠税年份进行绑定。

variants.pt: 税务法院非正式程序门槛与规则
variants.trap: 误认小额诉讼判决具判例效力
variants.stem: Samantha received an unfavorable decision from the CRA Appeals Branch regarding a disallowed business expense deduction, involving $31,000 in disputed federal income tax. Samantha wishes to avoid expensive legal representation and formal evidentiary procedures. She asks her tax preparer whether she can access the Informal Procedure of the Tax Court of Canada. How should the preparer advise Samantha under the Tax Court of Canada Act?
variants.zh: Samantha 收到 CRA 上诉处的不利决定，其自雇业务费用扣除被剔除，涉及 $31,000 的争议联邦所得税。Samantha 希望避免高昂的律师代理费用与繁琐的正式证据规则，她询问报税员自己能否选择走加拿大税务法院的非正式程序。根据《加拿大税务法院法》，报税员应如何向 Samantha 提供建议？

opts.t: Samantha is strictly disqualified from the Informal Procedure under any circumstances because her disputed federal tax exceeds $25,000.
opts.w: 错误。税法赋予了纳税人主动限额选择权，超过门槛并非绝对被排斥。

opts.t: Samantha may automatically access the Informal Procedure provided she pays an administrative waiver fee equal to 10% of the excess $6,000 balance.
opts.w: 错误。税务法院没有所谓缴纳 10% 超额豁免费即可免除门槛限制的规定。

opts.t: Samantha can access the Informal Procedure only if the Department of Justice grants special written dispensation prior to filing.
opts.w: 错误。是否走非正式程序取决于法定门槛或纳税人单方选择，无需司法部批准。

opts.t: Samantha may elect to limit her dispute to $25,000 in federal tax, thereby entitling her to proceed under the Informal Procedure.
opts.w: 正确。根据《加拿大税务法院法》第 18 条及讲义第 2.9 节，争议金额超过 $25,000 门槛的纳税人，可以依法主动选择将争议金额上限限制在 $25,000 以内（放弃对超出部分的主张），从而换取走成本更低、流程更简便的非正式程序（Informal Procedure）。

bank.pt: 普通法关系 12 个月连续同居的中断规则
bank.stem: 小林与男友 2025 年 4 月起同居，2025 年 10 月因吵架分开住了 60 天后又搬回一起住。到 2026 年 4 月，他们是否已满足普通法伴侣「连续同居 12 个月」的条件？

opts.t: 是，因为分开的 60 天不满 90 天，这段间断仍计入连续同居期间
否，因为只要分开住过一天，12 个月就必须从复合那天重新起算
opts.w: 这条判断把间断的门槛记错了：只有分开满 90 天才会真正中断计时，60 天的间断仍算作连续同居的一部分。

opts.t: 否，因为普通法关系只能以共同抚养子女的条件成立，同居时长完全不作数
opts.w: 同居满 12 个连续月是三条独立成立条件中的一条，并非只能靠共同子女成立，这条选项把条件搞反了。

opts.t: 是，但仅限双方在分开期间仍共同持有银行账户才算连续，否则要重新起算
opts.w: 连续同居的认定不附加共同账户这类条件，法律只看分开是否满 90 天，这是虚构的附加要求。

bank.note: 普通法伴侣的 12 个月连续同居计时，允许一次不满 90 天的因关系破裂分居间断，不因中间分开而归零，故到 2026 年 4 月已满足条件。

bank.pt: 分居生效日的判定
bank.stem: 一对夫妻因关系破裂于 2026 年 5 月 1 日起分开居住，且此后持续分开满 90 天以上，双方也未复合。他们「分居」状态的法定生效日应该是哪一天？

opts.t: 2026 年 7 月 30 日，也就是满 90 天的那一天
opts.w: 生效日不是满 90 天的那一天，而是往前追溯到实际开始分开居住的那一天。

opts.t: 2026 年 5 月 1 日，也就是他们实际开始分开居住的那一天
他们向 CRA 提交婚姻状况变更通知表格的那一天
opts.w: 通知 CRA 的日期只是行政动作的时间，法定生效日与何时通知无关，通知本身也要等满 90 天才能提交。

opts.t: 当年 12 月 31 日，因为分居状态只能在年底统一认定
opts.w: 分居生效日不需要等到年底才能确定，一旦满 90 天，生效日立刻回溯到开始分开住那天，与 12 月 31 日无关。

bank.note: 一旦分居满 90 天，法定生效日回溯到开始分开居住的那一天，不是满 90 天当天，也不是通知或年底那天。

bank.pt: 配偶净收入栏是否可以留空
bank.stem: 王太太 2026 年 12 月 31 日有普通法伴侣，对方当年完全没有收入、也不打算单独报税。王太太在自己的申报表上应该怎么处理对方的净收入栏？

opts.t: 可以留空，因为对方没有收入也没有单独申报
opts.w: 留空是错的：即使对方没有收入或不单独申报，也要填上如果对方报税会显示的净收入金额，哪怕是零。

opts.t: 填写「不适用」三个字代替具体的收入数字即可
opts.w: 填写的应是具体的净收入金额（此例为零），而不是用文字代替数字，文字无法进入后续的计算公式。

opts.t: 填零，因为这是计算王太太抵免与福利的必要数字
只有对方净收入超过基本个人免税额时才需要填写
opts.w: 这条附加了不存在的门槛：不论对方净收入是否超过任何免税额，只要有配偶或普通法伴侣就必须填写该数字。

bank.note: 配偶或普通法伴侣的净收入即使为零，也必须填写，因为它是计算本人配偶额抵免与多项家庭福利的输入变量，不能留空或用文字代替。

bank.pt: 配偶自雇对本人申报期限的影响
bank.stem: 李先生本人是受雇人士，不从事自雇业务；他的普通法伴侣 2026 年全年经营自雇生意。李先生本人 2026 税年的申报期限是哪一天？

opts.t: 2027 年 4 月 30 日，因为只有本人自雇才会延期，配偶自雇不影响本人期限
opts.w: 这条判断弄反了规则：配偶或普通法伴侣当年自雇同样会把本人的申报期限延到 6 月 15 日，不是只看本人是否自雇。

opts.t: 2026 年 12 月 31 日，因为受雇人士必须在税年结束前就完成申报
opts.w: 个人申报表要等税年结束、收到全年信息凭证后才能计算与提交，不可能在税年结束当天前完成，这个日期不成立。

opts.t: 由 CRA 针对每个案件逐一通知，没有统一的法定期限可以遵循
opts.w: 个人申报期限是法律明确规定的日期，不是由 CRA 逐案单独通知决定的。

opts.t: 2027 年 6 月 15 日，因为普通法伴侣当年自雇会把本人的申报期限一并顺延

bank.note: 申报期限延至 6 月 15 日的规则跟随配偶或普通法伴侣的身份走：只要其中一方当年自雇，两人的申报期限都顺延，不是只看本人是否自雇。

bank.pt: 居住省的判定基准
bank.stem: 赵先生 2026 年 1 月到 12 月 19 日一直住在阿尔伯塔，12 月 20 日搬到 BC 并在 12 月 31 日仍住在 BC。他 2026 税年申报表上「居住省」应该填哪一个？

opts.t: BC，因为居住省按 12 月 31 日当天的居住地判定
阿尔伯塔，因为他全年绝大部分时间住在阿尔伯塔
opts.w: 居住省的判定基准是 12 月 31 日当天的居住地，不是按全年累计居住天数最长的省份计算。

opts.t: 由赵先生自行选择对自己更有利的一个省份填写
opts.w: 居住省不是可以自由选择的选项，法律规定必须填 12 月 31 日当天实际居住或被视为事实居民的那个省。

opts.t: 两省各按居住天数比例分摊，分别使用两张省表
opts.w: 居住省的判定不做按天数比例分摊，只按 12 月 31 日当天这一个时点确定唯一的省份并使用对应的一张省表。

bank.note: 居住省的判定基准是 12 月 31 日当天的实际居住地或事实居民地，不看全年累计天数，因此赵先生应填 BC，套用 BC 的税率与省级抵免。

bank.pt: T1135 申报门槛的计算方式
bank.stem: 关于 Form T1135「特定海外财产」$100,000 申报门槛的判断方式，以下哪一项是不正确的说法？

opts.t: 门槛按成本额（通常即调整后成本基础）计算，不是按财产的公允市场价值计算
opts.w: 这个说法是正确的：官方明确门槛依据是成本额，不是市值，这道题问的是找出不正确的那一项。

opts.t: 门槛按每项财产单独判断，单项成本额不超 $100,000 就不必合并计算
只要当年任何时刻曾达到门槛，即使年底前已卖出该财产，仍须申报
opts.w: 这个说法是正确的：只要年内任何时刻曾达标，就必须申报当年持有过的全部特定海外财产，这道题要找的是不正确的说法。

opts.t: 个人自用财产（例如自住为主的度假屋）完全不计入这项门槛的合计计算
opts.w: 这个说法是正确的：个人自用财产明确排除在特定海外财产之外，不计入门槛合计，这道题要找的是不正确的说法。

bank.note: 门槛按同一申报人名下全部特定海外财产的成本额合计判断，不是逐项单独判断——两项各 $75,000 与 $35,000 的财产合计 $110,000 同样要申报，「按每项财产单独判断」这个说法不正确。

bank.pt: 海外财产未合规申报的后果
bank.stem: 纳税人当年有未申报的海外财产收入，且 Form T1135 未按规定申报或申报不准确，这会对 CRA 复评这份申报表的权力产生什么影响？

opts.t: 没有特别影响，CRA 仍按个人一般 3 年的正常复评期限处理
opts.w: 这个说法忽略了延长规则：满足条件时，正常复评期限会在原有基础上再延长 3 年，不是维持不变。

opts.t: CRA 会立刻取消该纳税人当年所有已获得的抵免与福利资格
opts.w: 延长复评期不等于立刻取消全部抵免与福利资格，两者是不同的法律后果，这个说法夸大了实际效果。

opts.t: 整份申报表的正常复评期限会在原有基础上再延长 3 年
只有海外财产收入那一部分金额可以被复评，其余部分的复评期限不受影响
opts.w: 延长复评期适用于整份申报表，不是只针对海外财产收入那一部分单独计算，这个说法缩小了影响范围。

bank.note: 满足「当年有未申报海外收入」且「T1135 未报、逾期或不准确」两个条件时，整份申报表的正常复评期限会延长 3 年，这是比单纯罚款更重的后果。

bank.pt: 免税收入是否仍需报税
bank.stem: 陈先生依《印第安人法》第 87 条享有雇佣收入免税，多年因此没有报税。这样做对他有什么实际影响？

opts.t: 没有任何实际影响，因为免税收入原本就不需要缴税或申报
opts.w: 这个说法混淆了「收入免税」和「不用申报」两件事：免税只是不用为这笔收入交税，不等于不用申报，不申报会影响福利资格。

opts.t: CRA 会因此追缴他过去几年免税收入对应的全部税款
opts.w: 第 87 条豁免的收入本身合法免税，不存在被追缴税款的问题，这个说法虚构了不存在的后果。

opts.t: 只要将来报税，以前错过的福利会被自动全额补发，没有追溯期限制
opts.w: 福利的追溯申领受法定追溯期限制，不是没有限制地全额补发，这个说法忽略了追溯期的存在。

opts.t: 他会错过这些年份按已提交申报表核发的家庭与消费类福利资格

bank.note: CCB、CGEB 等现金福利的核发前提是「已提交申报表」，免税收入者同样要通过 T90 计算净额并随申报表提交，不报税会直接错过这些福利，与是否欠税无关。

bank.pt: Line 22215 增强供款扣除的 2026 税年金额
bank.stem: 周先生 2026 税年只有一个雇主，全年可供款收入 12 万元，CPP 与 CPP2 都被扣满。他的申报表 Line 22215 应当填多少？

opts.t: 1,127.00 元，即第一层增强 711.00 元与 CPP2 的 416.00 元之和
1,074.00 元，即第一层增强 678.00 元与 CPP2 的 396.00 元之和
opts.w: 这是 2025 税年的上限。2026 税年 YMPE 与 YAMPE 都上调了，两段增强供款要按当年参数重算，照抄上一年会少扣五十多元。

opts.t: 711.00 元，即第一层增强那一段，CPP2 另行走抵免
opts.w: CPP2 与第一层增强同属增强供款，两段都走扣除、合并填在同一行，CPP2 并不走非退还抵免那条路。

opts.t: 4,230.45 元，即该年度雇员一侧的 CPP 供款上限全额
opts.w: 这是 CPP1 的雇员供款上限全额，其中占大头的基础段走的是抵免、填在另一行，整笔搬到扣除行等于重复计算。

bank.pt: 多雇主 CPP 超缴时三行各填什么
