opts.t: Identification requires a joint entry of both the deceased and all legal heirs, and email registration provides immediate real-time telephone support priority.
opts.w: 错误。报税表不填报继承人名单，提供电子邮件也不会赋予纳税人电话支持优先权。

opts.t: Identification must leave the SIN field blank until probate is completed, and email registration is legally compulsory for all estate filings.
opts.w: 错误。必须填写逝者本人的有效 SIN，且电子邮件地址始终是可选栏位（optional field）。

checks.pt: BC居民跨省搬迁与省表结算规则
checks.stem: An individual lived and worked in Alberta from January until December 10, 2026, when they relocated to British Columbia for a new job. Which provincial tax calculation rules apply on their 2026 federal T1 return?
checks.zh: 某纳税人于 2026 年 1 月至 12 月 10 日期间在阿尔伯塔省生活和工作，随后因新工作搬迁至 BC 省并在当地定居。该纳税人的 2026 年联邦 T1 申报表应如何适用省税计算规则？

opts.t: The taxpayer must calculate 11 months of Alberta provincial tax and 1 month of BC provincial tax based on days lived.
opts.w: 错误。个人所得税不按跨省居住天数或月数进行比例分摊。

opts.t: Because the taxpayer resided in BC on December 31, 2026, all provincial tax is calculated entirely under BC Form 428 within the single T1 return.
opts.w: 正确。BC 与除魁省外的其他省份一样不单独征税；居住省按 12 月 31 日这一天单一事实确定，全年在同一份 T1 申报表中通过 BC Form 428 套用 BC 税率与抵免计算省税。

opts.t: The taxpayer must file an Alberta Form 428 with CRA and submit a separate standalone provincial return directly to the BC Ministry of Finance.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省税由 CRA 统一征收，无需且不存在单独向 BC 财政厅申报的个人税表。

opts.t: The taxpayer is exempt from BC provincial tax for 2026 because their primary annual income was earned in Alberta.
opts.w: 错误。省税管辖权取决于年底居住省，收入在阿尔伯塔赚取并不免除 12 月 31 日定居 BC 的纳税人缴纳 BC 省税的义务。

checks.pt: T1135两档申报与家庭福利历史演变
checks.stem: How did Form T1135 reporting change to ease the burden on filers, and what role does the $250,000 cost level play?
checks.zh: Form T1135（海外财产申报表）的报送方式怎样调整以减轻申报负担？$250,000 这个成本额在其中起什么作用？

opts.t: The filing threshold was raised from $100,000 to $250,000, so assets under $250,000 need no disclosure.
opts.w: 错误。申报门槛始终是 $100,000，从未整体上调至 $250,000。

opts.t: Since 2015, filers whose total cost stays under $250,000 may use simplified Part A; at or above it, Part B.
opts.w: 正确。讲义第五节：2015 年起新增两档报送方式——有申报义务且全年成本额始终低于 250,000 元，可选简化的 Part A；任何时点达到或超过 250,000 元须用 Part B 详细申报。

opts.t: Form T1135 was merged into the principal residence declaration form, removing separate offshore penalties entirely.
opts.w: 错误。T1135 仍是完全独立的海外财产申报表，且保留了严厉的法定迟报罚款。

opts.t: All individual reporting was eliminated in 2016 and replaced by direct automatic information exchange with foreign banks.
opts.w: 错误。纳税人自行申报的法定责任依然存在，并未被自动化交换取代。

checks.pt: 案例场景下同居中断与海外资产判断
checks.stem: In the chapter's illustrative cases, why did the couple in Surrey qualify as common-law partners despite having a 50-day separation during their first year of cohabitation?
checks.zh: 在本章的示范案例中，素里的那对情侣在同居第一年内经历了 50 天的分开居住，为什么仍然被认定为成立普通法伴侣关系？

opts.t: Because a break of under 90 days does not reset the 12-month cohabitation clock under federal tax rules.
opts.w: 正确。讲义案例一明确说明：因感情破裂分开居住不满 90 天（50天）复合的，仍算作连续同居的一部分，不会将 12 个月的同居计时器归零。

opts.t: Because common-law status is established automatically on the 180th day of cohabitation regardless of interruptions.
opts.w: 错误。税法规定的基础同居时限是连续 12 个月，不存在 180 天的法定规则。

opts.t: Because provincial family law in BC immediately overrides the federal Income Tax Act whenever couples rent a property jointly.
opts.w: 错误。联邦所得税目的下的婚姻状况严格依《所得税法》定义判定，省级家庭法并不在此处自动覆盖联邦税法。

opts.t: Because separations occurring within the first six months of cohabitation are legally deemed null and void.
opts.w: 错误。税法中不存在所谓前六个月内分居无效的规定。

checks.pt: 原住民结算土地与免税勾选本质差异
checks.stem: According to the chapter's checklist of common filing errors, what is the fundamental legal difference between the 'Residing on Indigenous government lands' checkbox and the Indian Act Section 87 tax exemption?
checks.zh: 根据本章常见错报与自查清单，询问是否「居住在原住民政府土地上」的勾选框与《印第安人法》第 87 条免税申报之间有何根本法定区别？

opts.t: The former determines whether personal income is fully exempt, while the latter determines whether provincial sales tax is refunded.
opts.w: 错误。两项勾选均不用于判定省销售税退税。

opts.t: The former is an optional survey question, while the latter is only available to non-resident foreign nationals.
opts.w: 错误。前者是法定税务归属问题而非调查问卷，后者仅针对有身份的原住民，非外国公民。

opts.t: The former applies only in NL, NT and YT to share tax revenue; the latter exempts reserve-situated property, via Form T90.
opts.w: 正确。讲义清单第7项强调：「居住在原住民政府土地上」仅适用纽芬兰与拉布拉多、西北地区、育空三地居民，用于在政府间分配税收；而《印第安人法》第 87 条免税适用于全国符合资格者，通过 Form T90 计算免税净额以确保按家庭核发的福利不受影响。

opts.t: Both checkboxes achieve identical tax outcomes and selecting either one automatically eliminates all federal and provincial tax liabilities.
opts.w: 错误。两者的法律功能完全互斥且目标不同，不能随意混淆或相互替代。

checks.pt: 源头扣缴与自评税制和解及罚则机制
checks.stem: Under the Income Tax Act, why does the T4 slip report both total remuneration and taxes withheld, and what is the legal character of Line 43700?
checks.zh: 根据《所得税法》，为什么 T4 报表同时报告报酬总额与已代扣税款，第 43700 行在法律上具有什么性质？

opts.t: Line 43700 represents a non-refundable tax credit that expires if not fully utilized against the current year's taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。Line 43700 是已预缴税款（prepaid taxes），直接冲抵最终应纳税额，若超出应纳税额则全额退税，绝非会过期的非退还抵免。

opts.t: The T4 reconciles source deductions with self-assessment; Line 43700 is tax already paid, offsetting the final bill dollar for dollar.
opts.w: 正确。T4 是源头扣缴（source deductions, ITA s.153）与自评税制（self-assessment system）之间的和解凭证，Line 43700 汇总全年预缴税款，直接与最终算出的应缴税额冲抵，多退少补。

opts.t: Line 43700 represents an income deduction that directly reduces Net Income on Line 23600.
opts.w: 错误。代扣税款不是税前扣除项（deduction），不减少净收入或应税收入。

opts.t: The T4 slip is issued solely for provincial statistical tracking and does not alter federal filing obligations.
opts.w: 错误。T4 是联邦法定义务凭证，是 T1 申报的核心输入。

checks.pt: EI保费与保险性收入的申报及核对
checks.stem: In the 2026 tax year, an employee earned $75,000 in employment income. How should the employer's EI payroll deductions be reported on the employee's T1 return, and what is the function of Box 24?
checks.zh: 在 2026 税年，一名雇员取得雇佣收入 $75,000。雇主代扣的 EI 费用应如何在雇员 T1 申报表上填报，Box 24 具有什么功能？

opts.t: Box 18 reports the maximum employee EI premium of $1,123.07 which is claimed as a deduction on Line 22215, while Box 24 enters Line 10100.
opts.w: 错误。EI 保费走 Line 31200 走非退还抵免，而不是 Line 22215 扣除；Box 24 是核对框，不进 Line 10100。

opts.t: Box 18 reports the maximum employee EI premium of $1,049.12 on Line 31200, while Box 24 must be left blank.
Box 18 ($1,123.07) is claimed as a credit on Line 31200; Box 24 ($68,900) is only a check figure.
opts.w: 正确。2026 税年 EI 最大可保收入（Maximum Insurable Earnings, MIE）为 $68,900，雇员保费上限为 $68,900 × 1.63% = $1,123.07，填入 Box 18 并申报在 Line 31200 享受非退还抵免（non-refundable tax credit）；Box 24（EI 保险性收入）为备忘核对框，不进入申报表任何一行。

opts.t: Box 18 is reported on Line 45000 as an automatic refundable credit, while Box 24 enters Line 20700.
opts.w: 错误。正常的单雇主法定保费填 Line 31200；Line 45000 仅用于超额缴费退税。

checks.pt: 多份工作TD1申报与源头预扣不足
checks.stem: An individual worked two jobs concurrently throughout 2026, earning $45,000 from Employer X and $40,000 from Employer Y. Both employers withheld tax strictly according to the TD1 forms submitted, but at tax filing time, the individual faced a substantial unexpected tax balance owing. What is the structural cause of this outcome?
checks.zh: 某人 2026 年全年同时从事两份工作，从雇主 X 处获得 $45,000，从雇主 Y 处获得 $40,000。两位雇主均严格按照其提交的 TD1 表代扣税款，但在报税时，该纳税人却面临一大笔意外的补税。造成这一结果的结构性原因是什么？

opts.t: Each TD1 claimed the full basic personal amount, so each employer withheld as if it paid the only income.
opts.w: 正确。当雇员在两家雇主的 TD1（个人税收抵免申报表，Personal Tax Credits Return）上都申报了全额基本个人金额（basic personal amount）时，两家雇主各自都假设这是其唯一收入并享受免税门槛与低税阶，导致全年累计源头代扣税款（Box 22）显著低于合并总收入（$85,000）适用的实际税负，产生结构性欠税。

opts.t: Employer Y committed a statutory payroll violation by failing to match the precise marginal tax rate applied by Employer X.
opts.w: 错误。各雇主依法独立按雇员提交的 TD1 计算代扣税款，无权也无法知晓另一雇主的扣缴情况，雇主并未违规。

opts.t: The CRA automatically doubles the provincial tax rate whenever an individual receives more than one T4 slip in a calendar year.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 不会因收到多张 T4 而双倍征收省税，合并计税严格按实际总收入和法定税阶计算。

opts.t: Holding concurrent employment automatically disqualifies the individual from claiming any personal tax credits on the annual T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。兼职工作不会剥夺个人的法定税收抵免资格，只是抵免在合并申报时只能按一人一份扣减。

checks.pt: BC雇主健康税与工伤给付省内规则
checks.stem: Which of the following correctly describes how British Columbia provincial rules treat the BC Employer Health Tax (EHT) and WorkSafeBC wage-loss replacement benefits on an employee's personal tax return?
checks.zh: 下列哪项正确描述了 BC 省级规则在雇员个人纳税申报表上如何处理 BC 雇主健康税（EHT）以及 WorkSafeBC 工伤替代给付？

opts.t: BC EHT is reported on the employee's T4 Box 85, while WorkSafeBC benefits are fully taxable as regular employment income on Line 10100.
opts.w: 错误。BC EHT 是雇主缴纳的税种，不出现在 T4 任何一格；WorkSafeBC 工伤给付由 T5007 报告且免税。

opts.t: BC EHT must be claimed by the employee on Form BC428 as a provincial health credit, while WorkSafeBC benefits reduce Line 31260.
opts.w: 错误。雇员无法在 BC428 申报 EHT 抵免，工伤给付也不影响联邦加拿大就业额。

opts.t: EHT is paid by employers and never appears on a T4; WorkSafeBC benefits go on a T5007, Line 14400, then Line 25000.
opts.w: 正确。BC 雇主健康税（Employer Health Tax, EHT）纯属雇主方义务，完全不进雇员 T4；因工伤获得的 WorkSafeBC 给付由公共体系发放，报在 T5007，先计入 Line 14400 净收入，再在 Line 25000 全额扣回，本身不交税，仅用于收入挂钩福利门槛核算。

opts.t: BC EHT requires a mandatory matching employee contribution on Line 22215, while WorkSafeBC benefits are exempt from filing entirely.
opts.w: 错误。雇员无需缴纳 EHT 供款，T5007 仍须在税表上申报流转以核算净收入。

checks.pt: Box 45 牙科标记的历史与福利连接
checks.stem: Why was Box 45 (Employer-offered dental benefits indicator) introduced to the T4 slip starting in the 2023 tax year, and what is its tax filing impact on the employee's T1 return?
checks.zh: 为什么自 2023 纳税年度起在 T4 上新增了 Box 45（雇主提供牙科保障标记），它对雇员 T1 申报表有何税务影响？

opts.t: It creates a new non-refundable provincial dental tax credit on Line 33099 for employees without group dental insurance.
opts.w: 错误。Box 45 不是任何税收抵免项，不进入 Line 33099。

opts.t: It only flags dental coverage to check CDCP eligibility; it is not income, a deduction or a credit.
opts.w: 正确。Box 45 是 2023 税年新增的标记框（indicator），专门用来帮助 CRA 核对雇员是否已通过雇主福利获得牙科覆盖，以判定其是否有资格申领加拿大牙科关怀计划（Canadian Dental Care Plan, CDCP）；它本身不进 T1 申报表任何收入、扣除或抵免行。

opts.t: It adds a mandatory $500 taxable benefit to Box 14 whenever an employer provides comprehensive orthodontic coverage.
opts.w: 错误。Box 45 不是应税福利金额框，不增加 Box 14 收入。

opts.t: It automatically reduces the employee's Canada employment amount on Line 31260 by the value of dental coverage received.
opts.w: 错误。Box 45 完全不影响加拿大就业额。

checks.pt: 新移民境外雇佣与抵加前后收入划分
checks.stem: Marcus became a Canadian tax resident on July 1, 2026. Prior to moving to Canada (January to June 2026), he earned $20,000 CAD equivalent from a foreign employer. From July to October 2026, he continued working remotely for the same foreign employer, earning $14,000 CAD equivalent without receiving a Canadian T4 slip. He also earned $30,000 CAD from a local Canadian employer with a T4. How should Marcus report his employment earnings on his 2026 Canadian T1 return?
checks.zh: Marcus 于 2026 年 7 月 1 日成为加拿大税务居民。移居前（2026 年 1–6 月）他从境外雇主处赚取折合 20,000 加元的收入；7–10 月他继续为该境外雇主远程工作，赚取折合 14,000 加元，没有加拿大 T4；此外他从加拿大本地雇主处赚取 30,000 加元（有 T4）。Marcus 应如何在 2026 年加拿大 T1 上申报雇佣收入？

opts.t: He must report $30,000 on Line 10100 and $14,000 on Line 10400, excluding the pre-residency $20,000 from Canadian employment income.
opts.w: 正确。新移民仅就成为加拿大税务居民之后取得的全球收入在加拿大纳税。抵加前的 $20,000 不计入加拿大应税收入；抵加后无 T4 的境外雇佣收入（foreign employment income）$14,000 折算后申报在 Line 10400；本地 T4 的 $30,000 申报在 Line 10100。合计雇佣收入为 $44,000。

opts.t: He must report the entire worldwide total of $64,000 on Line 10100 because Canadian residents are taxed on full-year worldwide income regardless of arrival date.
opts.w: 错误。抵加前非税务居民期间取得的境外收入不属于加拿大纳税申报表中的应税雇佣收入。

opts.t: He only needs to report $30,000 on Line 10100, because foreign income without a Canadian T4 slip is legally exempt from Canadian tax.
opts.w: 错误。没有 T4 并不等于免税，成为税务居民后的境外雇佣收入依法必须在 Line 10400 申报。

opts.t: He must report $50,000 on Line 10100 and claim a 50% foreign employment deduction on Line 24900.
opts.w: 错误。境外雇佣收入无 T4 走 Line 10400，Line 24900 属于证券期权扣除，不能用于境外雇佣。

checks.pt: 团体人寿保费无豁免门槛常见错报
checks.stem: An employer paid $800 in annual group term life insurance premiums on behalf of an employee. How is this benefit treated for Canadian personal income tax purposes, and what common misconception often arises?
checks.zh: 雇主代表雇员支付了 $800 的年度团体定期人寿保险保费。在加拿大个人所得税中该福利如何处理，通常会产生什么常见误区？

opts.t: The entire $800 is a taxable benefit included in Box 14 and Box 40 of the T4 slip, because Canadian tax law provides no dollar exemption threshold for group term life insurance premiums.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大税法对雇主支付的团体人寿保险（group term life insurance）保费没有任何免税豁免门槛，无论金额多少，全额属于应税福利，须并入 T4 Box 14（总雇佣收入）并在 Box 40（备忘福利框）单独列示。套用美国税法所谓「前 50,000 美元保额免税」是华人报税最容易犯的错误。

opts.t: The first $500 of premium is statutory exempt under ITA s.6(1)(a), so only the excess $300 is taxable in Box 14.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大税法对团体人寿保险保费没有任何免税起征点或免除额度。

opts.t: The benefit is fully non-taxable because group life insurance is primarily for the administrative benefit of the employer.
opts.w: 错误。团体人寿保险的直接受益人是雇员或其指定受益人，纯属个人经济利益，属于应税福利。

opts.t: The $800 premium must be deducted by the employee on Line 22215 as an enhanced life insurance contribution.
opts.w: 错误。雇主缴纳的人寿保费不能转化为雇员的税前扣除项。

checks.pt: 解析两笔供款对价机制与报表分轨逻辑
checks.stem: Why does the federal tax system divide an employee's CPP contributions into two different reporting paths—Line 30800 as a non-refundable tax credit and Line 22215 as an income deduction?
checks.zh: 为什么联邦税收制度将雇员的 CPP 供款划分为两条不同的申报路径——Line 30800 作为非退还抵免，而 Line 22215 作为收入扣除？

opts.t: Because Line 30800 applies only to self-employed individuals, while Line 22215 applies exclusively to employees with multiple T4 slips.
opts.w: 混淆适用人群（自雇与多雇主陷阱）。Line 30800 与 Line 22215 同时适用于受雇员工的 CPP 申报，并非按自雇或多雇主划分。

opts.t: Because the 4.95% base gives everyone the same credit at the lowest rate, while the enhanced part is deducted at each person's marginal rate.
opts.w: 正确阐述了立法底层逻辑。基础供款（base contribution，4.95%）按最低税阶率折算为非退还抵免（non-refundable tax credit），对所有人平等待遇；增强段（enhanced contribution，1% 加上 CPP2 的 4%）按个人边际税率折算为扣除（deduction），体现收入对价关系。

opts.t: Because Line 30800 is calculated before considering the $3,500 basic exemption, whereas Line 22215 applies the basic exemption directly.
opts.w: 计算基数倒置。基础段与第一层增强段均扣除 $3,500 基本免税额（basic exemption），而 CPP2 针对超过 YMPE 的部分，不涉及免税额。

opts.t: Because Line 22215 is an optional provincial election, whereas Line 30800 is a mandatory federal deduction.
opts.w: 概念捏造。Line 22215 是联邦强制的税前扣除项目，并非省级自选项目。

checks.pt: 掌握 2026 税年关键参数与技工工具计算
checks.stem: In the 2026 tax year, an apprentice tradesperson purchased $2,500 of eligible new tools required for their employment. Given that the 2026 Canada Employment Amount is $1,501, what is the maximum tradesperson's tools deduction they can claim on Line 22900?
checks.zh: 在 2026 税年，一名学徒技工因工作需要自费购买了 $2,500 的合格新工具。已知 2026 年加拿大就业额为 $1,501，该技工在 Line 22900 上最多可申报多少技工工具扣除？

opts.t: $1,000, because eligible tradesperson's tools are subject to a flat statutory deduction of $1,000 regardless of the Canada Employment Amount threshold.
opts.w: 忽略了减除门槛公式。技工工具扣除（tradesperson's tools deduction）公式为 min($1,000, 工具成本 − 当年加拿大就业额)，不可直接取 $1,000 封顶值。

opts.t: $1,029, calculated by subtracting the 2025 Canada Employment Amount ($1,471) from the total tool cost.
opts.w: 误用往年历史参数（年份照抄陷阱）。2026 税年加拿大就业额（Canada Employment Amount）已指数化上调至 $1,501，不能使用 2025 年的 $1,471。

opts.t: $2,500, because the full acquisition cost of work tools is fully deductible up to net employment income.
opts.w: 混淆自雇全额抵扣与雇员封闭清单。受雇技工工具并非全额可扣，受法定公式与 $1,000 上限制约。

opts.t: $999, calculated as the lesser of $1,000 and the tool cost ($2,500) minus the 2026 Canada Employment Amount ($1,501).

checks.pt: 梳理报表填报次序与居家办公扣除限制
checks.stem: When completing Form T777 (Statement of Employment Expenses) for an eligible employee, why must home office expenses (Line 9945) be calculated strictly after all other employment expenses?
checks.zh: 在为合格雇员填写 T777 表（雇佣支出计算表）时，为什么家庭办公室支出（Line 9945）必须严格在计算完所有其他雇佣支出之后才能计算？

opts.t: Because home office costs cannot create or increase an employment loss, so they only use what is left after other expenses.
opts.w: 准确阐释了税法的扣除限额规则。家庭办公室支出（work-space-in-the-home expenses）受净雇佣收入限制，不能制造或扩大雇佣亏损，必须用扣除其他支出后的剩余空间来吸收，未用完部分结转次年。

opts.t: Because home office deductions require an automatic provincial matching credit on Form BC428 that must be finalized first.
opts.w: 概念捏造。BC 省没有独立的省级家庭办公室附加扣除或自动配比抵免。

opts.t: Because Form T2200 is only valid if motor vehicle and travel expenses are claimed ahead of remote workspace claims.
opts.w: 错判凭证与表格逻辑。T2200（雇佣条件声明）是雇主出具的整体事实证明，并不限定各费用项目的申报先后顺序。

opts.t: Because home office expenses are refundable tax credits that must be reconciled against total federal income tax payable.
opts.w: 性质混淆。家庭办公室支出属于 Line 22900 的税前扣除（deduction），而非可退还抵免（refundable tax credit）。

checks.pt: 明确 BC 省级抵免折算率与税收特例
checks.stem: A resident of British Columbia is completing their 2026 provincial Form BC428. How are the provincial non-refundable tax credits for base CPP contributions (Line 30800) and EI premiums (Line 31200) calculated, and how is enhanced CPP (Line 22215) treated on the provincial return?
checks.zh: 一名卑诗省居民正在填写其 2026 年省级税表 BC428。基础 CPP 供款（Line 30800）与 EI 保费（Line 31200）的省级非退还抵免如何折算，且增强 CPP（Line 22215）在省表上如何处理？

opts.t: Both base contributions and enhanced CPP are converted into provincial credits at the federal rate of 14%.
opts.w: 混淆联邦与省折算率。省表非退还抵免必须乘以 BC 省最低税阶率，而非联邦最低税阶率 14%。

opts.t: Base CPP and EI credits use the 2025 BC rate of 5.06%, while Line 22215 needs a separate provincial deduction schedule.
opts.w: 错误。5.06% 是 2025 年 BC 最低税阶率，2026 税年是 5.60%；Line 22215 是扣除，压低应税收入后省侧自动受益，不需要单独的省级附表。

opts.t: Base CPP and EI amounts are multiplied by BC's 2026 lowest rate of 5.60%; Line 22215 lowers taxable income with no BC line.
opts.w: 完全符合 2026 BC 省现行规则。基础 CPP 与 EI 抄联邦金额乘以 BC 最低税阶率 5.60%；Line 22215 增强段是税前扣除，直接压低应税收入（taxable income），使联邦与省两侧自动同时受益，省表无需对应行。

opts.t: British Columbia disallows provincial credits for federal EI premiums but provides an enhanced 10% credit for Line 22215.
opts.w: 捏造省级规则。BC 省完全认可 EI 保费的省级抵免，且 Line 22215 绝非抵免项目。

checks.pt: 辨析居家办公临时统一费率法废止历史
checks.stem: A taxpayer claims that they can deduct home office expenses in the 2026 tax year by simply multiplying their remote work days by a flat daily rate without receipts or Form T2200. Is this method permitted for the 2026 tax year?
checks.zh: 某纳税人声称其在 2026 税年可以仅按在家工作天数乘以定额日费率来申报家庭办公室支出，无需收据也无需 T2200 表。该方法在 2026 税年是否被允许？

opts.t: Yes, because the CRA made the temporary flat-rate method permanent for all Canadian remote workers starting in 2024.
opts.w: 混淆政策方向。临时统一费率法（temporary flat rate method）并没有被永久化，而是已被彻底废除。

opts.t: No, because the temporary flat-rate method ended after 2022; from 2023 only the detailed method with a T2200 applies.
opts.w: 准确阐明历史变革沿革。2020 至 2022 税年因应对疫情推行的简易定额法（简化版 T777S/T2200S）自 2023 税年起已全面作废，2026 税年仅剩详细法（detailed method），必须具备雇主签署的 T2200、原始收据及面积时间分摊。

opts.t: Yes, provided that the taxpayer works exclusively in a designated home office room and meets clients in person.
opts.w: 张冠李戴。专用房间且当面会客是详细法（detailed method）下的资格替代条件，不是定额简易法允许的理由。

opts.t: No, but the taxpayer can instead claim the Canada Employment Amount on Form T777 at a flat rate of $10 per day.
opts.w: 混淆报表项目。加拿大就业额（Canada Employment Amount，Line 31260）是固定上限的打包抵免，在基本表自动计算，无需在 T777 上按天申领。

checks.pt: 测算换工作导致的 EI 超缴与报表填报
checks.stem: In 2026, Sophia changed employers in September. Employer A withheld $850.00 of EI premiums (Box 18) on insurable earnings of $52,147. Employer B withheld $550.00 of EI premiums (Box 18) on insurable earnings of $33,742. Sophia's total 2026 insurable earnings exceeded the MIE ($68,900). Given the 2026 maximum employee EI premium is $1,123.07, what amounts should be reported on Line 31200 and Line 45000?
checks.zh: 2026 年，Sophia 在 9 月换了工作。A 雇主在 $52,147 的可保收入上代扣了 $850.00 的 EI 保费（Box 18）；B 雇主在 $33,742 的可保收入上代扣了 $550.00 的 EI 保费（Box 18）。Sophia 全年可保收入超过最高可保收入 MIE（$68,900）。已知 2026 年雇员 EI 最高保费为 $1,123.07，她在 Line 31200 与 Line 45000 上应分别填报多少？

opts.w: 照抄实扣金额陷阱。直接把两张 T4 的 Box 18 实扣相加（$850 + $550 ＝ $1,400），未通过 T2204 算出超缴并退回，导致多缴保费白白损失。
双重享受利益错误。若在 Line 31200 填实扣 $1,400 又在 Line 45000 退税 $276.93，会导致超缴部分既享受了抵免又拿回了退税，必定被 CRA 比对系统调整补税并计息。
误用往年历史参数（历史口径陷阱）。$1,049.12 是 2024 税年的旧上限，2026 税年 EI 雇员最高保费已上调至 $1,123.07。
计算精准无误。实扣合计 $850.00 ＋ $550.00 ＝ $1,400.00。应缴法定上限为 $1,123.07，填入 Line 31200 享受非退还抵免；超缴额（EI overpayment）为 $1,400.00 − $1,123.07 ＝ $276.93，通过 Form T2204 填入 Line 45000 退回。

checks.pt: 严格区分 EI 保费超缴与福利退还申报
checks.stem: During the 2026 tax year, a taxpayer repaid $1,500 of EI regular benefits received earlier in the year due to high net income (social benefits repayment). How should this repayment be reported, and why is claiming it on Line 45000 a critical error?
checks.zh: 在 2026 税年，某纳税人因后续净收入较高，依法退还了年初领取的 $1,500 EI 常规福利（社会福利退还款）。该笔退款应如何申报？为什么将其填在 Line 45000 是严重错误？

opts.t: It must be reported as a deduction on Line 23200 (or under Line 23500 rules); Line 45000 is strictly reserved for refundable overpayments of EI premiums, not benefit repayments.
opts.w: 准确区分了性质完全相反的两类申报。退还多领的失业福利（social benefits repayment）属于减少应税收入的税前扣除，应填 Line 23200 或按 Line 23500 规则处理；而 Line 45000 是多缴保费退还（EI overpayment），属于增加退税的可退还抵免。混淆两行会被 CRA 评税系统驳回。

opts.t: It should be claimed on Line 45000 as a refundable credit, because all repayments involving the Employment Insurance program flow through that line.
opts.w: 掉入常见错报第 5 坑。中文语境中'退 EI'既可指退保费也可指退福利，但 Line 45000 仅限代扣过多的保费，不可填报福利退还。

opts.t: It should be subtracted directly from T4 Box 14 total employment income on Line 10100.
opts.w: 擅自修改原始凭证。T4 的雇佣收入（Box 14）必须原样申报，福利退还走独立的专门扣除行，不能直接倒扣工资总额。

opts.t: It should be reported on Line 31200 as an addition to the employee's annual EI non-refundable tax credit base.
opts.w: 抵免与扣除混淆。退还福利不能增加保费抵免基数（Line 31200），否则既无法获得应有的扣除，又造成抵免金额与 T4 不符。

checks.pt: 解释养老金三层分流与反滥用规则的底层逻辑
checks.stem: Why did Parliament deliberately exclude Old Age Security (OAS) and Canada Pension Plan (CPP) payments from qualifying for the federal pension income amount (line 31400) and Form T1032 pension income splitting?
checks.zh: 为什么加拿大国会在制度设计上有意将老年保障金（OAS）和加拿大退休金计划（CPP）排除在联邦养老金收入额（Line 31400）和 Form T1032 退休收入分割的合格范围之外？

opts.t: Because OAS and CPP are fully tax-exempt under the Income Tax Act and do not require relief mechanisms.
opts.w: 错误。OAS 和 CPP 给付均属于全额应税收入（分别填在 Line 11300 和 Line 11400），并非免税收入。

opts.t: Because individuals receiving OAS and CPP are prohibited by law from holding third-tier employer registered pensions.
opts.w: 错误。税法完全允许纳税人同时领取第一层 OAS、第二层 CPP 和第三层雇主养老金（RPP/RRIF），不存在排他限制。

opts.t: Because OAS and CPP are already universal or contribution-based benefits, and the relief targets employer and registered savings.
opts.w: 正确。根据第一节的制度设计逻辑，OAS 属于全民普惠福利，CPP 属于供款换权利的社会保险，两者本身已具备社保属性，国会无意在其上叠加额外税收优惠；而 Line 31400 抵免与 T1032 分割是专门为了缓解雇主养老金及注册递延储蓄中单一收入家庭与双收入家庭税负不公才设立的。

opts.t: Because provincial tax laws forbid federal tax software from applying credits to government-administered pensions.
opts.w: 错误。税收规则由联邦《所得税法》（ITA）统一制定，与各省报税软件的技术限制无关。

checks.pt: 掌握2026年OAS门槛、股息比例与两套养老金抵免规则
checks.stem: In 2026, CRA published the indexed OAS clawback net income threshold as $95,323, while an Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) information page updated in mid-2026 listed $93,454 for 2025. What is the reason for this discrepancy?
checks.zh: 2026 年，CRA 公布的指数化 OAS 回收净收入门槛为 $95,323，而加拿大就业与社会发展部（ESDC）于 2026 年中更新的信息页却列出了适用于 2025 年的 $93,454。造成这种差异的原因是什么？

opts.t: ESDC made a typographical error that will be retroactively corrected during annual reconciliation.
opts.w: 错误。这不是笔误，两个部门的数据均在各自职权范围内准确无误。

opts.t: CRA gives the 2026 threshold used to compute the recovery, while ESDC gives last year's figure that sets payments from July.
opts.w: 正确。CRA 的指数化页面给出的是 2026 税年年终汇算回收计算所用的当年门槛（$95,323）；而 ESDC 给付说明页给出的是基于上一年（2025 年）收入决定当年 7 月起付款预扣的门槛（$93,454），两者回答的是不同时间跨度的问题，本来就相差一年。

opts.t: CRA uses the consumer price index, while ESDC is legally required to freeze threshold numbers for three-year intervals.
opts.w: 错误。两部门均遵循法定指数化调整规则，不存在 ESDC 冻结三年的法律规定。

opts.t: British Columbia has an independent provincial OAS program that forces ESDC to publish alternative threshold schedules.
opts.w: 错误。OAS 是纯粹的联邦全民福利计划，与 BC 省无关。

checks.pt: 掌握各税单框号到T1行号的对应及RRIF借龄规则
checks.stem: Walter converted his RRSP into a Registered Retirement Income Fund (RRIF) in November of Year 1. His spouse is four years younger than him. What are the mandatory minimum withdrawal rules for this RRIF in Year 1 and the options available before receiving the first payment?
checks.zh: 沃尔特（Walter）于第 1 年 11 月将其 RRSP 转为注册退休收入基金（RRIF）。他的配偶比他年轻四岁。该 RRIF 在第 1 年的法定最低提取额是多少，且在收到首笔付款前他拥有什么选择权？

opts.t: The minimum withdrawal is zero in the year of establishment (Year 1), and Walter may irrevocably elect to base future minimum withdrawals on his younger spouse's age.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RRIF 规则，成立当年（Year 1）的法定最低提取额为零，从次年（第 2 年）起才强制提取；此外，在收到第一笔付款之前，沃尔特可以做出一项不可撤销的选择，按更年轻配偶的年龄计算每年的最低提取额，从而降低强制提款比例并拉长免税复利递延期。

opts.t: Walter must withdraw a prorated minimum amount in Year 1 based on his own age, and spousal age elections are prohibited after age 65.
opts.w: 错误。成立当年没有任何最低提款要求（最低额为零），不需要按月折算（prorate）。

opts.t: The minimum withdrawal is zero in Year 1, but Walter cannot use his spouse's age unless the spouse is also named as the sole joint annuitant on an employer RPP.
opts.w: 错误。RRIF 借用配偶年龄的选举是独立法定的，不需要配偶在雇主 RPP 上成为共同年金领取人。

opts.t: Walter must withdraw at least 10% of the account balance in Year 1, and 20% withholding tax applies automatically to all withdrawals.
opts.w: 错误。RRIF 成立当年没有最低提取额；最低额本身不预扣，只有超过最低额的部分才按阶梯预扣。

checks.pt: 掌握BC省养老金抵免、老年额与股息抵免的独立核算
checks.stem: A retired individual residing in British Columbia is completing Form BC428. How do the BC provincial pension income amount and the BC age amount compare to their federal counterparts for the 2026 tax year?
checks.zh: 一位定居卑诗省（BC）的退休人士正在填写 Form BC428。在 2026 税年，BC 省级养老金收入额和 BC 省级老年额与其联邦对应的项目相比有何特征？

opts.t: Both the BC pension income amount and BC age amount are fixed percentages (50%) of the final calculated federal credit amounts.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省表不是直接按固定比例套用联邦最终抵免结果，两级抵免均有独立的门槛和计算表。

opts.t: The BC pension income amount is indexed annually to $2,000, while the BC age amount stays fixed at $1,000.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省养老金收入额是长青不变的 $1,000（不是 $2,000）；老年额才逐年指数化（2026 年 5,927 元）。

opts.t: BC 428 disallows the pension income amount entirely for individuals who split pension income on federal Form T1032.
opts.w: 错误。BC 428 表自动沿用联邦 T1032 分割结果，并完全允许符合条件的纳税人申报省养老金收入额。

opts.t: The BC pension income amount stays at $1,000, while the BC age amount is indexed by BC's own formula each year.
opts.w: 正确。第四节：BC 428 的养老金收入额省级上限长青 $1,000，与联邦 $2,000 各自计算；老年额按 BC 自己的 CPI 公式逐年指数化，2026 税年 5,927 元。

checks.pt: 理解2007年养老金分割与2006年合资格股息改革沿革
checks.stem: What was the primary historical reason Parliament introduced the pension income splitting regime (Form T1032) in 2007?
checks.zh: 加拿大国会于 2007 年引入退休收入分割制度（Form T1032）的主要历史原因是什么？

opts.t: To fix the inequity where a single-earner retired couple paid more tax than a two-earner couple with the same total income.
opts.w: 正确。在 2007 年之前，若家庭总养老金完全集中在一人名下，在累进税制下会被推至高边际税率档，导致缴税远多于夫妻二人均摊同样总收入的家庭。国会引入 T1032 退休收入分割制度（pension income splitting），正是为了精准解决这种「同等家庭收入却因收入集中而税负不公」的问题。

opts.t: To encourage senior Canadians to liquidate their employer RPP plans and transition entirely into tax-free savings accounts (TFSAs).
opts.w: 错误。TFSA 迟至 2009 年才设立，且退休收入分割并非为了清算 RPP。

opts.t: To allow low-income retirees to transfer unused Old Age Security entitlements to high-earning spouses.
opts.w: 错误。OAS 属于第一层普惠福利，从 2007 年改革之初就被严格排除在 T1032 分割之外。

opts.t: To eliminate the requirement for Canadian financial institutions to issue T4A and T4RIF slips to married annuitants.
opts.w: 错误。税单寄发制度从未废除，T1032 只是在报税表层面的联合转移选择。

checks.pt: 通过四类典型家庭案例综合运用入表、抵免与分割计算
checks.stem: Clara, a tax resident of Canada, received $4,000 in foreign interest from an offshore account, from which $600 in foreign tax was withheld at source. Her Canadian tax payable attributable to this foreign interest under Canadian marginal rates is $900. Under Form T2209 and line 40500, what is Clara's allowable Foreign Tax Credit (FTC)?
checks.zh: 加拿大税务居民克拉拉（Clara）从海外账户收到了 $4,000 的外国利息，并在当地被源泉扣缴了 $600 的外国税。按照加拿大边际税率，该笔外国利息对应的加拿大应缴税额为 $900。根据 Form T2209 和 Line 40500，克拉拉可申报的外国税收抵免（FTC）是多少？

opts.w: 错误。此选项取了加拿大应缴税额。外国税收抵免不能超过实际在境外缴纳的税款，否则等于由加拿大政府倒贴补贴外国税。
正确。根据第六节案例四与 ITA 外国税收抵免（Foreign Tax Credit, FTC）规则，Line 40500 上的抵免额取「外国实缴税额」（$600）与「该笔收入按加拿大税率本应缴纳的税款」（$900）两者中较小的一个。因此，克拉拉可全额抵免实际缴纳的外国税 $600，剩余的 $300 加拿大税额仍需补缴。
错误。此选项将外国实缴税与加拿大税额直接相加（$600 + $900），这完全违背了抵免机制的原理。
错误。此选项用 $900 减去 $600 计算差额。差额 $300 是抵免后克拉拉仍需向加拿大补缴的税款，而不是 Line 40500 上的抵免额本身。

checks.pt: 识别少报未开单利息、拆单避预扣税及假定口头分割等陷阱
checks.stem: During the tax year, Derek earned $38 of total interest across two savings accounts at a Canadian chartered bank. The bank did not issue a T5 slip because the interest was under $50. How should Derek handle this interest when preparing his T1 return?
checks.zh: 在税年内，德里克（Derek）在一家加拿大特许银行的两个储蓄账户共获得了 $38 的利息。由于利息未达到 $50，银行未寄发 T5 凭单。德里克在准备其 T1 报税表时应如何处理这笔利息？

opts.t: He is exempt from reporting it because CRA rules explicitly relieve taxpayers from declaring investment income under $50.
opts.w: 错误。这落入了「有 slip 才用交税」的最常见误解。金融机构 $50 的发单门槛仅是发单规定，绝非纳税人的法定免税或免申报额度。

opts.t: He should report the $38 on line 13000 as miscellaneous non-taxable income for record-keeping purposes only.
opts.w: 错误。利息属于标准的投资收益，必须进 Line 12100 作为应税收入，不能定性为 Line 13000 的免税杂项。

opts.t: He must report the $38 on line 12100, because the duty to report rests on earning it, not on getting a slip.
opts.w: 正确。第七节常见错报清单第六条明确指出，低于 $50 没收到 T5 凭单照样有法定义务申报。所得税法的申报义务基础是「确实赚到了该笔收入」，而不是「是否收到信息单」。德里克必须将这 $38 计入 Line 12100。

opts.t: He can defer reporting the $38 until a subsequent tax year when cumulative interest from the bank exceeds $50.
opts.w: 错误。利息收入必须按发生归属年度如实申报，不得跨年累积递延。

checks.pt: 阐明工伤与社保计入净收入以核定福利的底层逻辑
checks.stem: Why does the Canadian tax system require non-taxable social benefits, such as Workers' Compensation (WCB) and social assistance, to be included in total income to form net income (line 23600) before being fully deducted on line 25000?
checks.zh: 为什么加拿大税收制度要求工伤给付（WCB）和社会援助等免税社会福利，必须先计入总收入形成净收入（Line 23600），然后再通过 Line 25000 全额扣除？

opts.t: To make income-tested benefits see the family's real resources while the relief payments themselves stay tax-free.
opts.w: 正确。根据第一节的制度设计逻辑，净收入（net income, line 23600）承担着双重功能：它既是计税起点，又是几乎所有收入测试型福利（CCB、CGEB、医疗费用门槛等）的核定基数。工伤给付与社会援助先计入总收入形成净收入，能确保福利评估准确反映家庭的真实经济状况；随后在 Line 25000 全额扣除，则确保这笔社会保障金本身不产生任何所得税负。

opts.t: Because tax software requires every entry on a T-slip to generate an equal and offsetting federal surtax calculation.
opts.w: 错误。这是税法制度的顶层政策设计，而非报税软件的技术算法限制。

opts.t: Because Workers' Compensation benefits become fully taxable if the recipient remains unemployed for more than 12 consecutive months.
opts.w: 错误。工伤给付（Workers' Compensation Benefits）根据税法始终属于非应税项目，不存在失业满 12 个月就转为应税的规定。

opts.t: Because provincial governments collect provincial income tax on these payments while federal law exempts them from federal tax.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省等各省个人所得税表完全沿用联邦净收入与应税收入计算，工伤给付与社会援助在省级层面同样不缴税。

checks.pt: 掌握2026年EI回收门槛与赡养费奖学金现行规则
checks.stem: For the 2026 tax year, how do the Employment Insurance (EI) clawback and the Old Age Security (OAS) clawback compare in terms of their statutory net income thresholds, clawback rates, and the types of benefits affected?
checks.zh: 在 2026 税年，就业保险（EI）福利回收与老年保障金（OAS）福利回收在法定净收入门槛、回收比率以及受影响的福利类型方面有何区别？

opts.t: Both programs share an identical threshold of $86,125 and a uniform clawback rate of 25% applied to all government benefits.
opts.w: 错误。两条回收线完全独立，门槛、比率和适用对象各不相同，不存在统一的 $86,125 门槛或 25% 比率。

opts.t: EI: 1.25 × MIE, 30%, regular benefits only; OAS: an indexed threshold, 15%, the OAS pension only.
opts.w: 正确。2026 税年 EI 回收门槛＝1.25 × MIE 68,900 元＝86,125 元，回收率 30%，只影响常规/延长福利；OAS 回收门槛是逐年指数化的 95,323 元，回收率 15%，只影响老年保障金。两条线各算各的。

opts.t: EI clawback applies to all EI benefits including maternity and sickness at 15%, while OAS clawback applies at 30% only to low-income seniors.
opts.w: 错误。此选项颠倒了回收率（EI 为 30%、OAS 为 15%），且产假与病假等特殊福利天然免受 EI 回收规则约束。

opts.t: EI clawback is calculated using final taxable income on line 26000, while OAS clawback is calculated using gross employment earnings.
opts.w: 错误。两项福利回收均是以调整前的净收入（Line 23400）为基础计算，而非应税收入（Line 26000）或工资总额。

checks.pt: 掌握各类税单到T1申报行号的映射与凭证留存规范
checks.stem: When completing a T1 return involving T5007 slips, T4A scholarship slips, and a written support payment agreement, what is the CRA's standard filing procedure regarding documentation and line reporting?
checks.zh: 在完成涉及 T5007 凭单、T4A 奖学金凭单以及书面赡养费协议的 T1 申报时，CRA 关于文件凭单递送与行号申报的标准实务程序是什么？

opts.t: Taxpayers must mail all original T5007 slips, T4A slips, and court agreements to CRA alongside their tax return before the filing deadline.
opts.w: 错误。根据实务流程第三步，T5007、T4A 及法院令等支持文件只需纳税人妥善留存备查，电子或纸质申报时均不需要随表寄出给 CRA。

opts.t: Report each slip on its own lines, such as T5007 on 14400/14500 and 25000, and keep the papers for CRA review.
opts.w: 正确。实务申报规范明确要求：纳税人根据信息单如实填报对应行号（如工伤填 Line 14400 与 Line 25000、奖学金填 Line 13010 等），并保留相关支持文件（T5007、T4A、赡养费协议等）以备 CRA 日后核查，严禁随申报表一并寄出。

opts.t: Taxpayers only need to report support payments if the legal agreement was registered with the provincial family maintenance registry within 30 days.
opts.w: 错误。联邦税法上的赡养费申报义务取决于书面协议成立日期与支付性质，并不以是否在省级抚养维权机构（如 BC FMEP）登记为先决条件。

opts.t: Taxpayers receiving T5007 slips must request a formal tax-exemption certificate from Service Canada prior to filing.
opts.w: 错误。税法直接赋予了 Line 25000 的全额抵扣权利，无需向加拿大服务局（Service Canada）申请任何免税凭单。

checks.pt: 理解BC省福利与联邦净收入锚定及省工伤处理机制
checks.stem: A resident of British Columbia received $12,000 in Workers' Compensation Benefits (WorkSafeBC) in 2026. How does this benefit affect their British Columbia provincial tax liability and provincial income-tested benefits?
checks.zh: 一名卑诗省（BC）居民在 2026 年收到了 $12,000 的工伤给付（由 WorkSafeBC 发放）。这笔款项对其 BC 省级税负以及省级收入测试型福利有何影响？

opts.t: WorkSafeBC benefits generate a separate BC provincial income tax of 5.06%, but have no impact on provincial benefits.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省沿用联邦应税收入（taxable income），Line 25000 扣除后该金额为零，不产生任何省级所得税。

opts.t: WorkSafeBC benefits are exempt from federal tax but subject to BC provincial health care surtaxes on Form BC428.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省没有针对工伤给付的省级健康附加税，该给付在联邦与省两级均免于征税。

opts.t: No BC tax arises after the line 25000 deduction, but the higher net income can reduce BC income-tested benefits.
opts.w: 正确。根据第四节说明，BC 省个人税完全沿用联邦净收入与应税收入核算：工伤给付在 Line 25000 扣除后不产生应税收入和税负；但由于计入了 Line 14400，抬高了联邦净收入（Line 23600），而 BC 省家庭福利（BC Family Benefit）和房客税收抵免等收入测试型福利均锚定该净收入基数，因而可能会导致所领取的 BC 省级福利减少。

opts.t: BC tax law requires WorkSafeBC payments to be deducted from federal net income prior to calculating provincial entitlement thresholds.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省级福利核算直接以联邦 Line 23600 净收入为唯一定准基数，不会在省表层面将其剥离扣除。

checks.pt: 理解1997年子女赡养费改革与退休津贴冻结历史动因
checks.stem: What was the fundamental legislative reason why Parliament amended the Income Tax Act in May 1997 to make child support payments non-deductible by the payer and non-taxable to the recipient?
checks.zh: 1997 年 5 月，加拿大国会修订《所得税法》将子女赡养费改为支付方不可扣除、接收方不课税的根本立法原因是什么？

opts.t: To match the new Child Support Guidelines, which set after-tax amounts from payer income and ended the deduct-and-include shift.
opts.w: 正确。第五节指出，1997 年 5 月生效的《联邦子女抚养准则》（Federal Child Support Guidelines）改由支付方收入直接查表确定税后抚养费金额，彻底摆脱了此前需要预先折算双方边际税率的复杂流程。税法顺势取消了子女赡养费的「扣除/课税」折算机制，改为不可扣除且不课税；而配偶赡养费不适用该准则表，故维持旧口径。

opts.t: To eliminate spousal support deductions entirely from the Canadian personal income tax system.
opts.w: 错误。1997 年改革针对的是子女赡养费（child support），配偶赡养费至今依然保留定期给付可扣除且课税的待遇。

opts.t: To force all divorced parents to purchase registered education savings plans for their dependent children.
opts.w: 错误。税改目的是配合家庭法抚养准则简化税负核算，与 RESP 的购买要求毫无联系。

opts.t: Because the Supreme Court of Canada ruled that provincial courts lacked constitutional jurisdiction to calculate taxable support.
opts.w: 错误。这是联邦国会主动重构家庭法与税法衔接的政策立法，并非最高法院判定省级法院缺乏宪法管辖权。

checks.pt: 掌握工伤退款多行分流与意外之财投资利息归属规则
checks.stem: In 2026, David won $100,000 in a government lottery. He gifted $20,000 to his 15-year-old daughter, who deposited the funds in a high-interest savings account and earned $800 in interest during the year. How should the lottery prize and the interest income be reported for Canadian tax purposes?
checks.zh: 2026 年，大卫（David）中了 100,000 加元的政府彩票。他将其中 20,000 加元赠予其 15 岁的女儿，女儿将钱存入高息储蓄账户并在当年赚取了 800 加元利息。根据加拿大税法，彩票奖金与利息收入应如何列报？

opts.t: The $100,000 lottery prize is taxable on line 13000, while the $800 interest is non-taxable because it was earned by a minor.
opts.w: 错误。彩票奖金属于意外之财（windfall），根本不是收入；而未成年人赚取的利息并不免税。

opts.t: The $100,000 prize is not income, but the $800 interest on money gifted to a minor is attributed to David.
opts.w: 正确。根据案例三及税法通则，彩票中奖属于意外之财，从不进任何收入行，大卫和女儿均无需申报该本金；但用赠款投资产生的收益正常应税，且由于受赠人为未成年子女（未满 18 岁），根据财产归属规则（ITA s.74.1(2)），该 $800 存款利息必须归属到出资赠款的父亲大卫名下列报纳税。

opts.t: The $100,000 lottery prize is excluded from income, and the $800 interest must be reported exclusively on the 15-year-old daughter's tax return.
opts.w: 错误。此选项忽略了向未成年人赠款产生投资收益时的反避税归属规则（attribution rules），未将利息归属回父亲名下。

opts.t: David must report the entire $100,800 on line 13000 as other income.
opts.w: 错误。彩票中奖本金并非应税收入，不得填入 Line 13000。

checks.pt: 排查EI漏报与社保配偶申报归属等常见错报陷阱
checks.stem: According to the self-check list for social assistance reporting, when an individual receives a T5007 slip with an amount in box 11 while cohabiting with a spouse or common-law partner, what is the mandatory reporting rule?
checks.zh: 根据社会援助申报的自查清单，当纳税人在与配偶或普通法伴侣同居期间收到一张 box 11 显示有金额的 T5007 凭单时，法定的申报归属规则是什么？

opts.t: The spouse whose legal name appears on the T5007 slip must always report the amount, regardless of income differences.
opts.w: 错误。这落入了自查清单强调的典型错报陷阱。社会援助的申报义务并不单纯看支票抬头人或 T5007 登记姓名。

opts.t: The partner with the higher net income must report it, not necessarily the person named on the slip.
opts.w: 正确。第七节及 2.2 节自查要点明确规定：领取社会援助（T5007 box 11）期间如果与配偶或普通法伴侣同居，申报义务法定落在当年净收入较高的一方（higher net income spouse）名下，无论支票抬头开给谁；两人净收入相同时才由税单上登记的人申报。

opts.t: The payment must be split 50/50 between both partners using Form T1032.
opts.w: 错误。Form T1032 是合格雇主养老金与 RRIF 的联合分割表，社会援助绝不能通过该表进行五五分割。

opts.t: Neither spouse is required to report the payment because social assistance is completely non-taxable on line 25000.
opts.w: 错误。社会援助必须进入净收入（Line 14500），以确保家庭收入测试型福利核定无误，严禁直接隐形不报。

checks.pt: 两层扣除边界与净收入福利联动机制
checks.stem: Under the six-step structure of the Canadian T1 return, why did Parliament structure social assistance payments (line 14500) to be included in net income on line 23600 and subsequently deducted on line 25000 in Step 4, rather than deducting them in Step 3?
checks.zh: 在加拿大 T1 报税表的六步结构中，为什么国会在制度设计上将社会援助给付（Line 14500）纳入 Line 23600 的净收入计算中、随后才在第 4 步的 Line 25000 中全额扣除，而不是直接在第 3 步扣除？

opts.t: Because line 25000 deductions are subject to provincial income tax surtaxes on Form BC428.
opts.w: 错误。Line 25000 属于联邦应税收入层扣除，BC 省税直接以联邦 Line 26000 应税收入为起算点，不存在所谓省级附加税（surtax）征税的要求。

opts.t: Because social assistance payments are intended to be taxed at provincial progressive rates but exempted from federal tax.
opts.w: 错误。社会援助在联邦和省两级均不纳税，并非仅在联邦免税而在省层面征税。

opts.t: Because social assistance shows the household's real resources for benefit tests, even though it is not meant to be taxed.
opts.w: 正确。第一节制度设计底层逻辑指出，净收入（net income, line 23600）的核心职能是衡量家庭真实可支配的经济能力，并作为绝大多数收入测试型福利（如 CCB、消费税抵免）的核定基数。社会援助给付从税收政策角度不应课税，但确实反映了家庭接受政府救助的经济现状；将其保留在净收入中、再在第 4 步 Line 25000（其他给付扣除，other payments deduction）扣除，既实现了免税，又确保了福利核定基数的真实性。

opts.t: Because T1 tax preparation software is technically unable to process non-taxable slips prior to line 23600.
opts.w: 错误。税收规则是国家法律与税制政策的设计结果，与报税软件的技术架构无关。

checks.pt: 现行指标托儿限额与搬家费扣除标准
checks.stem: In 2026, Fiona contributed $10,000 to her Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), which was fully within her CRA deduction limit. Because her net income was abnormally low due to maternity leave, Fiona deducted only $2,000 on line 20800. What is the mandatory reporting procedure for the remaining $8,000 under CRA rules?
checks.zh: 2026 年，菲奥娜（Fiona）向其注册退休储蓄计划（RRSP）供款 $10,000，该金额完全在其 CRA 扣除限额之内。由于休产假导致其净收入异常偏低，菲奥娜在 Line 20800 仅申报扣除了 $2,000。根据 CRA 规定，对于剩余的 $8,000，法定的申报程序是什么？

opts.t: She must record the $8,000 on Schedule 7 as unused contributions and still report all receipts this year.
opts.w: 正确。第二节 RRSP 规则明确规定，纳税人完全有权选择当年少扣或不扣已供款金额；但即使当年不扣除，CRA 明确要求所有供款收据必须随当年申报一并提交，并在附表 7（Schedule 7）上登记为已供未扣供款（unused RRSP contributions）。如果不申报，该笔款项在税局系统里将不存在，未来任何一年也无法扣除。

opts.t: She is prohibited from carrying forward the $8,000, and the undeducted balance is permanently forfeited.
opts.w: 错误。RRSP 已供未扣款项可以无限期结转并在未来高收入年份扣除，绝不会作废。

opts.t: She must pay a mandatory 1% monthly penalty tax on the undeducted $8,000 until it is fully deducted on line 20800.
opts.w: 错误。只有超过扣除限额加 $2,000 终身超额缓冲的供款才会面临每月 1% 的存量罚税（Part X.1 tax）。菲奥娜的供款在扣除限额之内，完全不属于超额供款。

opts.t: She is legally required to deduct the entire $10,000 in 2026 because the Income Tax Act prohibits voluntary partial deductions.
opts.w: 错误。税法完全允许纳税人根据自身税务规划少扣或不扣 RRSP 供款，不存在强制顶格扣除的规定。

checks.pt: 扣除项配套表格凭证与审核应对要领
checks.stem: Gregory claimed an interprovincial moving expenses deduction on Form T1-M and line 21900. Several months after filing, CRA selected his return for a post-assessment review. Which specific document does CRA frequently require employers to provide regarding moving reimbursements?
checks.zh: 格雷戈里（Gregory）在 Form T1-M 和 Line 21900 上申报了跨省搬家费扣除。报税数月后，CRA 选中其税表进行评税后审核。对于搬家补偿方面，CRA 经常要求提供由雇主出具的哪项特定证明文件？

opts.t: A Form T2200 signed by the employer, stating that the move was a required condition of the job.
opts.w: 错误。Form T2200 是用于雇佣费用（Line 22900）的雇佣条件声明，并非搬家费的专用雇主证明。

opts.t: A letter from the employer stating whether any moving costs were reimbursed or paid as an allowance.
opts.w: 正确。第三节实务流程与凭证要求明确指出，搬家费扣除的高频核查点之一就是雇主补偿情况。CRA 有权要求纳税人提供雇主出具的正式信件（employer confirmation letter），明确说明雇主是否报销了搬家费用或发放了搬迁津贴，以及具体金额。任何已获雇主补偿且未计入收入的金额均须从可扣除费用中扣减。

opts.t: An affidavit from the local real estate board confirming market conditions at the time of the move.
opts.w: 错误。地产局的声明与搬家费扣除的合法凭证无关。

opts.t: A notarized declaration from the moving company confirming that no personal furniture was damaged.
opts.w: 错误。搬家公司的货损记录与税务凭证审核无关。

checks.pt: BC省表衔接机制与跨境扣除差异要点
checks.stem: A taxpayer resident in British Columbia is completing Form BC428. How does the BC provincial tax system integrate federal Step 3 deductions (lines 20700–23500) and Step 4 deductions (lines 24400–25600) into the calculation of provincial income tax payable?
checks.zh: 一位居住在卑诗省（BC）的纳税人正在填写 Form BC428。BC 省个人所得税体系如何将联邦第 3 步扣除（Line 20700–23500）与第 4 步扣除（Line 24400–25600）整合进省应缴税款的计算中？

opts.t: BC disallows all federal Step 4 deductions and requires taxpayers to add them back to provincial income.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省完全认可并沿用联邦第 4 步扣除，不存在将其加回的省税调整。

opts.t: BC requires taxpayers to re-calculate every individual deduction on a separate provincial schedule before entering it on Form BC428.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省并不单独设立一套平行的省扣除附表，而是直接接收联邦结果。

opts.t: BC applies provincial tax directly to federal net income on line 23600, completely bypassing federal taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省税并非从净收入（Line 23600）起算，而是从应税收入（Line 26000）起算。

opts.t: BC has no deduction system of its own; its tax starts from federal line 26000, which already reflects both tiers.
opts.w: 正确。第四节明确指出，BC 省不另设一套个人扣除项体系，省税计算直接从同一个联邦 Line 26000（应税收入，taxable income）起算。这意味着联邦第 3 步和第 4 步的所有合法扣除均已被全盘接收并在计算 BC 省税时生效。

checks.pt: 赡养费双轨历史沿革与托儿费改革历程
checks.stem: Henry pays child support pursuant to a binding court order executed in November 1995 that has never been amended, replaced, or varied. Under Canadian tax history and current 2026 rules, what is the tax treatment of these child support payments for Henry and the recipient?
checks.zh: 亨利（Henry）根据一项于 1995 年 11 月生效且从未经修改、替换或变更的有约束力法院命令支付子女赡养费。根据加拿大税制演变与现行 2026 年规则，该笔子女赡养费对亨利及收款人应如何进行税务处理？

opts.t: Under the rules for pre-May 1997 agreements, Henry deducts the child support and the recipient includes it in income.
opts.w: 正确。第五节历史变革指出，1997 年 5 月 1 日是加拿大赡养费制度的分水岭。此前订立且从未修改过的旧协议至今仍适用旧规则（双轨制），即子女赡养费（child support payments）对付款方可全额扣除、对收款方必须全额计入应税收入。只有 1997 年 4 月之后订立或变更的协议，子女赡养费才转为付方不可扣、收方不计税。

opts.t: All pre-1997 support agreements were automatically terminated by statutory amendment on January 1, 2020.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大法律并未强制废止或统一修改历史旧协议，未修改的旧协议继续受祖父条款保护。

opts.t: Henry cannot deduct child support, but the recipient is legally required to include 50% of it in taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在付方不可扣而收方计入 50% 的折中规定。

opts.t: Grandfathering rules apply only to spousal support, so pre-1997 child support is non-deductible to Henry and non-taxable to the recipient.
opts.w: 错误。祖父条款的核心适用对象正是子女赡养费，旧协议下付款方依然享有扣除权利。

checks.pt: 典型多类扣除家庭实务取舍与最优申报
checks.stem: Jack, an employed professional with an annual salary of $60,000, incurred $5,000 for specialized attendant care required specifically to enable him to work. He obtained all prescribed medical certificates. Jack is evaluating whether to claim this $5,000 on line 21500 (disability supports deduction) or on line 33099 (medical expense tax credit). Why is line 21500 financially more advantageous for Jack?
checks.zh: 杰克（Jack）是一名年薪 $60,000 的在职专业人士。当年他因专门为了支持其正常工作而发生了 $5,000 的合资格特护看护服务支出，并取得了所有规定的医疗诊断证明。杰克正在评估是将这 $5,000 申报在 Line 21500（伤残支持扣除）还是 Line 33099（医疗费抵免）。为什么 Line 21500 对杰克而言在财务上明显更为有利？

opts.t: Because line 21500 provides a 50% refundable credit regardless of the taxpayer's employment status or income.
opts.w: 错误。Line 21500 是一项净收入层税前扣除，并非 50% 的可退还税收抵免。

opts.t: Line 21500 cuts net income, saving tax at his marginal rate with no 3% threshold, and can raise income-tested benefits.
opts.w: 正确。Line 21500 属净收入层扣除：按边际税率省税，不受医疗费抵免「净收入 3% 或 2,890 元封顶」门槛削减；同时压低 Line 23600，可能增加按净收入核定的福利。走 Line 33099 则要先过门槛，抵免率只有 14%，且非退还。

opts.t: Because the medical expense tax credit on line 33099 requires a minimum out-of-pocket expenditure of $10,000 before any credit is granted.
opts.w: 错误。医疗费抵免门槛是净收入的 3% 与 2,890 元（2026 年）两者取小，不是 10,000 元。

opts.t: Because claiming expenses on line 21500 automatically doubles the allowable child care expense limits for the household.
opts.w: 错误。伤残支持扣除与托儿费限额没有自动翻倍的联动机制。

checks.pt: 排查收据SIN遗漏与投资利息误报陷阱
checks.stem: Karen paid $4,500 in cash to an individual caregiver (her neighbour) to care for her 4-year-old daughter while Karen worked. The neighbour provided a signed handwritten receipt detailing the amounts and dates, but refused to provide her Social Insurance Number (SIN). If Karen claims this $4,500 on Form T778 and line 21400, what action will CRA take upon verification?
checks.zh: 凯伦（Karen）向一位个人看护人（其邻居）支付了 $4,500 现金，以便在其工作期间照看其 4 岁的女儿。该邻居提供了一份手写并签字的收据，载明了金额和付款日期，但拒绝提供其社会保险号（SIN）。如果凯伦在 Form T778 和 Line 21400 上申报这笔 $4,500，CRA 在核查时会采取什么行动？

opts.t: CRA will allow the deduction without issue, provided Karen submits bank withdrawal slips confirming cash withdrawals.
opts.w: 错误。银行取款凭单只能证明取出了现金，无法替代含有收款人 SIN 的法规划线收据。

opts.t: CRA will automatically transfer the deduction to Karen's higher-income spouse without requesting additional information.
opts.w: 错误。扣除凭证不合规将导致整笔扣除被驳回，绝不会自动转让给配偶。

opts.t: CRA will deny the claim, since receipts from an individual caregiver must show that person's SIN.
opts.w: 正确。第七节常见错报与核查要点明确提示：托儿费收据如果开具方是个人（如保姆、邻居），收据上必须载有对方的社会保险号（SIN）。这不仅是形式要求，更是 CRA 用于与收款人申报表进行交叉核对的核心依据。收款人拒绝提供 SIN 将直接导致该笔支出在税务上无法获得认可并被税局驳回。

opts.t: CRA will convert the deduction into a provincial child fitness non-refundable tax credit on Form BC428.
opts.w: 错误。托儿费缺乏合规凭证直接被驳回，税局不会将其擅自转为其他省抵免项目。

checks.pt: 抵免法定扣减顺序与后部浪费风险
checks.stem: Under ITA s. 118.92, the Canadian tax system imposes a mandatory statutory ordering for claiming non-refundable tax credits. Why is a taxpayer prohibited from electing to claim charitable donations (Line 34900) first to absorb their federal tax payable and reserving their Basic Personal Amount (Line 30000) to carry forward to future years?
checks.zh: 根据《所得税法》ITA s.118.92，加拿大税制对非退还税收抵免的扣减规定了强制性的法定顺序。为什么纳税人不能选择先申报慈善捐赠抵免（Line 34900）以抵减其联邦应缴税额，而将基本个人金额（Line 30000）保留并结转到未来年度使用？

opts.t: Because the s.118.92 order is mandatory, and the basic personal amount can neither be waived nor carried forward.
opts.w: 正确。第一节制度设计明确指出，ITA s.118.92 规定的各项抵免扣减顺序具有法律强制性，纳税人无权自行变更顺序。基本个人金额（basic personal amount, BPA）必须在最前端强制扣减，既不能放弃不报，多余部分也不能结转到未来年度。慈善捐赠排在极靠后的顺位，最容易在税额被前端抵免冲至零时面临当年浪费（但捐赠额本身依法拥有 5 年结转权利）。

opts.t: Because charitable donations are classified as refundable tax credits that must be disbursed exclusively as direct cash refunds.
opts.w: 错误。慈善捐赠抵免（charitable donations tax credit）属于非退还税收抵免，绝非直接发放现金的可退还税收抵免（refundable tax credit）。

opts.t: Because Schedule 9 requires all charitable donation tax credit receipts to be converted into Registered Retirement Savings Plan contribution room.
opts.w: 错误。附表 9（Schedule 9）用于计算捐赠抵免额，捐赠收据绝不能转为注册退休储蓄计划（RRSP）的供款额度。

opts.t: Because the Basic Personal Amount applies solely to provincial income tax on Form BC428 and has no effect on federal tax payable.
opts.w: 错误。基本个人金额是联邦 T1 主表第五步最核心、排在第一位的联邦非退还抵免项目。

checks.pt: 加拿大就业额受雇限制与免凭证特性
checks.stem: In 2026, Henry operated an unincorporated consulting business as a sole proprietor, earning $45,000 in net self-employment business income, but had no T4 employment earnings. Can Henry claim the Canada employment amount (Line 31260, maximum $1,501 in 2026) on his T1 return?
checks.zh: 2026 年，亨利（Henry）作为个体独资经营者经营一家未成立法人的咨询公司，获得 $45,000 的自雇商业净收入，但没有任何 T4 受雇雇佣收入。亨利能否在其 T1 税表上申报加拿大就业额（Line 31260，2026 年上限为 $1,501）？

opts.t: Yes, because the Canada employment amount is an automatic credit available to all Canadian residents who report any positive net earned income.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大就业额并非对所有有收入者无条件普惠，税法明确限定其计税基数仅限于受雇收入。

opts.t: Yes, provided that Henry files Form T2125 and submits all official client invoices and business expense receipts directly to CRA.
opts.w: 错误。自雇商业收入通过 Form T2125 申报，但这无法使自雇收入转化为加拿大就业额的合资格受雇收入。

opts.t: No, because the Canada employment amount is legally restricted to qualifying employment income and excludes self-employment business income.
opts.w: 正确。第二节第 2.8 小节明确规定，加拿大就业额（Canada employment amount, Line 31260）在 2026 税年的上限为 $1,501，取纳税人受雇收入与该上限的较小者。自雇收入（self-employment business income）被法律明确排除在外，因此纯自雇无 T4 雇佣收入的人士无法享受该项抵免。

opts.t: No, because any taxpayer whose net business income exceeds the 2026 first bracket threshold of $58,523 is automatically disqualified.
opts.w: 错误。亨利无法申报的原因是收入性质不符（自雇而非受雇），而不是因为收入超过门槛；且亨利收入为 $45,000，本身也未超第一档门槛。

checks.pt: 非退还抵免申报凭证与事后抽查纪律
checks.stem: When submitting an electronic T1 return claiming medical expenses, tuition transfers, and home accessibility renovations, what is the CRA administrative requirement regarding supporting receipts, and how should a tax preparer handle them?
checks.zh: 在电子申报包含医疗费、学费转让以及无障碍居家改造的 T1 税表时，CRA 对支持性凭证有何法定要求，报税人应如何处理这些收据？

opts.t: Keep all receipts and certificates for at least six years without sending them, in case CRA reviews the claims.
opts.w: 正确。第三节实务流程与凭证纪律明确指出，这一段的绝大多数非退还抵免在电子申报时不需要附送凭证，属于「先报后查」机制。纳税人必须保留全部收据与证明至少六年备查。若遇到 CRA 事后核查（post-assessment review），通常须在指定的 30 天内补交凭证，逾期不交将直接导致该项抵免被剔除并计征利息。

opts.t: All physical receipts must be certified by a notary public and mailed to the regional CRA tax center within 48 hours of electronic transmission.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 电子申报不需要公证或在 48 小时内寄送实体收据，擅自寄送不会被人工录入甚至会被退回。

opts.t: Taxpayers are legally exempt from retaining any receipts once CRA issues the initial official Notice of Assessment.
opts.w: 错误。收到初次评税通知书（Notice of Assessment, NOA）绝不代表核查结束，CRA 往往在评税后数月展开抽查，凭证必须保留六年。

opts.t: Only receipts exceeding the statutory ceiling of $20,000 must be uploaded through CRA My Account prior to submitting the T1 return.
opts.w: 错误。初次报税时无需主动上传收据，只有在收到 CRA 明确的书面查账补件信时才需上传。

checks.pt: BC省抵免率结构与联邦配偶额差异
checks.stem: A taxpayer residing in British Columbia is completing provincial Form BC428 for the 2026 tax year. How does the BC provincial spouse or common-law partner amount differ structurally from the federal spouse amount?
checks.zh: 一名居住在卑诗省（BC）的纳税人正在编制 2026 税年的省级申报表 Form BC428。BC 省的配偶或同居伴侣额在制度结构上与联邦配偶额有何根本不同？

opts.t: BC matches the federal spouse amount dollar-for-dollar but applies a mandatory 50% high-income surtax deduction on all provincial claims.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省配偶额并不照搬联邦金额，且不存在所谓的 50% 高收入附加税扣减机制。

opts.t: BC sets its own spouse amount, lower than its basic personal amount, which starts to shrink once the spouse has modest income.
opts.w: 正确。第四节：联邦配偶额上限等于 BPA（16,452 元），从配偶净收入第一元起逐元递减；BC 2026 年配偶额是独立值 11,317 元（低于 BC 基本个人金额 13,216 元），配偶净收入超过 1,132 元后才逐元递减。

opts.t: BC completely disallows spouse amounts for all married residents, replacing the credit with an automatic provincial family bonus.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省税表 BC428 保留了明确的配偶额抵免行，绝没有废除该项抵免。

opts.t: BC applies the exact federal phase-out curve between $181,440 and $258,482 to calculate provincial spouse credit entitlements.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省基本个人金额和配偶额均没有联邦那套针对申报人高收入（$181,440 至 $258,482）的线性递减机制。

checks.pt: 废止抵免历史追溯与结转额后续处理
checks.stem: A taxpayer paid $400 annually from 2022 through 2026 for a qualifying Canadian digital news subscription, but never claimed the digital news subscription tax credit on past returns. How can this taxpayer claim tax relief under current CRA rules?
checks.zh: 一名纳税人自 2022 年至 2026 年每年支付 $400 订阅合资格的加拿大数字新闻服务，但过去从未在报税表上申报过该项抵免。根据现行税法，该纳税人目前应如何申请税收减免？

opts.t: The taxpayer can combine all five years of subscriptions ($2,000) and claim them in full on line 31350 of the 2026 tax return.
opts.w: 错误。数字新闻订阅抵免在 2026 税年已经废止不可申报，且该抵免原本就有每年 $500 的法定上限，绝不能跨年合并申报。

opts.t: The taxpayer can transfer the expired subscription credits directly to an eligible dependant's Schedule 11 to offset tuition tax liability.
opts.w: 错误。新闻订阅抵免属于个人专项抵免，从未允许转让给受抚养人，更不能转入附表 11（Schedule 11）充当学费。

opts.t: The taxpayer has permanently lost all past tax benefits because the repeal of a tax credit extinguishes all prior-year amendment rights.
opts.w: 错误。税法项目的废止只针对生效日之后的税年，纳税人对法定追溯期内（存续期 2020–2024 年）未报的合资格支出依然享有更正申报权利。

opts.t: It cannot be claimed for 2026, but T1 adjustments can still recover it for the unclaimed 2022 to 2024 years.
opts.w: 正确。第五节及第二节第 2.11 小节指出，数字新闻订阅抵免（digital news subscription tax credit）存续期为 2020 至 2024 税年（上限每年 $500），2025 及以后税年已不可申报。但在 2020–2024 年期间发生的未报合资格支出，仍可通过向 CRA 提交更正申报（T1 Adjustment）进行追溯补报，这是历史废止项目在实务中的真实出口。

checks.pt: 老年额净收入超额递减与归零测算
checks.stem: In 2026, Eleanor turned 67 years of age and had a net income of $66,432. Under the 2026 federal rules, what is Eleanor's allowable age amount on line 30100 (statutory maximum base $9,208; phase-out threshold $46,432 with a 15% reduction rate)?
checks.zh: 2026 年，埃莉诺（Eleanor）年满 67 岁，全年净收入为 $66,432。根据 2026 税年联邦规则，埃莉诺在 Line 30100 处可申报的老年额是多少（法定最高基准额 $9,208；递减门槛 $46,432，超额部分按 15% 递减）？

opts.t: $6,208, calculated as the $9,208 maximum base minus 15% of the $20,000 net income exceeding the $46,432 threshold.
opts.w: 正确。第六节与第 2.5 小节明确了老年额（age amount, Line 30100）的测算机制：2026 税年年满 65 岁人士的最高额度为 $9,208，净收入超过 $46,432 的部分按 15% 递减。埃莉诺净收入超出下限金额为 $66,432 − $46,432 ＝ $20,000；递减削减额为 $20,000 × 15% ＝ $3,000；因此最终可申报老年额为 $9,208 − $3,000 ＝ $6,208。

opts.t: $9,208, because the age amount is a universal fixed entitlement for all resident Canadian seniors regardless of income.
opts.w: 错误。老年额不是无条件全额发放的普惠抵免，它具有明确的高收入按 15% 递减规则（相较之下，约在 $107,819 以上归零）。

opts.t: $5,790, calculated by subtracting the $3,000 reduction from the historical 2024 base amount of $8,790.
opts.w: 错误。此选项误用了考试口径中 2024 税年的历史基准金额 $8,790，落入了过时数字陷阱。

opts.t: $0, because earning net income over the 2026 first bracket threshold of $58,523 results in an immediate and total clawback.
opts.w: 错误。老年额并非在超过第一档税阶时一次性归零，而是按超出门槛部分的 15% 线性平缓递减，净收入达到约 $107,819 时才会完全归零。

checks.pt: 志愿消防搜救额免税津贴互斥核查
checks.stem: In 2026, David completed 240 hours of qualifying volunteer firefighting service for his rural municipality and received a $1,000 tax-exempt municipal volunteer allowance that was excluded from his T4 income. How should David report this service on his 2026 federal tax return?
checks.zh: 2026 年，大卫（David）为其乡村市镇完成了 240 小时的合资格志愿消防服务，并获得了 $1,000 的免税市镇志愿者津贴（该津贴未计入其 T4 收入）。大卫在其 2026 年联邦报税表上应如何申报此项服务？

opts.t: David can claim the full $6,000 volunteer firefighters amount on line 31220 and retain the $1,000 tax-exempt allowance without any reduction.
opts.w: 错误。税法明确规定志愿者额与免税补贴严格互斥，不能在享受免税补贴的同时全额享受 $6,000 抵免。

opts.t: David must claim both the $6,000 volunteer firefighters amount and the $6,000 search and rescue amount because his service exceeded 200 hours.
opts.w: 错误。志愿消防员额与搜救志愿者额两项只能二选一，即使两个机构都参与或时数充足也绝不能兼得。

opts.t: David cannot claim the $6,000 volunteer firefighters amount on line 31220 if he retains the $1,000 tax-exempt allowance for the same volunteer duties.
opts.w: 正确。第七节错报清单与第 2.10 节明确指出，志愿消防员额（volunteer firefighters amount, Line 31220）和搜救志愿者额（Line 31240）均为 $6,000，申请门槛为当年完成至少 200 小时合格服务。但税法严格规定：两项抵免只能二选一；且纳税人如果就同一批服务领取了不超过 $1,000 的免税应急服务津贴（tax-exempt allowance），则不能再申报这 $6,000 的抵免额。纳税人必须在「享受免税津贴」与「申报 $6,000 抵免」之间二选一（若选择申报抵免，须将津贴并入应税收入）。

opts.t: David can claim an adjusted tax credit of $5,000 on line 31220 by subtracting the $1,000 cash allowance directly from the statutory base.
opts.w: 错误。税法规则是二选一的法定排他机制，不存在直接从 $6,000 抵免额中扣减 $1,000 差额后申报 $5,000 的混合折中处理方式。

checks.pt: 解释抵免非扣除逻辑与门槛取小适当百分比机制
checks.stem: Under the Income Tax Act, why does the formula for the medical expense tax credit (METC) deduct the 'lesser' rather than the 'greater' of 3% of net income and the annual dollar cap?
checks.zh: 根据《所得税法》，为什么医疗费用税收抵免（METC）的公式中规定扣除净收入的 3% 与年度法定封顶值中「较小（lesser）」的数额，而不是较大者？

opts.t: To keep the threshold low for low-income filers while capping it so high earners are not shut out.
opts.w: 正确。「取小」让低收入者按净收入 3% 得到更低的门槛，同时用法定封顶值（2026 年 2,890 元）挡住高收入者门槛无限攀升。

opts.t: To convert the non-refundable tax credit into a progressive tax deduction for middle-income earners.
opts.w: 错误。医疗费用属于非退还税收抵免（non-refundable tax credit），其抵免率在所有纳税人之间是平等的，并不改变其抵免本质为扣除（deduction）。

opts.t: To completely eliminate the threshold requirement for any taxpayer whose income exceeds the national median.
opts.w: 错误。高收入者依然需要扣除法定封顶值门槛，并未被免除门槛要求。

opts.t: To ensure that total medical expense claims are capped at exactly 3% of the taxpayer's total taxable income.
opts.w: 错误。3% 是扣除门槛而非申报金额上限，超过门槛的部分全部可以申报。

checks.pt: 解析2026现行门槛封顶值捐赠降税费率与退税补助
checks.stem: In the 2026 tax year, a taxpayer with a net income of $120,000 paid $5,000 in eligible medical expenses for themselves. Given the 2026 statutory threshold cap of $2,890, what is the eligible medical expense amount that can be converted into a non-refundable tax credit on line 33099?
checks.zh: 在 2026 税年，一位净收入为 $120,000 的纳税人为自己支付了 $5,000 合资格医疗费用。已知 2026 年法定门槛封顶值为 $2,890，该纳税人可在 line 33099 用于折算非退还税收抵免的合资格医疗费用金额是多少？

opts.t: $1,400, calculated as $5,000 minus 3% of net income ($3,600).
opts.w: 错误。此选项误按净收入 3%（$3,600）扣减门槛，掉入了「取大」陷阱。净收入超约 $96,333 时门槛锁定在法定封顶值 $2,890。

opts.t: $5,000, because taxpayers earning over $96,333 are exempt from the medical threshold deduction.
opts.w: 错误。税法并未免除高收入者的门槛，必须先扣除法定封顶值 $2,890。

opts.t: $2,110, calculated as $5,000 minus the statutory capped threshold of $2,890.
$2,241, calculated using the outdated 2024 threshold of $2,759.
opts.w: 错误。此选项使用了 2024 税年的历史封顶值 $2,759，而非 2026 税年生效的 $2,890。

checks.pt: 掌握任意12个月窗口选择受抚养人分流与对价扣减
checks.stem: A taxpayer drove 95 kilometres each way to take their spouse to a specialized cancer treatment clinic in Canada, paying $3,000 in eligible treatments. Which additional travel expenses can the taxpayer claim under the medical expense provisions?
checks.zh: 一位纳税人单程驾车 95 公里护送配偶前往加拿大境内的一家专科癌症诊所就医，支付了 $3,000 合资格治疗费。根据医疗费用抵免规定，该纳税人还可以额外申报哪些差旅费用？

opts.t: Only public transit or private vehicle mileage costs, because claiming meals and lodging requires travel of at least 150 kilometres.
opts.w: 错误。单程达到 80 公里即可申报住宿与餐饮，无需达到 150 公里。

opts.t: Mileage or transit, plus reasonable lodging, meals and parking, as the one-way trip meets the 80 km test.
opts.w: 正确。根据医疗差旅费用规定，单程达到 40 公里可报交通或自驾里程费；单程达到 80 公里可进一步加报住宿、餐饮和停车费。95 公里已达到 80 公里门槛。

opts.t: No travel expenses are eligible because medical travel within Canada is excluded from line 33099.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大境内符合里程门槛的就医差旅完全属于合法报销范围。

opts.t: Only accommodation expenses, because meal expenses require a formal referral letter from Health Canada.
opts.w: 错误。单程达 80 公里餐饮费即可申报（可选详细法或简化法定额），并不需要卫生部的专门信件。

checks.pt: 对比BC省捐赠首段升至5.6%与农产品叠加抵免
checks.stem: A British Columbia resident who operates a commercial farm donates $2,000 worth of eligible fresh agricultural produce directly to a registered local food bank in 2026. What unique provincial tax incentive is available to this farmer in BC?
checks.zh: 2026 年，一位经营商业农场的 BC 省居民将价值 $2,000 的合资格新鲜农产品直接捐赠给本地注册食物银行。在 BC 省，该农户可以享受哪项独特的省级税收优惠？

opts.t: A 100% full tax deduction against agricultural gross revenue that replaces all charitable tax credits.
opts.w: 错误。农产品捐赠抵免是税收抵免而非收入扣除，且不取代普通慈善捐赠抵免。

opts.t: An exemption from filing provincial personal income tax returns for the subsequent three years.
opts.w: 错误。税法不存在免除申报个人税的优惠。

opts.t: A non-refundable BC provincial tax credit equal to 50% of the produce value that cannot be combined with federal credits.
opts.w: 错误。BC 农产品捐赠抵免比例为 25% 而非 50%，且允许与普通慈善捐赠抵免叠加申报。

opts.t: A 25% BC farmers' food donation tax credit that can be claimed in addition to the regular charitable donation tax credit.
opts.w: 正确。BC 省独有农产品捐赠抵免（BC Farmers' Food Donation Tax Credit），符合资格的农户向食物银行捐赠农产品，可享受合资格金额 25% 的省级税收抵免，且可与普通慈善捐赠抵免叠加申报（BC Budget 2026 已将该政策永久化）。

checks.pt: 梳理2026禁双报HATC与降税联动适当百分比历史
checks.stem: Which of the following personal income tax credit changes was newly enacted and became effective starting in the 2026 tax year?
checks.zh: 下列哪项关于个人所得税抵免的变动是在 2026 税年新设立并正式生效的？

opts.t: The carryforward duration for standard charitable donation amounts was reduced from 5 years to 3 years.
opts.w: 错误。普通慈善捐赠额度的结转年限长青保持为 5 年未变。

opts.t: A qualifying home accessibility renovation expense can no longer be claimed simultaneously under both HATC and METC.
opts.w: 正确。此前十余年合资格家居无障碍改造支出可同时进 HATC 和 METC，但从 2026 税年起，预算实施法正式取消了这一双重申报机制，纳税人对同一笔支出只能二选一。

opts.t: The medical expense net income threshold was permanently raised from 3% to 4%.
opts.w: 错误。医疗费用 3% 的净收入比例门槛长青未变。

opts.t: The capital gains inclusion rate on listed securities donated to registered charities was increased from 0% to 25%.
opts.w: 错误。捐赠已上市证券的资本利得纳入率长青保持为零（0%）。

checks.pt: 解析双职工跨年合报捐证券与自雇退还补助实务
checks.stem: In 2026, a Canadian tax resident sent $3,000 directly via international wire transfer to their elderly grandparents overseas to assist with living expenses. How should this wire transfer be reported on the Canadian T1 return?
checks.zh: 2026 年，一位加拿大税务居民通过国际电汇直接向其海外年迈祖父母汇款 $3,000 以补贴生活费。这笔电汇款项应如何在加拿大 T1 申报表上申报？

opts.t: Neither line applies: support sent to relatives abroad is not a gift to a qualified donee or an eligible medical expense.
opts.w: 正确。给海外亲属汇款属于私人家庭赡养支出，海外亲属个人不是 CRA 注册慈善机构或其他合格受赠人（qualified donee），不能申报慈善捐赠；同时该笔款项属于普遍生活补贴而非合格医疗支出清单项目且亲属为非居民，不能申报医疗抵免。

opts.t: It can be claimed as a charitable donation on line 34900 under the international family humanitarian gift exemption.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大税法不存在所谓的国际家庭人道主义捐赠豁免，未向合格受赠人捐赠不得申报 line 34900。

opts.t: It qualifies for the standard 14% lowest-tier charitable donation credit provided bank wire transfer receipts are attached.
opts.w: 错误。银行电汇凭证仅证明资金转移，并非合格受赠人出具的法定正式捐赠收据。

opts.t: It is 100% tax-deductible as an overseas alimony and maintenance support payment on line 22000.
opts.w: 错误。自愿资助父母或祖父母的生活费不属于法定分居或离婚赡养费（support payments），不能在 line 22000 扣除。

checks.pt: 排查门槛取大惯性双报旧口径与证券变现错报雷区
checks.stem: A taxpayer donates $600 to a registered charity's annual benefit dinner and receives a banquet ticket with an established fair market value of $50. How does the de minimis rule apply to this donation receipt?
checks.zh: 一位纳税人向某注册慈善机构的年度慈善晚宴捐赠了 $600，并收到一张公允市值为 $50 的宴会门票。微量对价豁免规则（de minimis rule）如何适用于这张捐赠收据？

opts.t: The de minimis threshold is exceeded, so the charity must issue a receipt for the net amount of $550.
opts.w: 错误。微量对价门槛为 $75 或捐赠市值 10%（$600 × 10% = $60）中较小者，即 $60。门票市值 $50 未超过 $60，符合微量豁免条件。

opts.t: The receipt must be issued for $0 because receiving any banquet advantage completely invalidates charitable intent.
opts.w: 错误。对价扣减（split receipting）仅扣减回报市值，绝不导致整笔捐赠收据作废。

opts.t: The $50 does not exceed the lesser of $75 and 10% of the gift ($60), so a full $600 receipt is issued.
opts.w: 正确。根据微量豁免规则（de minimis rule），纳税人换回的回报（advantage）公允市值若不超过 $75 或捐款金额 10% 两者中较小者（本例为 min($75, $60) = $60），该对价可忽略不计，慈善机构可按 $600 全额开具捐赠收据。

opts.t: The taxpayer must report the $50 banquet dinner as taxable employment income on line 10100.
opts.w: 错误。慈善晚宴门票不是雇员福利，与受雇收入无关。

checks.pt: 阐明三层资金分流与夫妻双报自动续期因果链
checks.stem: A lower-income individual with zero taxable income and zero tax payable qualifies for several tax provisions. Which of the following amounts will result in a direct cash refund to the individual when filing Form T1?
checks.zh: 一位应税收入与应缴税额均为零的低收入纳税人符合多项税收规定。在申报 T1 税表时，下列哪项金额能够为该纳税人带来直接的现金退税？

opts.t: Non-refundable basic personal amount tax credit on line 30000.
opts.w: 错误。line 30000 属于非退还税收抵免（non-refundable tax credit），应缴税额已为零时无法产生现金退税。

opts.t: Refundable Canada Workers Benefit on line 45300.
opts.w: 正确。line 45300 加拿大工作福利（Canada Workers Benefit, CWB）属于退还性抵免（refundable tax credit），写在 T1 第六步，即使纳税人应缴税额为零，超出部分仍以现金全额退还。

opts.t: Medical expense tax credit on line 33099.
opts.w: 错误。line 33099 为非退还性医疗费用税收抵免，不能压出负税额退税（退还性医疗费用补助在 line 45200）。

opts.t: Tuition tax credit transferred from a spouse on line 32400.
opts.w: 错误。配偶转让的学费抵免属于非退还性税收抵免，无法退还现金。

checks.pt: 解析2026CGEB更名增额与CWB门槛数字
checks.stem: Effective July 2026 under federal legislation (Bill C-19), how was the federal GST/HST credit restructured?
checks.zh: 根据联邦 C-19 法案，自 2026 年 7 月起，联邦 GST/HST 抵免进行了何种重组与调整？

opts.t: It was converted into a non-refundable tax credit reported on Step 5 of the T1 tax return.
opts.w: 错误。该福利依然不上表、按季免税发放，并未转变为第五步的非退还税收抵免。

opts.t: It was permanently terminated and replaced by an expanded Canada Child Benefit supplement.
opts.w: 错误。该项福利并未永久终止，而是更名扩容。

opts.t: It was renamed the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit, with amounts up 25% and the same formula.
opts.w: 正确。2026 年 7 月起原 GST/HST 抵免更名为加拿大杂货与必需品福利（CGEB），增额 25%（成人上限 445 元，上一期为 349 元），资格与计算公式不变。

opts.t: It was restructured to require mandatory receipts for all annual grocery and essential item purchases.
opts.w: 错误。CGEB 仍按调整后家庭净收入自动核算发放，不需要纳税人收集或提供杂货购物收据。

checks.pt: 掌握福利年时间轴错位与分居九十天填表规则
checks.stem: A taxpayer legally separated from their spouse on February 10. According to CRA administrative rules, when should the taxpayer submit Form RC65 (Marital Status Change) to update their marital status for child and family benefits?
checks.zh: 一位纳税人于 2 月 10 日与配偶正式分居。根据 CRA 的行政规定，该纳税人应当在何时提交表格 RC65（婚姻状况变更）以更新其申领儿童与家庭福利的婚姻状态？

opts.t: Immediately on the day of physical separation, February 10.
opts.w: 错误。若分居未满 90 天即提交 RC65，税局不予受理并会被退回重来。

opts.t: Only after 90 days apart, with the separation then dated back to February 10.
opts.w: 正确。税法对分居设立了「90 天规则」（90-day rule）：纳税人必须持续分居满 90 天后才能提交 RC65，满 90 天后分居生效日将回溯认定至实际分居的首日（即 2 月 10 日）。

opts.t: Exactly on December 31 of the tax year during annual T1 return preparation.
opts.w: 错误。婚姻状况改变属于重要家庭变故，须在满 90 天后及时告知税局重新核定月度福利，而非拖到年底。

opts.t: Within 30 days of receiving a formal final divorce decree issued by a provincial court.
opts.w: 错误。税法认定的分居无须等待法院正式离婚判决书，只需事实分居满 90 天即可申报。

checks.pt: 辨析CWB三省重配协议与BC省终止气候抵免
checks.stem: A tax preparer is calculating the Canada Workers Benefit (CWB) for a low-income worker. In which of the following jurisdictions would applying the standard federal Schedule 6 phase-in and phase-out thresholds produce an incorrect calculation due to a provincial reconfiguration agreement?
checks.zh: 报税员正在为一位低收入劳动者计算加拿大工作福利（CWB）。由于存在省级重配协议，在下列哪一个省份或地区直接套用联邦通则附表 6 的门槛与金额会导致计算错误？

opts.t: Ontario
opts.w: 错误。安大略省执行联邦通则附表 6 计算规则。

opts.t: British Columbia
opts.w: 错误。BC 省执行联邦通则附表 6 计算规则。

opts.t: Alberta
opts.w: 正确。艾伯塔省（Alberta）、魁北克省（Quebec）和努纳武特地区（Nunavut）与联邦政府签署了工作福利重配协议（reconfiguration agreement），其基本额上限、递减起点与归零线均自成一套，套用联邦通则必错。

opts.t: Nova Scotia
opts.w: 错误。新斯科舍省执行联邦通则附表 6 计算规则。

checks.pt: 梳理UCCB到CCB及碳税返还终止的演进脉络
checks.stem: In July 2016, the federal government replaced the former Universal Child Care Benefit (UCCB) with the Canada Child Benefit (CCB). What was the fundamental structural shift represented by this reform?
checks.zh: 2016 年 7 月，联邦政府用加拿大儿童福利金（CCB）取代了原先的全民托儿福利（UCCB）。这项改革代表了什么根本性的制度转变？

opts.t: From an income-tested non-refundable tax credit to a flat-rate taxable universal benefit.
opts.w: 错误。改革方向恰恰相反，是由人人有份且课税转向按收入定向且免税。

opts.t: From a universal taxable payment reported on line 11700 to an income-tested, completely tax-free monthly benefit.
opts.w: 正确。2016 年 7 月改革的关键转变是从原 UCCB 的「人人有份、计入应税收入（line 11700）」转变为 CCB 的「按家庭净收入精准定向递减、完全免税（tax-free）」的现代化福利机制。

opts.t: From an employer-sponsored child care rebate to an annual voucher system administered by provincial schools.
opts.w: 错误。UCCB 与 CCB 均为联邦政府直接发放给监护人的现金给付，与雇主或学校凭证无关。

opts.t: From a quarterly GST supplement to a one-time lump-sum grant issued upon primary school graduation.
opts.w: 错误。CCB 是按月发放的未成年子女照料津贴，而非 GST 补充或一次性毕业补助。

checks.pt: 剖析双职工两孩家庭CCB两级门槛分段递减计算
checks.stem: A married couple in Vancouver has two children aged 3 and 7. For the 2025 base tax year, their combined adjusted family net income (AFNI) was $36,000. Based on the 2026-2027 benefit year rules (first threshold of $38,237; maximums of $8,157 for under age 6 and $6,883 for ages 6 to 17), what is their total annual Canada Child Benefit (CCB)?
checks.zh: 温哥华的一对夫妻育有两名子女，年龄分别为 3 岁和 7 岁。2025 基准税年两人的合计调整后家庭净收入（AFNI）为 $36,000。依据 2026-2027 福利年现行规则（第一递减门槛 $38,237；6 岁以下每年上限 $8,157，6 至 17 岁每年上限 $6,883），该家庭全年的加拿大儿童福利金（CCB）总额是多少？

opts.t: $13,468, because the older child is phased out when total family income exceeds $35,000.
opts.w: 错误。两名子女均符合申领条件，且收入未超门槛不发生扣减。

opts.t: $15,040, the full amounts for both children, as their AFNI is under the $38,237 first threshold.
opts.w: 正确。该家庭 AFNI 为 $36,000，严格低于 2026-2027 福利年的第一递减门槛 $38,237，因此不发生任何递减，全额领取两名子女的上限：$8,157 + $6,883 = $15,040。

opts.t: $14,743, calculated by deducting 13.5% of total AFNI from the maximum child benefit amount.
opts.w: 错误。13.5% 的递减比率仅适用于 AFNI 超出第一门槛的部分，在未超出第一门槛时不适用递减。

opts.t: $8,157, because only one child per household is eligible for the maximum benefit rate.
opts.w: 错误。家庭中有几名合格子女即可按对应年龄上限叠加计算，不存在每户仅限一人的限制。

checks.pt: 核查分期自缴漏填与销售退税次年计入收入
checks.stem: In 2025, an eligible employee filed Form GST370 and received an employee GST/HST rebate of $420 on line 45700 of their T1 return. When preparing their subsequent personal income tax return for 2026, how must this $420 rebate be treated?
checks.zh: 2025 年，一位合资格雇员提交了表格 GST370，并在其 T1 税表的 line 45700 获得了 $420 的雇员 GST/HST 退税。在编制其接下来的 2026 年度个人所得税申报表时，该笔 $420 的退税款应当如何处理？

opts.t: It is completely tax-exempt and never reported on any future tax return.
opts.w: 错误。此选项掉入了免税陷阱。该退税是对先前已在就业支出中全额扣除之销售税的返还，因此在收到年度必须纳税。

opts.t: It must be deducted from the basic personal amount claimed on line 30000.
opts.w: 错误。该退税款不影响基本个人额（line 30000）的计算。

opts.t: Include it as other employment income on line 10400 in the year it is received.
opts.w: 正确。根据税法规定，雇员收到的 GST/HST 退税（line 45700）必须在其收到的那一税年计入 line 10400（其他就业收入，other employment income）。若次年漏填即构成漏报收入。

opts.t: It must be refunded to the employer to offset payroll CPP and EI remittances.
opts.w: 错误。该款项属于个人退税，无须上缴雇员雇主冲抵工资税。

checks.pt: 阐明学费先自用后转让的立法折中与单向门设计
checks.stem: A full-time university student with modest part-time earnings generated a small federal tax liability of $300 in the tax year. The student paid $6,000 in eligible tuition. Under Canadian income tax principles, what governs the allocation of the student's current-year tuition tax credit on Schedule 11?
checks.zh: 一名全日制大学生在税年内有少量兼职收入，产生了 $300 的联邦税额。该学生当年支付了 $6,000 的合格学费。根据加拿大所得税制度设计原则，哪项规则统领该学生在附表 11 上对当年学费抵免额的分配？

opts.t: The student may freely bypass their own tax liability and transfer the entire $5,000 maximum tuition amount directly to a supporting parent.
opts.w: 错误。此选项违背了自用优先原则。税法不允许学生跳过自身税额直接全额转让学费抵免。

opts.t: The student must first use the credit to bring their own federal tax payable to zero; only the rest may be transferred or carried forward.
opts.w: 正确。学费税收抵免（tuition tax credit）在立法设计上以学生本人为首要抵免主体，纳税人必须首先使用当年学费额将自身联邦应纳税额抵减至零，剩余部分方可选择转让或结转。

opts.t: The student must carry forward all unused tuition credits until post-secondary graduation before any transfer to family members is permitted.
opts.w: 错误。税法并未要求必须等到毕业后才能转让，只要当年有扣减自用后的剩余额度即可在当年报税时决定转让。

opts.t: The tuition tax credit is converted into an automatic refundable cash transfer deposited into the student's bank account regardless of tax payable.
opts.w: 错误。学费抵免属于非退还税收抵免（non-refundable tax credit），无法直接作为现金全额退还。

checks.pt: 掌握培训抵免限额累积与学费半数取小的申领公式
checks.stem: An eligible 32-year-old worker with a Canada training credit limit (CTCL) of $1,250 on their 2025 Notice of Assessment incurs $2,000 in eligible tuition fees at an eligible educational institution in 2026. What is the maximum Canada Training Credit the worker can claim on line 45350 of their 2026 T1 return?
checks.zh: 一位符合资格的 32 岁劳动者在其 2025 年评税通知书（NOA）上显示有 $1,250 的加拿大培训抵免限额（CTCL），2026 年在合格教育机构支付了 $2,000 的合格学费。该劳动者在 2026 年 T1 税表 line 45350 最多可申领多少加拿大培训抵免（CTC）？

opts.t: $500, which represents the standard annual accumulation increment for training credits.
opts.w: 错误。CTC 每年累积增量为 $250 而非 $500，且实际申领金额按 CTCL 与学费 50% 测算。

opts.t: $1,000, which is the lesser of the worker's CTCL balance ($1,250) and 50% of the eligible tuition fees ($1,000).
opts.w: 正确。根据加拿大培训抵免（Canada Training Credit, CTC）规则，实际申领金额为上一税年评税通知书上的培训抵免限额（CTCL，$1,250）与当年合资格学费 50%（$2,000 × 50% = $1,000）两者中较小者，因此在 line 45350 可申报 $1,000。

opts.t: $1,250, because taxpayers are always entitled to withdraw their full accumulated CTCL balance.
opts.w: 错误。申领金额受合格学费 50%（$1,000）的封顶限制，不能直接申领全部 CTCL 余额。

opts.t: $2,000, because the Canada Training Credit fully refunds 100% of tuition fees paid by adult workers.
opts.w: 错误。CTC 仅能对合格学费的 50% 进行抵免，而非 100% 全额覆盖。

checks.pt: 理清凭T2202官方凭证填报与转让结转实务路径
checks.stem: A college student paid $5,400 in tuition during 2026 but misplaced their institutional login credentials and cannot retrieve Form T2202 before the April 30 filing deadline. How should the preparer handle the tuition tax credit claim on Schedule 11?
checks.zh: 一名大专学生在 2026 年支付了 $5,400 学费，但在 4 月 30 日报税截止日前遗失了学校登录凭据，无法获取表格 T2202。报税员应当如何在附表 11 上处理该笔学费税收抵免申报？

opts.t: Claim the tuition amount using credit card statements and receipt copies, as CRA allows commercial payment slips in lieu of tax slips.
opts.w: 错误。银行对账单或支付凭据不能替代官方 T2202 证明书，私自填报会导致系统核对差异。

opts.t: Enter an estimated tuition amount on Schedule 11 and adjust the figure via a subsequent T1-ADJ after receiving the slip.
opts.w: 错误。实务流程中严禁自行估算学费金额申报，无正式凭证不应上表。

opts.t: Ask the registrar to reissue the official T2202 before claiming, since CRA matches the institution's own filing.
opts.w: 正确。实务申报学费税收抵免严格以教育机构出具的 T2202（学费与注册证明，Tuition and Enrolment Certificate）为法定依据；教育机构会同步向 CRA 报送数据，缺少 T2202 时必须联系学校补开，切勿自行估算填报。

opts.t: Claim the tuition as moving expenses on line 21900 to circumvent the requirement for educational tax certificates.
opts.w: 错误。学费不能混淆为搬家费申报，此举属于严重错报。

checks.pt: 明确BC省取消教育额保留学费额与教育储蓄千二补助
checks.stem: A student attending a post-secondary institution in British Columbia reviews their provincial tax calculation on Form BC428. Which of the following correctly describes the provincial education credits available in BC?
checks.zh: 一名在不列颠哥伦比亚省就读大专院校的学生在表 BC428 上查看其省税核算。下列哪项正确描述了 BC 省现行的省级教育类税收抵免？

opts.t: BC maintains a provincial tuition tax credit parallel to the federal rules, but eliminated the provincial education amount in 2019.
opts.w: 正确。BC 省走的是第三种省税模式：表 BC428 保留了与联邦平行的省级学费抵免（provincial tuition tax credit），但省级教育额（education amount）已于 2019 年正式取消，仅保留 2018 年及以前年度结转下来的旧教育额。

opts.t: BC completely eliminated both provincial tuition credits and provincial education amounts, exactly like Ontario and Alberta.
opts.w: 错误。安省、阿省完全取消了省级学费和教育额，而 BC 省保留了学费抵免，仅取消了教育额。

opts.t: BC provides a full monthly provincial education amount and exam amount of $400 per full-time study month.
opts.w: 错误。BC 省教育额已于 2019 年取消，不再按月提供新的教育额抵免。

opts.t: BC replaces provincial tuition credits with an automatic provincial student loan interest deduction on line 31900.
opts.w: 错误。line 31900 属于学生贷款利息抵免，与学费抵免属于完全不同的税目。

checks.pt: 把握联邦教育额取消历史与RESP初期提取限额调整
checks.stem: Students could once claim federal education and textbook amounts in addition to tuition fees. In which tax year were the federal education and textbook amounts eliminated?
checks.zh: 学生过去除了学费额，还能申报联邦教育额与教科书额。联邦教育额与教科书额是从哪一个税年起取消的？

opts.t: The 2017 tax year; since then only tuition can be claimed, apart from pre-2017 carried-forward amounts.
opts.w: 正确。联邦教育额与教科书额已于 2017 税年取消，此后学生只能申报学费额本身；2016 及以前年度结转下来的旧教育／教科书额仍可继续使用直到用完。

opts.t: The 2019 tax year, coincident with the elimination of the provincial education amount in British Columbia.
opts.w: 错误。2019 年是 BC 省取消省级教育额及 T2202 表格改革的年份，联邦教育额取消是在 2017 税年。

opts.t: The 2023 tax year, as part of the Budget 2023 changes that increased the RESP withdrawal threshold.
opts.w: 错误。Budget 2023 调整的是 RESP 的 EAP 提取上限（上调至 $8,000 与 $4,000），与教育额取消无关。

opts.t: The 2026 tax year, under the legislative package that introduced the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit.
opts.w: 错误。联邦教育额已被取消达九年之久，绝非 2026 年的新政。

checks.pt: 掌握学费转让上限扣除自用与国际生工卡号申请判定
checks.stem: An international university student arrived in British Columbia in late November 2026, staying 45 days during the tax year. The student retains a permanent residence abroad, has no dependants, and holds a valid study permit marked 'may accept employment.' Which tax filing classification and identifier apply to this student for 2026?
checks.zh: 一名国际留学生于 2026 年 11 月下旬抵达 BC 省，税年内在境内停留 45 天。该学生在境外保留永久住所，无受抚养人，持有注明“may accept employment”的有效学习许可。2026 年该学生适用哪种纳税人分类及报税证件号？

opts.t: Deemed resident under the 183-day rule; must obtain an Individual Tax Number (ITN) because international students cannot hold a SIN.
opts.w: 错误。境内停留仅 45 天远未达到 183 天推定居民门槛，且学习许可注明允许工作即可申请 SIN。

opts.t: Non-resident: no significant residential ties and under 183 days; may get a SIN because the permit allows work.
opts.w: 正确。该留学生未建立显著居住联系且停留远未满 183 天，属于非税务居民（non-resident for tax purposes），仅需就加拿大来源收入报税；同时因学习许可（study permit）注明允许工作，可凭此直接向加拿大服务部申领社会保险号（SIN）。

opts.t: Factual resident for tax purposes; strictly prohibited from filing a Canadian T1 return until holding Canadian permanent residency.
opts.w: 错误。留学生报税与是否持有枫叶卡无关，且缺乏显著居住联系不构成事实居民。

opts.t: Deemed non-resident; must pay a mandatory 25% flat withholding tax on all foreign study allowances and cannot claim tuition credits.
opts.w: 错误。境外资助或生活费不属于加拿大预提税征税范围，分类判断也存在错误。

checks.pt: 排查搬家费抵扣受限与代付贷款利息主体错报陷阱
checks.stem: A full-time graduate student incurring $3,000 in moving expenses to begin a degree program received a $12,000 post-secondary fellowship that qualifies for the full scholarship exemption. The student had no employment or research assistant income. Can the student deduct the moving expenses on line 21900?
checks.zh: 一名全日制研究生为就读学位课程发生了 $3,000 搬家费，税年内获得一笔 $12,000 符合全额免税条件的高校奖学金。该学生没有受雇或助研收入。该学生能否在 line 21900 扣除该笔搬家费用？

opts.t: Yes, because moving expenses incurred by full-time students can be applied against any scholarship received during the year.
opts.w: 错误。全日制免税奖学金不计入收入，不能作为搬家费扣除的资金基础。

opts.t: No; student moving costs are deductible only against taxable award or employment income, and an exempt scholarship gives none.
opts.w: 正确。搬家费（moving expenses, line 21900）对学生有一项硬性限制：只能从需要计入应税收入的奖励类收入（如应税研究资助）或工薪中抵扣。全额免税的奖学金不计入净收入，因此没有可供抵扣的基础。

opts.t: Yes, but the moving expense deduction must be transferred to the student's parents on Schedule 11.
opts.w: 错误。搬家费不能转让给父母，且附表 11 专用于计算学费抵免与培训抵免。

opts.t: No, because post-secondary student moving expenses are strictly limited to moves exceeding 100 kilometres rather than 40 kilometres.
opts.w: 错误。学生搬家费的法定距离门槛同样是 40 公里，而非 100 公里。

checks.pt: 理解老年额补偿与防套利立法动机及CRA与ESDC分工
checks.stem: Under Canadian tax policy, different statutory provisions select age 65 for fundamentally different legislative purposes.
