Leo asserts that the three-year normal reassessment period expired on June 1, 2025. Under ITA s.152(4)(b.2), what is the statutory reassessment window available to the CRA?
checks.zh: 2026 年，CRA 对 Leo 的 2021 税年个人税表进行复评审查（原始 NOA 发出日为 2022 年 6 月 1 日）。CRA 查明 Leo 当年未申报 T1135 境外资产申报表，且同时漏报了该境外资产产生的 $18,000 投资收益。Leo 坚称 3 年正常复评期已于 2025 年 6 月 1 日届满。根据 ITA s.152(4)(b.2)，CRA 享有的法定复评窗口期为多久？

opts.t: The CRA is statute-barred from reassessing Leo because the three-year normal reassessment period expired on June 1, 2025, and s.152(4)(b.2) applies only to corporate taxpayers.
opts.w: 错误。ITA s.152(4)(b.2) 同样适用于个人纳税人，并非仅针对公司。

opts.t: It is extended by three years, to six years in total (until June 1, 2028), because both T1135 and the related income were omitted.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.152(4)(b.2) 及讲义第 2.2 节表格，当纳税人“未申报 T1135 且同时未申报该境外财产产生的收入”（两项要件并存）时，复评期限在正常 3 年的基础上再延长 3 年（合计 6 年）。原始 NOA 发出日为 2022 年 6 月 1 日，因此 CRA 在 2028 年 6 月 1 日前均有权重新评税。

opts.t: The CRA is automatically granted an unlimited reassessment window whenever a foreign asset is held abroad, irrespective of whether income was produced.
opts.w: 错误。只有在存在欺诈或可归因于疏忽、粗心、故意隐瞒的失实陈述时才适用无限期复评；仅凭持有海外资产并不自动触发无限期规则。

opts.t: The reassessment window is restricted to four years from the filing date, identical to the statutory period governing non-CCPC corporations.
opts.w: 错误。非 CCPC 公司法定期限是 4 年，但本案是个人的 T1135 双重缺失，法定后果是延长 3 年至合计 6 年。

checks.pt: 异议逾九十天未获回应直诉税务法院
checks.stem: Clara served a formal Notice of Objection (Form T400A) on the CRA on September 1, 2025, disputing an adverse reassessment. As of January 15, 2026 (more than 90 days after serving the objection), the CRA Appeals Branch has not issued a decision, requested documents, or contacted Clara. Anxious about accruing arrears interest, Clara wants to advance her case. Under the Income Tax Act, what procedural right can Clara exercise at this juncture?
checks.zh: Clara 于 2025 年 9 月 1 日向 CRA 正式递交了异议通知书（Form T400A）以不服一份不利的重新评税。截至 2026 年 1 月 15 日（递交异议已超过 90 天），CRA 上诉处既未作出决定，也未向 Clara 索取材料或联络。因担心欠税利息不断累加，Clara 希望加快进程。根据《所得税法》，Clara 此时可行使何种程序权利？

opts.t: Clara must wait indefinitely because an appeal to the Tax Court of Canada can only be filed after the CRA issues a formal Notice of Confirmation or reassessment.
opts.w: 错误。法律并未强制要求必须等到 CRA 出具确认通知；逾期不答复赋予了纳税人跳级诉讼的权利。

opts.t: Clara may bypass further CRA administrative delay and appeal directly to the Tax Court of Canada because more than 90 days have elapsed without a CRA response.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.169 及讲义第 2.5 节与第三节第 6 节点，异议提出后若 CRA 在 90 天内未予答复，纳税人可以直接跳过行政等待，将争议直接上诉至加拿大税务法院（Tax Court of Canada），从而打破僵局并避免利息长期空转。

opts.t: Clara must submit an application on Form RC4288 to mandate that the Taxpayers' Ombudsperson dismiss the underlying tax reassessment.
opts.w: 错误。RC4288 是纳税人减免申请表，申诉专员公署（Taxpayers' Ombudsperson）只管服务问题，无权撤销或裁决税务争议。

opts.t: Clara's objection is automatically deemed allowed in full by operation of law once the statutory 90-day administrative window expires.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 超过 90 天未答复并不等于纳税人自动胜诉或异议被视同支持，只赋予纳税人向法院起诉的资格。

checks.pt: 卑诗省个人税与独立省税争议救济区别
checks.stem: Arthur, a resident of Vancouver, receives two separate tax assessments in 2026: (1) a federal Notice of Reassessment disallowing an eligible provincial tax credit claimed on his personal T1 return, and (2) a provincial assessment issued by British Columbia imposing the BC Speculation and Vacancy Tax on his residential condo. How should Arthur structure his legal disputes against these two distinct assessments?
checks.zh: 温哥华居民 Arthur 在 2026 年收到两份独立的评税通知：(1) 联邦重新评税通知（NOR），剔除了他在个人 T1 税表上申报的卑诗省税抵免额；(2) 卑诗省政府出具的省税评税单，对其自住公寓开征卑诗省投机与空置税（SVT）。Arthur 应如何针对这两笔不同的评税提起法律争议？

opts.t: Arthur must consolidate both disputes into a single federal Notice of Objection (Form T400A) submitted to the CRA because the CRA administers all provincial property and income taxes.
opts.w: 错误。CRA 仅代征代管卑诗省个人所得税，并不负责管理省级的投机与空置税等独立省税，不可合并在 T400A 异议中。

opts.t: The BC credit goes through the federal objection and Tax Court route; the SVT has its own separate provincial appeal process.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第四节，卑诗省个人所得税由 CRA 代征代管，其评税、异议与上诉整条链条与联邦完全共用（通过 T400A 向 CRA 提出，不服上诉至税务法院）；而卑诗省独立的省级税种（如投机与空置税、物业转让税）拥有自己独立的申诉通道，绝不能塞进所得税异议中处理。

opts.t: Arthur must file both disputes directly with the BC Ministry of Finance because provincial jurisdiction takes absolute constitutional precedence over personal taxes.
opts.w: 错误。T1 个人税表上的省税部分依法由联邦 CRA 上诉处和税务法院管辖，卑诗省财政厅不直接受理 T1 表个人所得税异议。

opts.t: Arthur must submit both assessments to the Taxpayers' Ombudsperson for an expedited binding ruling on constitutional tax duplication.
opts.w: 错误。纳税人申诉专员公署无权推翻或裁定任何税务评税结果，更无权审理宪法级重复征税争议。

checks.pt: 二五年自愿披露新规未被联系认定
checks.stem: In February 2026, Henry discovers that he omitted capital gains from foreign cryptocurrency investments on his returns from 2022 through 2024. In late 2025, Henry received a generic informational newsletter from the CRA educating taxpayers about cryptocurrency reporting requirements in general, with no reference to Henry's personal affairs or specific accounts. Under the Voluntary Disclosures Program (VDP) rules in effect since October 1, 2025, how is Henry's application classified and what relief is available?
checks.zh: 2026 年 2 月，Henry 发现自己在 2022 至 2024 税年的申报中漏报了境外加密货币交易的资本利得。2025 年底，Henry 曾收到过 CRA 发送的一封通用性质的普及宣传信，信中仅笼统介绍加密货币的申报要求，未提及 Henry 本人的具体账户或错漏。根据 2025 年 10 月 1 日起生效的自愿披露计划（VDP）新规，Henry 的披露申请属于哪一档并可获得何种减免？

opts.t: Henry is completely barred from VDP because the receipt of any written correspondence from the CRA automatically invalidates voluntary status.
opts.w: 错误。新规明确放宽了限制，一般普法提醒信不剥夺自愿披露资格，只有指出具体错漏或已展开稽查调查才丧失资格。

opts.t: It can be Unprompted, since a generic educational letter is not specific contact; if accepted, 75% interest and 100% penalty relief.
opts.w: 正确。2025-10-01 起的新规按 Unprompted／Prompted 分档：一般教育信不影响 Unprompted，指出具体错漏的通信才归 Prompted。Unprompted 档获受理的，利息减免 75%、罚款减免 100%；能否受理、减免是否成立，要等申请符合全部条件并被 CRA 接受后才确定。

opts.t: Henry's application falls under the Prompted category, which provides 100% interest cancellation and a maximum 50% penalty abatement.
opts.w: 错误。Prompted 档的减免幅度是利息减免 25%＋最多罚款减免 100%，且 Henry 收到的仅为通用教育信，应定性为 Unprompted 档。

opts.t: Henry must be assessed under the 2018 Limited Program criteria because digital asset transactions are excluded from the 2025 VDP update.
opts.w: 错误。自 2025 年 10 月 1 日起收到的披露申请全盘转入新规体系，不再沿用旧版 Limited / General 分类，数字资产并未被排除在外。

checks.pt: 正常复评期起算锚点非税年或申报日
checks.stem: Wendy, a resident of Burnaby, filed her 2023 personal tax return on October 15, 2024. The CRA processed the late-filed return and mailed Wendy's initial Notice of Assessment on December 1, 2024. In November 2027, the CRA issues a Notice of Reassessment disallowing certain business deductions. Wendy made honest disclosures without neglect or fraud and argues that the reassessment is invalid because more than three years have passed since the 2023 tax year concluded. Is the CRA's reassessment valid under ITA s.152(3.1)(b)?
checks.zh: 本拿比居民 Wendy 于 2024 年 10 月 15 日迟报了其 2023 税年个人税表。CRA 完成处理并于 2024 年 12 月 1 日发出了 Wendy 的原始评税通知（NOA）。2027 年 11 月，CRA 发出重新评税通知并剔除了部分自雇业务扣除。Wendy 如实申报、无疏忽或欺诈，她辩称自 2023 税年结束起已超过三年，故复评无效。根据 ITA s.152(3.1)(b)，CRA 的重新评税是否合法有效？

opts.t: The reassessment is invalid because the three-year normal reassessment period is calculated strictly from December 31, 2023, expiring on December 31, 2026.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的“按税年数三年”陷阱；税法规定正常复评期从原始 NOA 发出日开始起算，而非从税年结日算起。

opts.t: The reassessment is invalid because the limitation clock began on the actual transmission date of October 15, 2024, expiring on October 15, 2027.
opts.w: 错误。起算点是 CRA 原始 NOA 的寄发日期，而非纳税人的实际交表申报日期。

opts.t: Valid: the three years run from the original NOA date of December 1, 2024, so they end on December 1, 2027.
opts.w: 正确。根据 ITA s.152(3.1)(b) 及讲义第 6.1 节案例，个人正常复评期 3 年是从原始 NOA（或无需纳税通知）发出之日起算，既不看税年结束日，也不看实际报税日。原始 NOA 日期为 2024 年 12 月 1 日，3 年期满日为 2027 年 12 月 1 日；CRA 于 2027 年 11 月发出复评，完全在法定 3 年窗口期之内，合法有效。

opts.t: The reassessment is valid only because late-filed personal tax returns are automatically subject to an extended six-year reassessment window.
opts.w: 错误。迟交税表并不自动将个人的正常复评期变成 6 年；复评期仍为标准的 3 年，只是起算点顺延到了实际收到 NOA 的发信日。

checks.pt: 改表十年退税与减免十年利息起算区分
checks.stem: In 2026, an individual taxpayer consults a tax professional with two distinct requests: (1) submit a Change my return request for the 2015 tax year to retroactively claim a medical expense deduction and receive a tax refund, and (2) submit an application on Form RC4288 for Taxpayer Relief seeking cancellation of arrears interest that accumulated during 2017 on an unpaid 2011 tax assessment. How do the statutory 10-year limitation rules apply to these two requests?
checks.zh: 2026 年，一位个人纳税人向税务专业人士咨询两项诉求：(1) 通过 Change my return 对 2015 税年提出调整，追溯申领一笔医疗费用扣除以获取退税；(2) 依据 Form RC4288 申请纳税人减免，请求减免 2017 日历年期间因 2011 税年未缴税款而累积的滞纳利息。根据法定 10 年时效规则，应如何处理这两项请求？

opts.t: Both requests are statutorily barred because neither request relates to a tax year ending within the immediately preceding three calendar years.
opts.w: 错误。3 年是正常复评期，改表退税与纳税人减免均适用更宽的 10 年公平条款机制，并非 3 年。

opts.t: Both requests are fully eligible because the 10-year period is measured from the date when the taxpayer first registered for CRA My Account access.
opts.w: 错误。法定 10 年限制与 My Account 注册时间毫无关联，属于虚构标准。

opts.t: The 2015 refund is barred as that tax year is over 10 years back, but the 2017 interest accrued within the 10-year window.
opts.w: 正确。根据讲义第 2.4、2.7 节及第七节错报清单第 4 项，两个“10 年”锚点完全不同：改表退税（s.152(4.2)）锚在“税年”，2026 年受理的退税只能覆盖 2016 及以后税年，2015 税年已超期不可退；而纳税人减免（RC4288）中利息的 10 年锚在“累积的日历年份”，2026 年申请可审查 2016 年 1 月 1 日及以后累积的利息，即便原始税债源自 2011 年，2017 年产生的利息仍在受理窗口内。

opts.t: The 2015 adjustment can result in a refund, but the 2017 interest is strictly excluded because taxpayer relief never applies to debts originating over a decade ago.
opts.w: 错误。这完全搞反了规则：改表退税受税年 10 年硬顶限制无法退税，而利息减免看的是利息发生的年份，不受欠税所属税年限制。
